```
    91→    # Resolve subjective visibility policy for gating
    92→    policy = resolved_options.policy or compute_subjective_visibility(
    93→        state,
    94→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
    95→        plan=resolved_options.plan,
    96→    )
    97→
    98→    if (
    99→        resolved_options.include_subjective
   100→        and status in {"open", "all"}
   101→        and not resolved_options.chronic
   102→    ):
   103→        subjective_items = build_subjective_items(
   104→            state,
   105→            state.get("findings", {}),
   106→            threshold=subjective_threshold_value,
   107→        )
   108→        # When a plan explicitly includes a subjective item in queue_order,
   109→        # surface it regardless of policy — the plan is authoritative.
   110→        plan_queue_set: set[str] = (
   111→            set(resolved_options.plan.get("queue_order", []))
   112→            if resolved_options.plan
   113→            else set()
   114→        )
   115→        for item in subjective_items:
   116→            if not scope_matches(item, resolved_options.scope):
   117→                continue
   118→            # Non-initial subjective items only surface when objective
   119→            # backlog is drained — unless the plan explicitly queued them
   120→            # (e.g. stale dims injected after a completed cycle).
   121→            item_id = item.get("id", "")
   122→            if not policy.should_surface(item) and item_id not in plan_queue_set:
   123→                continue
   124→            all_items.append(item)
   125→
   126→    # Inject triage stage items and workflow items when plan requires it
   127→    if resolved_options.plan and status in {"open", "all"}:
   128→        synth_items = build_triage_stage_items(resolved_options.plan, state)
   129→        all_items.extend(synth_items)
   130→        checkpoint_item = build_score_checkpoint_item(resolved_options.plan, state)
   131→        if checkpoint_item is not None:
   132→            all_items.append(checkpoint_item)
   133→        plan_item = build_create_plan_item(resolved_options.plan)
   134→        if plan_item is not None:
   135→            all_items.append(plan_item)
   136→
   137→    enrich_with_impact(all_items, state.get("dimension_scores", {}))
   138→
   139→    # Impact floor: drop mechanical findings with negligible score impact
   140→    MIN_STANDALONE_IMPACT = 0.05
   141→    all_items = [
   142→        item for item in all_items
   143→        if item.get("kind") != "finding"
   144→        or item.get("is_review")
   145→        or item.get("is_subjective")
   146→        or not item.get("estimated_impact")

   160→            cluster=resolved_options.cluster,
   161→            new_ids=new_ids,
   162→        )

   164→    # Collapse auto-clusters into meta-items (unless drilling into a cluster)

   168→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   169→        and not resolved_options.plan.get("active_cluster")

   177→    if not all_items and resolved_options.plan:
```

```
    23→def enrich_with_impact(items: list[dict], dimension_scores: dict) -> None:
    24→    """Stamp ``estimated_impact`` on each item based on dimension-level headroom.
    25→
    26→    Impact = ``overall_per_point * headroom`` where headroom = ``100 - score``.
    27→    Items in dimensions with more score headroom sort first.
    28→    """
    29→    if not dimension_scores:
    30→        for item in items:
    31→            item["estimated_impact"] = 0.0
    32→        return
    33→
    34→    from desloppify.engine._scoring.results.health import compute_health_breakdown
    35→    from desloppify.engine._scoring.results.impact import get_dimension_for_detector
    36→
    37→    breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dimension_scores)
    38→    entries = breakdown.get("entries", [])
    39→
    40→    # Build lookup: normalized dimension name -> {per_point, headroom}
    41→    dim_impact: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
    42→    for entry in entries:
    43→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
    44→        if not name:
    45→            continue
    46→        per_point = float(entry.get("overall_per_point", 0.0))
    47→        score = float(entry.get("score", 0.0))
    48→        headroom = 100.0 - score
    49→        dim_impact[name.lower()] = {"per_point": per_point, "headroom": headroom}
    50→
    51→    for item in items:
    52→        impact = _compute_item_impact(item, dim_impact, get_dimension_for_detector)
    53→        item["estimated_impact"] = impact
    54→
    55→
    56→def _compute_item_impact(
    57→    item: dict,
    58→    dim_impact: dict[str, dict[str, float]],
    59→    get_dimension_for_detector,
    60→) -> float:
    61→    """Compute impact value for a single queue item."""
    62→    kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
    63→
    64→    # Subjective items (synthetic dimensions or subjective findings):
    65→    # look up by detail.dimension_name
    66→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
    67→        dim_name = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
    68→        entry = dim_impact.get(dim_name.lower())
    69→        if entry:
    70→            return entry["per_point"] * entry["headroom"]
    71→        return 0.0
    72→
    73→    # Mechanical findings: use detector -> dimension mapping
    74→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    75→    if detector:
    76→        dimension = get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
    77→        if dimension:
    78→            entry = dim_impact.get(dimension.name.lower())
    79→            if entry:
    80→                return entry["per_point"] * entry["headroom"]
    81→
    82→    return 0.0
    83→
    84→
    85→def subjective_score_value(item: dict) -> float:
    86→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
    87→        detail = detail_dict(item)
    88→        return float(detail.get("strict_score", item.get("subjective_score", 100.0)))
    89→    return float(item.get("subjective_score", 100.0))
    90→
    91→
    92→def build_finding_items(
    93→    state: dict,
    94→    *,
    95→    scan_path: str | None,
    96→    status_filter: str,
    97→    scope: str | None,
    98→    chronic: bool,
    99→) -> list[dict]:
   100→    scoped = path_scoped_findings(state.get("findings", {}), scan_path)
   101→    subjective_scores = subjective_strict_scores(state)
   102→    out: list[dict] = []
   103→
   104→    for finding_id, finding in scoped.items():
   105→        if finding.get("suppressed"):
   106→            continue
   107→        if not status_matches(finding.get("status", "open"), status_filter):
   108→            continue
   109→        if chronic and not (
   110→            finding.get("status") == "open" and finding.get("reopen_count", 0) >= 2
   111→        ):
   112→            continue
   113→
   114→        # Evidence-only: skip findings below standalone confidence threshold
   115→        detector = finding.get("detector", "")
   116→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   117→        if meta and meta.standalone_threshold:
   118→            threshold_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(meta.standalone_threshold, 9)
   119→            finding_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(finding.get("confidence", "low"), 9)
   120→            if finding_rank > threshold_rank:
   121→                continue
   122→
   123→        item = dict(finding)
   124→        item["id"] = finding_id
   125→        item["kind"] = "finding"
   126→        item["is_review"] = is_review_finding(item)
   127→        item["is_subjective"] = is_subjective_finding(item)
   128→        item["review_weight"] = (
   129→            review_finding_weight(item) if item["is_review"] else None
   130→        )
   131→        subjective_score = None
   132→        if item["is_subjective"]:
   133→            detail = detail_dict(finding)
   134→            dim_name = detail.get("dimension_name", "")
   135→            dim_key = detail.get("dimension", "") or slugify(dim_name)
   136→            subjective_score = subjective_scores.get(
   137→                dim_key, subjective_scores.get(dim_name.lower(), 100.0)
   138→            )
   139→        item["subjective_score"] = subjective_score
   140→        supported_fixers = supported_fixers_for_item(state, item)
   141→        item["primary_command"] = primary_command_for_finding(
   142→            item,
   143→            supported_fixers=supported_fixers,
   144→        )
   145→
   146→        if not scope_matches(item, scope):
   147→            continue
   148→        out.append(item)
   149→
   150→    return out

   153→def item_sort_key(item: dict) -> tuple:
   154→    kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   155→
   156→    # Initial-review subjective items: highest priority (tier -3)
   157→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" and item.get("initial_review"):
   158→        return (-3, 0, subjective_score_value(item), item.get("id", ""))
   159→
   160→    # Triage stage items: tier -2, stage order, blocked after unblocked
   161→    if kind == "workflow_stage":
   162→        blocked_penalty = 1 if item.get("is_blocked") else 0
   163→        stage_index = int(item.get("stage_index", 0))
   164→        return (-2, blocked_penalty, stage_index, item.get("id", ""))
   165→
   166→    # Workflow action items (e.g. create-plan): tier -1
   167→    if kind == "workflow_action":
   168→        return (-1, 0, 0, item.get("id", ""))
   169→
   170→    if kind == "cluster":
   171→        # Clusters sort before individual findings, ordered by action type
   172→        action_pri = ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY.get(
   173→            item.get("action_type", "manual_fix"), 3
   174→        )
   175→        return (
   176→            0,
   177→            action_pri,
   178→            -int(item.get("member_count", 0)),
   179→            item.get("id", ""),
   180→        )
   181→
   182→    impact = item.get("estimated_impact", 0.0)
   183→
   184→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
   185→        return (
   186→            1,
   187→            -impact,
   188→            subjective_score_value(item),
   189→            item.get("id", ""),
   190→        )
   191→
   192→    detail = detail_dict(item)
   193→    review_weight = float(item.get("review_weight", 0.0) or 0.0)
   194→    return (
   195→        1,
   196→        -impact,
   197→        CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(item.get("confidence", "low"), 9),
   198→        -review_weight,
   199→        -int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0),
   200→        item.get("id", ""),
   201→    )
   202→
   203→

   284→def group_queue_items(items: list[dict], group: str) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:

   290→        elif group == "detector":

   292→        elif group == "cluster":

   294→            key = plan_cluster["name"] if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict) else "(unclustered)"
   295→        else:
   296→            key = "items"
   297→        grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(item)
   298→    return grouped
```

```
1→"""Helper utilities for work queue item construction."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import re
     6→from fnmatch import fnmatch
     7→
     8→from desloppify.core.enums import finding_status_tokens
     9→from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
    10→from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
    11→    all_subjective_entries,
    12→)
    13→from desloppify.intelligence.integrity import (
    14→    is_holistic_subjective_finding,
    15→    unassessed_subjective_dimensions,
    16→)
    17→from desloppify.scoring import DISPLAY_NAMES
    18→
    19→ALL_STATUSES = set(finding_status_tokens(include_all=True))
    20→ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY = {"auto_fix": 0, "refactor": 1, "manual_fix": 2, "reorganize": 3}
    21→ATTEST_EXAMPLE = (
    22→    "I have actually [DESCRIBE THE CONCRETE CHANGE YOU MADE] "
    23→    "and I am not gaming the score by resolving without fixing."
    24→)
    25→
    26→
    27→def detail_dict(item: dict) -> dict:
    28→    """Return finding detail as a dict; tolerate legacy/non-dict payloads."""
    29→    detail = item.get("detail")
    30→    return detail if isinstance(detail, dict) else {}
    31→
    32→
    33→def status_matches(item_status: str, status_filter: str) -> bool:
    34→    return status_filter == "all" or item_status == status_filter
    35→
    36→
    37→def is_subjective_finding(item: dict) -> bool:
    38→    detector = item.get("detector")
    39→    if detector in {"subjective_assessment"}:
    40→        return True
    41→    if detector == "holistic_review":
    42→        return True
    43→    return False
    44→
    45→
    46→def is_review_finding(item: dict) -> bool:
    47→    return item.get("detector") == "review"
    48→
    49→
    50→def is_subjective_queue_item(item: dict) -> bool:
    51→    """True for subjective work items, including collapsed subjective clusters."""
    52→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
    53→        return True
    54→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
    55→        members = item.get("members", [])
    56→        return bool(members) and all(
    57→            m.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension" for m in members
    58→        )
    59→    return False
    60→
    61→
    62→def review_finding_weight(item: dict) -> float:
    63→    """Return review issue weight aligned with issues list ordering."""
    64→    confidence = str(item.get("confidence", "low")).lower()
    65→    weight_by_confidence = {
    66→        "high": 1.0,
    67→        "medium": 0.7,
    68→        "low": 0.3,
    69→    }
    70→    weight = weight_by_confidence.get(confidence, 0.3)
    71→    if detail_dict(item).get("holistic"):
    72→        weight *= 10.0
    73→    return float(weight)
    74→
    75→
    76→def scope_matches(item: dict, scope: str | None) -> bool:
    77→    """Apply show-style pattern matching against a queue item."""
    78→    if not scope:
    79→        return True
    80→
    81→    item_id = item.get("id", "")
    82→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    83→    filepath = item.get("file", "")
    84→    summary = item.get("summary", "")
    85→    dimension = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
    86→    kind = item.get("kind", "")
    87→
    88→    if "*" in scope:
    89→        return any(
    90→            fnmatch(candidate, scope)
    91→            for candidate in (item_id, filepath, detector, dimension, summary)
    92→        )
    93→
    94→    if "::" in scope:
    95→        return item_id.startswith(scope)
    96→
    97→    lowered = scope.lower()
    98→    if kind == "subjective_dimension":
    99→        return (
   100→            lowered in item_id.lower()
   101→            or lowered in dimension.lower()
   102→            or lowered in summary.lower()
   103→        )
   104→
   105→    # Hash suffix: 8+ hex chars matches the tail segment of a finding ID.
   106→    if len(lowered) >= 8 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]+", lowered):
   107→        return item_id.lower().endswith("::" + lowered)
   108→
   109→    return (
   110→        detector == scope
   111→        or filepath == scope
   112→        or filepath.startswith(scope.rstrip("/") + "/")
   113→    )
   114→
   115→
   116→def slugify(text: str) -> str:
   117→    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", text.lower()).strip("_")
   118→
   119→
   120→def _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(display_name: str) -> str:
   121→    """Map a display label (e.g. 'Mid elegance') to its canonical dimension key."""
   122→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   123→    target = cleaned.lower()
   124→
   125→    for dim_key, label in DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
   126→        if str(label).lower() == target:
   127→            return str(dim_key)
   128→    return slugify(cleaned)
   129→
   130→
   131→def _subjective_dimension_aliases(display_name: str) -> set[str]:
   132→    """Return normalized aliases used to match display labels with finding dimension keys."""
   133→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   134→    canonical = _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(cleaned)
   135→    return {
   136→        cleaned.lower(),
   137→        cleaned.replace(" ", "_").lower(),
   138→        slugify(cleaned),
   139→        canonical.lower(),
   140→        slugify(canonical),
   141→    }
   142→
   143→
   144→def supported_fixers_for_item(state: dict, item: dict) -> set[str] | None:
   145→    """Return supported fixers for an item's language when known."""
   146→    lang = str(item.get("lang", "") or "").strip()
   147→    if not lang:
   148→        return None
   149→
   150→    caps = state.get("lang_capabilities", {})
   151→    if not isinstance(caps, dict):
   152→        return None
   153→
   154→    lang_caps = caps.get(lang, {})
   155→    if not isinstance(lang_caps, dict):
   156→        return None
   157→
   158→    fixers = lang_caps.get("fixers")
   159→    if not isinstance(fixers, list):
   160→        return None
   161→    return {fixer for fixer in fixers if isinstance(fixer, str)}
   162→
   163→
   164→def primary_command_for_finding(
   165→    item: dict, *, supported_fixers: set[str] | None = None
   166→) -> str:
   167→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   168→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   169→    if meta and meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and meta.fixers:
   170→        available_fixers = [
   171→            fixer
   172→            for fixer in meta.fixers
   173→            if supported_fixers is not None and fixer in supported_fixers
   174→        ]
   175→        if available_fixers:
   176→            return f"desloppify autofix {available_fixers[0]} --dry-run"
   177→    if detector == "subjective_review":
   178→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   179→            return "desloppify review --prepare"
   180→        return "desloppify show subjective"
   181→    return f'desloppify plan done "{item.get("id", "")}" --note "<what you did>" --confirm'
   182→
   183→
   184→def build_triage_stage_items(plan: dict, state: dict) -> list[dict]:
   185→    """Build synthetic work items for each ``triage::*`` stage ID in the queue.
   186→
   187→    Returns an empty list when no triage stages are pending.
   188→    """
   189→    from desloppify.app.commands.plan.triage_playbook import (
   190→        TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES,
   191→        TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS,
   192→    )
   193→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
   194→        TRIAGE_IDS,
   195→        TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS,
   196→    )
   197→
   198→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   199→    order_set = set(order)
   200→    present = order_set & TRIAGE_IDS
   201→    if not present:
   202→        return []
   203→
   204→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   205→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   206→
   207→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   208→    open_review_count = sum(
   209→        1 for f in findings.values()
   210→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   211→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   212→    )
   213→
   214→    label_map = dict(TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS)
   215→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   216→
   217→    items: list[dict] = []
   218→    for idx, (sid, name) in enumerate(zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names)):
   219→        if sid not in present:
   220→            continue
   221→        if name in confirmed:
   222→            continue
   223→
   224→        # Compute blocked_by: dependency stages that are still in the queue
   225→        deps = TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())
   226→        blocked_by = sorted(
   227→            f"triage::{dep}" for dep in deps
   228→            if f"triage::{dep}" in present and dep not in confirmed
   229→        )
   230→
   231→        cmd = f"desloppify plan triage --stage {name}"
   232→        if name == "commit":
   233→            cmd = 'desloppify plan triage --complete --strategy "..."'
   234→
   235→        items.append({
   236→            "id": sid,
   237→            "tier": 1,
   238→            "confidence": "high",
   239→            "detector": "triage",
   240→            "file": ".",
   241→            "kind": "workflow_stage",
   242→            "stage_name": name,
   243→            "stage_index": idx,
   244→            "summary": f"Triage: {label_map.get(name, name)}",
   245→            "detail": {
   246→                "total_review_findings": open_review_count,
   247→                "stage": name,
   248→                "stage_label": label_map.get(name, name),
   249→            },
   250→            "primary_command": cmd,
   251→            "blocked_by": blocked_by,
   252→            "is_blocked": bool(blocked_by),
   253→        })
   254→    return items
   255→
   256→
   257→def build_score_checkpoint_item(plan: dict, state: dict) -> dict | None:
   258→    """Build a synthetic work item for ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` if it's in the queue.
   259→
   260→    Returns ``None`` when the item is not pending.
   261→    """
   262→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID
   263→
   264→    if WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID not in plan.get("queue_order", []):
   265→        return None
   266→
   267→    from desloppify import state as state_mod
   268→
   269→    snapshot = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   270→    strict = snapshot.strict if snapshot.strict is not None else 0.0
   271→    plan_start = (plan.get("plan_start_scores") or {}).get("strict")
   272→    delta = round(strict - plan_start, 1) if plan_start is not None else None
   273→    delta_str = f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})" if delta else ""
   274→
   275→    return {
   276→        "id": WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID,
   277→        "tier": 1,
   278→        "confidence": "high",
   279→        "detector": "workflow",
   280→        "file": ".",
   281→        "kind": "workflow_action",
   282→        "summary": f"Score checkpoint: strict {strict:.1f}/100{delta_str}",
   283→        "detail": {
   284→            "strict": strict,
   285→            "plan_start_strict": plan_start,
   286→            "delta": delta,
   287→        },
   288→        "primary_command": f'desloppify plan done "{WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID}" --note "Reviewed score checkpoint" --confirm',
   289→        "blocked_by": [],
   290→        "is_blocked": False,
   291→    }

   319→def subjective_strict_scores(state: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
   320→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   321→    if not dim_scores:
   322→        return {}
   323→
   324→    entries = all_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   325→    scores: dict[str, float] = {}
   326→    for entry in entries:
   327→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   328→        if not name:
   329→            continue
   330→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   331→        [REDACTED](name)
   332→        aliases = _subjective_dimension_aliases(name)
   333→        for cli_key in entry.get("cli_keys", []):
   334→            key = str(cli_key).strip().lower()
   335→            if not key:
   336→                continue
   337→            aliases.add(key)
   338→            aliases.add(slugify(key))
   339→        aliases.add(dim_key.lower())
   340→        aliases.add(slugify(dim_key))
   341→        for alias in aliases:
   342→            scores[alias] = strict_val
   343→    return scores
   344→
   345→
   346→def build_subjective_items(
   347→    state: dict, findings: dict, *, threshold: float = 100.0
   348→) -> list[dict]:
   349→    """Create synthetic subjective work items."""
   350→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   351→    if not dim_scores:
   352→        return []
   353→    threshold = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(threshold)))
   354→
   355→    subjective_entries = all_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   356→    if not subjective_entries:
   357→        return []
   358→    unassessed_dims = {
   359→        str(name).strip()
   360→        for name in unassessed_subjective_dimensions(
   361→            dim_scores
   362→        )
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    # Review findings are keyed by raw dimension name (snake_case).
   366→    review_open_by_dim: dict[str, int] = {}
   367→    for finding in findings.values():
   368→        if finding.get("status") != "open" or finding.get("detector") != "review":
   369→            continue
   370→        dim_key = str(detail_dict(finding).get("dimension", "")).strip().lower()
   371→        if not dim_key:
   372→            continue
   373→        review_open_by_dim[dim_key] = review_open_by_dim.get(dim_key, 0) + 1
   374→
   375→    items: list[dict] = []
   376→    def _prepare_command(
   377→        cli_keys: list[str],
   378→        *,
   379→        force_review_rerun: bool = False,
   380→    ) -> str:
   381→        command = "desloppify review --prepare"
   382→        if cli_keys:
   383→            command += " --dimensions " + ",".join(cli_keys)
   384→        if force_review_rerun:
   385→            command += " --force-review-rerun"
   386→        return command
   387→
   388→    for entry in subjective_entries:
   389→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   390→        if not name:
   391→            continue
   392→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   393→        if strict_val >= threshold:
   394→            continue
   395→
   396→        [REDACTED](name)
   397→        aliases = set(_subjective_dimension_aliases(name))
   398→        cli_keys = [
   399→            str(key).strip().lower()
   400→            for key in entry.get("cli_keys", [])
   401→            if str(key).strip()
   402→        ]
   403→        aliases.update(cli_keys)
   404→        aliases.update(slugify(key) for key in cli_keys)
   405→        open_review = sum(review_open_by_dim.get(alias, 0) for alias in aliases)
   406→        is_unassessed = bool(entry.get("placeholder")) or (
   407→            name in unassessed_dims
   408→            or (strict_val <= 0.0 and int(entry.get("issues", 0)) == 0)
   409→        )
   410→        is_stale = bool(entry.get("stale"))
   411→        # If review findings already exist for this dimension, triage/fix them
   412→        # before suggesting another review refresh pass.
   413→        if open_review > 0:
   414→            primary_command = "desloppify show review --status open"
   415→        else:
   416→            primary_command = _prepare_command(cli_keys)
   417→        stale_tag = " [stale — re-review]" if is_stale else ""
   418→        summary = f"Subjective dimension below target: {name} ({strict_val:.1f}%){stale_tag}"
   419→        items.append(
   420→            {
   421→                "id": f"subjective::{slugify(dim_key)}",
   422→                "detector": "subjective_assessment",
   423→                "file": ".",
   424→                "confidence": "medium",
   425→                "summary": summary,
   426→                "detail": {
   427→                    "dimension_name": name,
   428→                    "dimension": dim_key,
   429→                    "issues": int(entry.get("issues", 0)),
   430→                    "strict_score": strict_val,
   431→                    "open_review_findings": open_review,
   432→                    "cli_keys": cli_keys,
   433→                },
   434→                "status": "open",
   435→                "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   436→                "primary_command": primary_command,
   437→                "initial_review": is_unassessed,
   438→                "stale_review": is_stale and not is_unassessed,
   439→            }
   440→        )
   441→    return items
   442→
```

```
1→"""Scan preflight guard: warn and gate scan when queue has unfinished items."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import logging
     6→
     7→from desloppify import state as state_mod
     8→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import plan_aware_queue_count
     9→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.state import state_path
    10→from desloppify.core.exception_sets import PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS, CommandError
    11→from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize
    12→from desloppify.engine.plan import load_plan, save_plan
    13→
    14→
    15→def scan_queue_preflight(args) -> None:
    16→    """Warn and gate scan when queue has unfinished items."""
    17→    # CI profile always passes
    18→    if getattr(args, "profile", None) == "ci":
    19→        return
    20→
    21→    # --force-rescan with valid attestation bypasses
    22→    if getattr(args, "force_rescan", False):
    23→        attest = getattr(args, "attest", None) or ""
    24→        if "i understand" not in attest.lower():
    25→            raise CommandError(
    26→                '--force-rescan requires --attest "I understand this is not '
    27→                "the intended workflow and I am intentionally skipping queue "
    28→                'completion"'
    29→            )
    30→        print(
    31→            colorize(
    32→                "  --force-rescan: bypassing queue completion check. "
    33→                "Plan-start score will be reset.",
    34→                "yellow",
    35→            )
    36→        )
    37→        # Clear plan_start_scores
    38→        try:
    39→            plan = load_plan()
    40→            if plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
    41→                plan["plan_start_scores"] = {}
    42→                save_plan(plan)
    43→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
    44→            logging.debug("Plan score cleanup skipped: %s", exc)
    45→        return
    46→
    47→    # No plan = no gate (first scan, or user never uses plan)
    48→    try:
    49→        plan = load_plan()
    50→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
    51→        return
    52→    if not plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
    53→        return  # No active cycle
    54→
    55→    # Count plan-aware remaining items
    56→    try:
    57→        state = state_mod.load_state(state_path(args))
    58→        remaining = plan_aware_queue_count(state, plan)
    59→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
    60→        return
    61→    if remaining == 0:
    62→        return  # Queue clear, scan allowed
    63→
    64→    # GATE
    65→    raise CommandError(
    66→        f"{remaining} item{'s' if remaining != 1 else ''}"
    67→        " remaining in your queue.\n"
    68→        "  The intended workflow is to complete the queue before scanning.\n"
    69→        "  Work through items with `desloppify next`, then scan when clear.\n\n"
    70→        "  To force a rescan (resets your plan-start score):\n"
    71→        '    desloppify scan --force-rescan --attest "I understand this is not '
    72→        "the intended workflow and I am intentionally skipping queue "
    73→        'completion"'
    74→    )
    75→
    76→
    77→__all__ = ["scan_queue_preflight"]
    78→
```

```
1→"""Plan-aware queue progress and frozen score display helpers."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass
     6→
     7→from desloppify.core.exception_sets import PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS
     8→from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize
     9→from desloppify.engine.work_queue import is_subjective_queue_item
    10→
    11→
    12→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    13→# QueueBreakdown — single source of truth for queue numbers
    14→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    15→
    16→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    17→class QueueBreakdown:
    18→    """All numbers needed to render the standardized queue display."""
    19→
    20→    queue_total: int = 0
    21→    plan_ordered: int = 0
    22→    skipped: int = 0
    23→    subjective: int = 0
    24→    workflow: int = 0
    25→    focus_cluster: str | None = None
    26→    focus_cluster_count: int = 0
    27→    focus_cluster_total: int = 0
    28→
    29→
    30→def plan_aware_queue_breakdown(
    31→    state: dict,
    32→    plan: dict | None = None,
    33→) -> QueueBreakdown:
    34→    """Build a full :class:`QueueBreakdown` from a single ``build_work_queue`` call."""
    35→    from desloppify.engine.work_queue import QueueBuildOptions, build_work_queue
    36→
    37→    result = build_work_queue(
    38→        state,
    39→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
    40→            status="open",
    41→            count=None,
    42→            plan=plan,
    43→            collapse_clusters=True,
    44→            include_skipped=False,
    45→            scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),
    46→        ),
    47→    )
    48→
    49→    queue_total = result["total"]
    50→
    51→    # Count subjective and workflow items in the queue.
    52→    # Collapsed clusters whose members are all subjective count as subjective.
    53→    items = result.get("items", [])
    54→    subjective = sum(
    55→        1 for item in items
    56→        if is_subjective_queue_item(item)
    57→    )
    58→    workflow = sum(
    59→        1 for item in items
    60→        if item.get("kind") in ("workflow_stage", "workflow_action")
    61→    )
    62→
    63→    # Plan-derived counts
    64→    plan_ordered = 0
    65→    skipped = 0
    66→    if plan:
    67→        skipped = len(plan.get("skipped", {}))
    68→        # plan_ordered = items that are in queue_order minus skipped
    69→        queue_order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    70→        skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    71→        plan_ordered = sum(1 for fid in queue_order if fid not in skipped_ids)
    72→
    73→    # Focus cluster info
    74→    focus_cluster = None
    75→    focus_cluster_count = 0
    76→    focus_cluster_total = 0
    77→    if plan:
    78→        active = plan.get("active_cluster")
    79→        if active:
    80→            focus_cluster = active
    81→            cluster_data = plan.get("clusters", {}).get(active, {})
    82→            focus_cluster_total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
    83→            # Count how many cluster members are still in the queue
    84→            cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
    85→            open_findings = {
    86→                fid
    87→                for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
    88→                if f.get("status") == "open"
    89→            }
    90→            focus_cluster_count = len(cluster_member_ids & open_findings)
    91→
    92→    return QueueBreakdown(
    93→        queue_total=queue_total,
    94→        plan_ordered=plan_ordered,
    95→        skipped=skipped,
    96→        subjective=subjective,
    97→        workflow=workflow,
    98→        focus_cluster=focus_cluster,
    99→        focus_cluster_count=focus_cluster_count,
   100→        focus_cluster_total=focus_cluster_total,
   101→    )
   102→
   103→
   104→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   105→# Formatting helpers — single source of truth for queue display
   106→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   107→
   108→def format_queue_headline(breakdown: QueueBreakdown) -> str:
   109→    """The one-line Queue summary. Same format everywhere.
   110→
   111→    Examples::
   112→
   113→        Queue: 1934 items (292 planned · 23 skipped)
   114→        Queue: 1934 items
   115→    """
   116→    n = breakdown.queue_total
   117→    label = f"Queue: {n} item{'s' if n != 1 else ''}"
   118→
   119→    # Parenthesized segments
   120→    segments: list[str] = []
   121→    if breakdown.workflow > 0:
   122→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.workflow} planning step{'s' if breakdown.workflow != 1 else ''}")
   123→    if breakdown.plan_ordered > 0:
   124→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.plan_ordered} planned")
   125→    if breakdown.skipped > 0:
   126→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.skipped} skipped")
   127→    if breakdown.subjective > 0:
   128→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.subjective} subjective")
   129→    if segments:
   130→        sep = " \u00b7 "
   131→        detail = sep.join(segments)
   132→        return f"{label} ({detail})"
   133→    return label
   134→
   135→
   136→def format_queue_block(
   137→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown,
   138→    *,
   139→    frozen_score: float | None = None,
   140→) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
   141→    """Full queue block: focus banner + queue line + contextual hints.
   142→
   143→    Returns a list of ``(text, style)`` pairs ready for ``colorize()``.
   144→    """
   145→    lines: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
   146→
   147→    # Focus banner (prominent, separate)
   148→    if breakdown.focus_cluster:
   149→        focus_line = (
   150→            f"  Focus: `{breakdown.focus_cluster}` "
   151→            f"\u2014 {breakdown.focus_cluster_count}/{breakdown.focus_cluster_total}"
   152→            f" items remaining"
   153→        )
   154→        lines.append((focus_line, "cyan"))
   155→
   156→    # Frozen score line
   157→    if frozen_score is not None:
   158→        lines.append((
   159→            f"  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {frozen_score:.1f}/100",
   160→            "cyan",
   161→        ))
   162→
   163→    # Queue headline — always the same
   164→    lines.append((f"  {format_queue_headline(breakdown)}", "bold"))
   165→
   166→    # Contextual hints (dim)
   167→    if breakdown.focus_cluster:
   168→        lines.append((
   169→            f"  Unfocus: `desloppify plan focus --clear`"
   170→            f" \u00b7 Cluster details: `desloppify next --cluster {breakdown.focus_cluster} --count 10`",
   171→            "dim",
   172→        ))
   173→    elif breakdown.plan_ordered > 0 or breakdown.skipped > 0:
   174→        lines.append((
   175→            "  Details: `desloppify plan queue`"
   176→            " \u00b7 Skip: `desloppify plan skip <id>`",
   177→            "dim",
   178→        ))
   179→    else:
   180→        lines.append((
   181→            "  Start planning: `desloppify plan`",
   182→            "dim",
   183→        ))
   184→
   185→    return lines
   186→
   187→
   188→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   189→# Legacy / backward-compatible helpers
   190→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   191→
   192→def plan_aware_queue_count(state: dict, plan: dict | None = None) -> int:
   193→    """Count remaining plan-aware queue items (skips excluded, clusters collapsed)."""
   194→    from desloppify.engine.work_queue import QueueBuildOptions, build_work_queue
   195→
   196→    result = build_work_queue(
   197→        state,
   198→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   199→            status="open",
   200→            count=None,
   201→            plan=plan,
   202→            collapse_clusters=True,
   203→            include_skipped=False,
   204→            scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),
   205→        ),
   206→    )
   207→    return result["total"]
   208→
   209→
   210→def get_plan_start_strict(plan: dict | None) -> float | None:
   211→    """Extract the frozen plan-start strict score, or None if unset."""
   212→    if not plan:
   213→        return None
   214→    return plan.get("plan_start_scores", {}).get("strict")
   215→
   216→
   217→def print_frozen_score_with_queue_context(
   218→    plan: dict,
   219→    queue_remaining: int,
   220→    *,
   221→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown | None = None,
   222→) -> None:
   223→    """Show frozen plan-start score + queue progress.
   224→
   225→    When *breakdown* is provided, uses the standardized queue block.
   226→    Otherwise falls back to the legacy two-line format.
   227→    """
   228→    scores = plan.get("plan_start_scores", {})
   229→    strict = scores.get("strict")
   230→    if strict is None:
   231→        return
   232→
   233→    if breakdown is not None:
   234→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=strict)
   235→        print()
   236→        for text, style in block:
   237→            print(colorize(text, style))
   238→        if queue_remaining > 0:
   239→            print(colorize(
   240→                "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   241→                "dim",
   242→            ))
   243→        return
   244→
   245→    # Legacy fallback
   246→    print(
   247→        colorize(
   248→            f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {strict:.1f}/100",
   249→            "cyan",
   250→        )
   251→    )
   252→    print(
   253→        colorize(
   254→            f"  Queue: {queue_remaining} item{'s' if queue_remaining != 1 else ''}"
   255→            " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   256→            "dim",
   257→        )
   258→    )
   259→
   260→
   261→def _print_objective_drained_banner(
   262→    frozen_strict: float,
   263→    remaining: int,
   264→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown,
   265→) -> None:
   266→    """Show a phase-transition banner when objective work is drained."""
   267→    kind_labels: list[str] = []
   268→    if breakdown.subjective > 0:
   269→        kind_labels.append("subjective")
   270→    if breakdown.workflow > 0:
   271→        kind_labels.append("workflow")
   272→    kind_desc = " + ".join(kind_labels) if kind_labels else "non-objective"
   273→    print(colorize(
   274→        f"\n  Objective queue complete (plan-start was {frozen_strict:.1f})."
   275→        f" {remaining} {kind_desc} item{'s' if remaining != 1 else ''} remain.",
   276→        "cyan",
   277→    ))
   278→    print(colorize(
   279→        "  Run `desloppify next` for remaining work,"
   280→        " then `desloppify scan` to finalize.",
   281→        "dim",
   282→    ))
   283→
   284→
   285→def print_execution_or_reveal(
   286→    state: dict,
   287→    prev,
   288→    plan: dict | None,
   289→) -> None:
   290→    """Context-aware score display: frozen plan-start score or live scores.
   291→
   292→    Three display modes:
   293→
   294→    1. **Frozen** — objective queue items remain → show frozen plan-start score.
   295→    2. **Phase transition** — objective drained, subjective/workflow remains
   296→       → show live scores + transition banner.
   297→    3. **Live** — no active plan cycle or queue is clear → show live scores.
   298→    """
   299→    frozen_strict: float | None = None
   300→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown | None = None
   301→
   302→    if plan and plan.get("plan_start_scores", {}).get("strict") is not None:
   303→        frozen_strict = plan["plan_start_scores"]["strict"]
   304→        try:
   305→            breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan)
   306→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   307→            pass
   308→
   309→    remaining = breakdown.queue_total if breakdown else 0
   310→
   311→    # Frozen: objective work remains — show frozen plan-start score and return
   312→    if remaining > 0 and frozen_strict is not None:
   313→        objective_remaining = remaining - breakdown.subjective - breakdown.workflow
   314→        if objective_remaining > 0:
   315→            print_frozen_score_with_queue_context(
   316→                plan, remaining, breakdown=breakdown,
   317→            )
   318→            return
   319→
   320→    # Live scores (or phase transition): show current scores
   321→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score_update import print_score_update
   322→
   323→    print_score_update(state, prev)
   324→
   325→    # Phase transition: objective drained but subjective/workflow remains
   326→    if remaining > 0 and frozen_strict is not None:
   327→        _print_objective_drained_banner(frozen_strict, remaining, breakdown)
   328→
   329→
   330→def show_score_with_plan_context(state: dict, prev) -> None:
   331→    """Load plan (best-effort) and show frozen or live score context.
   332→
   333→    Encapsulates the common load_plan + PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS + reveal
   334→    choreography so command modules don't each repeat it.
   335→    """
   336→    from desloppify.engine.plan import load_plan
   337→
   338→    try:
   339→        plan = load_plan()
   340→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   341→        plan = None
   342→    print_execution_or_reveal(state, prev, plan)
   343→
   344→

   354→    "show_score_with_plan_context",
   355→]
```

```
     2→
     3→Blocks reruns while backlog remains (objective findings and/or subjective queue
     4→work), unless ``--force-review-rerun`` is set. Also clears stale subjective
     5→markers before a new cycle.

    13→from desloppify.core.exception_sets import CommandError

    22→def clear_stale_subjective_entries(
    23→    state: StateModel,
    24→    *,
    25→    dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
    26→) -> list[str]:
    27→    """Clear ``needs_review_refresh`` markers from subjective assessments.
    28→
    29→    When *dimensions* is provided, only those dimensions are cleared;
    30→    otherwise all stale dimensions are cleared.
    31→
    32→    Returns the list of dimension keys that were cleared.
    33→    """
    34→    assessments: dict = state.get("subjective_assessments", {})
    35→    cleared: list[str] = []
    36→    for dim_key, assessment in assessments.items():
    37→        if not isinstance(assessment, dict):
    38→            continue
    39→        if dimensions is not None and dim_key not in dimensions:
    40→            continue
    41→        if assessment.get("needs_review_refresh"):
    42→            assessment.pop("needs_review_refresh", None)
    43→            assessment.pop("stale_since", None)
    44→            assessment.pop("refresh_reason", None)
    45→            cleared.append(dim_key)
    46→    return cleared
    47→
    48→
    49→def _scored_dimensions(state: StateModel) -> list[str]:
    50→    """Return dimension keys that already have a nonzero subjective score."""
    51→    assessments: dict = state.get("subjective_assessments", {})
    52→    scored: list[str] = []
    53→    for dim_key, assessment in assessments.items():
    54→        if isinstance(assessment, dict):
    55→            if assessment.get("score", 0):
    56→                scored.append(dim_key)
    57→        elif isinstance(assessment, (int, float)) and assessment:
    58→            scored.append(dim_key)
    59→    return sorted(scored)
    60→
    61→
    62→def _normalize_dimension_key(raw: object) -> str:
    63→    """Normalize a dimension key/name to canonical snake_case."""
    64→    text = str(raw or "").strip().lower().replace(" ", "_")
    65→    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", text).strip("_")
    66→
    67→
    68→def _count_open_subjective_queue_items(
    69→    state: StateModel,
    70→    *,
    71→    dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
    72→    policy=None,
    73→) -> int:
    74→    """Count open synthetic subjective queue items for rerun gating."""
    75→    normalized_dims = (
    76→        {_normalize_dimension_key(dim) for dim in dimensions}
    77→        if dimensions is not None
    78→        else None
    79→    )
    80→    queue = build_work_queue(
    81→        state,
    82→        options=QueueBuildOptions(

    84→            include_subjective=True,
    85→            count=None,
    86→            policy=policy,
    87→        ),
    88→    )
    89→    count = 0
    90→    for item in queue.get("items", []):
    91→        if item.get("kind") != "subjective_dimension":
    92→            continue
    93→        # Stale reruns are not blocking backlog — they ARE the work
    94→        if item.get("stale_review"):
    95→            continue
    96→        if normalized_dims is None:
    97→            count += 1
    98→            continue
    99→        detail = item.get("detail")
   100→        raw_dim = detail.get("dimension", "") if isinstance(detail, dict) else ""
   101→        item_dim = _normalize_dimension_key(raw_dim)
   102→        if item_dim and item_dim in normalized_dims:
   103→            count += 1
   104→    return count
   105→
   106→
   107→def _blocking_scored_dimensions(
   108→    state: StateModel,
   109→    *,
   110→    dimensions: set[str] | None,
   111→    normalized_dimensions: set[str] | None,
   112→) -> list[str]:
   113→    scored_dims = _scored_dimensions(state)
   114→    if dimensions is None:
   115→        return scored_dims
   116→    normalized = normalized_dimensions or set()
   117→    return sorted(
   118→        dim
   119→        for dim in scored_dims
   120→        if _normalize_dimension_key(dim) in normalized

   122→

   140→
   141→

   171→        )
   172→    if subjective_total > 0:
   173→        print(

   176→                "yellow",
   177→            ),
   178→            file=sys.stderr,
   179→        )
   180→    print("", file=sys.stderr)
   181→    if dimensions is not None:
   182→        unscored = sorted(dimensions - set(blocking_dims))
   183→        if unscored:
   184→            print(
   185→                colorize(
   186→                    f"  Tip: target only unscored dimensions with "
   187→                    f"--dimensions {','.join(unscored)}",
   188→                    "dim",
   189→                ),
   190→                file=sys.stderr,
   191→            )
   192→    print(
   193→        colorize(
   194→            "  Resolve open items first, or override with --force-review-rerun",
   195→            "dim",
   196→        ),
   197→        file=sys.stderr,
   198→    )
   199→
   200→
   201→def review_rerun_preflight(
   202→    state: StateModel,
   203→    args,
   204→    *,
   205→    state_file=None,
   206→    save_fn=save_state,
   207→) -> None:
   208→    """Single entry point: gate check -> clear stale -> save.
   209→
   210→    Exits with code 1 when open backlog exists and ``--force-review-rerun`` is
   211→    not set. On success, clears stale subjective markers for targeted
   212→    dimensions and persists state.
   213→    """
   214→    dimensions = parse_dimensions(args)
   215→    normalized_dimensions = (
   216→        {_normalize_dimension_key(dim) for dim in dimensions}
   217→        if dimensions is not None
   218→        else None
   219→    )
   220→
   221→    # --force-review-rerun bypasses the gate
   222→    if getattr(args, "force_review_rerun", False):
   223→        print(
   224→            colorize(
   225→                "  --force-review-rerun: bypassing rerun backlog checks.",
   226→                "yellow",
   227→            )
   228→        )
   229→    else:
   230→        # Only gate dimensions that are actually targeted by this review run.
   231→        blocking_dims = _blocking_scored_dimensions(
   232→            state,
   233→            dimensions=dimensions,
   234→            normalized_dimensions=normalized_dimensions,
   235→        )
   236→
   237→        # No gate when none of the targeted dimensions have prior scores —
   238→        # this is a first run for these dimensions, not a rerun.
   239→        if blocking_dims:
   240→            objective_total, subjective_total = _objective_and_subjective_backlog(
   241→                state,
   242→                blocking_dims=blocking_dims,
   243→            )
   244→            if objective_total > 0 or subjective_total > 0:
   245→                _print_backlog_blocked_message(
   246→                    blocking_dims=blocking_dims,
   247→                    objective_total=objective_total,
   248→                    subjective_total=subjective_total,
   249→                    dimensions=dimensions,
   250→                )
   251→                raise CommandError(
   252→                    f"rerun blocked: open backlog (objective: {objective_total}, "
   253→                    f"subjective: {subjective_total})",
   254→                    exit_code=1,
   255→                )
   256→
   257→    # Gate passed — clear stale for targeted dims
   258→    cleared = clear_stale_subjective_entries(state, dimensions=dimensions)
   259→    if cleared and state_file:
   260→        save_fn(state, state_file)
   261→        print(
   262→            colorize(
   263→                f"  Cleared stale review markers: {', '.join(sorted(cleared))}",

   266→        )
```

```
1→"""Unified subjective-visibility policy.
     2→
     3→A single frozen dataclass computed once per operation replaces the scattered
     4→``has_objective_items`` / ``objective_count`` computations in
     5→``stale_dimensions``, ``auto_cluster``, and ``_work_queue/core``.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→from dataclasses import dataclass
    11→
    12→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    13→
    14→# Detectors whose findings are NOT objective mechanical work.
    15→# Canonical definition — re-exported by stale_dimensions for back-compat.
    16→NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    17→    "review", "concerns", "subjective_review", "subjective_assessment",
    18→})
    19→
    20→
    21→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    22→class SubjectiveVisibility:
    23→    """Immutable snapshot of the subjective-vs-objective balance."""
    24→
    25→    has_objective_backlog: bool  # any open non-subjective findings?
    26→    objective_count: int  # how many
    27→    unscored_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing initial review
    28→    stale_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing re-review
    29→    under_target_ids: frozenset[str]  # below target, not stale/unscored
    30→
    31→    def should_surface(self, item: dict) -> bool:
    32→        """Should this subjective queue item appear in the work queue?
    33→
    34→        Unscored (initial_review) -> always.  All others -> only when drained.
    35→        """
    36→        if item.get("initial_review"):
    37→            return True
    38→        return not self.has_objective_backlog
    39→
    40→    def should_inject_to_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    41→        """Should this subjective ID be injected into plan queue_order?"""
    42→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    43→            return True  # unconditional
    44→        if fid in self.stale_ids:
    45→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    46→        if fid in self.under_target_ids:
    47→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    48→        return False
    49→
    50→    def should_evict_from_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    51→        """Should this subjective ID be removed from plan queue_order?"""
    52→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    53→            return False  # never evict unscored
    54→        if fid in self.stale_ids or fid in self.under_target_ids:
    55→            return self.has_objective_backlog
    56→        return False
    57→
    58→    @property
    59→    def backlog_blocks_rerun(self) -> bool:
    60→        """Preflight: should reruns be blocked?"""
    61→        return self.has_objective_backlog
    62→
    63→
    64→def _is_evidence_only(finding: dict) -> bool:
    65→    """Return True if the finding is below its detector's standalone threshold."""
    66→    from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
    67→    from desloppify.engine.planning.common import CONFIDENCE_ORDER
    68→
    69→    detector = finding.get("detector", "")
    70→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
    71→    if meta and meta.standalone_threshold:
    72→        threshold_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(meta.standalone_threshold, 9)
    73→        finding_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(finding.get("confidence", "low"), 9)
    74→        if finding_rank > threshold_rank:
    75→            return True
    76→    return False
    77→
    78→
    79→def compute_subjective_visibility(
    80→    state: StateModel,
    81→    *,
    82→    target_strict: float = 95.0,
    83→    scan_path: str | None = None,
    84→    plan: dict | None = None,
    85→) -> SubjectiveVisibility:
    86→    """Build the policy snapshot from current state.
    87→
    88→    When *scan_path* is set, only findings within that scope count toward
    89→    the objective backlog.  When *plan* is set, findings whose IDs appear
    90→    in ``plan["skipped"]`` are excluded.
    91→
    92→    Imports building-block helpers from ``stale_dimensions`` so the
    93→    source-of-truth logic stays in one place.
    94→    """
    95→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
    96→        _current_stale_ids,
    97→        current_under_target_ids,
    98→        current_unscored_ids,
    99→    )
   100→    from desloppify.engine._state.filtering import finding_in_scan_scope
   101→
   102→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   103→    skipped_ids = set((plan or {}).get("skipped", {}).keys())
   104→
   105→    # Count open, non-suppressed, objective findings.
   106→    # Evidence-only findings (below standalone confidence threshold) are
   107→    # excluded — they still affect scores but are not actionable queue items.
   108→    # Findings outside scan_path and plan-skipped findings are also excluded
   109→    # so the policy matches what the user actually sees in the queue.
   110→    objective_count = sum(
   111→        1
   112→        for fid, f in findings.items()
   113→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   114→        and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   115→        and not f.get("suppressed")
   116→        and not _is_evidence_only(f)
   117→        and finding_in_scan_scope(str(f.get("file", "")), scan_path)
   118→        and fid not in skipped_ids
   119→    )
   120→
   121→    unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   122→    stale = _current_stale_ids(state)
   123→    under_target = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
   124→
   125→    return SubjectiveVisibility(
   126→        has_objective_backlog=objective_count > 0,
   127→        objective_count=objective_count,
   128→        unscored_ids=frozenset(unscored),
   129→        stale_ids=frozenset(stale),
   130→        under_target_ids=frozenset(under_target),
   131→    )
   132→
   133→
   134→__all__ = [
   135→    "NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS",
   136→    "SubjectiveVisibility",
   137→    "compute_subjective_visibility",
   138→]
   139→
```

```
     6→- Fix 3: compute_subjective_visibility respects scan_path + plan
     7→- Fix 4a: workflow::run-scan synthetic item
     8→- Fix 6: queue_guard passes scan_path
     9→"""

    11→from __future__ import annotations
    12→
    13→from unittest.mock import patch

    15→from desloppify.engine._state.merge_findings import auto_resolve_disappeared
    16→from desloppify.engine._plan.subjective_policy import compute_subjective_visibility

    18→
    19→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    20→# Helpers
    21→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    22→
    23→def _finding(
    24→    fid: str,
    25→    detector: str = "unused",
    26→    status: str = "open",
    27→    file: str = "src/foo.ts",
    28→    suppressed: bool = False,
    29→) -> dict:
    30→    f: dict = {
    31→        "id": fid,
    32→        "detector": detector,
    33→        "status": status,
    34→        "file": file,
    35→    }
    36→    if suppressed:
    37→        f["suppressed"] = True
    38→    return f
    39→
    40→
    41→def _state_with_findings(*findings: dict) -> dict:
    42→    return {
    43→        "findings": {f["id"]: f for f in findings},
    44→        "scan_count": 5,
    45→    }

    52→class TestAutoResolveOutOfScope:
    53→    def test_out_of_scope_findings_are_resolved(self):
    54→        """Findings outside scan_path are auto-resolved, not skipped."""
    55→        existing = {
    56→            "f1": {
    57→                "id": "f1", "status": "open", "file": "supabase/fn.ts",
    58→                "detector": "unused",
    59→            },
    60→            "f2": {
    61→                "id": "f2", "status": "open", "file": "src/app.ts",
    62→                "detector": "unused",
    63→            },
    64→        }
    65→        resolved, _lang, out_of_scope, detectors = auto_resolve_disappeared(
    66→            existing,
    67→            current_ids=set(),
    68→            suspect_detectors=set(),
    69→            now="2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",

    71→            scan_path="src",

   215→
   216→class TestSubjectivePolicyScanPathAndPlan:
   217→    def test_scan_path_excludes_out_of_scope_findings(self):
   218→        """Findings outside scan_path don't count toward objective backlog."""
   219→        state = _state_with_findings(
   220→            _finding("f1", "unused", file="src/app.ts"),
   221→            _finding("f2", "unused", file="supabase/fn.ts"),
   222→            _finding("f3", "unused", file="src/lib.ts"),
   223→        )
   224→        # Without scan_path: all 3 count
   225→        policy_all = compute_subjective_visibility(state)
   226→        assert policy_all.objective_count == 3
   227→
   228→        # With scan_path: only 2 in src/ count
   229→        policy_scoped = compute_subjective_visibility(state, scan_path="src")
   230→        assert policy_scoped.objective_count == 2
   231→        assert policy_scoped.has_objective_backlog is True
   232→
   233→    def test_scan_path_drains_backlog_correctly(self):
   234→        """When all in-scope findings are resolved, backlog is drained even
   235→        if out-of-scope findings remain open."""
   236→        state = _state_with_findings(
   237→            _finding("f1", "unused", file="supabase/fn.ts"),
   238→            _finding("f2", "unused", file="supabase/other.ts"),
   239→        )
   240→        policy = compute_subjective_visibility(state, scan_path="src")
   241→        assert policy.objective_count == 0
   242→        assert policy.has_objective_backlog is False
   243→
   244→    def test_plan_skipped_findings_excluded(self):
   245→        """Findings in plan['skipped'] don't count toward objective backlog."""
   246→        state = _state_with_findings(
   247→            _finding("f1", "unused", file="src/a.ts"),
   248→            _finding("f2", "unused", file="src/b.ts"),
   249→            _finding("f3", "unused", file="src/c.ts"),
   250→        )
   251→        plan = {"skipped": {"f1": {"kind": "temporary"}, "f2": {"kind": "permanent"}}}
   252→        policy = compute_subjective_visibility(state, plan=plan)
   253→        assert policy.objective_count == 1  # only f3
   254→
   255→    def test_scan_path_and_plan_combined(self):
   256→        """Both filters applied together: scope + skipped."""
   257→        state = _state_with_findings(
   258→            _finding("f1", "unused", file="src/a.ts"),     # in scope, not skipped → counts
   259→            _finding("f2", "unused", file="src/b.ts"),     # in scope, skipped → excluded
   260→            _finding("f3", "unused", file="other/c.ts"),   # out of scope → excluded
   261→        )
   262→        plan = {"skipped": {"f2": {"kind": "temporary"}}}
   263→        policy = compute_subjective_visibility(state, scan_path="src", plan=plan)
   264→        assert policy.objective_count == 1
   265→        assert policy.has_objective_backlog is True
   266→
   267→    def test_no_params_backward_compat(self):
   268→        """Without new params, behavior is unchanged (all findings counted)."""
   269→        state = _state_with_findings(
   270→            _finding("f1", "unused", file="anywhere/a.ts"),
   271→        )
   272→        policy = compute_subjective_visibility(state)
   273→        assert policy.objective_count == 1

   370→    def test_run_scan_does_not_block_scan_preflight(self):
   371→        """The workflow::run-scan item only appears when the queue is otherwise empty,
   372→        so plan_aware_queue_count returns 1 (the workflow item itself), but the scan
   373→        preflight gate would have returned 0 before the item is injected — meaning
   374→        the gate naturally passes (0 real items)."""
   375→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import plan_aware_queue_count
   376→
   377→        state: dict = {"findings": {}, "scan_count": 5}
   378→        plan = {
   379→            "plan_start_scores": {"strict": 75.0},
   380→            "queue_order": [],
   381→            "skipped": {},
   382→        }
   383→        # The count includes the workflow item
   384→        count = plan_aware_queue_count(state, plan=plan)
   385→        # workflow::run-scan is the only item → count == 1
   386→        # But the scan gate checks plan_aware_queue_count which now includes it.
   387→        # This is actually fine because the workflow item is telling the user
   388→        # to scan, and the gate checks for *remaining work* items.
   389→        # The test verifies the count is deterministic.
   390→        assert count == 1
```

## Root Cause Analysis: Queue Counting Discrepancies in Desloppify

Based on my thorough code analysis, I've identified the three interconnected issues and their root causes:

### **Issue Summary**

- **Issue #196**: `desloppify scan` says 20 items remain but `desloppify next` says 0 items → they disagree on queue count
- **Issue #197**: `desloppify next` shows 14 subjective items and tells user to run `review --prepare`, but `review --prepare` blocks with "87 open objective findings"
- **Root Problem**: The commands use different filtering paths when counting queue items, particularly around **plan.skipped** handling

```
  - Open objective findings (evidence-only filtered): 130

plan.json:

  - skipped: 239 items (all "props" interface findings)
```

```python
def plan_aware_queue_count(state: dict, plan: dict | None = None) -> int:
    """Count remaining plan-aware queue items (skips excluded, clusters collapsed)."""
    result = build_work_queue(
        state,
        options=QueueBuildOptions(
            status="open",
            count=None,
            plan=plan,  # ← PLAN PASSED HERE
            collapse_clusters=True,
            include_skipped=False,
            scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),
        ),
    )
    return result["total"]
```

**Result**: Counts **20 items** (after plan filtering + collapse_clusters)
- This INCLUDES the plan when filtering, so skipped items are excluded
- This counts synthetic items (workflow, subjective dimensions, clusters)

```
   132→        scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),
   133→        plan=plan_data,
   134→    )
   135→    objective_total = policy.objective_count
   136→    subjective_total = _count_open_subjective_queue_items(
   137→        state,
   138→        dimensions=set(blocking_dims),
   139→        policy=policy,
   140→    )
   141→    return objective_total, subjective_total

   143→
   144→def _print_backlog_blocked_message(
   145→    *,
   146→    blocking_dims: list[str],
   147→    objective_total: int,
   148→    subjective_total: int,
   149→    dimensions: set[str] | None,
   150→) -> None:
   151→    print(
   152→        colorize(
   153→            "  Blocked: rerun requires drained backlog "
   154→            f"(objective: {objective_total}, subjective: {subjective_total}).",
   155→            "red",
   156→        ),
   157→        file=sys.stderr,
   158→    )
   159→    print(
   160→        colorize(
   161→            f"  Scored dimensions: {', '.join(blocking_dims)}",
   162→            "yellow",
   163→        ),
   164→        file=sys.stderr,
   165→    )
   166→    if objective_total > 0:
   167→        print(
   168→            colorize(
   169→                f"  Open objective finding(s): {objective_total}",
   170→                "yellow",
   171→            ),
   172→            file=sys.stderr,
   173→        )
   174→    if subjective_total > 0:
   175→        print(
   176→            colorize(
   177→                f"  Open subjective queue item(s): {subjective_total}",
   178→                "yellow",
   179→            ),
   180→            file=sys.stderr,
   181→        )
   182→    print("", file=sys.stderr)
   183→    if dimensions is not None:
   184→        unscored = sorted(dimensions - set(blocking_dims))
   185→        if unscored:
   186→            print(
   187→                colorize(
   188→                    f"  Tip: target only unscored dimensions with "
   189→                    f"--dimensions {','.join(unscored)}",
   190→                    "dim",
   191→                ),
   192→                file=sys.stderr,
   193→            )
   194→    print(
   195→        colorize(
   196→            "  Resolve open items first, or override with --force-review-rerun",
   197→            "dim",
   198→        ),
   199→        file=sys.stderr,
   200→    )
   201→
   202→
   203→def review_rerun_preflight(
   204→    state: StateModel,
   205→    args,
   206→    *,
   207→    state_file=None,
   208→    save_fn=save_state,
   209→) -> None:
   210→    """Single entry point: gate check -> clear stale -> save.
   211→
   212→    Exits with code 1 when open backlog exists and ``--force-review-rerun`` is
   213→    not set. On success, clears stale subjective markers for targeted
   214→    dimensions and persists state.
   215→    """
   216→    dimensions = parse_dimensions(args)
   217→    normalized_dimensions = (
   218→        {_normalize_dimension_key(dim) for dim in dimensions}
   219→        if dimensions is not None
   220→        else None
   221→    )
   222→
   223→    # --force-review-rerun bypasses the gate
   224→    if getattr(args, "force_review_rerun", False):
   225→        print(
   226→            colorize(
   227→                "  --force-review-rerun: bypassing rerun backlog checks.",
   228→                "yellow",
   229→            )
   230→        )
   231→    else:
   232→        # Only gate dimensions that are actually targeted by this review run.
   233→        blocking_dims = _blocking_scored_dimensions(
   234→            state,
   235→            dimensions=dimensions,
   236→            normalized_dimensions=normalized_dimensions,
   237→        )
   238→
   239→        # No gate when none of the targeted dimensions have prior scores —
   240→        # this is a first run for these dimensions, not a rerun.
   241→        if blocking_dims:
   242→            objective_total, subjective_total = _objective_and_subjective_backlog(
   243→                state,
   244→                blocking_dims=blocking_dims,
   245→            )
   246→            if objective_total > 0 or subjective_total > 0:
   247→                _print_backlog_blocked_message(
   248→                    blocking_dims=blocking_dims,
   249→                    objective_total=objective_total,
   250→                    subjective_total=subjective_total,
   251→                    dimensions=dimensions,
   252→                )
   253→                raise CommandError(
   254→                    f"rerun blocked: open backlog (objective: {objective_total}, "
   255→                    f"subjective: {subjective_total})",
   256→                    exit_code=1,
   257→                )
   258→
   259→    # Gate passed — clear stale for targeted dims
   260→    cleared = clear_stale_subjective_entries(state, dimensions=dimensions)
   261→    if cleared and state_file:
   262→        save_fn(state, state_file)
   263→        print(
   264→            colorize(
   265→                f"  Cleared stale review markers: {', '.join(sorted(cleared))}",
   266→                "cyan",
   267→            )
   268→        )
   269→
```

```
1→"""Unified subjective-visibility policy.
     2→
     3→A single frozen dataclass computed once per operation replaces the scattered
     4→``has_objective_items`` / ``objective_count`` computations in
     5→``stale_dimensions``, ``auto_cluster``, and ``_work_queue/core``.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→from dataclasses import dataclass
    11→
    12→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    13→
    14→# Detectors whose findings are NOT objective mechanical work.
    15→# Canonical definition — re-exported by stale_dimensions for back-compat.
    16→NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    17→    "review", "concerns", "subjective_review", "subjective_assessment",
    18→})
    19→
    20→
    21→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    22→class SubjectiveVisibility:
    23→    """Immutable snapshot of the subjective-vs-objective balance."""
    24→
    25→    has_objective_backlog: bool  # any open non-subjective findings?
    26→    objective_count: int  # how many
    27→    unscored_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing initial review
    28→    stale_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing re-review
    29→    under_target_ids: frozenset[str]  # below target, not stale/unscored
    30→
    31→    def should_surface(self, item: dict) -> bool:
    32→        """Should this subjective queue item appear in the work queue?
    33→
    34→        Unscored (initial_review) -> always.  All others -> only when drained.
    35→        """
    36→        if item.get("initial_review"):
    37→            return True
    38→        return not self.has_objective_backlog
    39→
    40→    def should_inject_to_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    41→        """Should this subjective ID be injected into plan queue_order?"""
    42→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    43→            return True  # unconditional
    44→        if fid in self.stale_ids:
    45→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    46→        if fid in self.under_target_ids:
    47→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    48→        return False
    49→
    50→    def should_evict_from_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    51→        """Should this subjective ID be removed from plan queue_order?"""
    52→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    53→            return False  # never evict unscored
    54→        if fid in self.stale_ids or fid in self.under_target_ids:
    55→            return self.has_objective_backlog
    56→        return False
    57→
    58→    @property
    59→    def backlog_blocks_rerun(self) -> bool:
    60→        """Preflight: should reruns be blocked?"""
    61→        return self.has_objective_backlog
    62→
    63→
    64→def _is_evidence_only(finding: dict) -> bool:
    65→    """Return True if the finding is below its detector's standalone threshold."""
    66→    from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
    67→    from desloppify.engine.planning.common import CONFIDENCE_ORDER
    68→
    69→    detector = finding.get("detector", "")
    70→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
    71→    if meta and meta.standalone_threshold:
    72→        threshold_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(meta.standalone_threshold, 9)
    73→        finding_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(finding.get("confidence", "low"), 9)
    74→        if finding_rank > threshold_rank:
    75→            return True
    76→    return False
    77→
    78→
    79→def compute_subjective_visibility(
    80→    state: StateModel,
    81→    *,
    82→    target_strict: float = 95.0,
    83→    scan_path: str | None = None,
    84→    plan: dict | None = None,
    85→) -> SubjectiveVisibility:
    86→    """Build the policy snapshot from current state.
    87→
    88→    When *scan_path* is set, only findings within that scope count toward
    89→    the objective backlog.  When *plan* is set, findings whose IDs appear
    90→    in ``plan["skipped"]`` are excluded.
    91→
    92→    Imports building-block helpers from ``stale_dimensions`` so the
    93→    source-of-truth logic stays in one place.
    94→    """
    95→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
    96→        _current_stale_ids,
    97→        current_under_target_ids,
    98→        current_unscored_ids,
    99→    )
   100→    from desloppify.engine._state.filtering import finding_in_scan_scope
   101→
   102→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   103→    skipped_ids = set((plan or {}).get("skipped", {}).keys())
   104→
   105→    # Count open, non-suppressed, objective findings.
   106→    # Evidence-only findings (below standalone confidence threshold) are
   107→    # excluded — they still affect scores but are not actionable queue items.
   108→    # Findings outside scan_path and plan-skipped findings are also excluded
   109→    # so the policy matches what the user actually sees in the queue.
   110→    objective_count = sum(
   111→        1
   112→        for fid, f in findings.items()
   113→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   114→        and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   115→        and not f.get("suppressed")
   116→        and not _is_evidence_only(f)
   117→        and finding_in_scan_scope(str(f.get("file", "")), scan_path)
   118→        and fid not in skipped_ids
   119→    )
   120→
   121→    unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   122→    stale = _current_stale_ids(state)
   123→    under_target = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
   124→
   125→    return SubjectiveVisibility(
   126→        has_objective_backlog=objective_count > 0,
   127→        objective_count=objective_count,
   128→        unscored_ids=frozenset(unscored),
   129→        stale_ids=frozenset(stale),
   130→        under_target_ids=frozenset(under_target),
   131→    )
   132→
   133→
   134→__all__ = [
   135→    "NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS",
   136→    "SubjectiveVisibility",
   137→    "compute_subjective_visibility",
   138→]
   139→
```
