    29→def _render_workflow_stage(item: dict) -> None:
    30→    """Render a triage workflow stage item."""
    31→    blocked = item.get("is_blocked", False)
    32→    stage = item.get("stage_name", "")
    33→    tag = " [blocked]" if blocked else ""
    34→    style = "dim" if blocked else "bold"
    35→    print(colorize(f"  (Planning stage: {stage}{tag})", style))
    36→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
    37→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
    38→    detail = item.get("detail", {})
    39→    total = detail.get("total_review_findings", 0)
    40→    if total:
    41→        print(colorize(f"  {total} review findings to analyze", "dim"))
    42→    if blocked:
    43→        blocked_by = item.get("blocked_by", [])
    44→        deps = ", ".join(b.replace("triage::", "") for b in blocked_by)
    45→        print(colorize(f"  Blocked by: {deps}", "dim"))
    46→        first_dep = blocked_by[0] if blocked_by else ""
    47→        dep_name = first_dep.replace("triage::", "")
    48→        if dep_name:
    49→            print(colorize(f"  Next step: desloppify plan triage --stage {dep_name}", "dim"))
    50→    else:
    51→        print(colorize(f"\n  Action: {item.get('primary_command', '')}", "cyan"))
    52→
    53→
    54→def _render_workflow_action(item: dict) -> None:
    55→    """Render a workflow action item (e.g. create-plan)."""
    56→    print(colorize("  (Workflow step)", "bold"))
    57→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
    58→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
    59→    print(colorize(f"\n  Action: {item.get('primary_command', '')}", "cyan"))
    60→
    61→
    62→def _render_subjective_dimension(item: dict, *, explain: bool) -> None:
    63→    """Render a subjective dimension re-review item."""
    64→    detail = item.get("detail", {})
    65→    subjective_score = float(
    66→        detail.get("strict_score", item.get("subjective_score", 100.0))
    67→    )
    68→    print(f"  Dimension: {detail.get('dimension_name', 'unknown')}")
    69→    print(f"  Score: {subjective_score:.1f}%")
    70→    print(
    71→        colorize(
    72→            f"  Action: {item.get('primary_command', 'desloppify review --prepare')}",
    73→            "cyan",
    74→        )
    75→    )
    76→    print(colorize(
    77→        "  Note: re-review scores what it finds — scores can go down if issues are discovered.",
    78→        "dim",
    79→    ))
    80→    if explain:
    81→        reason = item.get("explain", {}).get(
    82→            "policy",
    83→            "subjective items sort after mechanical items at the same level.",
    84→        )
    85→        print(colorize(f"  explain: {reason}", "dim"))
    86→

    88→def _render_finding_detail(item: dict) -> dict:
    89→    """Render plan overrides, file info, and detail fields. Returns parsed detail dict."""
    90→    if item.get("plan_description"):
    91→        print(colorize(f"  → {item['plan_description']}", "cyan"))
    92→    plan_cluster = item.get("plan_cluster")
    93→    if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict):
    94→        cluster_name = plan_cluster.get("name", "")
    95→        cluster_desc = plan_cluster.get("description") or ""
    96→        total = plan_cluster.get("total_items", 0)
    97→        desc_str = f' — "{cluster_desc}"' if cluster_desc else ""
    98→        print(colorize(f"  Cluster: {cluster_name}{desc_str} ({total} items)", "dim"))
    99→    if item.get("plan_note"):
   100→        print(colorize(f"  Note: {item['plan_note']}", "dim"))
   101→
   102→    print(f"  File: {item.get('file', '')}")
   103→    print(colorize(f"  ID:   {item.get('id', '')}", "dim"))
   104→
   105→    detail = item.get("detail", {})
   106→    if isinstance(detail, str):
   107→        detail = {"suggestion": detail}
   108→    if isinstance(detail, dict):
   109→        detail.setdefault("lines", [])
   110→        detail.setdefault("line", None)
   111→        detail.setdefault("category", None)
   112→        detail.setdefault("importers", None)
   113→        detail.setdefault("count", 0)
   114→    if detail.get("lines"):
   115→        print(f"  Lines: {', '.join(str(line_no) for line_no in detail['lines'][:8])}")
   116→    if detail.get("category"):
   117→        print(f"  Category: {detail['category']}")
   118→    if detail.get("importers") is not None:
   119→        print(f"  Active importers: {detail['importers']}")
   120→    if detail.get("suggestion"):
   121→        print(colorize(f"\n  Suggestion: {detail['suggestion']}", "dim"))
   122→
   123→    target_line = detail.get("line") or (detail.get("lines", [None]) or [None])[0]
   124→    if target_line and item.get("file") not in (".", ""):
   125→        snippet = read_code_snippet(item["file"], target_line)
   126→        if snippet:
   127→            print(colorize("\n  Code:", "dim"))
   128→            print(snippet)
   129→
   130→    return detail

   133→def _render_score_impact(
   134→    item: dict, dim_scores: dict, potentials: dict | None,
   135→) -> None:
   136→    """Render dimension score context and impact estimates."""
   137→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   138→    if dim_scores:
   139→        dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   140→        if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   141→            dimension_score = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   142→            strict_val = dimension_score.get("strict", dimension_score["score"])
   143→            print(
   144→                colorize(
   145→                    f"\n  Dimension: {dimension.name} — {dimension_score['score']:.1f}% "
   146→                    f"(strict: {strict_val:.1f}%) "
   147→                    f"({dimension_score['issues']} of {dimension_score['checks']:,} checks failing)",
   148→                    "dim",
   149→                )
   150→            )
   151→
   152→    if potentials and detector and dim_scores:
   153→        try:
   154→            impact = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=1)
   155→            if impact > 0:
   156→                print(colorize(f"  Impact: fixing this is worth ~+{impact:.1f} pts on overall score", "cyan"))
   157→            else:
   158→                dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   159→                if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   160→                    issues = dim_scores[dimension.name].get("issues", 0)
   161→                    if issues > 1:
   162→                        bulk = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=issues)
   163→                        if bulk > 0:
   164→                            print(colorize(
   165→                                f"  Impact: fixing all {issues} {detector} issues → ~+{bulk:.1f} pts",
   166→                                "cyan",
   167→                            ))
   168→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   169→            log(f"  score impact estimate skipped: {exc}")
   170→    elif detector == "review" and dim_scores:
   171→        try:
   172→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   173→            if dim_key:
   174→                breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   175→                for entry in breakdown.get("entries", []):
   176→                    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   177→                        continue
   178→                    entry_key = str(entry.get("name", "")).lower().replace(" ", "_")
   179→                    if entry_key == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   180→                        drag = float(entry.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   181→                        if drag > 0.01:
   182→                            print(colorize(
   183→                                f"  Dimension drag: {entry['name']} costs -{drag:.2f} pts on overall score",
   184→                                "cyan",
   185→                            ))
   186→                        break
   187→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   188→            log(f"  dimension drag estimate skipped: {exc}")
   189→

   191→def _render_item(
   192→    item: dict, dim_scores: dict, findings_scoped: dict, explain: bool,
   193→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   194→) -> None:
   195→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
   196→        _render_cluster_item(item)
   197→        return
   198→    if item.get("kind") == "workflow_stage":
   199→        _render_workflow_stage(item)
   200→        return
   201→    if item.get("kind") == "workflow_action":
   202→        _render_workflow_action(item)
   203→        return
   204→
   205→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   206→    print(colorize(f"  ({confidence} confidence)", "bold"))
   207→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   208→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   209→
   210→    if item.get("detector") == "review":
   211→        print(colorize("  Type: Design review (requires judgment)", "dim"))
   212→    elif is_auto_fix_command(item.get("primary_command")):
   213→        print(colorize("  Type: Auto-fixable", "dim"))
   214→
   215→    if item.get("kind", "finding") == "subjective_dimension":
   216→        _render_subjective_dimension(item, explain=explain)
   217→        return
   218→
   219→    detail = _render_finding_detail(item)
   220→    _render_score_impact(item, dim_scores, potentials)
   221→
   222→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   223→    auto_fix_command = item.get("primary_command")
   224→    if is_auto_fix_command(auto_fix_command):
   225→        similar_count = sum(
   226→            1
   227→            for finding in findings_scoped.values()
   228→            if finding.get("detector") == detector_name and finding["status"] == "open"
   229→        )
   230→        if similar_count > 1:
   231→            print(
   232→                colorize(
   233→                    f"\n  Auto-fixable: {similar_count} similar findings. "
   234→                    f"Run `{auto_fix_command}` to fix all at once.",
   235→                    "cyan",
   236→                )
   237→            )
   238→    if explain:
   239→        explanation = item.get("explain", {})
   240→        count_weight = explanation.get("count", int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0))
   241→        detector = item.get("detector", "")
   242→        base = (
   243→            f"ranked by confidence={confidence}, "
   244→            f"count={count_weight}, id={item.get('id', '')}"
   245→        )
   246→        if dim_scores and detector:
   247→            dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   248→            if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   249→                ds = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   250→                base += (
   251→                    f". Dimension: {dimension.name} at {ds['score']:.1f}% "
   252→                    f"({ds['issues']} open issues)"
   253→                )
   254→        if item.get("detector") == "review" and dim_scores:
   255→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   256→            if dim_key:
   257→                for ds_name, ds_data in dim_scores.items():
   258→                    if ds_name.lower().replace(" ", "_") == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   259→                        score_val = ds_data.get("score", "?")
   260→                        score_str = f"{score_val:.1f}" if isinstance(score_val, (int, float)) else str(score_val)
   261→                        base += f". Subjective dimension: {ds_name} at {score_str}%"
   262→                        break
   263→        policy = explanation.get("policy")
   264→        if policy:
   265→            base = f"{base}. {policy}"
   266→        print(colorize(f"  explain: {base}", "dim"))
   267→

   269→def render_terminal_items(
   270→    items: list[dict],
   271→    dim_scores: dict,
   272→    findings_scoped: dict,
   273→    *,
   274→    group: str,
   275→    explain: bool,
   276→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   277→    plan: dict | None = None,
   278→    cluster_filter: str | None = None,
   279→) -> None:
   280→    # Show focus header if plan has active cluster
   281→    if plan and plan.get("active_cluster"):
   282→        cluster_name = plan["active_cluster"]
   283→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   284→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   285→        total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   286→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({len(items)} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))
   287→
   288→    if group != "item":
   289→        _render_grouped(items, group)
   290→        return
   291→
   292→    # Detect cluster drill-in: multiple items with cluster focus active
   293→    is_cluster_drill = len(items) > 1 and (
   294→        cluster_filter or (plan and plan.get("active_cluster"))
   295→    )
   296→
   297→    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
   298→        if idx > 0:
   299→            print()
   300→        # Full card for first item, compact for rest in cluster drill-in
   301→        if is_cluster_drill and idx > 0:
   302→            _render_compact_item(item, idx, len(items))
   303→            continue
   304→        queue_pos = item.get("queue_position")
   305→        if queue_pos and len(items) > 1:
   306→            label = f"  [#{queue_pos}]"
   307→        elif len(items) > 1:
   308→            label = f"  [{idx + 1}/{len(items)}]"
   309→        else:
   310→            pos_str = f"  (#{ queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   311→            label = f"  Next item{pos_str}"
   312→        print(colorize(label, "bold"))
   313→        _render_item(item, dim_scores, findings_scoped, explain=explain, potentials=potentials)
   314→
   315→
   316→def render_uncommitted_reminder(plan: dict | None) -> None:
   317→    """Show a subtle reminder if there are uncommitted resolved findings."""
   318→    if plan is None:
   319→        return
   320→    try:
   321→        from desloppify.core.config import load_config
   322→
   323→        config = load_config()
   324→        if not config.get("commit_tracking_enabled", True):
   325→            return
   326→
   327→        uncommitted = plan.get("uncommitted_findings", [])
   328→        if not uncommitted:
   329→            return
   330→
   331→        count = len(uncommitted)
   332→        print(colorize(
   333→            f"\n  {count} resolved finding{'s' if count != 1 else ''} uncommitted"
   334→            " — `desloppify plan commit-log` to review",
   335→            "dim",
   336→        ))
   337→    except (ImportError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
   338→        pass

   341→def render_single_item_resolution_hint(items: list[dict]) -> None:
   342→    if len(items) != 1:
   343→        return
   344→    kind = items[0].get("kind", "finding")
   345→    if kind in ("cluster", "workflow_stage", "workflow_action"):
   346→        return  # These kinds have their own resolution hints
   347→    if kind != "finding":
   348→        return
   349→    item = items[0]
   350→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   351→    if detector_name == "subjective_review":
   352→        print(colorize("\n  Review with:", "dim"))
   353→        primary = item.get(
   354→            "primary_command", "desloppify show subjective"
   355→        )
   356→        print(f"    {primary}")
   357→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   358→            print("    desloppify review --prepare")
   359→        return
   360→
   361→    primary = item.get("primary_command", "")
   362→    if is_auto_fix_command(primary):
   363→        print(colorize("\n  Fix with:", "dim"))
   364→        print(f"    {primary}")
   365→        print(colorize("  Or resolve individually:", "dim"))
   366→    else:
   367→        print(colorize("\n  Resolve with:", "dim"))
   368→
   369→    print(
   370→        f'    desloppify plan done "{item["id"]}" --note "<what you did>" --confirm'
   371→    )
   372→    print(
   373→        f'    desloppify plan skip --permanent "{item["id"]}" --note "<why>" '
   374→        f'--attest "{ATTEST_EXAMPLE}"'
   375→    )

   378→def render_followup_nudges(
   379→    state: dict,
   380→    dim_scores: dict,
   381→    findings_scoped: dict,
   382→    *,
   383→    strict_score: float | None,
   384→    target_strict_score: float,
   385→    queue_total: int = 0,
   386→    plan_start_strict: float | None = None,
   387→    breakdown: "QueueBreakdown | None" = None,
   388→) -> None:
   389→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
   390→        format_queue_block,
   391→    )
   392→
   393→    subjective_threshold = target_strict_score
   394→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective(state, dim_scores)
   395→    followup = build_subjective_followup(
   396→        state,
   397→        subjective_entries,
   398→        threshold=subjective_threshold,
   399→        max_quality_items=3,
   400→        max_integrity_items=5,
   401→    )
   402→    unassessed_subjective = unassessed_subjective_dimensions(dim_scores)
   403→    # Show frozen plan-start score + queue block when in an active cycle
   404→    if queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None and breakdown is not None:
   405→        frozen = plan_start_strict
   406→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=frozen)
   407→        print()
   408→        for text, style in block:
   409→            print(colorize(text, style))
   410→        print(colorize(
   411→            "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   412→            "dim",
   413→        ))
   414→    elif queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None:
   415→        print(
   416→            colorize(
   417→                f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {plan_start_strict:.1f}/100",
   418→                "cyan",
   419→            )
   420→        )
   421→        print(
   422→            colorize(
   423→                f"  Queue: {queue_total} item{'s' if queue_total != 1 else ''}"
   424→                " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   425→                "dim",
   426→            )
   427→        )
   428→    elif strict_score is not None:
   429→        gap = round(float(target_strict_score) - float(strict_score), 1)
   430→        if gap > 0:
   431→            print(
   432→                colorize(
   433→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 → target {target_strict_score:.1f} (+{gap:.1f} needed)",
   434→                    "cyan",
   435→                )
   436→            )
   437→        else:
   438→            print(
   439→                colorize(
   440→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 meets target {target_strict_score:.1f}",
   441→                    "green",
   442→                )
   443→            )
   444→    # Show queue block after north star when no frozen score
   445→    if breakdown is not None and queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is None:
   446→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown)
   447→        for text, style in block:
   448→            print(colorize(text, style))
   449→
   450→    # Subjective bottleneck banner — only shown when the objective queue is
   451→    # clear.  While objective items remain, the queue is the single authority
   452→    # on what to work on next; no need to distract with subjective advice.
   453→    _objective_remaining = max(
   454→        0,
   455→        (breakdown.queue_total - breakdown.subjective) if breakdown else queue_total,
   456→    )
   457→    if strict_score is not None and dim_scores and _objective_remaining <= 0:
   458→        try:
   459→            health_breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   460→            subjective_drag = sum(
   461→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   462→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   463→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") == "subjective"
   464→            )
   465→            mechanical_drag = sum(
   466→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   467→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   468→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") != "subjective"
   469→            )
   470→            if subjective_drag > mechanical_drag and subjective_drag > 5.0:
   471→                print(colorize(
   472→                    f"\n  Subjective dimensions are the main bottleneck "
   473→                    f"(-{subjective_drag:.0f} pts vs -{mechanical_drag:.0f} pts mechanical).",
   474→                    "yellow",
   475→                ))
   476→                print(colorize(
   477→                    "  Code fixes alone won't close the gap — run "
   478→                    "`desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import` "
   479→                    "to re-score.",
   480→                    "yellow",
   481→                ))
   482→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   483→            log(f"  subjective bottleneck banner skipped: {exc}")
   484→
   485→    # Integrity penalty/warn lines preserved (anti-gaming safeguard, must remain visible).
   486→    for style, message in followup.integrity_lines:
   487→        print(colorize(f"\n  {message}", style))
   488→
   489→    # Rescan nudge after structural work
   490→    if queue_total > 10:
   491→        print(colorize(
   492→            "\n  Tip: after structural fixes (splitting files, moving code), rescan to "
   493→            "let cascade effects settle: `desloppify scan --path .`",
   494→            "dim",
   495→        ))
   496→
   497→    # Collapsed subjective summary.
   498→    coverage_open, _coverage_reasons, _holistic_reasons = subjective_coverage_breakdown(
   499→        findings_scoped
   500→    )
   501→    parts: list[str] = []
   502→    low_dims = len(followup.low_assessed)
   503→    unassessed_count = len(unassessed_subjective)
   504→    stale_count = sum(1 for e in subjective_entries if e.get("stale"))
   505→    open_review = [
   506→        f for f in findings_scoped.values()
   507→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") == "review"
   508→    ]
   509→    if low_dims:
   510→        parts.append(f"{low_dims} dimension{'s' if low_dims != 1 else ''} below target")
   511→    if stale_count:
   512→        parts.append(f"{stale_count} stale")
   513→    if unassessed_count:
   514→        parts.append(f"{unassessed_count} unassessed")
   515→    if len(open_review):
   516→        parts.append(f"{len(open_review)} review finding{'s' if len(open_review) != 1 else ''} open")
   517→    if coverage_open > 0:
   518→        parts.append(f"{coverage_open} file{'s' if coverage_open != 1 else ''} need review")
   519→
   520→    if parts:
   521→        print(colorize(f"\n  Subjective: {', '.join(parts)}.", "cyan"))
   522→        print(colorize("  Run `desloppify show subjective` for details.", "dim"))
   523→
   524→

    36→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    37→class QueueBuildOptions:
    38→    """Configuration for queue construction."""
    39→
    40→    count: int | None = 1
    41→    scan_path: str | None = None
    42→    scope: str | None = None
    43→    status: str = "open"
    44→    include_subjective: bool = True
    45→    subjective_threshold: float = 100.0

    47→    explain: bool = False
    48→    plan: dict | None = None

    55→class WorkQueueResult(TypedDict):
    56→    """Typed shape of the dict returned by :func:`build_work_queue`."""
    57→
    58→    items: list[dict]
    59→    total: int
    60→    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]]
    61→    new_ids: set[str]

    63→
    64→def build_work_queue(
    65→    state: StateModel,
    66→    *,
    67→    options: QueueBuildOptions | None = None,
    68→) -> WorkQueueResult:
    69→    """Build ranked queue items + tier metadata."""
    70→    resolved_options = options or QueueBuildOptions()
    71→
    72→    status = resolved_options.status
    73→    if status not in ALL_STATUSES:
    74→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported status filter: {status}")
    75→    try:
    76→        subjective_threshold_value = float(resolved_options.subjective_threshold)
    77→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
    78→        subjective_threshold_value = 100.0
    79→    subjective_threshold_value = max(0.0, min(100.0, subjective_threshold_value))
    80→
    81→    finding_items = build_finding_items(
    82→        state,
    83→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
    84→        status_filter=status,
    85→        scope=resolved_options.scope,
    86→        chronic=resolved_options.chronic,
    87→    )
    88→
    89→    all_items = list(finding_items)
    90→
    91→    # Resolve subjective visibility policy for gating
    92→    policy = resolved_options.policy or compute_subjective_visibility(
    93→        state,
    94→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
    95→        plan=resolved_options.plan,
    96→    )
    97→
    98→    if (
    99→        resolved_options.include_subjective
   100→        and status in {"open", "all"}
   101→        and not resolved_options.chronic
   102→    ):
   103→        subjective_items = build_subjective_items(
   104→            state,
   105→            state.get("findings", {}),
   106→            threshold=subjective_threshold_value,
   107→        )
   108→        # When a plan explicitly includes a subjective item in queue_order,
   109→        # surface it regardless of policy — the plan is authoritative.
   110→        plan_queue_set: set[str] = (
   111→            set(resolved_options.plan.get("queue_order", []))
   112→            if resolved_options.plan
   113→            else set()
   114→        )
   115→        for item in subjective_items:
   116→            if not scope_matches(item, resolved_options.scope):
   117→                continue
   118→            # Non-initial subjective items only surface when objective
   119→            # backlog is drained — unless the plan explicitly queued them
   120→            # (e.g. stale dims injected after a completed cycle).
   121→            item_id = item.get("id", "")
   122→            if not policy.should_surface(item) and item_id not in plan_queue_set:
   123→                continue
   124→            all_items.append(item)
   125→
   126→    # Inject triage stage items and workflow items when plan requires it
   127→    if resolved_options.plan and status in {"open", "all"}:
   128→        synth_items = build_triage_stage_items(resolved_options.plan, state)
   129→        all_items.extend(synth_items)
   130→        checkpoint_item = build_score_checkpoint_item(resolved_options.plan, state)
   131→        if checkpoint_item is not None:
   132→            all_items.append(checkpoint_item)
   133→        plan_item = build_create_plan_item(resolved_options.plan)
   134→        if plan_item is not None:
   135→            all_items.append(plan_item)
   136→
   137→    enrich_with_impact(all_items, state.get("dimension_scores", {}))
   138→
   139→    # Impact floor: drop mechanical findings with negligible score impact
   140→    MIN_STANDALONE_IMPACT = 0.05
   141→    all_items = [
   142→        item for item in all_items
   143→        if item.get("kind") != "finding"
   144→        or item.get("is_review")
   145→        or item.get("is_subjective")
   146→        or not item.get("estimated_impact")
   147→        or item["estimated_impact"] >= MIN_STANDALONE_IMPACT
   148→    ]
   149→
   150→    all_items.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   151→
   152→    # Apply living plan ordering if provided
   153→    new_ids: set[str] = set()
   154→    if resolved_options.plan:
   155→        new_ids = _new_item_ids(state)
   156→        all_items = _apply_plan_order(
   157→            all_items,
   158→            resolved_options.plan,
   159→            include_skipped=resolved_options.include_skipped,
   160→            cluster=resolved_options.cluster,
   161→            new_ids=new_ids,
   162→        )
   163→
   164→    # Collapse auto-clusters into meta-items (unless drilling into a cluster)
   165→    should_collapse = (
   166→        resolved_options.collapse_clusters
   167→        and resolved_options.plan
   168→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   169→        and not resolved_options.plan.get("active_cluster")
   170→    )
   171→    if should_collapse:
   172→        all_items = _collapse_clusters(all_items, resolved_options.plan)
   173→
   174→    # Inject "run scan" workflow item when queue is empty and a plan cycle
   175→    # is active (plan_start_scores exist).  This gives the user an explicit
   176→    # next-step rather than a bare "nothing to do" message.
   177→    if not all_items and resolved_options.plan:
   178→        plan_scores = resolved_options.plan.get("plan_start_scores", {})
   179→        if plan_scores.get("strict") is not None:
   180→            all_items.append({
   181→                "id": "workflow::run-scan",
   182→                "kind": "workflow_action",
   183→                "summary": "Queue cleared \u2014 run scan to finalize and reveal your updated score.",
   184→                "primary_command": "desloppify scan",
   185→                "file": "",
   186→                "detector": "workflow",
   187→                "confidence": "high",
   188→            })

   202→        "new_ids": new_ids,
   203→    }

1→"""Helper utilities for work queue item construction."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import re
     6→from fnmatch import fnmatch
     7→
     8→from desloppify.core.enums import finding_status_tokens
     9→from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
    10→from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
    11→    all_subjective_entries,
    12→)
    13→from desloppify.intelligence.integrity import (
    14→    is_holistic_subjective_finding,
    15→    unassessed_subjective_dimensions,
    16→)
    17→from desloppify.scoring import DISPLAY_NAMES
    18→
    19→ALL_STATUSES = set(finding_status_tokens(include_all=True))
    20→ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY = {"auto_fix": 0, "refactor": 1, "manual_fix": 2, "reorganize": 3}
    21→ATTEST_EXAMPLE = (
    22→    "I have actually [DESCRIBE THE CONCRETE CHANGE YOU MADE] "
    23→    "and I am not gaming the score by resolving without fixing."
    24→)
    25→
    26→
    27→def detail_dict(item: dict) -> dict:
    28→    """Return finding detail as a dict; tolerate legacy/non-dict payloads."""
    29→    detail = item.get("detail")
    30→    return detail if isinstance(detail, dict) else {}
    31→
    32→
    33→def status_matches(item_status: str, status_filter: str) -> bool:
    34→    return status_filter == "all" or item_status == status_filter
    35→
    36→
    37→def is_subjective_finding(item: dict) -> bool:
    38→    detector = item.get("detector")
    39→    if detector in {"subjective_assessment"}:
    40→        return True
    41→    if detector == "holistic_review":
    42→        return True
    43→    return False
    44→
    45→
    46→def is_review_finding(item: dict) -> bool:
    47→    return item.get("detector") == "review"
    48→
    49→
    50→def is_subjective_queue_item(item: dict) -> bool:
    51→    """True for subjective work items, including collapsed subjective clusters."""
    52→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
    53→        return True
    54→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
    55→        members = item.get("members", [])
    56→        return bool(members) and all(
    57→            m.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension" for m in members
    58→        )
    59→    return False
    60→
    61→
    62→def review_finding_weight(item: dict) -> float:
    63→    """Return review issue weight aligned with issues list ordering."""
    64→    confidence = str(item.get("confidence", "low")).lower()
    65→    weight_by_confidence = {
    66→        "high": 1.0,
    67→        "medium": 0.7,
    68→        "low": 0.3,
    69→    }
    70→    weight = weight_by_confidence.get(confidence, 0.3)
    71→    if detail_dict(item).get("holistic"):
    72→        weight *= 10.0
    73→    return float(weight)
    74→
    75→
    76→def scope_matches(item: dict, scope: str | None) -> bool:
    77→    """Apply show-style pattern matching against a queue item."""
    78→    if not scope:
    79→        return True
    80→
    81→    item_id = item.get("id", "")
    82→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    83→    filepath = item.get("file", "")
    84→    summary = item.get("summary", "")
    85→    dimension = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
    86→    kind = item.get("kind", "")
    87→
    88→    if "*" in scope:
    89→        return any(
    90→            fnmatch(candidate, scope)
    91→            for candidate in (item_id, filepath, detector, dimension, summary)
    92→        )
    93→
    94→    if "::" in scope:
    95→        return item_id.startswith(scope)
    96→
    97→    lowered = scope.lower()
    98→    if kind == "subjective_dimension":
    99→        return (
   100→            lowered in item_id.lower()
   101→            or lowered in dimension.lower()
   102→            or lowered in summary.lower()
   103→        )
   104→
   105→    # Hash suffix: 8+ hex chars matches the tail segment of a finding ID.
   106→    if len(lowered) >= 8 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]+", lowered):
   107→        return item_id.lower().endswith("::" + lowered)
   108→
   109→    return (
   110→        detector == scope
   111→        or filepath == scope
   112→        or filepath.startswith(scope.rstrip("/") + "/")
   113→    )
   114→
   115→
   116→def slugify(text: str) -> str:
   117→    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", text.lower()).strip("_")
   118→
   119→
   120→def _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(display_name: str) -> str:
   121→    """Map a display label (e.g. 'Mid elegance') to its canonical dimension key."""
   122→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   123→    target = cleaned.lower()
   124→
   125→    for dim_key, label in DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
   126→        if str(label).lower() == target:
   127→            return str(dim_key)
   128→    return slugify(cleaned)
   129→
   130→
   131→def _subjective_dimension_aliases(display_name: str) -> set[str]:
   132→    """Return normalized aliases used to match display labels with finding dimension keys."""
   133→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   134→    canonical = _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(cleaned)
   135→    return {
   136→        cleaned.lower(),
   137→        cleaned.replace(" ", "_").lower(),
   138→        slugify(cleaned),
   139→        canonical.lower(),
   140→        slugify(canonical),
   141→    }
   142→
   143→
   144→def supported_fixers_for_item(state: dict, item: dict) -> set[str] | None:
   145→    """Return supported fixers for an item's language when known."""
   146→    lang = str(item.get("lang", "") or "").strip()
   147→    if not lang:
   148→        return None
   149→
   150→    caps = state.get("lang_capabilities", {})
   151→    if not isinstance(caps, dict):
   152→        return None
   153→
   154→    lang_caps = caps.get(lang, {})
   155→    if not isinstance(lang_caps, dict):
   156→        return None
   157→
   158→    fixers = lang_caps.get("fixers")
   159→    if not isinstance(fixers, list):
   160→        return None
   161→    return {fixer for fixer in fixers if isinstance(fixer, str)}
   162→
   163→
   164→def primary_command_for_finding(
   165→    item: dict, *, supported_fixers: set[str] | None = None
   166→) -> str:
   167→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   168→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   169→    if meta and meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and meta.fixers:
   170→        available_fixers = [
   171→            fixer
   172→            for fixer in meta.fixers
   173→            if supported_fixers is not None and fixer in supported_fixers
   174→        ]
   175→        if available_fixers:
   176→            return f"desloppify autofix {available_fixers[0]} --dry-run"
   177→    if detector == "subjective_review":
   178→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   179→            return "desloppify review --prepare"
   180→        return "desloppify show subjective"
   181→    return f'desloppify plan done "{item.get("id", "")}" --note "<what you did>" --confirm'
   182→
   183→
   184→def build_triage_stage_items(plan: dict, state: dict) -> list[dict]:
   185→    """Build synthetic work items for each ``triage::*`` stage ID in the queue.
   186→
   187→    Returns an empty list when no triage stages are pending.
   188→    """
   189→    from desloppify.app.commands.plan.triage_playbook import (
   190→        TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES,
   191→        TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS,
   192→    )
   193→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
   194→        TRIAGE_IDS,
   195→        TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS,
   196→    )
   197→
   198→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   199→    order_set = set(order)
   200→    present = order_set & TRIAGE_IDS
   201→    if not present:
   202→        return []
   203→
   204→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   205→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   206→
   207→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   208→    open_review_count = sum(
   209→        1 for f in findings.values()
   210→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   211→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   212→    )
   213→
   214→    label_map = dict(TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS)
   215→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   216→
   217→    items: list[dict] = []
   218→    for idx, (sid, name) in enumerate(zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names)):
   219→        if sid not in present:
   220→            continue
   221→        if name in confirmed:
   222→            continue
   223→
   224→        # Compute blocked_by: dependency stages that are still in the queue
   225→        deps = TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())
   226→        blocked_by = sorted(
   227→            f"triage::{dep}" for dep in deps
   228→            if f"triage::{dep}" in present and dep not in confirmed
   229→        )
   230→
   231→        cmd = f"desloppify plan triage --stage {name}"
   232→        if name == "commit":
   233→            cmd = 'desloppify plan triage --complete --strategy "..."'
   234→
   235→        items.append({
   236→            "id": sid,
   237→            "tier": 1,
   238→            "confidence": "high",
   239→            "detector": "triage",
   240→            "file": ".",
   241→            "kind": "workflow_stage",
   242→            "stage_name": name,
   243→            "stage_index": idx,

   257→def build_score_checkpoint_item(plan: dict, state: dict) -> dict | None:
   258→    """Build a synthetic work item for ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` if it's in the queue.

   267→    from desloppify import state as state_mod

   271→    plan_start = (plan.get("plan_start_scores") or {}).get("strict")
   272→    delta = round(strict - plan_start, 1) if plan_start is not None else None

## Bug Analysis Report: Circular Dependency in desloppify review --prepare

Based on my thorough investigation of the desloppify codebase, I've identified a critical circular dependency bug. Here's what I found:

### The Core Problem

When running `desloppify review --prepare --dimensions mid_level_elegance`, the command is blocked with:
```
Blocked: rerun requires drained backlog (objective: 0, subjective: 1).
```

But `desloppify next` tells the user to run this exact command. This is circular - the action that should resolve the issue is blocked by the same issue.

### Root Cause Analysis

The problem lies in the interaction between three components:

#### 1. **Preflight Gate Logic** (`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/review/preflight.py`)

The `review_rerun_preflight()` function (lines 203-269) blocks reruns when:
- A dimension has a prior nonzero score (it's a "rerun", not a first-time review)
- AND there's open backlog work remaining

The key logic (lines 232-245):
```python
blocking_dims = _blocking_scored_dimensions(
    state,
    dimensions=dimensions,
    normalized_dimensions=normalized_dimensions,
)

if blocking_dims:  # Only gate if targeting a previously-scored dimension
    objective_total, subjective_total = _objective_and_subjective_backlog(
        state,
        blocking_dims=blocking_dims,
    )
    if objective_total > 0 or subjective_total > 0:
        # BLOCK
```

#### 2. **Subjective Queue Item Counting** (`_count_open_subjective_queue_items`, lines 68-104)

This function builds a synthetic work queue using `build_work_queue()` with `include_subjective=True`. It then counts only items with `kind == "subjective_dimension"` that:
- Are NOT marked with `stale_review: true` (line 94)
- Match the target dimensions (lines 99-103)

The problem: This counts **all subjective_dimension items in the queue**, which includes items that are **unscored/initial_review items**.

#### 3. **Subjective Item Generation** (`/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/helpers.py`, lines 346-441)

The `build_subjective_items()` function creates synthetic queue items for subjective dimensions. For each dimension with `strict_val < threshold`:
- It creates a `"subjective_dimension"` kind item (line 435)
- It marks it as `"initial_review": is_unassessed` (line 437)
- But it doesn't prevent it from being counted in the preflight check

### Why This Is Circular

1. **State file shows**: `mid_level_elegance` has `score: 50.0` (lines 136-139 of state-typescript.json)
   - This is a **prior score**, so it's a rerun
   
2. **Preflight sees**: `mid_level_elegance` is a scored dimension
   - So it triggers the gate (line 241: `if blocking_dims:`)

3. **When counting subjective backlog**:
   - `build_work_queue()` creates a `subjective_dimension` item for `mid_level_elegance`
   - Why? Because `50.0 < 95.0` (the default threshold in `build_subjective_items`)
   - This synthetic item is not marked `stale_review: true` (only real stale items are)
   - So it counts as 1 open item (line 103)

4. **The gate blocks** because `subjective_total = 1` (line 246 check fails)

5. **Meanwhile, `desloppify next` shows**: "Run `desloppify review --prepare` to re-review"
   - This is from `render_single_item_resolution_hint()` (line 357-358 in render.py)
   - or from `_render_subjective_dimension()` (lines 62-85 in render.py)

6. **Result**: The user is told to run the command, but the command is blocked by its own expected work item.

### Why the Count is 1, Not 110

The state file shows 110 subjective_review findings (as mentioned in your description), but the blocker says `subjective: 1`. Here's why:

- `_count_open_subjective_queue_items()` counts **synthetic subjective_dimension queue items** (items of kind `subjective_dimension`)
- NOT subjective_review findings
- The 110 items are `subjective_review` detector findings (file-level reviews)
- These are different from the synthetic `subjective_dimension` dimension-level items created by `build_subjective_items()`
- When you specify `--dimensions mid_level_elegance`, the count filters down to just items matching that dimension
- Result: 1 synthetic item for mid_level_elegance that's below threshold

### The Key Issue: Wrong Blocking Logic

The preflight assumes that when you're running `--prepare` to address a specific subjective dimension, you need to drain ALL open work for that dimension first. But this is backwards:

- **Initial review** items (unscored dimensions) should NEVER block - they're the work being addressed
- **Stale review** items are already excluded (line 94)
- Only **under-target items** should potentially block, and even then, only when targeting specific dimensions

The current code (line 94) explicitly skips `stale_review` items with comment: `"Stale reruns are not blocking backlog — they ARE the work"`. But it should apply the same logic to **initial_review** items when specifically targeting a dimension.

### Evidence from Tests

The test file (`test_review_preflight.py`, line 271-282) confirms this: when targeting only **unscored** dimensions, the gate is skipped entirely:

```python
def test_targeting_only_unscored_dims_skips_gate():
    """--dimensions targeting only unscored dimensions bypasses the gate."""
```

But the reverse doesn't work: when a dimension IS scored (like mid_level_elegance at 50%), targeting it still blocks even though the item being counted is the item you're about to resolve.

### Summary of the Circular Dependency

| Component | State | Problem |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `desloppify next` | Shows "Run `review --prepare`" | Suggests action that seems needed |
| `desloppify review --prepare` | Blocked by subjective:1 | Blocks on the exact item being targeted for review |
| State: mid_level_elegance | Score 50.0 (below 95% target) | Triggers rerun gate (has prior score) |
| Work queue: mid_level_elegance | Creates synthetic item | Item counts toward backlog in preflight |
| Preflight gate | Blocks reruns with backlog | Considers the synthetic queue item as "blocking backlog" |

This is a **logic error**: when specifically targeting a dimension with `--dimensions`, the preflight should not count the synthetic item for that dimension as "blocking backlog" if it's the initial/unscored item being prepared for review. The item being prepared TO REVIEW should not block review preparation.

### Files Involved

1. **Root cause**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/review/preflight.py` - lines 68-104, 124-141
   - Function `_count_open_subjective_queue_items()` counts queue items without considering that initial_review items should not block when specifically targeted

2. **Related**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/helpers.py` - lines 346-441
   - Function `build_subjective_items()` creates the synthetic items without a flag to indicate they're actionable work for --prepare

3. **Related**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/next.py` - lines 170-276
   - Function `_get_items()` builds queue for display without knowledge that these items will block rerun_preflight

4. **Related**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/next_parts/render.py` - lines 62-85, 341-359
   - Functions render the "Run review --prepare" action without checking if it will actually succeed

5. **Tests**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests/commands/test_review_preflight.py`
   - Tests confirm the gate logic but don't test the specific circular case: targeting an unscored dimension that's being prepared

     3→  reportError,
     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}
    30→

    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };

    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {

1→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import {
     3→  isMobileUA as isMobileUaSignal,
     4→  useIsMobile as useIsMobileSignal,
     5→  useIsTablet as useIsTabletSignal,
     6→  useIsTouchDevice as useIsTouchDeviceSignal,
     7→} from './deviceSignals';
     8→import { useDeviceInfo as useDeviceInfoSignal } from './responsiveViewModel';
     9→
    10→export const isMobileUA = isMobileUaSignal;
    11→
    12→/** App-facing mobile signal with a defensive fallback for non-browser runtimes. */
    13→export function useIsMobile() {
    14→  const detected = useIsMobileSignal();
    15→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    16→    return false;
    17→  }
    18→  return detected ?? window.innerWidth < 768;
    19→}
    20→
    21→/** App-facing tablet signal with a defensive fallback for non-browser runtimes. */
    22→export function useIsTablet() {
    23→  const detected = useIsTabletSignal();
    24→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    25→    return false;
    26→  }
    27→  return detected ?? (window.innerWidth >= 768 && window.innerWidth < 1024);
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** App-facing touch capability signal with runtime fallback for browser environments. */
    31→export function useIsTouchDevice() {
    32→  const detected = useIsTouchDeviceSignal();
    33→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    34→    return false;
    35→  }
    36→  if (detected !== undefined) {
    37→    return detected;
    38→  }
    39→  return 'ontouchstart' in window || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;
    40→}
    41→
    42→/** Composite device view model with normalized base signals from this public module. */
    43→export function useDeviceInfo() {
    44→  const viewModel = useDeviceInfoSignal();
    45→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
    46→  const isTablet = useIsTablet();
    47→  const isTouchDevice = useIsTouchDevice();
    48→
    49→  return useMemo(() => ({
    50→    ...viewModel,
    51→    isTablet,
    52→    isPhone: isMobile && !isTablet,
    53→    isTouchDevice,
    54→  }), [viewModel, isMobile, isTablet, isTouchDevice]);
    55→}
    56→

1→import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { useDeleteGeneration } from '@/domains/generation/hooks/useGenerationMutations';
     3→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     4→
     5→interface UseDeleteGenerationActionResult {
     6→  pendingDeleteId: string | null;
     7→  deletingId: string | null;
     8→  isPending: boolean;
     9→  requestDelete: (id: string) => void;
    10→  cancelDelete: () => void;
    11→  confirmDelete: () => Promise<void>;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseDeleteGenerationActionOptions {
    15→  projectId: string | null | undefined;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteGenerationAction({
    19→  projectId,
    20→}: UseDeleteGenerationActionOptions): UseDeleteGenerationActionResult {
    21→  const deleteGenerationMutation = useDeleteGeneration();
    22→  const [pendingDeleteId, setPendingDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    23→  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    24→
    25→  const requestDelete = useCallback((id: string) => {
    26→    setPendingDeleteId(id);
    27→  }, []);
    28→
    29→  const cancelDelete = useCallback(() => {
    30→    setPendingDeleteId(null);
    31→  }, []);
    32→
    33→  const confirmDelete = useCallback(async () => {
    34→    if (!pendingDeleteId || !projectId) {
    35→      setPendingDeleteId(null);
    36→      return;
    37→    }
    38→
    39→    const targetId = pendingDeleteId;
    40→    setDeletingId(targetId);
    41→    try {
    42→      await deleteGenerationMutation.mutateAsync({ id: targetId, projectId });
    43→      setPendingDeleteId((current) => (current === targetId ? null : current));
    44→    } catch (error) {
    45→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    46→        context: 'useDeleteGenerationAction.confirmDelete',
    47→        toastTitle: 'Delete failed',
    48→      });
    49→      // Keep the dialog open so users can retry or cancel after a failed delete.
    50→    } finally {
    51→      setDeletingId((current) => (current === targetId ? null : current));
    52→    }
    53→  }, [deleteGenerationMutation, pendingDeleteId, projectId]);
    54→
    55→  return {
    56→    pendingDeleteId,
    57→    deletingId,
    58→    isPending: deleteGenerationMutation.isPending,
    59→    requestDelete,
    60→    cancelDelete,
    61→    confirmDelete,
    62→  };
    63→}
    64→

    24→
    25→export interface ResourceBrowserData {

    43→  handleResourceClick: (resource: Resource) => Promise<void>;
    44→  clearSearch: () => void;
    45→}
    46→
    47→const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 16;
    48→
    49→export function useResourceBrowserData({
    50→  isOpen,
    51→  resourceType,
    52→  onOpenChange,
    53→  onImageSelect,
    54→  onResourceSelect,
    55→}: UseResourceBrowserDataProps): ResourceBrowserData {
    56→  const isVideoMode = resourceType === 'structure-video';
    57→
    58→  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    59→  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
    60→  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
    61→  const [processingResource, setProcessingResource] = useState<string | null>(null);
    62→  const [loadedThumbnails, setLoadedThumbnails] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    63→  const [showMyResourcesOnly, setShowMyResourcesOnly] = useState(false);
    64→
    65→  // Reset to page 1 synchronously when filter changes (avoids extra render from useEffect+setState)
    66→  const prevShowMyResourcesOnlyRef = React.useRef(showMyResourcesOnly);
    67→  if (prevShowMyResourcesOnlyRef.current !== showMyResourcesOnly) {
    68→    prevShowMyResourcesOnlyRef.current = showMyResourcesOnly;
    69→    setCurrentPage(1);
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  useEffect(() => {
    73→    if (!isOpen) {
    74→      return;
    75→    }
    76→
    77→    const getUser = async () => {
    78→      const {
    79→        data: { session },
    80→      } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
    81→      setUserId(session?.user?.id || null);
    82→    };
    83→
    84→    void getUser();
    85→  }, [isOpen]);
    86→
    87→  useEffect(() => {
    88→    if (!isOpen) {
    89→      setProcessingResource(null);
    90→      setLoadedThumbnails(new Set());
    91→    }
    92→  }, [isOpen]);
    93→
    94→  const publicResources = useListPublicResources(resourceType);
    95→  const myResources = useListResources(resourceType);
    96→  const updateResource = useUpdateResource();
    97→
    98→  const allResources = useMemo(() => {
    99→    const publicRefs = (publicResources.data || []) as Resource[];
   100→    const ownRefs = (myResources.data || []) as Resource[];
   101→    const combined = [...publicRefs];
   102→    const publicIds = new Set(publicRefs.map((resource) => resource.id));
   103→
   104→    ownRefs.forEach((resource) => {
   105→      if (!publicIds.has(resource.id)) {
   106→        combined.push(resource);
   107→      }
   108→    });
   109→
   110→    return combined;
   111→  }, [myResources.data, publicResources.data]);
   112→
   113→  const getSearchableText = useCallback(
   114→    (resource: Resource): string => {
   115→      if (isVideoMode) {
   116→        const metadata = resource.metadata as StructureVideoMetadata;
   117→        return metadata.name?.toLowerCase() || '';
   118→      }
   119→
   120→      const metadata = resource.metadata as StyleReferenceMetadata;
   121→      return [metadata.name, metadata.subjectDescription, metadata.styleBoostTerms]
   122→        .filter(Boolean)
   123→        .join(' ')
   124→        .toLowerCase();
   125→    },
   126→    [isVideoMode]
   127→  );
   128→
   129→  const filteredResources = useMemo(() => {
   130→    const base = showMyResourcesOnly ? ((myResources.data || []) as Resource[]) : allResources;
   131→    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
   132→      return base;
   133→    }
   134→
   135→    const lowerSearch = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
   136→    return base.filter((resource) => getSearchableText(resource).includes(lowerSearch));
   137→  }, [allResources, getSearchableText, myResources.data, searchTerm, showMyResourcesOnly]);
   138→
   139→  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredResources.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
   140→
   141→  const paginatedResources = useMemo(() => {
   142→    const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
   143→    return filteredResources.slice(startIndex, startIndex + ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
   144→  }, [currentPage, filteredResources]);
   145→
   146→  const loading = publicResources.isLoading || myResources.isLoading;
   147→
   148→  const handleSearch = useCallback((newSearchTerm: string) => {
   149→    setSearchTerm(newSearchTerm);
   150→    setCurrentPage(1);
   151→  }, []);
   152→
   153→  const handlePageChange = useCallback((newPage: number) => {
   154→    setCurrentPage(newPage);
   155→  }, []);
   156→
   157→  const handleToggleVisibility = useCallback(
   158→    async (resourceId: string, currentIsPublic: boolean) => {
   159→      const resource = allResources.find((entry) => entry.id === resourceId);
   160→      if (!resource) {
   161→        console.error('[ResourceBrowser] Could not find resource:', resourceId);
   162→        return;
   163→      }
   164→
   165→      try {
   166→        const metadataObject =
   167→          typeof resource.metadata === 'object' &&
   168→          resource.metadata !== null &&
   169→          !Array.isArray(resource.metadata)
   170→            ? (resource.metadata as Record<string, unknown>)
   171→            : {};
   172→        const updatedMetadata = { ...metadataObject, is_public: !currentIsPublic };
   173→        await updateResource.mutateAsync({
   174→          id: resourceId,
   175→          type: resourceType,
   176→          metadata: updatedMetadata as ResourceMetadata,
   177→        });
   178→      } catch (error) {
   179→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   180→          context: 'ResourceBrowser',
   181→          toastTitle: 'Failed to update visibility',
   182→        });
   183→      }
   184→    },
   185→    [allResources, resourceType, updateResource]
   186→  );
   187→
   188→  const handleResourceClick = useCallback(

   192→      }
   193→
   194→      setProcessingResource(resource.id);
   195→

   207→          const file = await processImageUrl(imageUrl, filename);
   208→          onImageSelect([file]);

   211→      } catch (error) {
   212→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   213→          context: 'ResourceBrowser',
   214→          toastTitle: 'Failed to process selected resource',
   215→        });
   216→      } finally {

   218→      }
   219→    },
   220→    [isVideoMode, onImageSelect, onOpenChange, onResourceSelect, processingResource]
   221→  );
   222→
   223→  const clearSearch = useCallback(() => {
   224→    setSearchTerm('');
   225→    setCurrentPage(1);
   226→  }, []);
   227→
   228→  const isThumbnailLoaded = useCallback(
   229→    (id: string) => loadedThumbnails.has(id),
   230→    [loadedThumbnails]
   231→  );
   232→
   233→  const markThumbnailLoaded = useCallback((id: string) => {
   234→    setLoadedThumbnails((previous) => new Set(previous).add(id));
   235→  }, []);
   236→
   237→  const toggleMyResourcesFilter = useCallback(() => {
   238→    setShowMyResourcesOnly((previous) => !previous);
   239→  }, []);
   240→
   241→  const clearMyResourcesFilter = useCallback(() => {
   242→    setShowMyResourcesOnly(false);
   243→  }, []);
   244→
   245→  return {
   246→    isVideoMode,
   247→    userId,
   248→    searchTerm,
   249→    currentPage,
   250→    processingResource,
   251→    isThumbnailLoaded,
   252→    markThumbnailLoaded,
   253→    showMyResourcesOnly,
   254→    toggleMyResourcesFilter,
   255→    clearMyResourcesFilter,
   256→    filteredResources,
   257→    paginatedResources,
   258→    totalPages,
   259→    loading,
   260→    handleSearch,
   261→    handlePageChange,
   262→    handleToggleVisibility,
   263→    handleResourceClick,
   264→    clearSearch,
   265→  };
   266→}

1→import type { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import {
     3→  reportError,
     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}
    30→

1→/** @publicContract Supabase browser runtime entrypoint. */
     2→
     3→import {
     4→  type SupabaseClientAccessResult,
     5→  getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult,
     6→  initializeSupabaseClientRuntime,
     7→  normalizeSupabaseError,
     8→} from '@/integrations/supabase/runtime/supabaseRuntime';
     9→
    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };
    11→
    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }
    46→  return result.client;
    47→}

1→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import {
     3→  isMobileUA as isMobileUaSignal,
     4→  useIsMobile as useIsMobileSignal,
     5→  useIsTablet as useIsTabletSignal,
     6→  useIsTouchDevice as useIsTouchDeviceSignal,
     7→} from './deviceSignals';
     8→import { useDeviceInfo as useDeviceInfoSignal } from './responsiveViewModel';
     9→
    10→export const isMobileUA = isMobileUaSignal;
    11→
    12→/** App-facing mobile signal with a defensive fallback for non-browser runtimes. */
    13→export function useIsMobile() {
    14→  const detected = useIsMobileSignal();
    15→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    16→    return false;
    17→  }
    18→  return detected ?? window.innerWidth < 768;
    19→}
    20→
    21→/** App-facing tablet signal with a defensive fallback for non-browser runtimes. */
    22→export function useIsTablet() {
    23→  const detected = useIsTabletSignal();
    24→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    25→    return false;
    26→  }
    27→  return detected ?? (window.innerWidth >= 768 && window.innerWidth < 1024);
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** App-facing touch capability signal with runtime fallback for browser environments. */
    31→export function useIsTouchDevice() {
    32→  const detected = useIsTouchDeviceSignal();
    33→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    34→    return false;
    35→  }
    36→  if (detected !== undefined) {
    37→    return detected;
    38→  }
    39→  return 'ontouchstart' in window || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;
    40→}
    41→
    42→/** Composite device view model with normalized base signals from this public module. */
    43→export function useDeviceInfo() {
    44→  const viewModel = useDeviceInfoSignal();
    45→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
    46→  const isTablet = useIsTablet();
    47→  const isTouchDevice = useIsTouchDevice();
    48→
    49→  return useMemo(() => ({
    50→    ...viewModel,
    51→    isTablet,
    52→    isPhone: isMobile && !isTablet,
    53→    isTouchDevice,
    54→  }), [viewModel, isMobile, isTablet, isTouchDevice]);
    55→}
    56→

1→const EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
     2→const STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
     3→
     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {
    17→    return input.url;
    18→  }
    19→  return String(input);
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    91→  const { signal, cleanup } = composeAbortSignals(
    92→    controller.signal,
    93→    callerSignal,
    94→  );
    95→
    96→  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal }).finally(() => {
    97→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    98→    cleanup();
    99→  });
   100→}
   101→

    37→  paginatedResources: Resource[];
    38→  totalPages: number;
    39→  loading: boolean;
    40→  handleSearch: (newSearchTerm: string) => void;
    41→  handlePageChange: (newPage: number) => void;
    42→  handleToggleVisibility: (resourceId: string, currentIsPublic: boolean) => Promise<void>;
    43→  handleResourceClick: (resource: Resource) => Promise<void>;
    44→  clearSearch: () => void;
    45→}
    46→
    47→const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 16;
    48→
    49→export function useResourceBrowserData({
    50→  isOpen,
    51→  resourceType,
    52→  onOpenChange,
    53→  onImageSelect,
    54→  onResourceSelect,
    55→}: UseResourceBrowserDataProps): ResourceBrowserData {
    56→  const isVideoMode = resourceType === 'structure-video';
    57→
    58→  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    59→  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
    60→  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
    61→  const [processingResource, setProcessingResource] = useState<string | null>(null);
    62→  const [loadedThumbnails, setLoadedThumbnails] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    63→  const [showMyResourcesOnly, setShowMyResourcesOnly] = useState(false);
    64→
    65→  // Reset to page 1 synchronously when filter changes (avoids extra render from useEffect+setState)
    66→  const prevShowMyResourcesOnlyRef = React.useRef(showMyResourcesOnly);
    67→  if (prevShowMyResourcesOnlyRef.current !== showMyResourcesOnly) {
    68→    prevShowMyResourcesOnlyRef.current = showMyResourcesOnly;
    69→    setCurrentPage(1);
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  useEffect(() => {
    73→    if (!isOpen) {
    74→      return;
    75→    }
    76→
    77→    const getUser = async () => {
    78→      const {
    79→        data: { session },
    80→      } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
    81→      setUserId(session?.user?.id || null);
    82→    };
    83→
    84→    void getUser();
    85→  }, [isOpen]);
    86→
    87→  useEffect(() => {
    88→    if (!isOpen) {
    89→      setProcessingResource(null);
    90→      setLoadedThumbnails(new Set());
    91→    }
    92→  }, [isOpen]);
    93→
    94→  const publicResources = useListPublicResources(resourceType);
    95→  const myResources = useListResources(resourceType);
    96→  const updateResource = useUpdateResource();
    97→
    98→  const allResources = useMemo(() => {
    99→    const publicRefs = (publicResources.data || []) as Resource[];
   100→    const ownRefs = (myResources.data || []) as Resource[];
   101→    const combined = [...publicRefs];
   102→    const publicIds = new Set(publicRefs.map((resource) => resource.id));
   103→
   104→    ownRefs.forEach((resource) => {
   105→      if (!publicIds.has(resource.id)) {
   106→        combined.push(resource);
   107→      }
   108→    });
   109→
   110→    return combined;
   111→  }, [myResources.data, publicResources.data]);
   112→
   113→  const getSearchableText = useCallback(
   114→    (resource: Resource): string => {
   115→      if (isVideoMode) {
   116→        const metadata = resource.metadata as StructureVideoMetadata;
   117→        return metadata.name?.toLowerCase() || '';
   118→      }
   119→
   120→      const metadata = resource.metadata as StyleReferenceMetadata;
   121→      return [metadata.name, metadata.subjectDescription, metadata.styleBoostTerms]
   122→        .filter(Boolean)
   123→        .join(' ')
   124→        .toLowerCase();
   125→    },
   126→    [isVideoMode]
   127→  );
   128→
   129→  const filteredResources = useMemo(() => {
   130→    const base = showMyResourcesOnly ? ((myResources.data || []) as Resource[]) : allResources;
   131→    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
   132→      return base;
   133→    }
   134→
   135→    const lowerSearch = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
   136→    return base.filter((resource) => getSearchableText(resource).includes(lowerSearch));
   137→  }, [allResources, getSearchableText, myResources.data, searchTerm, showMyResourcesOnly]);
   138→
   139→  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredResources.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
   140→
   141→  const paginatedResources = useMemo(() => {
   142→    const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
   143→    return filteredResources.slice(startIndex, startIndex + ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
   144→  }, [currentPage, filteredResources]);
   145→
   146→  const loading = publicResources.isLoading || myResources.isLoading;
   147→
   148→  const handleSearch = useCallback((newSearchTerm: string) => {
   149→    setSearchTerm(newSearchTerm);
   150→    setCurrentPage(1);
   151→  }, []);
   152→
   153→  const handlePageChange = useCallback((newPage: number) => {
   154→    setCurrentPage(newPage);
   155→  }, []);
   156→
   157→  const handleToggleVisibility = useCallback(
   158→    async (resourceId: string, currentIsPublic: boolean) => {
   159→      const resource = allResources.find((entry) => entry.id === resourceId);
   160→      if (!resource) {
   161→        console.error('[ResourceBrowser] Could not find resource:', resourceId);
   162→        return;
   163→      }
   164→
   165→      try {
   166→        const metadataObject =
   167→          typeof resource.metadata === 'object' &&
   168→          resource.metadata !== null &&
   169→          !Array.isArray(resource.metadata)
   170→            ? (resource.metadata as Record<string, unknown>)
   171→            : {};
   172→        const updatedMetadata = { ...metadataObject, is_public: !currentIsPublic };
   173→        await updateResource.mutateAsync({
   174→          id: resourceId,
   175→          type: resourceType,
   176→          metadata: updatedMetadata as ResourceMetadata,
   177→        });
   178→      } catch (error) {
   179→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   180→          context: 'ResourceBrowser',
   181→          toastTitle: 'Failed to update visibility',
   182→        });
   183→      }
   184→    },
   185→    [allResources, resourceType, updateResource]
   186→  );
   187→
   188→  const handleResourceClick = useCallback(
   189→    async (resource: Resource) => {
   190→      if (processingResource) {
   191→        return;
   192→      }
   193→
   194→      setProcessingResource(resource.id);
   195→
   196→      try {
   197→        if (onResourceSelect) {
   198→          onResourceSelect(resource);
   199→          onOpenChange(false);
   200→          return;
   201→        }
   202→
   203→        if (onImageSelect && !isVideoMode) {
   204→          const metadata = resource.metadata as StyleReferenceMetadata;
   205→          const imageUrl = metadata.styleReferenceImageOriginal;
   206→          const filename = `${metadata.name.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_')}.png`;
   207→          const file = await processImageUrl(imageUrl, filename);
   208→          onImageSelect([file]);
   209→          onOpenChange(false);
   210→        }
   211→      } catch (error) {
   212→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   213→          context: 'ResourceBrowser',
   214→          toastTitle: 'Failed to process selected resource',
   215→        });
   216→      } finally {
   217→        setProcessingResource(null);
   218→      }
   219→    },
   220→    [isVideoMode, onImageSelect, onOpenChange, onResourceSelect, processingResource]
   221→  );
   222→
   223→  const clearSearch = useCallback(() => {
   224→    setSearchTerm('');
   225→    setCurrentPage(1);
   226→  }, []);
   227→
   228→  const isThumbnailLoaded = useCallback(
   229→    (id: string) => loadedThumbnails.has(id),
   230→    [loadedThumbnails]
   231→  );
   232→
   233→  const markThumbnailLoaded = useCallback((id: string) => {
   234→    setLoadedThumbnails((previous) => new Set(previous).add(id));
   235→  }, []);
   236→
   237→  const toggleMyResourcesFilter = useCallback(() => {
   238→    setShowMyResourcesOnly((previous) => !previous);
   239→  }, []);
   240→
   241→  const clearMyResourcesFilter = useCallback(() => {
   242→    setShowMyResourcesOnly(false);
   243→  }, []);
   244→
   245→  return {
   246→    isVideoMode,
   247→    userId,
   248→    searchTerm,
   249→    currentPage,
   250→    processingResource,
   251→    isThumbnailLoaded,
   252→    markThumbnailLoaded,
   253→    showMyResourcesOnly,
   254→    toggleMyResourcesFilter,
   255→    clearMyResourcesFilter,
   256→    filteredResources,
   257→    paginatedResources,
   258→    totalPages,
   259→    loading,
   260→    handleSearch,
   261→    handlePageChange,
   262→    handleToggleVisibility,
   263→    handleResourceClick,
   264→    clearSearch,
   265→  };
   266→}
   267→
