1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→
     3→export type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
     4→export type SettingsScopeTableName = 'users' | 'projects' | 'shots';
     5→
     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';
    12→    case 'shot':
    13→      return 'shots';
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  throw new Error(`Invalid settings scope: ${String(scope)}`);
    17→}
    18→
    19→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    20→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    21→  return getSupabaseClient()
    22→    .from(tableName)
    23→    .select('settings')
    24→    .eq('id', id)
    25→    .single();
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc(
    29→  tableName: SettingsScopeTableName,
    30→  id: string,
    31→  toolId: string,
    32→  settings: Record<string, unknown>,
    33→) {
    34→  return getSupabaseClient().rpc('update_tool_settings_atomic', {
    35→    p_table_name: tableName,
    36→    p_id: id,
    37→    p_tool_id: toolId,
    38→    p_settings: settings,
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→

   259→function useConstellationAnimation(canvasRef: RefObject<HTMLCanvasElement>): void {
   260→  const starsRef = useRef<Star[]>([]);
   261→  const wanderingGroupsRef = useRef<WanderingGroup[]>([]);
   262→  const wanderingFadeInRef = useRef({ startTime: 0 });
   263→  const animationFrameRef = useRef<number>();
   264→  const mouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   265→  const smoothMouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   266→  const dimensionsRef = useRef({ width: 0, height: 0 });
   267→
   268→  useEffect(() => {
   269→    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
   270→    if (!canvas) return;
   271→
   272→    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
   273→    if (!context) return;
   274→
   275→    const initializeScene = () => {
   276→      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
   277→      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
   278→
   279→      dimensionsRef.current = { width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height };
   280→      mouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   281→      smoothMouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   282→
   283→      starsRef.current = initializeStars(canvas.width, canvas.height);
   284→      wanderingGroupsRef.current = createWanderingGroups(
   285→        canvas.width,
   286→        canvas.height,
   287→        performance.now()
   288→      );
   289→      wanderingFadeInRef.current = { startTime: performance.now() };
   290→    };
   291→
   292→    const handleMouseMove = (event: MouseEvent) => {
   293→      mouseRef.current = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
   294→    };
   295→
   296→    const drawFrame = (time: number) => {
   297→      context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   298→
   299→      const lerpFactor = 0.05;
   300→      smoothMouseRef.current.x += (mouseRef.current.x - smoothMouseRef.current.x) * lerpFactor;
   301→      smoothMouseRef.current.y += (mouseRef.current.y - smoothMouseRef.current.y) * lerpFactor;
   302→
   303→      const parallaxX =
   304→        (smoothMouseRef.current.x - dimensionsRef.current.width / 2) * 0.02;
   305→      const parallaxY =
   306→        (smoothMouseRef.current.y - dimensionsRef.current.height / 2) * 0.02;
   307→
   308→      updateAndDrawStars(
   309→        context,
   310→        canvas,
   311→        starsRef.current,
   312→        parallaxX,
   313→        parallaxY,
   314→        time
   315→      );
   316→
   317→      const now = performance.now();
   318→      const masterOpacity = calculateWanderingMasterOpacity(
   319→        wanderingFadeInRef.current.startTime,
   320→        now
   321→      );
   322→
   323→      if (masterOpacity > 0) {
   324→        updateAndDrawWanderingGroups(
   325→          context,
   326→          canvas,
   327→          wanderingGroupsRef.current,
   328→          now,
   329→          time,
   330→          masterOpacity
   331→        );
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   335→    };
   336→
   337→    initializeScene();
   338→
   339→    window.addEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   340→    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   341→    animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   342→
   343→    return () => {
   344→      window.removeEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   345→      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   346→
   347→      if (animationFrameRef.current) {
   348→        cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameRef.current);
   349→      }
   350→    };
   351→  }, [canvasRef]);
   352→}
   353→
   354→export const ConstellationCanvas = () => {
   355→  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
   356→
   357→  useConstellationAnimation(canvasRef);
   358→
   359→  return (
   360→    <canvas
   361→      ref={canvasRef}
   362→      className="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none"
   363→      style={{
   364→        zIndex: 3,
   365→        mixBlendMode: 'screen',
   366→        opacity: 0.6,
   367→      }}
   368→    />
   369→  );
   370→};

1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→

1→export const fileToDataURL = (file: File): Promise<string> =>
     2→  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     3→    const reader = new FileReader();
     4→    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
     5→    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
     6→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
     7→  });
     8→
     9→export const dataURLtoFile = (
    10→  dataUrl: string,
    11→  filename: string,
    12→  fileType?: string
    13→): File | null => {
    14→  try {
    15→    const [metadata, payload] = dataUrl.split(',');
    16→    if (!metadata || !payload) {
    17→      throw new Error('Invalid Data URL format');
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    const mimeMatch = metadata.match(/:(.*?);/);
    21→    const mimeType =
    22→      fileType ||
    23→      (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) ||
    24→      'application/octet-stream';
    25→    const decodedPayload = atob(payload);
    26→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(decodedPayload.length);
    27→
    28→    for (let i = 0; i < decodedPayload.length; i += 1) {
    29→      bytes[i] = decodedPayload.charCodeAt(i);
    30→    }
    31→
    32→    return new File([bytes], filename, { type: mimeType });
    33→  } catch {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→};
    37→

1→import type { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import {

     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}

     2→import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
     6→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     7→import { isTaskDbRow, mapTaskDbRowToTask } from '@/shared/lib/taskRowMapper';
     8→import {
     9→  getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations,
    10→  toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    11→  type GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    12→  type GenerationTaskMappingStatus,
    13→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    14→
    15→interface PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions {
    16→  batchSize?: number;
    17→  delayBetweenBatches?: number;
    18→  preloadFullTaskData?: boolean;
    19→  projectId?: string;
    20→}
    21→
    22→export interface GenerationWithTaskData extends GenerationRow {
    23→  taskId?: string | null;
    24→  taskData?: Task | null;
    25→  taskMappingStatus?: GenerationTaskMappingStatus;
    26→  taskMappingError?: string;
    27→}
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    31→ */
    32→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    33→  generationIds: string[],
    34→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    35→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    36→) {
    37→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    38→  const {
    39→    batchSize = 5,
    40→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    41→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    42→    projectId,
    43→  } = options;
    44→
    45→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    46→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    47→
    48→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId });
    49→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    50→
    51→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    52→
    53→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    54→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    55→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    56→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    57→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    58→        cacheEntry,
    59→      );
    60→
    61→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    62→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    63→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    64→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    65→          showToast: false,
    66→        });
    67→      }
    68→
    69→      if (preloadFullTaskData && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    70→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    71→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId),
    72→          queryFn: async () => {
    73→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    74→              .from('tasks')
    75→              .select('*')
    76→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    77→              .single();
    78→
    79→            if (error) throw error;
    80→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    81→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    82→            }
    83→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    84→          },
    85→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    86→        }));
    87→      }
    88→    });
    89→
    90→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
    91→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
    92→    }
    93→
    94→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
    95→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
    96→    }
    97→  }
    98→}
    99→
   100→/**
   101→ * Enhance generations with task data from cache.
   102→ */
   103→export function enhanceGenerationsWithTaskData(
   104→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   105→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   106→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   107→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   108→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   109→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   110→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   111→    );
   112→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   113→    const taskData = taskId ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId)) : null;
   114→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   115→
   116→    return {
   117→      ...generation,
   118→      taskId,
   119→      taskData,
   120→      taskMappingStatus,
   121→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   122→    };
   123→  });
   124→}

1→const EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
     2→const STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
     3→
     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {
    17→    return input.url;
    18→  }
    19→  return String(input);
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    91→  const { signal, cleanup } = composeAbortSignals(
    92→    controller.signal,
    93→    callerSignal,
    94→  );
    95→
    96→  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal }).finally(() => {
    97→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    98→    cleanup();
    99→  });
   100→}
   101→

     3→export type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';

     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';

    13→      return 'shots';

    19→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    20→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    21→  return getSupabaseClient()
    22→    .from(tableName)
    23→    .select('settings')
    24→    .eq('id', id)
    25→    .single();
    26→}

    52→export function buildStructureVideoForTask(

   151→function buildSubmitParamsBuilder(

   156→  return (prompt: string, enhancedPromptParam?: string) => {
   157→    return buildTaskParams(
   158→      { ...effectiveSettings, prompt },
   159→      {
   160→        projectId: task.projectId,

   162→        generationId: task.generationId,

   174→        structureVideo: task.structureVideo,
   175→      },

   177→  };
   178→}

   180→function applyPromptAffixes(settings: EffectiveSettings, prompt: string): string {
   181→  return joinPromptParts(

   184→  );
   185→}

   188→  const result = await createIndividualTravelSegmentTask(taskParams);
   189→  if (!result.task_id) {

   192→  return result.task_id;

   270→      temperature: 0.7,
   271→      numFrames: runtime.effectiveSettings.numFrames || defaultNumFrames,
   272→    },
   273→  });
   274→
   275→  if (enhanceError) {
   276→    runtime.reportNonFatalError?.('enhance_prompt', enhanceError);
   277→    normalizeAndPresentError(enhanceError, {
   278→      context: `${runtime.errorContext}.enhancePrompt`,
   279→      showToast: false,
   280→    });
   281→  }
   282→
   283→  return enhanceResult?.enhanced_prompt?.trim() || promptToEnhance;
   284→}
   285→
   286→async function submitEnhancedSegmentTask(
   287→  runtime: SubmitSegmentRuntime,
   288→  promptToEnhance: string,
   289→  defaultNumFrames: number,
   290→): Promise<string> {
   291→  await maybeSaveSettings(runtime);
   292→
   293→  const enhancedPromptResult = await enhanceSegmentPrompt(runtime, promptToEnhance, defaultNumFrames);
   294→  const originalPrompt = runtime.effectiveSettings.prompt?.trim() || '';
   295→  const originalPromptWithAffixes = applyPromptAffixes(runtime.effectiveSettings, originalPrompt);
   296→  const enhancedPromptWithAffixes = applyPromptAffixes(runtime.effectiveSettings, enhancedPromptResult);
   297→
   298→  await saveEnhancedPromptMetadata(
   299→    runtime,
   300→    runtime.task,
   301→    runtime.queryClient,
   302→    enhancedPromptResult,
   303→    promptToEnhance,
   304→    originalPrompt,
   305→  );
   306→
   307→  const taskParams = runtime.buildParams(originalPromptWithAffixes, enhancedPromptWithAffixes);
   308→  return createTaskOrThrow(taskParams);
   309→}
   310→
   311→/**
   312→ * Submit a segment task, handling both enhanced and standard prompt paths.
   313→ * Uses the task placeholder runner for lifecycle management.
   314→ * Returns immediately — task creation runs in the background (fire-and-forget).
   315→ */
   316→export function submitSegmentTask(input: SubmitSegmentTaskInput): void {
   317→  const {
   318→    taskLabel,
   319→    errorContext,
   320→    getSettings,
   321→    saveSettings,
   322→    shouldSaveSettings,
   323→    shouldEnhance,
   324→    enhancedPrompt,
   325→    defaultNumFrames,
   326→    images,
   327→    task,
   328→    run,
   329→    queryClient,
   330→    onGenerateStarted,
   331→    onNonFatalError,
   332→  } = input;
   333→
   334→  const effectiveSettings = getSettings();
   335→  const promptToEnhance = enhancedPrompt?.trim() || effectiveSettings.prompt?.trim() || '';
   336→  const buildParams = buildSubmitParamsBuilder(effectiveSettings, task, images);
   337→
   338→  // Notify parent for optimistic UI
   339→  onGenerateStarted?.();
   340→
   341→  const runtime: SubmitSegmentRuntime = {
   342→    errorContext,
   343→    shouldSaveSettings,
   344→    saveSettings,
   345→    effectiveSettings,
   346→    task,
   347→    queryClient,
   348→    buildParams,
   349→    reportNonFatalError: onNonFatalError,
   350→  };
   351→
   352→  // Fire and forget — run() handles add/resolve/refetch/remove/error lifecycle
   353→  void run({
   354→    taskType: 'individual_travel_segment',
   355→    label: taskLabel,
   356→    context: errorContext,
   357→    toastTitle: 'Failed to create task',
   358→    create: async () => {
   359→      if (shouldEnhance && promptToEnhance) {
   360→        return submitEnhancedSegmentTask(runtime, promptToEnhance, defaultNumFrames);
   361→      }
   362→      return submitStandardSegmentTask(runtime);
   363→    },
   364→  });
   365→}
   366→

1→/**
     2→ * useSegmentOutputsForShot Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Manages segment outputs for inline display above the timeline.
     5→ * Handles multiple parent generations (different "runs"), their children,
     6→ * and the slot system for partial results.
     7→ */
     8→
     9→import { useState, useMemo, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
    10→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    11→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    12→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    13→import { useSmartPollingConfig } from '@/shared/hooks/useSmartPolling';
    14→import { segmentQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/segments';
    15→import { getGenerationId } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaTypeHelpers';
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→// Slot type - either a real child or a placeholder for a processing segment
    19→export type SegmentSlot =
    20→  | { type: 'child'; child: GenerationRow; index: number; pairShotGenerationId?: string }
    21→  | { type: 'placeholder'; index: number; expectedFrames?: number; expectedPrompt?: string; startImage?: string; endImage?: string; pairShotGenerationId?: string };
    22→
    23→interface ExpectedSegmentData {
    24→  count: number;
    25→  frames: number[];
    26→  prompts: string[];
    27→  inputImages: string[];
    28→  inputImageGenIds: string[];
    29→  pairShotGenIds: string[];
    30→}
    31→
    32→interface UseSegmentOutputsReturn {
    33→  // Multiple parent generations (different "runs")
    34→  parentGenerations: GenerationRow[];
    35→  selectedParentId: string | null;
    36→  setSelectedParentId: (id: string | null) => void;
    37→
    38→  // Currently selected parent's data
    39→  selectedParent: GenerationRow | null;
    40→  hasFinalOutput: boolean; // parent.location exists
    41→
    42→  // Segment slots for current parent
    43→  segmentSlots: SegmentSlot[];
    44→  segments: GenerationRow[]; // Actual segment children (not placeholders)
    45→  segmentProgress: { completed: number; total: number };
    46→  expectedSegmentData: ExpectedSegmentData | null;
    47→
    48→  // Loading states
    49→  isLoading: boolean;
    50→  isRefetching: boolean;
    51→
    52→  // Actions
    53→  refetch: () => void;
    54→}
    55→
    56→/**
    57→ * Extract expected segment data from parent's orchestrator_details
    58→ */
    59→function extractExpectedSegmentData(parentParams: Record<string, unknown> | null): ExpectedSegmentData | null {
    60→  if (!parentParams) return null;
    61→
    62→  const orchestratorDetails = parentParams.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    63→  if (!orchestratorDetails) return null;
    64→
    65→  const segmentCount = (orchestratorDetails.num_new_segments_to_generate as number)
    66→    || (orchestratorDetails.segment_frames_expanded as unknown[] | undefined)?.length
    67→    || 0;
    68→
    69→  if (segmentCount === 0) return null;
    70→
    71→  return {
    72→    count: segmentCount,
    73→    frames: (orchestratorDetails.segment_frames_expanded as number[]) || [],
    74→    prompts: (orchestratorDetails.enhanced_prompts_expanded as string[]) || (orchestratorDetails.base_prompts_expanded as string[]) || [],
    75→    inputImages: (orchestratorDetails.input_image_paths_resolved as string[]) || [],
    76→    // Include IDs for tethering videos to shot_generations
    77→    inputImageGenIds: (orchestratorDetails.input_image_generation_ids as string[]) || [],
    78→    pairShotGenIds: (orchestratorDetails.pair_shot_generation_ids as string[]) || [],
    79→  };
    80→}
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Extract pair identifiers from a generation (checks column first, then params)
    84→ * @param generation - The generation row (may have pair_shot_generation_id column)
    85→ * @param params - The params JSONB (legacy storage location)
    86→ */
    87→function getPairIdentifiers(
    88→  generation: { pair_shot_generation_id?: string | null } | null,
    89→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null
    90→): { pairShotGenId?: string; startGenId?: string } {
    91→  const columnValue = generation?.pair_shot_generation_id;
    92→  if (!columnValue) return {};
    93→  const individualParams = params?.individual_segment_params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    94→  return {
    95→    pairShotGenId: columnValue,
    96→    startGenId: (individualParams?.start_image_generation_id || params?.start_image_generation_id) as string | undefined,
    97→  };
    98→}
    99→
   100→/**
   101→ * Check if a generation is a travel segment (has segment_index in params)
   102→ * vs a join output (no segment_index)
   103→ */
   104→function isSegment(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): boolean {
   105→  return typeof params?.segment_index === 'number';
   106→}
   107→
   108→/**
   109→ * Transform raw generation data to GenerationRow format
   110→ */
   111→interface RawGenerationDbRow {
   112→  id: string;
   113→  location?: string | null;
   114→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   115→  type?: string | null;
   116→  created_at?: string;
   117→  updated_at?: string | null;
   118→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   119→  parent_generation_id?: string | null;
   120→  child_order?: number | null;
   121→  starred?: boolean;
   122→  pair_shot_generation_id?: string | null;
   123→  primary_variant_id?: string | null;
   124→}
   125→
   126→function transformToGenerationRow(gen: RawGenerationDbRow): GenerationRow {
   127→  return {
   128→    id: gen.id,
   129→    location: gen.location || '',
   130→    imageUrl: gen.location || '',
   131→    thumbUrl: gen.thumbnail_url || gen.location || '',
   132→    type: gen.type || 'video',
   133→    created_at: gen.updated_at || gen.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
   134→    createdAt: gen.updated_at || gen.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
   135→    params: gen.params as GenerationRow['params'],
   136→    parent_generation_id: gen.parent_generation_id,
   137→    child_order: gen.child_order,
   138→    starred: gen.starred,
   139→    // Include pair_shot_generation_id column (for FK-based slot matching)
   140→    pair_shot_generation_id: gen.pair_shot_generation_id,
   141→  };
   142→}
   143→
   144→export function useSegmentOutputsForShot(
   145→  shotId: string | null,
   146→  projectId: string | null,
   147→  /** Local shot_generation positions for instant updates during drag */
   148→  localShotGenPositions?: Map<string, number>,
   149→  /** Optional controlled selected parent ID (lifted state from parent) */
   150→  controlledSelectedParentId?: string | null,
   151→  /** Optional callback when selected parent changes (for controlled mode) */
   152→  onSelectedParentChange?: (id: string | null) => void,
   153→  /** Optional preloaded generations for readOnly mode (bypasses database queries) */
   154→  preloadedGenerations?: GenerationRow[],
   155→  /** Optional trailing segment shot_generation_id (allows videos at end position to show) */
   156→  trailingShotGenId?: string
   157→): UseSegmentOutputsReturn {
   158→  // [TrailingDebug] Log when trailingShotGenId is passed
   159→
   160→  // Debug: Log when local positions are passed
   161→
   162→  // Track selected parent generation - use controlled value if provided, otherwise internal state
   163→  const [internalSelectedParentId, setInternalSelectedParentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
   164→
   165→  // Determine if we're in controlled mode
   166→  const isControlled = controlledSelectedParentId !== undefined;
   167→  const selectedParentId = isControlled ? controlledSelectedParentId : internalSelectedParentId;
   168→  const setSelectedParentId = useCallback((id: string | null) => {
   169→    if (isControlled && onSelectedParentChange) {
   170→      onSelectedParentChange(id);
   171→    } else {
   172→      setInternalSelectedParentId(id);
   173→    }
   174→  }, [isControlled, onSelectedParentChange]);
   175→
   176→  // Derive parent generations from preloaded data if available
   177→  // Parent generations are videos that:
   178→  // 1. type = 'video'
   179→  // 2. parent_generation_id IS NULL (not a child itself)
   180→  // 3. Has orchestrator_details OR has children pointing to it
   181→  const preloadedParentGenerations = useMemo(() => {
   182→    if (!preloadedGenerations) return undefined;
   183→
   184→    // First, find all generation IDs that are referenced as parents
   185→    const parentIds = new Set<string>();
   186→    preloadedGenerations.forEach(gen => {
   187→      const parentId = gen.parent_generation_id;
   188→      if (parentId) parentIds.add(parentId);
   189→    });
   190→
   191→    const parents = preloadedGenerations.filter(gen => {
   192→      const isVideo = gen.type?.includes('video');
   193→      // Check if this is NOT a child (no parent_generation_id)
   194→      const isNotChild = !gen.parent_generation_id;
   195→      // Has orchestrator_details OR is referenced as a parent by other generations
   196→      const hasOrchestratorDetails = !!(gen.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.orchestrator_details;
   197→      // Use generation_id for parent lookup (shot_generations.generation_id -> generations.id)
   198→      const genId = getGenerationId(gen);
   199→      const hasChildren = typeof genId === 'string' ? parentIds.has(genId) : false;
   200→
   201→      return isVideo && isNotChild && (hasOrchestratorDetails || hasChildren);
   202→    });
   203→
   204→    // Sort by created_at descending (most recent first) to match actual page behavior
   205→    // This ensures auto-select picks the most recent parent
   206→    parents.sort((a, b) => {
   207→      const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || a.createdAt || 0).getTime();
   208→      const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || b.createdAt || 0).getTime();
   209→      return dateB - dateA; // Descending - most recent first
   210→    });
   211→
   212→    return parents;
   213→  }, [preloadedGenerations]);
   214→
   215→  // Memoize query keys to prevent React Query observer.setOptions() from seeing
   216→  // "changed" options on every render (shallowEqualObjects compares by reference).
   217→  // Without this, unstable keys + staleTime: 0 cause a fetch→render→fetch loop.
   218→  const parentQueryKey = useMemo(
   219→    () => segmentQueryKeys.parents(shotId!, projectId ?? undefined),
   220→    [shotId, projectId]
   221→  );
   222→
   223→  // Fetch parent generations using the shot_final_videos view (single query, all filtering server-side)
   224→  // Skip query when preloaded data is available
   225→  const {
   226→    data: parentGenerationsData,
   227→    isLoading: isLoadingParents,
   228→    isFetching: isFetchingParents,
   229→    refetch: refetchParents,
   230→  } = useQuery({
   231→    queryKey: parentQueryKey,
   232→    queryFn: async () => {
   233→      if (!shotId || !projectId) return [];
   234→
   235→      // Single query using the shot_final_videos view
   236→      // This replaces 3 queries + client-side filtering with 1 indexed query
   237→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_final_videos')
   238→        .select('*')
   239→        .eq('shot_id', shotId)
   240→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
   241→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
   242→
   243→      if (error) {
   244→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   245→          context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchParents',
   246→          showToast: false,
   247→          logData: { shotId, projectId },
   248→        });
   249→        throw error;
   250→      }
   251→
   252→      return ((data || []) as unknown as RawGenerationDbRow[]).map(transformToGenerationRow);
   253→    },
   254→    enabled: !!shotId && !!projectId && !preloadedGenerations,
   255→    staleTime: 30000, // 30 seconds
   256→  });
   257→
   258→  // Use preloaded data if available, otherwise use query data
   259→  const parentGenerations = useMemo(
   260→    () => (preloadedParentGenerations ?? parentGenerationsData) || [],
   261→    [preloadedParentGenerations, parentGenerationsData],
   262→  );
   263→
   264→  // Auto-select the first (most recent) parent if none selected
   265→  // IMPORTANT: Only auto-select when:
   266→  // 1. The query is enabled (shotId exists) - prevents controlled components with disabled queries from clearing selection
   267→  // 2. NOT in controlled mode - parent component manages selection
   268→  // 3. There are parent generations to select from
   269→  useEffect(() => {
   270→    // Don't auto-select if query is disabled (we're just using controlled state passthrough)
   271→    if (!shotId) return;
   272→
   273→    // Don't auto-select if in controlled mode - parent component manages selection
   274→    if (isControlled) return;
   275→
   276→    if (parentGenerations.length > 0 && !selectedParentId) {
   277→      setSelectedParentId(parentGenerations[0].id);
   278→    } else if (parentGenerations.length > 0 && selectedParentId) {
   279→      // Validate that current selection exists in the list
   280→      const selectionExists = parentGenerations.some(p => p.id === selectedParentId);
   281→      if (!selectionExists) {
   282→        setSelectedParentId(parentGenerations[0].id);
   283→      }
   284→    }
   285→    // Note: We don't set to null when parentGenerations is empty - keep last selection
   286→  }, [parentGenerations, selectedParentId, shotId, isControlled, setSelectedParentId]);
   287→
   288→  // Get the selected parent
   289→  const selectedParent = useMemo(() => {
   290→    if (!selectedParentId) return null;
   291→    return parentGenerations.find(p => p.id === selectedParentId) || null;
   292→  }, [parentGenerations, selectedParentId]);
   293→
   294→  // Derive children from preloaded data if available
   295→  // Children are generations with parent_generation_id pointing to the selected parent
   296→  const preloadedChildren = useMemo(() => {
   297→    if (!preloadedGenerations || !selectedParentId) return undefined;
   298→
   299→    // The selected parent might be a shot_generations.id or a generations.id
   300→    // We need to find the generation_id for the selected parent
   301→    const selectedParent = parentGenerations.find(p => p.id === selectedParentId || p.generation_id === selectedParentId);
   302→    const parentGenId = selectedParent?.generation_id || selectedParentId;
   303→
   304→    const children = preloadedGenerations.filter(gen => {
   305→      // Check if this generation's parent_generation_id matches the selected parent
   306→      const parentId = gen.parent_generation_id;
   307→      return parentId === parentGenId || parentId === selectedParentId;
   308→    });
   309→
   310→    return children;
   311→  }, [preloadedGenerations, selectedParentId, parentGenerations]);
   312→
   313→  // Smart polling for segment children - allows new segments to appear after task completion
   314→  // CRITICAL: Memoize query key — an unstable array reference here was the root cause of a
   315→  // 15/sec render loop. React Query's setOptions() uses shallowEqualObjects which compares
   316→  // queryKey by reference. New array + staleTime: 0 → fetch→render→fetch infinite loop.
   317→  const childrenQueryKey = useMemo(
   318→    () => [...segmentQueryKeys.children(selectedParentId!)] as string[],
   319→    [selectedParentId]
   320→  );
   321→  const childrenPollingConfig = useSmartPollingConfig(childrenQueryKey);
   322→
   323→  // Fetch children for selected parent - skip if preloaded data available
   324→  const {
   325→    data: childGenerationsData,
   326→    isLoading: isLoadingChildren,
   327→    isFetching: isFetchingChildren,
   328→    refetch: refetchChildren,
   329→  } = useQuery({
   330→    [REDACTED],
   331→    queryFn: async () => {
   332→      if (!selectedParentId) return [];
   333→
   334→      // [TrailingDebug] Also check if there are ANY videos with matching pair_shot_generation_id
   335→      // This helps diagnose if videos exist but under a different parent
   336→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('generations')
   337→        .select('*')
   338→        .eq('parent_generation_id', selectedParentId)
   339→        .order('child_order', { ascending: true })
   340→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
   341→
   342→      if (error) {
   343→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→          context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchChildren',
   345→          showToast: false,
   346→          logData: { selectedParentId },
   347→        });
   348→        throw error;
   349→      }
   350→
   351→      return ((data || []) as unknown as RawGenerationDbRow[]).map(transformToGenerationRow);
   352→    },
   353→    enabled: !!selectedParentId && !preloadedGenerations,
   354→    // Smart polling config - polls when realtime is unhealthy, otherwise relies on invalidation
   355→    ...childrenPollingConfig,
   356→    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
   357→  });
   358→
   359→  // Use preloaded children if available
   360→  const childGenerations = useMemo(
   361→    () => (preloadedChildren ?? childGenerationsData) || [],
   362→    [preloadedChildren, childGenerationsData],
   363→  );
   364→
   365→  // Filter to only segments (not join outputs)
   366→  const segments = useMemo(() => {
   367→    const filtered = childGenerations.filter(child => isSegment(child.params as Record<string, unknown> | null));
   368→
   369→    return filtered;
   370→  }, [childGenerations]);
   371→
   372→  // Derive timeline data from preloaded generations if available
   373→  const preloadedTimelineData = useMemo(() => {
   374→    if (!preloadedGenerations) return undefined;
   375→    // Filter to positioned items and map to timeline format
   376→    return preloadedGenerations
   377→      .filter(gen => gen.timeline_frame !== null && gen.timeline_frame !== undefined && gen.timeline_frame >= 0)
   378→      .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0))
   379→      .map(gen => ({
   380→        id: gen.id,  // shot_generations.id
   381→        generation_id: gen.generation_id,
   382→        timeline_frame: gen.timeline_frame,
   383→      }));
   384→  }, [preloadedGenerations]);
   385→
   386→  const liveTimelineQueryKey = useMemo(
   387→    () => segmentQueryKeys.liveTimeline(shotId!),
   388→    [shotId]
   389→  );
   390→
   391→  // Fetch LIVE shot_generations to get current timeline order
   392→  // This is the source of truth for video positioning - videos move with their images
   393→  // Skip if preloaded data available
   394→  const {
   395→    data: liveTimelineData,
   396→    refetch: refetchTimeline,
   397→  } = useQuery({
   398→    [REDACTED],
   399→    queryFn: async () => {
   400→      if (!shotId) return [];
   401→
   402→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   403→        .select('id, generation_id, timeline_frame')
   404→        .eq('shot_id', shotId)
   405→        .gte('timeline_frame', 0) // Only positioned images
   406→        .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
   407→
   408→      if (error) {
   409→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   410→          context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchLiveTimeline',
   411→          showToast: false,
   412→          logData: { shotId },
   413→        });
   414→        throw error;
   415→      }
   416→
   417→      return data || [];
   418→    },
   419→    enabled: !!shotId && !preloadedGenerations,
   420→    staleTime: 10000, // Refresh more frequently to catch timeline changes
   421→  });
   422→
   423→  // Use preloaded timeline if available
   424→  const effectiveTimelineData = preloadedTimelineData ?? liveTimelineData;
   425→
   426→  // Build map of shot_generation.id → current position (live, not snapshot)
   427→  const liveShotGenIdToPosition = useMemo(() => {
   428→    const map = new Map<string, number>();
   429→    (effectiveTimelineData || []).forEach((sg, index) => {
   430→      map.set(sg.id, index);
   431→    });
   432→
   433→    return map;
   434→  }, [effectiveTimelineData, shotId, preloadedTimelineData]);
   435→
   436→  // Extract expected segment data from selected parent
   437→  const expectedSegmentData = useMemo(() => {
   438→    if (!selectedParent) return null;
   439→    return extractExpectedSegmentData(selectedParent.params as Record<string, unknown> | null);
   440→  }, [selectedParent]);
   441→
   442→  // Build segment slots
   443→  // Uses LOCAL positions (instant during drag) or LIVE timeline (from DB) for slot assignment
   444→  const segmentSlots = useMemo((): SegmentSlot[] => {
   445→    const hasLocalPositions = !!localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0;
   446→    const localPositionCount = localShotGenPositions?.size ?? 0;
   447→    const useLocalPositions = hasLocalPositions;
   448→
   449→    const positionMap = useLocalPositions ? localShotGenPositions : liveShotGenIdToPosition;
   450→    const baseSlotCount = useLocalPositions
   451→      ? localPositionCount - 1  // N images = N-1 pairs
   452→      : (effectiveTimelineData?.length ? effectiveTimelineData.length - 1 : 0);
   453→    // Add extra slot for trailing segment if provided
   454→    const slotCount = trailingShotGenId ? baseSlotCount + 1 : baseSlotCount;
   455→
   456→    // Use slotCount (current timeline) for positioning, not expectedCount (original generation)
   457→    if (slotCount === 0) {
   458→      if (!effectiveTimelineData) {
   459→        // Timeline still loading — return empty to avoid collision/shift artifacts.
   460→        // The child_order fallback below causes two problems when timeline data arrives:
   461→        // (1) segments with the same child_order collide, making one permanently invisible,
   462→        // (2) segments visually shift position when the FK-based layout kicks in.
   463→        return [];
   464→      }
   465→      // Genuinely no timeline images — show what we have at child_order positions
   466→      const fallbackSlots = segments.map((child, index) => ({
   467→        type: 'child' as const,
   468→        child,
   469→        index: child.child_order ?? index,
   470→      }));
   471→      return fallbackSlots;
   472→    }
   473→
   474→    // Create slots for all expected segments
   475→    const slots: SegmentSlot[] = [];
   476→    const childrenBySlot = new Map<number, GenerationRow>();
   477→    const usedSlots = new Set<number>();
   478→    const childrenWithoutValidSlot: GenerationRow[] = [];
   479→    // Priority chain for slot mapping:
   480→    // 1. pair_shot_generation_id → position (LOCAL for instant, LIVE as fallback)
   481→    // 2. child_order (fallback ONLY for videos without pair_shot_generation_id)
   482→    segments.forEach(child => {
   483→      const childParams = child.params as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   484→      const { pairShotGenId } = getPairIdentifiers(child, childParams);
   485→      const childOrder = child.child_order;
   486→
   487→      // Extract end image generation_id for pair validation
   488→      const individualParams = (childParams?.individual_segment_params || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   489→      const endGenId = (individualParams.end_image_generation_id || childParams?.end_image_generation_id) as string | undefined;
   490→
   491→      let derivedSlot: number | undefined;
   492→      let slotSource = 'NONE';
   493→      let pairShotGenPosition: number | undefined;
   494→
   495→      // Priority 1: pair_shot_generation_id → look up position (instant from local, or from DB)
   496→      // Videos should move with their images
   497→      if (pairShotGenId && positionMap.has(pairShotGenId)) {
   498→        pairShotGenPosition = positionMap.get(pairShotGenId)!;
   499→        // Only validate against slot count (current timeline)
   500→        // Position N means "start of pair N", but pair N only exists if there's an image at N+1
   501→        // EXCEPTION: If this is a trailing segment (pairShotGenId matches trailingShotGenId),
   502→        // allow it even at the end position
   503→        const isTrailingSegment = trailingShotGenId && pairShotGenId === trailingShotGenId;
   504→
   505→        if (pairShotGenPosition < slotCount || isTrailingSegment) {
   506→          derivedSlot = pairShotGenPosition;
   507→          slotSource = isTrailingSegment ? 'TRAILING_SEGMENT' : (useLocalPositions ? 'LOCAL_POSITION' : 'PAIR_SHOT_GEN_ID_LIVE');
   508→        } else {
   509→          // Image is at last position - no valid pair starts there
   510→          slotSource = 'PAIR_AT_END_NO_SLOT';
   511→        }
   512→
   513→        // Verify end image still matches — catches insertion between pair images.
   514→        // ONLY run against LIVE positions (not during local drag). During drag,
   515→        // derivedSlot comes from localShotGenPositions but effectiveTimelineData
   516→        // still has LIVE (pre-drag) order — the mixed coordinate systems cause
   517→        // false demotions on swap/reorder. After commit, LIVE data refreshes and
   518→        // this check runs against consistent positions.
   519→        if (!useLocalPositions && derivedSlot !== undefined && endGenId && effectiveTimelineData) {
   520→          const endImageInTimeline = effectiveTimelineData[derivedSlot + 1];
   521→          if (endImageInTimeline && endImageInTimeline.generation_id !== endGenId) {
   522→            // Only demote if the end image is still AFTER this slot (X inserted between A and B)
   523→            // or is gone entirely (end image deleted). If the end image moved BEFORE this slot
   524→            // (swap/reorder), the video should follow its start image — ambiguous order > lost data.
   525→            const endImageNewSlot = effectiveTimelineData.findIndex(
   526→              item => item.generation_id === endGenId
   527→            );
   528→            if (endImageNewSlot === -1 || endImageNewSlot > derivedSlot) {
   529→              derivedSlot = undefined;
   530→              slotSource = 'STALE_END_IMAGE';
   531→            }
   532→          }
   533→        }
   534→      }
   535→
   536→      // Priority 2: child_order fallback (legacy segments only)
   537→      // Fall back to child_order ONLY when there's no pairShotGenId at all.
   538→      // A stale FK (pairShotGenId exists but not in positionMap) means the source
   539→      // image was removed from the timeline — the segment is orphaned and should
   540→      // NOT claim a slot. Letting it fall back to child_order would block valid
   541→      // segments from their correct positions.
   542→      if (derivedSlot === undefined && !pairShotGenId &&
   543→          typeof childOrder === 'number' && childOrder >= 0 && childOrder < slotCount) {
   544→        derivedSlot = childOrder;
   545→        slotSource = 'CHILD_ORDER';
   546→      }
   547→
   548→      // Skip videos whose pair_shot_gen is at an invalid position (e.g., last image)
   549→      // These videos can't be shown because their start image has no following image
   550→      if (slotSource === 'PAIR_AT_END_NO_SLOT') {
   551→        return; // Skip this video entirely
   552→      }
   553→
   554→      // Check if slot is valid and not already used
   555→      if (derivedSlot !== undefined && !usedSlots.has(derivedSlot)) {
   556→        childrenBySlot.set(derivedSlot, child);
   557→        usedSlots.add(derivedSlot);
   558→      } else if (derivedSlot !== undefined && usedSlots.has(derivedSlot)) {
   559→        // Slot collision — prefer the segment with actual content (location).
   560→        // This prevents demoted/empty segments from blocking valid ones,
   561→        // even in timing windows where demote hasn't cleared location yet.
   562→        const existing = childrenBySlot.get(derivedSlot)!;
   563→        if (!existing.location && child.location) {
   564→          childrenBySlot.set(derivedSlot, child);
   565→          childrenWithoutValidSlot.push(existing);
   566→        } else {
   567→          childrenWithoutValidSlot.push(child);
   568→        }
   569→      } else {
   570→        childrenWithoutValidSlot.push(child);
   571→      }
   572→    });
   573→
   574→    // DON'T assign orphans to available slots - this was causing deleted segments
   575→    // to be replaced by other segments. Orphan segments (without valid pair_shot_generation_id)
   576→    // should NOT be displayed. They'll remain hidden until regenerated for the correct slot.
   577→
   578→    // Fill in slots using LIVE timeline data for placeholders
   579→    for (let i = 0; i < slotCount; i++) {
   580→      const child = childrenBySlot.get(i);
   581→      // Use live timeline for pair_shot_generation_id (shot_generations.id of start image)
   582→      const liveStartImage = effectiveTimelineData?.[i];
   583→      const liveEndImage = effectiveTimelineData?.[i + 1];
   584→      // Get pair_shot_generation_id: prefer live data, fall back to expected data
   585→      const pairShotGenerationId = liveStartImage?.id || expectedSegmentData?.pairShotGenIds?.[i];
   586→
   587→      if (child) {
   588→        // Use the child's own pair_shot_generation_id for the key.
   589→        // liveStartImage?.id is wrong when LOCAL and LIVE orders diverge (e.g. after a drag reorder),
   590→        // causing buildDisplaySlots to fail to match this slot to the correct LOCAL pair.
   591→        const childPsgId = getPairIdentifiers(child, child.params as Record<string, unknown> | null).pairShotGenId;
   592→        slots.push({ type: 'child', child, index: i, pairShotGenerationId: childPsgId || pairShotGenerationId });
   593→      } else {
   594→        slots.push({
   595→          type: 'placeholder',
   596→          index: i,
   597→          expectedFrames: expectedSegmentData?.frames[i],
   598→          expectedPrompt: expectedSegmentData?.prompts[i],
   599→          startImage: liveStartImage?.generation_id || expectedSegmentData?.inputImages[i],
   600→          endImage: liveEndImage?.generation_id || expectedSegmentData?.inputImages[i + 1],
   601→          pairShotGenerationId,
   602→        });
   603→      }
   604→    }
   605→
   606→    return slots;
   607→  }, [segments, expectedSegmentData, effectiveTimelineData, liveShotGenIdToPosition, localShotGenPositions, trailingShotGenId]);
   608→
   609→  // Calculate progress
   610→  const segmentProgress = useMemo(() => {
   611→    const completed = segmentSlots.filter(s => s.type === 'child' && s.child.location).length;
   612→    const total = segmentSlots.length;
   613→
   614→    return { completed, total };
   615→  }, [segmentSlots]);
   616→
   617→  // Combined refetch
   618→  const refetch = useCallback(() => {
   619→    refetchParents();
   620→    refetchChildren();
   621→    refetchTimeline();
   622→  }, [refetchParents, refetchChildren, refetchTimeline]);
   623→
   624→  return {
   625→    parentGenerations,
   626→    selectedParentId,
   627→    setSelectedParentId,
   628→    selectedParent,
   629→    hasFinalOutput: !!(selectedParent?.location),
   630→    segmentSlots,
   631→    segments, // Actual segment children (for join functionality)
   632→    segmentProgress,
   633→    expectedSegmentData,
   634→    isLoading: isLoadingParents || isLoadingChildren,
   635→    isRefetching: isFetchingParents || isFetchingChildren,
   636→    refetch,
   637→  };
   638→}
   639→

1→import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     2→
     3→const DEFAULT_ACCEPTED_TYPES = ['Files'];
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Track drag enter/leave events with proper nesting counter.
     7→ * Returns drag state and handlers.
     8→ *
     9→ * @param acceptedTypes - dataTransfer types to recognize (default: `['Files']`).
    10→ *   When a drag matches, `matchedType` will be set to the first matching type.
    11→ */
    12→export function useFileDragTracking(acceptedTypes: string[] = DEFAULT_ACCEPTED_TYPES) {
    13→  const [isDraggingOver, setIsDraggingOver] = useState(false);
    14→  const [matchedType, setMatchedType] = useState<string | null>(null);
    15→  const dragCounterRef = useRef(0);
    16→
    17→  const handleDragEnter = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
    18→    e.preventDefault();
    19→    e.stopPropagation();
    20→    dragCounterRef.current++;
    21→    const matched = acceptedTypes.find(t => e.dataTransfer.types.includes(t));
    22→    if (matched) {
    23→      setIsDraggingOver(true);
    24→      setMatchedType(matched);
    25→    }
    26→  }, [acceptedTypes]);
    27→
    28→  const handleDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
    29→    e.preventDefault();
    30→    e.stopPropagation();
    31→    dragCounterRef.current--;
    32→    if (dragCounterRef.current === 0) {
    33→      setIsDraggingOver(false);
    34→      setMatchedType(null);
    35→    }
    36→  }, []);
    37→
    38→  const resetDrag = useCallback(() => {
    39→    dragCounterRef.current = 0;
    40→    setIsDraggingOver(false);
    41→    setMatchedType(null);
    42→  }, []);
    43→
    44→  return { isDraggingOver, matchedType, handleDragEnter, handleDragLeave, resetDrag };
    45→}
    46→

1→import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type Listener = () => void;
     4→
     5→let openCount = 0;
     6→const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
     7→
     8→function notifyListeners(): void {
     9→  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
    10→}
    11→
    12→function getSnapshot(): boolean {
    13→  return openCount > 0;
    14→}
    15→
    16→function subscribe(listener: Listener): () => void {
    17→  listeners.add(listener);
    18→  return () => {
    19→    listeners.delete(listener);
    20→  };
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function acquireLightboxOpenState(): () => void {
    24→  openCount += 1;
    25→  notifyListeners();
    26→
    27→  let released = false;
    28→  return () => {
    29→    if (released) {
    30→      return;
    31→    }
    32→    released = true;
    33→    openCount = Math.max(0, openCount - 1);
    34→    notifyListeners();
    35→  };
    36→}
    37→
    38→export function useLightboxOpenState(): boolean {
    39→  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function __resetLightboxOpenStateForTests(): void {
    43→  openCount = 0;
    44→  notifyListeners();
    45→}
    46→

1→/**
     2→ * Batch Image Loading Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Wraps useProgressiveImage with common settings for batch view components.
     5→ * Provides a simplified interface for thumbnail → full image loading.
     6→ *
     7→ * Used by batch view components (ShotBatchItemMobile, ShotBatchItemDesktop).
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { useProgressiveImage } from './useProgressiveImage';
    11→import { isProgressiveLoadingEnabled } from '@/shared/settings/progressiveLoading';
    12→import { getDisplayUrl } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    13→
    14→interface UseBatchImageLoadingOptions {
    15→  /** Thumb URL for progressive loading */
    16→  thumbUrl: string | null | undefined;
    17→  /** Full image URL */
    18→  imageUrl: string;
    19→  /** Whether to start loading (for lazy loading) */
    20→  shouldLoad?: boolean;
    21→}
    22→
    23→interface UseBatchImageLoadingResult {
    24→  /** URL to display (either thumb or full depending on load state) */
    25→  displayImageUrl: string;
    26→  /** Ref to attach to the img element */
    27→  progressiveRef: (element: HTMLElement | null) => void;
    28→  /** Whether full image is loaded */
    29→  isFullLoaded: boolean;
    30→  /** Whether thumbnail is currently showing */
    31→  isThumbShowing: boolean;
    32→}
    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Hook for loading images in batch view with progressive loading support.
    36→ *
    37→ * @param options - Loading options
    38→ * @returns Object with display URL, ref, and loading state
    39→ */
    40→export function useBatchImageLoading({
    41→  thumbUrl,
    42→  imageUrl,
    43→  shouldLoad = true,
    44→}: UseBatchImageLoadingOptions): UseBatchImageLoadingResult {
    45→  const progressiveEnabled = isProgressiveLoadingEnabled();
    46→
    47→  const {
    48→    src: progressiveSrc,
    49→    isThumbShowing,
    50→    isFullLoaded,
    51→    ref: progressiveRef,
    52→  } = useProgressiveImage(
    53→    progressiveEnabled ? thumbUrl : null,
    54→    imageUrl,
    55→    {
    56→      priority: false,
    57→      lazy: true,
    58→      enabled: progressiveEnabled && shouldLoad,
    59→      crossfadeMs: 200,
    60→    }
    61→  );
    62→
    63→  // Use progressive src if available, otherwise fallback to display URL
    64→  const displayImageUrl = progressiveEnabled && progressiveSrc
    65→    ? progressiveSrc
    66→    : getDisplayUrl(thumbUrl || imageUrl);
    67→
    68→  return {
    69→    displayImageUrl,
    70→    progressiveRef,
    71→    isFullLoaded,
    72→    isThumbShowing,
    73→  };
    74→}
    75→

    19→export const CreateProjectModal: React.FC<CreateProjectModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onOpenChange, initialName }) => {

    29→  useEffect(() => {

    36→  useEffect(() => {

    43→  const handleCreateProject = async () => {
    44→    let finalProjectName = projectName.trim();

    46→    if (!finalProjectName) {
    47→      const existingNamesLower = projects.map(p => p.name.toLowerCase());
    48→

    50→      const maxTries = 10;

    52→      let candidateName = '';
    53→      while (tries < maxTries) {
    54→        candidateName = getRandomDummyName();

    56→          break;
    57→        }
    58→        tries++;

    60→
    61→      // As a fallback, append a random number to guarantee uniqueness
    62→      if (existingNamesLower.includes(candidateName.toLowerCase())) {

    45→
    46→type LineageScopeFailureStatus = Exclude<VariantProjectScopeStatus, 'ok'>;
    47→
    48→export class LineageScopeError extends Error {
    49→  readonly status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    50→  readonly variantId: string;
    51→  readonly projectId: string;
    52→  readonly queryError?: string;
    53→
    54→  constructor(params: {
    55→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    56→    variantId: string;
    57→    projectId: string;
    58→    queryError?: string;
    59→    message: string;
    60→  }) {
    61→    super(params.message);
    62→    this.name = 'LineageScopeError';
    63→    this.status = params.status;
    64→    this.variantId = params.variantId;
    65→    this.projectId = params.projectId;
    66→    this.queryError = params.queryError;
    67→  }
    68→}
    69→
    70→export function isLineageScopeError(error: unknown): error is LineageScopeError {
    71→  return error instanceof LineageScopeError;
    72→}
    73→
    74→function readSourceVariantId(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
    75→  return typeof params?.source_variant_id === 'string' ? params.source_variant_id : null;
    76→}
    77→
    78→function buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scopeStatus: string, queryError?: string): string {
    79→  switch (scopeStatus) {
    80→    case 'scope_mismatch':
    81→      return 'Variant exists but does not belong to the active project scope';
    82→    case 'missing_project_scope':
    83→      return 'Variant does not have project scope metadata';
    84→    case 'missing_variant':
    85→      return 'Variant not found';
    86→    case 'missing_generation':
    87→      return 'Variant generation was not found';
    88→    case 'query_failed':
    89→      return `Variant scope lookup failed${queryError ? `: ${queryError}` : ''}`;
    90→    default:
    91→      return `Variant scope validation failed (${scopeStatus})`;
    92→  }
    93→}
    94→
    95→function toLineageScopeError(
    96→  error: unknown,
    97→  fallback: {
    98→    variantId: string;
    99→    projectId: string;
   100→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
   101→    queryError?: string;
   102→  },
   103→): LineageScopeError {
   104→  if (isLineageScopeError(error)) {
   105→    return error;
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  const message = error instanceof Error
   109→    ? error.message
   110→    : buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(fallback.status, fallback.queryError);
   111→
   112→  return new LineageScopeError({
   113→    ...fallback,
   114→    message,
   115→  });
   116→}
   117→
   118→async function fetchVariantById(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<VariantRecord> {
   119→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
   120→  if (scope.status !== 'ok' || !scope.generationId) {
   121→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   122→      status: scope.status as LineageScopeFailureStatus,
   123→      variantId,
   124→      projectId,
   125→      queryError: scope.queryError,
   126→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scope.status, scope.queryError),
   127→    });
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseClient().from('generation_variants')
   131→    .select('id, generation_id, params, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, variant_type')
   132→    .eq('id', variantId)
   133→    .eq('generation_id', scope.generationId)
   134→    .single();
   135→
   136→  if (error) {
   137→    throw toLineageScopeError(error, {
   138→      status: 'query_failed',
   139→      variantId,
   140→      projectId,
   141→      queryError: error.message,
   142→    });
   143→  }
   144→
   145→  if (!data) {
   146→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   147→      status: 'missing_variant',
   148→      variantId,
   149→      projectId,
   150→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage('missing_variant'),
   151→    });
   152→  }
   153→  return data as VariantRecord;
   154→}
   155→
   156→/**
   157→ * Recursively fetch the lineage chain for a variant.
   158→ * Follows `params.source_variant_id` across generation boundaries.
   159→ */
   160→async function fetchLineageChain(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<LineageItem[]> {
   161→  const chain: LineageItem[] = [];
   162→  const visited = new Set<string>();
   163→  let currentId: string | null = variantId;
   164→
   165→  while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
   166→    visited.add(currentId);
   167→    const variant = await fetchVariantById(currentId, projectId);
   168→
   169→    chain.unshift({
   170→      id: variant.id,
   171→      imageUrl: variant.location,
   172→      thumbnailUrl: variant.thumbnail_url,
   173→      createdAt: variant.created_at,
   174→      type: 'variant',
   175→      variantType: variant.variant_type,
   176→    });
   177→    currentId = readSourceVariantId(variant.params);
   178→  }
   179→
   180→  return chain;
   181→}
   182→
   183→/**
   184→ * Hook to fetch the full lineage chain for a variant.
   185→ *
   186→ * @param variantId - The variant ID to fetch lineage for
   187→ * @param projectId - Project scope required for lineage traversal
   188→ * @returns Object with chain (oldest to newest), loading state, and whether there's lineage
   189→ */
   190→export function useLineageChain(variantId: string | null, projectId: string | null): LineageChainResult {
   191→  const { data: chain = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery<LineageItem[], LineageScopeError>({
   192→    queryKey: [...generationQueryKeys.lineageChain(variantId!), projectId ?? '__no-project__'],
   193→    queryFn: async () => {
   194→      try {
   195→        return await fetchLineageChain(variantId!, projectId!);
   196→      } catch (caughtError) {
   197→        const normalizedError = toLineageScopeError(caughtError, {
   198→          status: 'query_failed',
   199→          variantId: variantId!,
   200→          projectId: projectId!,
   201→        });
   202→        normalizeAndPresentError(normalizedError, {
   203→          context: 'useLineageChain',
   204→          showToast: false,
   205→          logData: {
   206→            variantId: normalizedError.variantId,
   207→            projectId: normalizedError.projectId,
   208→            status: normalizedError.status,
   209→            queryError: normalizedError.queryError,
   210→          },
   211→        });
   212→        throw normalizedError;
   213→      }
   214→    },
   215→    enabled: !!variantId && !!projectId,
   216→    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes - lineage doesn't change
   217→    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  return {
   221→    chain,
   222→    isLoading,
   223→    // Has lineage if chain has more than 1 item (the current variant + at least one ancestor)
   224→    hasLineage: chain.length > 1,
   225→    error: error ?? null,
   226→  };
   227→}
   228→
   229→/**
   230→ * Count the lineage chain length for a variant.
   231→ * Returns the number of ancestors (0 if no lineage, 1+ if has ancestors).
   232→ * This fetches directly without caching - use sparingly for initial checks.
   233→ *
   234→ * Reuses fetchLineageChain to avoid duplicating the traversal logic.
   235→ */
   236→export async function getLineageDepth(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<number> {
   237→  const chain = await fetchLineageChain(variantId, projectId);
   238→  // chain includes the variant itself; ancestors = chain length - 1
   239→  return Math.max(0, chain.length - 1);
   240→}
   241→
   242→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { useLineageChain } instead
   243→

1→/**
     2→ * Standardized error types for the application
     3→ *
     4→ * These error classes help distinguish between different error categories,
     5→ * enabling better error handling, user messaging, and logging.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * Base application error with additional context
    10→ */
    11→export class AppError extends Error {
    12→  /** Whether this error should be shown to the user via toast */
    13→  public readonly showToast: boolean;
    14→  /** Additional context for logging */
    15→  public readonly context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    16→  /** Original error if this wraps another error */
    17→  public readonly cause?: Error;
    18→
    19→  constructor(
    20→    message: string,
    21→    options?: {
    22→      showToast?: boolean;
    23→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    24→      cause?: Error;
    25→    }
    26→  ) {
    27→    super(message);
    28→    this.name = 'AppError';
    29→    this.showToast = options?.showToast ?? true;
    30→    this.context = options?.context;
    31→    this.cause = options?.cause;
    32→  }
    33→}
    34→
    35→/**
    36→ * Network-related errors (fetch failures, timeouts, offline)
    37→ * These are often transient and may benefit from retry
    38→ */
    39→export class NetworkError extends AppError {
    40→  /** Whether the user appears to be offline */
    41→  public readonly isOffline: boolean;
    42→  /** Whether this was a timeout */
    43→  public readonly isTimeout: boolean;
    44→
    45→  constructor(
    46→    message: string,
    47→    options?: {
    48→      isOffline?: boolean;
    49→      isTimeout?: boolean;
    50→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    51→      cause?: Error;
    52→    }
    53→  ) {
    54→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
    55→    this.name = 'NetworkError';
    56→    this.isOffline = options?.isOffline ?? !navigator.onLine;
    57→    this.isTimeout = options?.isTimeout ?? false;
    58→  }
    59→
    60→  static fromError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, unknown>): NetworkError {
    61→    const isTimeout = error.name === 'AbortError' || error.message.includes('timeout');
    62→    const isOffline = !navigator.onLine;
    63→
    64→    let message = 'Network request failed';
    65→    if (isOffline) {
    66→      message = 'You appear to be offline. Please check your connection.';
    67→    } else if (isTimeout) {
    68→      message = 'Request timed out. Please try again.';
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    return new NetworkError(message, { isOffline, isTimeout, context, cause: error });
    72→  }
    73→}
    74→
    75→/**
    76→ * Authentication/authorization errors
    77→ * User needs to log in or doesn't have permission
    78→ */
    79→export class AuthError extends AppError {
    80→  /** Whether the user needs to log in (vs lacking permission) */
    81→  public readonly needsLogin: boolean;
    82→
    83→  constructor(
    84→    message: string,
    85→    options?: {
    86→      needsLogin?: boolean;
    87→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    88→      cause?: Error;
    89→    }
    90→  ) {
    91→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
    92→    this.name = 'AuthError';
    93→    this.needsLogin = options?.needsLogin ?? true;
    94→  }
    95→
    96→  static fromError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AuthError {
    97→    const message = error.message.toLowerCase();
    98→    const needsLogin = message.includes('unauthorized') || message.includes('not authenticated');
    99→
   100→    return new AuthError(
   101→      needsLogin ? 'Please log in to continue' : 'You don\'t have permission for this action',
   102→      { needsLogin, context, cause: error }
   103→    );
   104→  }
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Validation errors (invalid input, missing required fields)
   109→ * These are user errors that can be corrected
   110→ */
   111→export class ValidationError extends AppError {
   112→  /** The field that failed validation, if applicable */
   113→  public readonly field?: string;
   114→
   115→  constructor(
   116→    message: string,
   117→    options?: {
   118→      field?: string;
   119→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   120→      cause?: Error;
   121→    }
   122→  ) {
   123→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
   124→    this.name = 'ValidationError';
   125→    this.field = options?.field;
   126→  }
   127→}
   128→
   129→/**
   130→ * Server/API errors (5xx responses, unexpected server behavior)
   131→ * These are typically not the user's fault
   132→ */
   133→export class ServerError extends AppError {
   134→  /** HTTP status code if available */
   135→  public readonly statusCode?: number;
   136→
   137→  constructor(
   138→    message: string,
   139→    options?: {
   140→      statusCode?: number;
   141→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   142→      cause?: Error;
   143→    }
   144→  ) {
   145→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
   146→    this.name = 'ServerError';
   147→    this.statusCode = options?.statusCode;
   148→  }
   149→}
   150→
   151→/**
   152→ * Errors that should be silently logged (not shown to user)
   153→ * Use for expected failures like localStorage unavailable, optional features
   154→ */
   155→export class SilentError extends AppError {
   156→  constructor(
   157→    message: string,
   158→    options?: {
   159→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   160→      cause?: Error;
   161→    }
   162→  ) {
   163→    super(message, { showToast: false, ...options });
   164→    this.name = 'SilentError';
   165→  }
   166→}
   167→
   168→/**
   169→ * Type guard to check if an error is one of our app errors
   170→ */
   171→export function isAppError(error: unknown): error is AppError {
   172→  return error instanceof AppError;
   173→}
   174→
   175→/**
   176→ * Type guard to check if an error is a network error
   177→ */
   178→export function isNetworkError(error: unknown): error is NetworkError {
   179→  return error instanceof NetworkError;
   180→}
   181→
   182→/**
   183→ * Type guard to check if an error is an auth error
   184→ */
   185→export function isAuthError(error: unknown): error is AuthError {
   186→  return error instanceof AuthError;
   187→}
   188→
   189→/**
   190→ * Categorize an unknown error into an appropriate AppError type
   191→ */
   192→export function categorizeError(error: unknown, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AppError {
   193→  // Already an AppError
   194→  if (isAppError(error)) {
   195→    return error;
   196→  }
   197→
   198→  // Convert to Error if needed
   199→  const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
   200→  const message = err.message.toLowerCase();
   201→
   202→  // Network errors
   203→  if (
   204→    err.name === 'AbortError' ||
   205→    message.includes('network') ||
   206→    message.includes('fetch') ||
   207→    message.includes('timeout') ||
   208→    message.includes('failed to fetch') ||
   209→    !navigator.onLine
   210→  ) {
   211→    return NetworkError.fromError(err, context);
   212→  }
   213→
   214→  // Auth errors
   215→  if (
   216→    message.includes('unauthorized') ||
   217→    message.includes('forbidden') ||
   218→    message.includes('not authenticated') ||
   219→    message.includes('authentication required')
   220→  ) {
   221→    return AuthError.fromError(err, context);
   222→  }
   223→
   224→  // Validation errors
   225→  if (
   226→    message.includes('required') ||
   227→    message.includes('invalid') ||
   228→    message.includes('validation')
   229→  ) {
   230→    return new ValidationError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  // Default to generic AppError
   234→  return new AppError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   235→}
   236→

    15→type QueryKeyLike = readonly unknown[];
