    17→interface DataFreshnessState {
    18→  realtimeStatus: RealtimeStatus;
    19→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>;
    20→  lastStatusChange: number;
    21→  /** Track consecutive fetch failures per query for circuit breaker */
    22→  fetchFailures: Map<string, { count: number; lastFailure: number }>;
    23→}
    24→
    25→class DataFreshnessManager {
    26→  private state: DataFreshnessState = {
    27→    realtimeStatus: 'disconnected',
    28→    lastEventTimes: new Map(),
    29→    lastStatusChange: Date.now(),
    30→    fetchFailures: new Map()
    31→  };
    32→
    33→  private subscribers = new Set<() => void>();
    34→
    35→  // Circuit breaker settings
    36→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD = 3; // failures before backing off
    37→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS = 60_000; // 1 minute to reset failure count
    38→
    39→  // Toast throttling - prevent spamming error toasts
    40→  private lastErrorToastTime = 0;
    41→  private readonly ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS = 30_000; // Only show error toast every 30 seconds
    42→
    43→  private parseQueryKey(rawKey: string): unknown {
    44→    try {
    45→      return JSON.parse(rawKey);
    46→    } catch {
    47→      return rawKey;
    48→    }
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  /**
    52→   * Report realtime connection status change
    53→   */
    54→  onRealtimeStatusChange(status: RealtimeStatus, _reason?: string) {
    55→    const previousStatus = this.state.realtimeStatus;
    56→    const now = Date.now();
    57→
    58→    // Ignore duplicate status changes to keep lastStatusChange stable.
    59→    // This allows the "recently connected" grace period in getPollingInterval to actually expire.
    60→    if (previousStatus === status) {
    61→      return; // Don't update state or notify subscribers for duplicates
    62→    }
    63→    
    64→    // Actual status transition - update state
    65→    this.state.realtimeStatus = status;
    66→    this.state.lastStatusChange = now;
    67→
    68→    // Notify all subscribers that polling intervals may have changed
    69→    this.notifySubscribers();
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  /**
    73→   * Report that realtime events were received for specific queries
    74→   */
    75→  onRealtimeEvent(_eventType: string, affectedQueries: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
    76→    const now = Date.now();
    77→
    78→    affectedQueries.forEach(queryKey => {
    79→      const key = JSON.stringify(queryKey);
    80→      this.state.lastEventTimes.set(key, now);
    81→    });
    82→
    83→    // Notify subscribers that data freshness has changed
    84→    this.notifySubscribers();
    85→  }
    86→
    87→  /**
    88→   * Get the appropriate polling interval for a query
    89→   * Returns false to disable polling when realtime is working well
    90→   */
    91→  getPollingInterval(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): PollingInterval {
    92→    const key = JSON.stringify(queryKey);
    93→    const lastEvent = this.state.lastEventTimes.get(key);
    94→    const now = Date.now();
    95→    const timeSinceStatusChange = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
    96→
    97→    // If realtime is connected, trust it after it's been stable
    98→    if (this.state.realtimeStatus === 'connected') {
    99→      // If realtime just connected (< 30 seconds), give it time to prove it's stable
   100→      if (timeSinceStatusChange < 30000) {
   101→        return 30000; // 30 seconds - wait for realtime to prove it's stable
   102→      }
   103→
   104→      // If realtime has been stable for >30 seconds, trust it.
   105→      // "No events" just means "nothing changed" — not "realtime is broken".
   106→      
   107→      if (lastEvent) {
   108→        const eventAge = now - lastEvent;
   109→        
   110→        if (eventAge < 60000) { // Events within 1 minute
   111→          return false; // Disable polling — realtime is working
   112→        } else if (eventAge < 3 * 60 * 1000) { // Events within 3 minutes
   113→          return 60000; // 60 seconds - light backup polling
   114→        }
   115→      }
   116→
   117→      // Realtime stable for >30s but no events — this is normal when idle.
   118→      // Use very light polling as a safety net only.
   119→      if (timeSinceStatusChange > 5 * 60 * 1000) {
   120→        // Realtime been stable for >5 minutes - fully trust it
   121→        return false; // Disable polling — realtime is stable, idle is OK
   122→      } else {
   123→        // Realtime stable for 30s-5min - use safety net polling
   124→        return 60000; // 60 seconds - safety net while realtime proves long-term stability
   125→      }
   126→    }
   127→
   128→    // If realtime is disconnected or errored, use GRADUATED backoff polling
   129→    // to prevent thundering herd and connection overload
   130→    const disconnectedDuration = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   131→
   132→    // Check circuit breaker - if this query has had many failures, back off more
   133→    const failureInfo = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   134→    const hasRecentFailures = failureInfo &&
   135→      (now - failureInfo.lastFailure) < this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS &&
   136→      failureInfo.count >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   137→
   138→    let pollingInterval: number;
   139→
   140→    if (hasRecentFailures) {
   141→      // Circuit breaker triggered - use much longer interval
   142→      pollingInterval = 60_000; // 60 seconds
   143→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 30_000) {
   144→      // First 30 seconds: 15s polling (give realtime time to reconnect)
   145→      pollingInterval = 15_000;
   146→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 2 * 60_000) {
   147→      // 30s - 2 minutes: 30s polling
   148→      pollingInterval = 30_000;
   149→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 5 * 60_000) {
   150→      // 2-5 minutes: 45s polling
   151→      pollingInterval = 45_000;
   152→    } else {
   153→      // >5 minutes: 60s polling (realtime probably has issues)
   154→      pollingInterval = 60_000;
   155→    }
   156→
   157→    return pollingInterval;
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  /**
   161→   * Report a fetch failure for circuit breaker tracking
   162→   */
   163→  onFetchFailure(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, error: Error) {
   164→    const key = JSON.stringify(queryKey);
   165→    const now = Date.now();
   166→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   167→
   168→    // Reset count if last failure was too long ago
   169→    const shouldReset = existing && (now - existing.lastFailure) > this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS;
   170→
   171→    const newCount = shouldReset ? 1 : (existing?.count || 0) + 1;
   172→    this.state.fetchFailures.set(key, { count: newCount, lastFailure: now });
   173→
   174→    const isCircuitBreakerTriggered = newCount >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   175→
   176→    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);
   177→
   178→    // Notify subscribers so polling intervals can adjust
   179→    if (isCircuitBreakerTriggered) {
   180→      this.notifySubscribers();
   181→
   182→      // Show user-facing error toast (throttled to prevent spam)
   183→      if (now - this.lastErrorToastTime > this.ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) {
   184→        this.lastErrorToastTime = now;
   185→
   186→        this.reportCircuitBreakerError({
   187→          queryKey: key,
   188→          failureCount: newCount,
   189→          errorType,
   190→          error,
   191→        });
   192→      }
   193→    }
   194→  }
   195→
   196→  private reportCircuitBreakerError(input: {
   197→    queryKey: string;
   198→    failureCount: number;
   199→    errorType: string;
   200→    error: Error;
   201→  }) {
   202→    const userMessage = this.getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(input.errorType, input.failureCount);
   203→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Data may be outdated. Will retry automatically.'), {
   204→      context: 'DataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure',
   205→      toastTitle: userMessage,
   206→      showToast: true,
   207→      logData: {
   208→        [REDACTED](input.queryKey),
   209→        failureCount: input.failureCount,
   210→        errorType: input.errorType,
   211→        errorMessage: input.error.message,
   212→      },
   213→    });
   214→  }
   215→
   216→  /**
   217→   * Get a user-friendly error message based on error type
   218→   */
   219→  private getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(errorType: string, failureCount: number): string {
   220→    switch (errorType) {
   221→      case 'CONNECTION_CLOSED':
   222→      case 'NETWORK_ERROR':
   223→        return 'Connection issue detected';
   224→      case 'TIMEOUT':
   225→        return 'Server is slow to respond';
   226→      case 'RATE_LIMITED':
   227→        return 'Too many requests - slowing down';
   228→      case 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE':
   229→        return 'Service temporarily unavailable';
   230→      case 'AUTH_ERROR':
   231→        return 'Authentication issue - try refreshing';
   232→      default:
   233→        return `Connection issues (${failureCount} failures)`;
   234→    }
   235→  }
   236→
   237→  /**
   238→   * Report a successful fetch (resets circuit breaker)
   239→   */
   240→  onFetchSuccess(queryKey: QueryKeyLike) {
   241→    const key = JSON.stringify(queryKey);
   242→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   243→
   244→    if (existing && existing.count > 0) {
   245→      // Reset failure count on success
   246→      this.state.fetchFailures.delete(key);
   247→    }
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  /**
   251→   * Classify error type for better logging and handling
   252→   */
   253→  private classifyError(error: Error): string {
   254→    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
   255→
   256→    if (message.includes('connection_closed') || message.includes('err_connection_closed')) {
   257→      return 'CONNECTION_CLOSED';
   258→    }
   259→    if (message.includes('failed to fetch') || message.includes('network')) {
   260→      return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
   261→    }
   262→    if (message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('timed out')) {
   263→      return 'TIMEOUT';
   264→    }
   265→    if (message.includes('abort')) {
   266→      return 'ABORTED';
   267→    }
   268→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {
   269→      return 'AUTH_ERROR';
   270→    }
   271→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   272→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   273→    }
   274→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   275→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   276→    }
   277→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   282→   */
   283→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   284→    const key = JSON.stringify(queryKey);
   285→    const lastEvent = this.state.lastEventTimes.get(key);
   286→    
   287→    if (!lastEvent) {
   288→      return false; // No events recorded = not fresh
   289→    }
   290→    
   291→    const age = Date.now() - lastEvent;
   292→    return age < freshnessThreshold;
   293→  }
   294→
   295→  /**
   296→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   297→   */
   298→  getDiagnostics() {
   299→    const now = Date.now();
   300→    return {
   301→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   302→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   303→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   304→      queryAges: Array.from(this.state.lastEventTimes.entries()).map(([key, time]) => {
   305→        return {
   306→          query: this.parseQueryKey(key),
   307→          ageMs: now - time,
   308→          ageSec: Math.round((now - time) / 1000)
   309→        };
   310→      }),
   311→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   312→      timestamp: now
   313→    };
   314→  }
   315→
   316→  /**
   317→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   318→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   319→   */
   320→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   321→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   322→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   323→  }
   324→
   325→  /**
   326→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   327→   */
   328→  reset() {
   329→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   330→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   331→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   332→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   333→    this.notifySubscribers();
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  /**
   337→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   338→   */
   339→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   340→    const now = Date.now();
   341→    queryKeys.forEach(queryKey => {
   342→      const key = JSON.stringify(queryKey);
   343→      this.state.lastEventTimes.set(key, now);
   344→    });
   345→
   346→    this.notifySubscribers();
   347→  }
   348→
   349→  private notifySubscribers() {
   350→    // Notify all React components that polling intervals may have changed
   351→    this.subscribers.forEach(callback => {
   352→      try {
   353→        callback();
   354→      } catch (error) {
   355→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   356→      }
   357→    });
   358→  }
   359→}
   360→
   361→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   362→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();
   363→let cleanupDataFreshnessDebugGlobal: (() => void) | null = null;
   364→
   365→/** Dev-only helper for wiring debug globals during app bootstrap. */
   366→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {
   367→  if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {
   368→    return;
   369→  }
   370→  cleanupDataFreshnessDebugGlobal?.();
   371→  cleanupDataFreshnessDebugGlobal = registerDebugGlobal(
   372→    '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__',
   373→    dataFreshnessManager,
   374→    'DataFreshnessManager',
   375→  );
   376→}

     7→  logData?: Record<string, unknown>;
     8→  onError?: (error: AppError) => void;
     9→}
    10→
    11→/** Normalize and log only. Does not trigger toast side effects. */
    12→export function reportError(error: unknown, options: ErrorReportOptions): AppError {
    13→  const { context, logData, onError } = options;
    14→  const appError = normalizeAndLogError(error, { context, logData });
    15→  onError?.(appError);
    16→  return appError;
    17→}
    18→
    19→export function reportAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: ErrorReportOptions): never {
    20→  throw reportError(error, options);

    60→export const useAddImageToShot = () => {
    61→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

   206→      shiftItems?: Array<{ id: string; newFrame: number }>;
   207→    }) => {
   208→      if (!shotId || !shotGenerationId || !projectId) {
   209→        throw new Error(`Missing required parameters`);
   210→      }
   211→
   212→      const { error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   213→        .update({ timeline_frame: null })
   214→        .eq('id', shotGenerationId);
   215→
   216→      if (error) {
   217→        throw error;
   218→      }
   219→
   220→      // Persist frame shifts (optimistic update already applied in onMutate)
   221→      if (shiftItems && shiftItems.length > 0) {
   222→        await persistTimelineFrameBatch({
   223→          shotId,
   224→          updates: shiftItems.map((item) => ({
   225→            shotGenerationId: item.id,
   226→            timelineFrame: item.newFrame,
   227→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'remove-shift' },
   228→          })),
   229→          operationLabel: 'remove-image-shift',
   230→          timeoutOperationName: 'remove-image-shift-rpc',
   231→          logPrefix: '[ShotGenerationMutations]',
   232→          log,
   233→        });
   234→      }
   235→
   236→      return { shotId, shotGenerationId, projectId };
   237→    },
   238→
   239→    onMutate: async (variables) => {
   240→      const { shotId, shotGenerationId, projectId, shiftItems } = variables;
   241→
   242→      await cancelShotsQueries(queryClient, projectId);
   243→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shotId);
   244→
   245→      const previousShots = findShotsCache(queryClient, projectId);
   246→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   247→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)
   248→      );
   249→
   250→      // Build a shift lookup for items that need frame updates
   251→      const shiftMap = new Map(shiftItems?.map(s => [s.id, s.newFrame]) ?? []);
   252→
   253→      // Optimistically: set timeline_frame = null on deleted item + shift remaining
   254→      if (previousFastGens) {
   255→        queryClient.setQueryData(
   256→          queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId),
   257→          previousFastGens.map(g => {
   258→            if (g.id === shotGenerationId) return { ...g, timeline_frame: null };
   259→            const shifted = shiftMap.get(g.id);
   260→            if (shifted !== undefined) return { ...g, timeline_frame: shifted };
   261→            return g;
   262→          })
   263→        );
   264→      }
   265→
   266→      if (previousShots) {
   267→        updateAllShotsCaches(queryClient, projectId, (shots = []) =>
   268→          shots.map(shot => {
   269→            if (shot.id === shotId) {
   270→              return {
   271→                ...shot,
   272→                images: (shot.images ?? []).map(img => {
   273→                  if (img.id === shotGenerationId) return { ...img, timeline_frame: null };
   274→                  const shifted = shiftMap.get(img.id);
   275→                  if (shifted !== undefined) return { ...img, timeline_frame: shifted };
   276→                  return img;
   277→                }),
   278→              };
   279→            }
   280→            return shot;
   281→          })
   282→        );
   283→      }
   284→
   285→      return { previousShots, previousFastGens, projectId, shotId };
   286→    },
   287→
   288→    onError: (err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   289→      if (context?.previousShots && context.projectId) {
   290→        rollbackShotsCaches(queryClient, context.projectId, context.previousShots);
   291→      }
   292→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   293→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   294→      }
   295→
   296→      toast.error(`Failed to remove image from timeline: ${err.message}`);
   297→    },
   298→
   299→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   300→      // Invalidate segment queries
   301→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   302→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   303→        [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId),
   304→      });
   305→    },
   306→  });
   307→};
   308→
   309→// ============================================================================
   310→// UPDATE SHOT IMAGE ORDER
   311→// ============================================================================
   312→
   313→export const useUpdateShotImageOrder = () => {
   314→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   315→
   316→  return useMutation({
   317→    mutationFn: async ({
   318→      updates,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      shotId,
   321→    }: {
   322→      updates: { shot_id: string; generation_id: string; timeline_frame: number }[];
   323→      projectId: string;
   324→      shotId: string;
   325→    }) => {
   326→      const promises = updates.map(update =>
   327→        supabase().from('shot_generations')
   328→          .update({ timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame })
   329→          .eq('shot_id', update.shot_id)
   330→          .eq('generation_id', update.generation_id)
   331→      );
   332→
   333→      const results = await Promise.all(promises);
   334→
   335→      const errors = results.filter(r => r.error);
   336→      if (errors.length > 0) {
   337→        throw new Error(`Reorder failed: ${errors.map(e => e.error?.message).join(', ')}`);
   338→      }
   339→
   340→      return { projectId, shotId, updates };
   341→    },
   342→
   343→    onMutate: async (variables) => {
   344→      const { updates, shotId } = variables;
   345→
   346→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shotId);
   347→
   348→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   349→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)
   350→      );
   351→
   352→      if (previousFastGens) {
   353→        const updatedGens = previousFastGens.map(gen => {
   354→          const update = updates.find(u => u.generation_id === gen.generation_id);
   355→          if (update) {
   356→            return { ...gen, timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame };
   357→          }
   358→          return gen;
   359→        });
   360→
   361→        updatedGens.sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame || 0) - (b.timeline_frame || 0));
   362→        queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), updatedGens);
   363→      }
   364→
   365→      return { previousFastGens, shotId };
   366→    },
   367→
   368→    onError: (_err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   369→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   370→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   371→      }
   372→
   373→      toast.error('Failed to reorder images');
   374→    },
   375→
   376→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   377→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   378→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   379→        predicate: query => query.queryKey[0] === 'source-slot-generations',
   380→      });
   381→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   382→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId) });
   383→    },
   384→  });
   385→};

   243→/**
   244→ * Calculates the final resolution for image generation tasks.
   245→ * Applies user-configurable scaling for supported image generation models.
   246→ * (internal use only - not exported)
   247→ * @param options - Resolution calculation options
   248→ * @returns Promise resolving to the final resolution string
   249→ */
   250→async function calculateTaskResolution(
   251→  options: CalculateTaskResolutionOptions
   252→): Promise<string> {
   253→  const { projectId, resolution_scale, resolution_mode, custom_aspect_ratio } = options;
   254→
   255→  // 1. If explicit custom resolution is provided, use it as-is (assumes it's already final)
   256→  if (options.customResolution?.trim()) {
   257→    return options.customResolution.trim();
   258→  }
   259→
   260→  // 2. Determine base resolution
   261→  let baseResolution: string;
   262→
   263→  if (resolution_mode === 'custom' && custom_aspect_ratio) {
   264→    // Use custom aspect ratio
   265→    baseResolution = ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[custom_aspect_ratio] ?? '902x508';
   266→  } else {
   267→    // Use project resolution
   268→    const { resolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(projectId);
   269→    baseResolution = resolution;
   270→  }
   271→
   272→  // 3. Apply scaling for image generation models
   273→  const isImageGenerationModel = options.modelName === 'qwen-image' || options.modelName === 'qwen-image-2512' || options.modelName === 'z-image';
   274→  if (isImageGenerationModel) {
   275→    const scale = resolution_scale ?? 1.5; // Default to 1.5 if not specified
   276→    const [width, height] = baseResolution.split('x').map(Number);
   277→    const scaledWidth = Math.round(width * scale);
   278→    const scaledHeight = Math.round(height * scale);
   279→    const scaledResolution = `${scaledWidth}x${scaledHeight}`;
   280→    return scaledResolution;
   281→  }
   282→
   283→  return baseResolution;
   284→}

   382→/**
   383→ * Creates a single image generation task using the unified approach

   385→ * (internal use only - used by createBatchImageGenerationTasks)
   386→ *
   387→ * @param params - Image generation task parameters

   390→async function createImageGenerationTask(params: ImageGenerationTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   391→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   392→    params,
   393→    context: 'ImageGeneration',
   394→    validate: validateImageGenerationParams,
   395→    buildTaskRequest: async (requestParams) => {
   396→      // 1. Calculate final resolution (handles Qwen scaling automatically)
   397→      const finalResolution = await calculateTaskResolution({
   398→        projectId: requestParams.project_id,
   399→        customResolution: requestParams.resolution,
   400→        modelName: requestParams.model_name,
   401→      });
   402→
   403→      // 2. Determine task type based on model and whether there's a style reference
   404→      const taskType = (() => {
   405→        const modelName = requestParams.model_name;
   406→        const hasStyleRef = !!requestParams.style_reference_image;
   407→
   408→        switch (modelName) {
   409→          case 'qwen-image':
   410→            // Use qwen_image_style for by-reference mode, qwen_image for just-text
   411→            return hasStyleRef ? 'qwen_image_style' : 'qwen_image';
   412→          case 'qwen-image-2512':
   413→            return 'qwen_image_2512';
   414→          case 'z-image':
   415→            return 'z_image_turbo';
   416→          default:
   417→            // Fallback to wan_2_2_t2i for unknown models
   418→            return 'wan_2_2_t2i';
   419→        }
   420→      })();
   421→      const supportsReferenceParamsModel =
   422→        requestParams.model_name?.startsWith('qwen-image') || requestParams.model_name === 'z-image';
   423→
   424→      // 3. Generate task ID for orchestration payload (stored in params, not as DB ID)
   425→      const taskId = generateTaskId(taskType);
   426→
   427→      // 4. Build intermediate params before assembling the final object
   428→      const lorasParam = buildLorasParam(
   429→        requestParams.loras,
   430→        supportsReferenceParamsModel && requestParams.in_this_scene && requestParams.in_this_scene_strength
   431→          ? { url: IN_SCENE_LORA_URL, strength: requestParams.in_this_scene_strength }
   432→          : undefined,
   433→      );
   434→      const referenceParams = supportsReferenceParamsModel
   435→        ? buildReferenceParams(requestParams.style_reference_image, requestParams.reference_mode, {
   436→            subjectReferenceImage: requestParams.subject_reference_image,
   437→            styleReferenceStrength: requestParams.style_reference_strength ?? 1.0,
   438→            subjectStrength: requestParams.subject_strength ?? 0.0,
   439→            subjectDescription: requestParams.subject_description,
   440→            inThisScene: requestParams.in_this_scene,
   441→            inThisSceneStrength: requestParams.in_this_scene_strength,
   442→          })
   443→        : {};
   444→      const hiresOverride = buildHiresOverride(
   445→        requestParams.hires_scale,
   446→        requestParams.hires_denoise,
   447→        requestParams.hires_steps,
   448→        requestParams.additional_loras,
   449→        lorasParam.additional_loras,
   450→      );
   451→
   452→      const taskParamsToSend = composeTaskParams({
   453→        source: requestParams,
   454→        baseParams: buildImageGenerationBaseParams(requestParams, taskId, finalResolution),
   455→        segments: [lorasParam, referenceParams, hiresOverride],
   456→        mappedFields: [
   457→          {
   458→            from: 'shot_id',
   459→            include: (value) => isNonEmptyString(value),
   460→          },
   461→          { from: 'lightning_lora_strength_phase_1' },
   462→          { from: 'lightning_lora_strength_phase_2' },
   463→        ],
   464→      });
   465→
   466→      return composeTaskRequest({
   467→        source: requestParams,
   468→        taskType,
   469→        params: taskParamsToSend,
   470→      });
   471→    },
   472→  });
   473→}

   213→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   214→
   215→  // Check for array format (image edit tasks use this)
   216→  const lorasArray = params.loras || orchestratorDetails?.loras || orchestratorPayload?.loras;
   217→  if (Array.isArray(lorasArray) && lorasArray.length > 0) {
   218→    return lorasArray
   219→      .map((lora): LoraInfo | null => {
   220→        const loraRecord = asRecord(lora);
   221→        if (!loraRecord) return null;
   222→        const url = asString(loraRecord.url) ?? '';
   223→        const parsedStrength = toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.strength) ?? toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.multiplier) ?? 1;
   224→        return {
   225→          url,
   226→          strength: parsedStrength,
   227→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   228→        };
   229→      })
   230→      .filter((lora): lora is LoraInfo => lora !== null);
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  // Check for object format (video tasks use additional_loras)
   234→  const additionalLoras = params.additional_loras || orchestratorDetails?.additional_loras || orchestratorPayload?.additional_loras;
   235→  if (additionalLoras && typeof additionalLoras === 'object' && Object.keys(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   236→    return Object.entries(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).map(([url, strength]) => ({
   237→      url,
   238→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   239→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   240→    }));
   241→  }

   243→  return [];
   244→}
   245→
   246→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {

   248→  return fileName.replace(/\.(safetensors|ckpt|pt)$/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');

   250→
   251→const TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   252→  'individualSegmentParams',
   253→  'taskViewContract',
   254→  'familyContract',
   255→  'rawParams',
   256→];
   257→
   258→const TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   259→  'taskViewContract',
   260→  'familyContract',
   261→  'orchestratorDetails',
   262→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   263→  'rawParams',
   264→];
   265→
   266→const TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   267→  'taskViewContract',
   268→  'familyContract',
   269→  'individualSegmentParams',
   270→  'orchestratorDetails',
   271→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   272→  'rawParams',
   273→];
   274→
   275→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   276→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));
   277→}
   278→
   279→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
   280→  const familyContract = asRecord(params.task_family_contract);
   281→  return (
   282→    params.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   283→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   284→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   285→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   286→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   287→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   288→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   289→  );
   290→}
   291→
   292→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   293→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   294→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   295→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   296→
   297→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   298→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   299→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   300→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   301→    }
   302→
   303→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   304→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   306→  }
   307→
   308→  const timelineSources = [
   309→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   310→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   311→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   312→  ];
   313→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {
   314→    if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {
   315→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(candidate);
   316→    }
   317→  }
   318→
   319→  return [];
   320→}
   321→
   322→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   323→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   324→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   325→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   326→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   327→
   328→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   329→    const enhancedPromptsExpanded = reader.pickStringArray('enhanced_prompts_expanded', [
   330→      'orchestratorDetails',
   331→      'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   332→      'rawParams',
   333→    ]);
   334→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   335→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   336→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   337→    );
   338→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   339→      return enhancedPrompt;
   340→    }
   341→
   342→    return (
   343→      pickFirstString(
   344→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   345→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   346→      ) ?? null
   347→    );
   348→  }
   349→
   350→  return (
   351→    pickFirstString(
   352→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   353→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   354→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   355→    ) ?? null
   356→  );
   357→}
   358→
   359→function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   360→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
   361→  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
   362→}
   363→
   364→function asString(value: unknown): string | null {
   365→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : null;
   366→}
   367→
   368→function asStringArray(value: unknown): string[] | null {
   369→  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return null;
   370→  return value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string');
   371→}
   372→
   373→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   374→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   375→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   376→  return numeric;
   377→}
   378→
   379→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   380→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   381→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   382→}
   383→
   384→function pickFirstString(...values: unknown[]): string | null {
   385→  for (const value of values) {
   386→    const text = asString(value);
   387→    if (text) return text;
   388→  }
   389→  return null;
   390→}
   391→

   355→
   356→    for (let index = 0; index < totalJoins; index++) {
   357→      const joinSettings = buildJoinOverrideRecord(params.per_join_settings?.[index]);
   358→
   359→      if (Object.keys(joinSettings).length > 0) {
   360→        hasOverrides = true;
   361→        perJoinOverrides.push(joinSettings);
   362→      } else {
   363→        perJoinOverrides.push({});
   364→      }
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    if (hasOverrides) {
   368→      orchestratorDetails.per_join_settings = perJoinOverrides;
   369→    }
   370→  }
   371→
   372→  const resolutionDisplay = params.resolution
   373→    ? `${params.resolution[0]}x${params.resolution[1]}`
   374→    : undefined;
   375→
   376→  const joinMode = normalized.joinMode;
   377→
   378→  const perJoinOverridesCount = params.per_join_settings?.filter((override) =>
   379→    !!override && Object.keys(override).length > 0
   380→  ).length ?? 0;
   381→
   382→  const familyContract = buildJoinClipsFamilyContract({
   383→    mode: joinMode,
   384→    runId,
   385→    clipUrls: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   386→    overridesCount: perJoinOverridesCount,
   387→    hasAudio: Boolean(params.audio_url),
   388→  });
   389→
   390→  const payload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   391→    taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   392→    orchestratorDetails,
   393→    orchestrationInput: {
   394→      taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   395→      orchestratorTaskId,
   396→      runId,
   397→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   398→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   399→      basedOn: params.based_on,
   400→      generationRouting: 'orchestrator',
   401→      siblingLookup: 'run_id',
   402→    },
   403→    taskViewInput: {
   404→      inputImages: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   405→      prompt: params.prompt,
   406→      negativePrompt: params.negative_prompt,
   407→      modelName: params.model,
   408→      resolution: resolutionDisplay,
   409→    },
   410→    familyContract,
   411→  });
   412→
   413→  return {
   414→    ...payload,
   415→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   416→    // Only include tool_type if explicitly passed (Join Clips page passes it, ShotEditor doesn't)
   417→    ...(params.tool_type && { tool_type: params.tool_type }),
   418→  };
   419→}
   420→
   421→/**
   422→ * Creates a join clips task using the unified approach
   423→ * 
   424→ * @param params - Join clips task parameters
   425→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   426→ */
   427→export async function createCanonicalJoinClipsTask(
   428→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   429→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   430→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   431→    params,
   432→    context: 'JoinClips',
   433→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   434→      const normalized = normalizeJoinClipsParams(requestParams);
   435→      const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("join_clips_orchestrator");
   436→      const runId = requestParams.run_id ?? generateRunId();
   437→      const orchestratorPayload = buildJoinClipsPayload(
   438→        requestParams,
   439→        normalized,
   440→        runId,
   441→        orchestratorTaskId,
   442→      );
   443→
   444→      return composeTaskRequest({
   445→        source: requestParams,
   446→        taskType: 'join_clips_orchestrator',
   447→        params: orchestratorPayload,
   448→      });
   449→    },
   450→  });
   451→}
   452→
   453→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally

1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation
    11→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    12→ *
    13→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→export interface QueuedWrite {
    19→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    20→  entityId: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    23→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PendingWrite {
    27→  write: QueuedWrite;
    28→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    29→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    30→  enqueuedAt: number;
    31→}
    32→
    33→// Configuration
    34→const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;
    35→const MAX_CONCURRENT = 1;
    36→
    37→// State
    38→const pendingByTarget = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();
    39→let inFlightCount = 0;
    40→const flushQueue: Array<{ targetKey: string; pending: PendingWrite }> = [];
    41→
    42→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    43→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    44→
    45→function createAbortError(): Error {
    46→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    47→    return new DOMException('Request was cancelled', 'AbortError');
    48→  }
    49→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    50→  error.name = 'AbortError';
    51→  return error;
    52→}
    53→
    54→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    55→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    56→    throw createAbortError();
    57→  }
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Set the write function that performs the actual DB update.
    62→ * Must be called once at app init (in useToolSettings.ts).
    63→ * Also registers page-unload listeners on first call (deferred from module load).
    64→ */
    65→export function setSettingsWriteFunction(fn: (write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) {
    66→  const isFirstInit = writeFunction === null;
    67→  writeFunction = fn;
    68→
    69→  if (isFirstInit && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    70→    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    71→      flushAll();
    72→    });
    73→    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    74→      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
    75→        flushAll();
    76→      }
    77→    });
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→/**
    82→ * Create a unique key for deduplication
    83→ */
    84→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
    85→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
    86→}
    87→
    88→/**
    89→ * Shallow merge (one level deep)
    90→ */
    91→function shallowMergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    92→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
    93→}
    94→
    95→/**
    96→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
    97→ */
    98→async function processQueue() {
    99→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
   100→    return;
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
   104→  if (!next) return;
   105→
   106→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
   107→  
   108→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
   109→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
   110→  
   111→  inFlightCount++;
   112→  
   113→  try {
   114→    if (!writeFunction) {
   115→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    throwIfAborted(pending.write.signal);
   119→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
   120→    
   121→    // Resolve all waiters
   122→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
   123→      resolve(result);
   124→    }
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
   127→
   128→    // Reject all waiters
   129→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
   130→      reject(error);
   131→    }
   132→  } finally {
   133→    inFlightCount--;
   134→    
   135→    // Process next item
   136→    processQueue();
   137→  }
   138→}
   139→
   140→/**
   141→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   142→ */
   143→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   144→  // Clear existing timer
   145→  if (pending.timerId) {
   146→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   147→    pending.timerId = null;
   148→  }
   149→  
   150→  // Add to flush queue and process
   151→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   152→  processQueue();
   153→}
   154→
   155→/**
   156→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   157→ * 
   158→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   159→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   160→ * 
   161→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   162→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   163→ */
   164→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   165→  write: QueuedWrite,
   166→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   167→): Promise<unknown> {
   168→  const key = targetKey(write);
   169→
   170→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   171→    if (write.signal?.aborted) {
   172→      reject(createAbortError());
   173→      return;
   174→    }
   175→
   176→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   177→
   178→    if (existing) {
   179→      // Merge with existing pending write
   180→      existing.write.patch = shallowMergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   181→      if (write.signal) {
   182→        existing.write.signal = write.signal;
   183→      }
   184→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   185→
   186→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   187→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   188→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   189→      }
   190→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   191→      
   192→    } else {
   193→      // Create new pending write
   194→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   195→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   196→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   197→        timerId: null,
   198→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   199→      };
   200→
   201→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   202→
   203→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   204→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   205→      } else {
   206→        // Set debounce timer
   207→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   208→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   209→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   210→      }
   211→    }
   212→  });
   213→}
   214→
   215→
   216→/**
   217→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   218→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   219→ */
   220→function flushAll(): void {
   221→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   222→    if (pending.timerId) {
   223→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   224→      pending.timerId = null;
   225→    }
   226→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   227→  }
   228→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   229→  processQueue();
   230→}
   231→
   232→

    65→>> = {
    66→  num_frames: 1,
    67→  use_calculated_fps: true,
    68→  video_quality: 'high',
    69→};
    70→
    71→/**
    72→ * Default values for FlashVSR upscaling (internal use only - not exported)
    73→ */
    74→const DEFAULT_FLASHVSR_PARAMS: Required<Pick<
    75→  FlashVsrUpscaleApiParams,
    76→  'upscale_factor' | 'color_fix' | 'output_quality'
    77→>> = {
    78→  upscale_factor: 2,
    79→  color_fix: true,
    80→  output_quality: 'high',
    81→};
    82→
    83→/**
    84→ * Combined video enhancement task parameters
    85→ */
    86→export interface VideoEnhanceTaskParams {
    87→  // Required
    88→  project_id: string;
    89→  video_url: string;
    90→
    91→  // Mode selection - at least one must be true
    92→  enable_interpolation: boolean;
    93→  enable_upscale: boolean;
    94→
    95→  // FILM interpolation params (used when enable_interpolation is true)
    96→  interpolation?: FilmInterpolationApiParams;
    97→
    98→  // FlashVSR upscale params (used when enable_upscale is true)
    99→  upscale?: FlashVsrUpscaleApiParams;
   100→
   101→  // Task metadata
   102→  shot_id?: string;
   103→  /** Generation ID this enhancement is based on - creates variant when set */
   104→  based_on?: string;
   105→  /** Source variant ID - track which variant was enhanced */
   106→  source_variant_id?: string;
   107→}
   108→
   109→/**
   110→ * Validates video enhancement task parameters
   111→ */
   112→function validateVideoEnhanceParams(params: VideoEnhanceTaskParams): void {
   113→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'video_url']);
   114→
   115→  if (!params.enable_interpolation && !params.enable_upscale) {
   116→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   117→      "At least one enhancement mode (interpolation or upscale) must be enabled",
   118→      'enable_interpolation'
   119→    );
   120→  }
   121→
   122→  // Validate interpolation params if enabled
   123→  if (params.enable_interpolation && params.interpolation?.num_frames !== undefined) {
   124→    if (params.interpolation.num_frames < 1 || params.interpolation.num_frames > 4) {
   125→      throw new TaskValidationError(
   126→        "num_frames must be between 1 and 4",
   127→        'interpolation.num_frames'
   128→      );
   129→    }
   130→  }
   131→
   132→  // Validate upscale params if enabled
   133→  if (params.enable_upscale && params.upscale?.upscale_factor !== undefined) {
   134→    if (params.upscale.upscale_factor < 1 || params.upscale.upscale_factor > 4) {
   135→      throw new TaskValidationError(
   136→        "upscale_factor must be between 1 and 4",
   137→        'upscale.upscale_factor'
   138→      );
   139→    }
   140→  }
   141→}
   142→
   143→/**
   144→ * Builds the task payload for video enhancement
   145→ */
   146→function buildVideoEnhancePayload(
   147→  params: VideoEnhanceTaskParams
   148→): Record<string, unknown> {
   149→  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
   150→    video_url: params.video_url,
   151→    enable_interpolation: params.enable_interpolation,
   152→    enable_upscale: params.enable_upscale,
   153→  };
   154→
   155→  // Add interpolation params with defaults
   156→  if (params.enable_interpolation) {
   157→    payload.interpolation = {
   158→      num_frames: params.interpolation?.num_frames ?? DEFAULT_FILM_PARAMS.num_frames,
   159→      use_calculated_fps: params.interpolation?.use_calculated_fps ?? DEFAULT_FILM_PARAMS.use_calculated_fps,
   160→      video_quality: params.interpolation?.video_quality ?? DEFAULT_FILM_PARAMS.video_quality,
   161→      // Optional params only if provided
   162→      ...(params.interpolation?.use_scene_detection !== undefined && {
   163→        use_scene_detection: params.interpolation.use_scene_detection,
   164→      }),
   165→      ...(params.interpolation?.loop !== undefined && {
   166→        loop: params.interpolation.loop,
   167→      }),
   168→      ...(params.interpolation?.fps !== undefined && {
   169→        fps: params.interpolation.fps,
   170→      }),
   171→      ...(params.interpolation?.video_write_mode !== undefined && {
   172→        video_write_mode: params.interpolation.video_write_mode,
   173→      }),
   174→    };
   175→  }
   176→
   177→  // Add upscale params with defaults
   178→  if (params.enable_upscale) {
   179→    payload.upscale = {
   180→      upscale_factor: params.upscale?.upscale_factor ?? DEFAULT_FLASHVSR_PARAMS.upscale_factor,
   181→      color_fix: params.upscale?.color_fix ?? DEFAULT_FLASHVSR_PARAMS.color_fix,
   182→      output_quality: params.upscale?.output_quality ?? DEFAULT_FLASHVSR_PARAMS.output_quality,
   183→      // Optional params only if provided
   184→      ...(params.upscale?.quality !== undefined && {
   185→        quality: params.upscale.quality,
   186→      }),
   187→      ...(params.upscale?.acceleration !== undefined && {
   188→        acceleration: params.upscale.acceleration,
   189→      }),
   190→      ...(params.upscale?.output_format !== undefined && {
   191→        output_format: params.upscale.output_format,
   192→      }),
   193→      ...(params.upscale?.output_write_mode !== undefined && {
   194→        output_write_mode: params.upscale.output_write_mode,
   195→      }),
   196→      ...(params.upscale?.preserve_audio !== undefined && {
   197→        preserve_audio: params.upscale.preserve_audio,
   198→      }),
   199→    };
   200→  }
   201→
   202→  // Add metadata
   203→  if (params.shot_id) {
   204→    payload.shot_id = params.shot_id;
   205→  }
   206→  // based_on tells complete_task to create a variant on the source generation
   207→  if (params.based_on) {
   208→    payload.based_on = params.based_on;
   209→    payload.parent_generation_id = params.based_on;
   210→    // is_primary=true makes the enhanced version the main display variant
   211→    payload.is_primary = true;
   212→  }
   213→  // source_variant_id tracks which variant was enhanced (for UI display)
   214→  if (params.source_variant_id) {
   215→    payload.source_variant_id = params.source_variant_id;
   216→  }
   217→
   218→  return payload;
   219→}
   220→
   221→/**
   222→ * Result of creating a video enhancement task
   223→ */
   224→interface VideoEnhanceTaskResult {
   225→  task: TaskCreationResult;
   226→}
   227→
   228→/**
   229→ * Creates a video enhancement task
   230→ *
   231→ * @param params - Video enhancement task parameters
   232→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   233→ */
   234→export async function createVideoEnhanceTask(
   235→  params: VideoEnhanceTaskParams
   236→): Promise<VideoEnhanceTaskResult> {
   237→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   238→    params,
   239→    context: 'VideoEnhance',
   240→    validate: validateVideoEnhanceParams,
   241→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   242→      const payload = buildVideoEnhancePayload(requestParams);
   243→
   244→      return composeTaskRequest({
   245→        source: requestParams,
   246→        taskType: 'video_enhance',
   247→        params: {
   248→          tool_type: 'video-enhance',
   249→          ...payload,
   250→        },
   251→      });
   252→    },
   253→    onCreated: (task) => ({ task }),
   254→  });
   255→}
   256→
   257→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   258→

1→import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     4→import { settingsQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/settings';
     5→import { SETTINGS_IDS } from '@/shared/lib/settingsIds';
     6→import {
     7→  fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow,
     8→  type SettingsFetchResult,
     9→} from '@/shared/lib/toolSettingsService';
    10→
    11→// Central list of tool IDs we want to preload. Update when you add more tools.
    12→const PREFETCH_TOOL_IDS = [
    13→  SETTINGS_IDS.IMAGE_GENERATION,
    14→  SETTINGS_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES,
    15→  SETTINGS_IDS.PROJECT_IMAGE_SETTINGS, // Shared settings including reference images
    16→];
    17→const EMPTY_SHOT_IDS: string[] = [];
    18→
    19→/**
    20→ * Fetch tool settings using the shared service contract (for prefetching).
    21→ */
    22→function fetchSettingsForPrefetch(
    23→  toolId: string,
    24→  ctx: { projectId?: string; shotId?: string },
    25→): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> {
    26→  return fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(toolId, ctx);
    27→}
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Prefetch tool settings for a project (and optionally its shots) so that
    31→ * individual pages can hydrate synchronously from React-Query cache.
    32→ * Now uses direct Supabase calls for better mobile reliability.
    33→ *
    34→ * @param projectId selected project id
    35→ * @param shotIds  array of shot ids belonging to the project (optional)
    36→ */
    37→export function usePrefetchToolSettings(projectId?: string | null, shotIds: string[] = EMPTY_SHOT_IDS) {
    38→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    39→  const shotIdsKey = shotIds.join(',');
    40→  const shotIdsForPrefetch = useMemo(
    41→    () => (shotIdsKey ? shotIdsKey.split(',') : EMPTY_SHOT_IDS),
    42→    [shotIdsKey],
    43→  );
    44→
    45→  useEffect(() => {
    46→    if (!projectId) {
    47→      return;
    48→    }
    49→
    50→    // Prefetch project-level settings for each tool.
    51→    PREFETCH_TOOL_IDS.forEach((toolId) => {
    52→      queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    53→        [REDACTED](toolId, projectId, undefined),
    54→        queryFn: () => fetchSettingsForPrefetch(toolId, { projectId }),
    55→        staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // keep fresh for 5 min (same as useToolSettings)
    56→      }).then(() => {
    57→      }).catch((error) => {
    58→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'usePrefetchToolSettings', showToast: false });
    59→      });
    60→    });
    61→
    62→    // Prefetch shot-level settings when shot IDs are provided.
    63→    if (shotIdsForPrefetch.length) {
    64→      shotIdsForPrefetch.forEach((shotId) => {
    65→        PREFETCH_TOOL_IDS.forEach((toolId) => {
    66→          queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    67→            [REDACTED](toolId, projectId, shotId),
    68→            queryFn: () => fetchSettingsForPrefetch(toolId, { projectId, shotId }),
    69→            staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
    70→          });
    71→        });
    72→      });
    73→    }
    74→  }, [projectId, shotIdsForPrefetch, queryClient]);
    75→}

   103→    // Use combined action for atomic state update - both deleted mark AND backfill loading

   302→      });

   304→    } catch (error) {

   319→    }
   320→  }, [filteredImages, setIsDownloadingStarred]);
   321→
   322→  // Cleanup on unmount
   323→  useEffect(() => {
   324→    return () => {
   325→      if (refetchTimeoutRef.current) {
   326→        clearTimeout(refetchTimeoutRef.current);
   327→      }
   328→      if (clearLoadingTimeoutRef.current) {

   330→      }
   331→    };
   332→  }, []);
   333→
   334→  return {

1→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP = 4;
     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→

    22→  createGenerationRecord,
    23→  deleteGenerationByScope,
    24→  deleteGenerationVariantByScope,
    25→  updateGenerationLocationByScope,
    26→  updateGenerationStarByScope,
    27→} from '@/integrations/supabase/repositories/generationMutationsRepository';
    28→import {
    29→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow,
    30→  normalizeAndPresentError,
    31→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    32→import { dispatchAppEvent } from '@/shared/lib/typedEvents';
    33→import { VARIANT_TYPE } from '@/shared/constants/variantTypes';
    34→import {
    35→  applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate,
    36→  rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate,
    37→} from '@/shared/hooks/invalidation/generationStarCacheCoordinator';
    38→import {
    39→  resolveGenerationProjectScope,
    40→  resolveVariantProjectScope,
    41→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    42→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    43→
    44→// ===== Helper Functions (internal) =====
    45→
    46→interface ScopedGenerationInput {
    47→  id: string;
    48→  projectId: string;
    49→}
    50→
    51→interface ScopedVariantInput {
    52→  id: string;
    53→  projectId: string;
    54→}
    55→
    56→function ensureProjectScope(projectId: string | undefined, context: string): string {
    57→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    58→    return projectId;
    59→  }
    60→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('Mutation requires project scope'), {
    61→    context,
    62→    showToast: false,
    63→    logData: { reason: 'missing_project_scope' },
    64→  });
    65→}
    66→
    67→async function verifyGenerationScope(generationId: string, projectId: string, context: string): Promise<void> {
    68→  const scope = await resolveGenerationProjectScope(generationId, projectId);
    69→  if (scope.status === 'ok') {
    70→    return;
    71→  }
    72→
    73→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
    74→    new Error(`Generation scope validation failed (${scope.status})`),
    75→    {
    76→      context,
    77→      showToast: false,
    78→      logData: {
    79→        generationId,
    80→        projectId,
    81→        scopeStatus: scope.status,
    82→        queryError: scope.queryError,
    83→      },
    84→    },
    85→  );
    86→}
    87→
    88→async function verifyVariantScope(
    89→  variantId: string,
    90→  projectId: string,
    91→  context: string,
    92→): Promise<{ generationId: string }> {
    93→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
    94→  if (scope.status === 'ok' && scope.generationId) {
    95→    return { generationId: scope.generationId };
    96→  }
    97→
    98→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
    99→    new Error(`Variant scope validation failed (${scope.status})`),
   100→    {
   101→      context,
   102→      showToast: false,
   103→      logData: {
   104→        variantId,
   105→        projectId,
   106→        generationId: scope.generationId,
   107→        scopeStatus: scope.status,
   108→        queryError: scope.queryError,
   109→      },
   110→    },
   111→  );
   112→}
   113→
   114→/**
   115→ * Update generation location using direct Supabase call.
   116→ * @internal Used by useUpdateGenerationLocation hook.
   117→ */
   118→async function updateGenerationLocation(
   119→  params: ScopedGenerationInput & { location: string; thumbUrl?: string },
   120→): Promise<void> {
   121→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   122→    params.projectId,
   123→    'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.projectScope',
   124→  );
   125→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   126→    params.id,
   127→    projectId,
   128→    'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.scopeValidation',
   129→  );
   130→
   131→  const updateData: { location: string; thumbnail_url?: string } = { location: params.location };
   132→
   133→  // If thumbUrl is provided, update it as well (important for flipped images)
   134→  if (params.thumbUrl) {
   135→    updateData.thumbnail_url = params.thumbUrl;
   136→  }
   137→
   138→  const { data, error } = await updateGenerationLocationByScope({
   139→    id: params.id,
   140→    projectId,
   141→    location: updateData.location,
   142→    thumbnailUrl: updateData.thumbnail_url,
   143→  });
   144→
   145→  if (error) {
   146→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   147→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation',
   148→      showToast: false,
   149→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId },
   150→    });
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   154→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows updated while enforcing generation project scope'), {
   155→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.noRows',
   156→      showToast: false,
   157→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId },
   158→    });
   159→  }
   160→}
   161→
   162→/**
   163→ * Create a new generation using direct Supabase call.
   164→ * @internal Used by useCreateGeneration hook.
   165→ */
   166→async function createGeneration(params: {
   167→  imageUrl: string;
   168→  fileName: string;
   169→  fileType: string;
   170→  fileSize: number;
   171→  projectId: string;
   172→  prompt: string;
   173→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
   174→  /** Resolution in "WIDTHxHEIGHT" format (e.g., "1920x1080") */
   175→  resolution?: string;
   176→  /** Standard aspect ratio (e.g., "16:9") */
   177→  aspectRatio?: string;
   178→}): Promise<GenerationRow> {
   179→  const generationParams: Record<string, Json | undefined> = {
   180→    prompt: params.prompt,
   181→    source: 'external_upload',
   182→    original_filename: params.fileName,
   183→    file_type: params.fileType,
   184→    file_size: params.fileSize,
   185→  };
   186→
   187→  // Add dimension params if provided
   188→  if (params.resolution) {
   189→    generationParams.resolution = params.resolution;
   190→  }
   191→  if (params.aspectRatio) {
   192→    generationParams.aspect_ratio = params.aspectRatio;
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  const { data, error } = await createGenerationRecord({
   196→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   197→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   198→    fileType: params.fileType || 'image',
   199→    projectId: params.projectId,
   200→    generationParams,
   201→  });
   202→
   203→  if (error || !data) {
   204→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error ?? new Error('Failed to create generation'), {
   205→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createGeneration',
   206→      showToast: false,
   207→      logData: { projectId: params.projectId },
   208→    });
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  // Create the original variant for this generation
   212→  const { error: variantError } = await createGenerationPrimaryVariant({
   213→    generationId: data.id,
   214→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   215→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   216→    generationParams,
   217→    variantType: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  if (variantError) {
   221→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(variantError, {
   222→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createVariant',
   223→      showToast: false,
   224→    });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  return data;
   228→}
   229→
   230→/**
   231→ * Star/unstar a generation using direct Supabase call.
   232→ * @internal Used by useToggleGenerationStar hook.
   233→ */
   234→async function toggleGenerationStar(params: ScopedGenerationInput & { starred: boolean }): Promise<void> {
   235→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   236→    params.projectId,
   237→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.projectScope',
   238→  );
   239→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   240→    params.id,
   241→    projectId,
   242→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.scopeValidation',
   243→  );
   244→
   245→  const { data, error } = await updateGenerationStarByScope({
   246→    id: params.id,
   247→    projectId,
   248→    starred: params.starred,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  if (error) {
   252→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   253→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar',
   254→      showToast: false,
   255→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   260→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
   261→      new Error('No rows updated while toggling generation star (possible RLS policy issue)'),
   262→      {
   263→        context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.noRows',
   264→        showToast: false,
   265→        logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   266→      },
   267→    );
   268→  }
   269→}
   270→
   271→// ===== Mutation Hooks =====
   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Shared delete mutation factory for generations and variants.
   275→ * @internal
   276→ */
   277→function useDeleteFromTable(table: 'generations' | 'generation_variants', entityLabel: string) {
   278→  return useMutation({
   279→    mutationFn: async (input: ScopedGenerationInput | ScopedVariantInput) => {
   280→      const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   281→        input.projectId,
   282→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.projectScope`,
   283→      );
   284→
   285→      if (table === 'generations') {
   286→        await verifyGenerationScope(
   287→          input.id,
   288→          projectId,
   289→          `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   290→        );
   291→
   292→        const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   293→          id: input.id,
   294→          projectId,
   295→        });
   296→
   297→        if (error) {
   298→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   299→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   300→            showToast: false,
   301→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   302→          });
   303→        }
   304→
   305→        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   306→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   307→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   308→            showToast: false,
   309→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   310→          });
   311→        }
   312→
   313→        return;
   314→      }
   315→
   316→      const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   317→        input.id,
   318→        projectId,
   319→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   320→      );
   321→      const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   322→        id: input.id,
   323→        generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   324→      });
   325→
   326→      if (error) {
   327→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   328→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   329→          showToast: false,
   330→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   331→        });
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   335→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   336→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   337→          showToast: false,
   338→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   339→        });
   340→      }
   341→    },
   342→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   343→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→        context: `useDelete${entityLabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + entityLabel.slice(1)}`,
   345→        toastTitle: `Failed to delete ${entityLabel}`,
   346→      });
   347→    },
   348→  });
   349→}
   350→
   351→export function useDeleteGeneration() {
   352→  return useDeleteFromTable('generations', 'generation');
   353→}
   354→
   355→/**
   356→ * Delete a variant from generation_variants table.
   357→ * Use this for edit tools (edit-images, edit-video, character-animate) that create variants.
   358→ */
   359→export function useDeleteVariant() {
   360→  return useDeleteFromTable('generation_variants', 'variant');
   361→}
   362→
   363→export function useUpdateGenerationLocation() {
   364→  return useMutation({
   365→    mutationFn: ({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId }: { id: string; location: string; thumbUrl?: string; projectId: string }) => {
   366→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });
   367→    },
   368→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   369→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useUpdateGenerationLocation', toastTitle: 'Failed to update generation' });
   370→    },
   371→  });
   372→}
   373→
   374→export function useCreateGeneration() {
   375→  return useMutation({
   376→    mutationFn: createGeneration,
   377→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   378→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useCreateGeneration', toastTitle: 'Failed to create generation' });
   379→    },
   380→  });
   381→}
   382→
   383→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {
   384→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   385→
   386→  return useMutation({
   387→    mutationFn: ({ id, starred, projectId }: { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }) => {
   388→      return toggleGenerationStar({ id, starred, projectId });
   389→    },
   390→    onMutate: async ({ id, starred, shotId }) => {
   391→      return applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, {
   392→        generationId: id,
   393→        starred,
   394→        shotId,
   395→      });
   396→    },
   397→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   398→      rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, context);
   399→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToggleGenerationStar', toastTitle: 'Failed to toggle star' });
   400→    },
   401→    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
   402→      // Emit custom event so Timeline knows to refetch star data
   403→      if (variables.shotId) {
   404→        dispatchAppEvent('generation-star-updated', {
   405→          generationId: variables.id, shotId: variables.shotId!, starred: variables.starred,
   406→        });
   407→      }
   408→    },
   409→  });
   410→}
   411→

   434→export function useInlineEditState(
   435→  media: GenerationRow,
   436→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   437→): InlineEditStateResult {
   438→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   439→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   440→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   441→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   442→
   443→  useEffect(() => {
   444→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   445→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   446→
   447→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   448→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   449→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   450→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   451→
   452→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   453→
   454→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   455→    media,
   456→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   457→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   458→      : undefined,
   459→  });
   460→
   461→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   462→
   463→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   464→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   465→  };
   466→
   467→  const {
   468→    inpaintingState,
   469→    transformState,
   470→    generationState,
   471→    imageEditValue,
   472→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   473→    env,
   474→    persistence,
   475→    inpainting,
   476→    magic,
   477→    reposition,
   478→    img2img,
   479→    starToggle,
   480→    handleDownload,
   481→  });
   482→
   483→  return {
   484→    media,
   485→    canvasEnvironment: {
   486→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   487→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   488→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   489→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   490→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   491→      effectiveImageUrl,
   492→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   493→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   494→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   495→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   496→    },
   497→    inpaintingState,
   498→    transformState,
   499→    generationState,
   500→    variants: {
   501→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   502→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   503→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   504→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   505→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   506→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   507→    },
   508→    sourceGenerationData,
   509→    availableLoras,
   510→    imageEditValue,
   511→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   512→}
   513→
