   474→
   475→/**
   476→ * Creates multiple image generation tasks in parallel (batch generation)
   477→ * This replaces the enqueueTasks pattern used in ImageGenerationForm
   478→ * 
   479→ * @param params - Batch image generation parameters
   480→ * @returns Promise resolving to array of created tasks
   481→ */
   482→export async function createBatchImageGenerationTasks(params: BatchImageGenerationTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
   483→
   484→  try {
   485→    return await runBatchTaskPipeline({
   486→      batchParams: params,
   487→      validateBatchParams: validateBatchImageGenerationParams,
   488→      buildSingleTaskParams: async (batchParams): Promise<ImageGenerationTaskParams[]> => {
   489→        const finalResolution = await calculateTaskResolution({
   490→          projectId: batchParams.project_id,
   491→          customResolution: batchParams.resolution,
   492→          modelName: batchParams.model_name,
   493→          resolution_scale: batchParams.resolution_scale,
   494→          resolution_mode: batchParams.resolution_mode,
   495→          custom_aspect_ratio: batchParams.custom_aspect_ratio,
   496→        });
   497→
   498→        const batchReferenceParams = buildReferenceParams(
   499→          batchParams.style_reference_image,
   500→          batchParams.reference_mode,
   501→          {
   502→            subjectReferenceImage: batchParams.subject_reference_image,
   503→            styleReferenceStrength: batchParams.style_reference_strength,
   504→            subjectStrength: batchParams.subject_strength,
   505→            subjectDescription: batchParams.subject_description,
   506→            inThisScene: batchParams.in_this_scene,
   507→            inThisSceneStrength: batchParams.in_this_scene_strength,
   508→          },
   509→        );
   510→
   511→        return batchParams.prompts.flatMap((promptEntry) => (
   512→          Array.from({ length: batchParams.imagesPerPrompt }, () => {
   513→            const seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x7fffffff);
   514→
   515→            return {
   516→              project_id: batchParams.project_id,
   517→              prompt: promptEntry.fullPrompt,
   518→              resolution: finalResolution,
   519→              seed,
   520→              loras: batchParams.loras,
   521→              shot_id: batchParams.shot_id,
   522→              model_name: batchParams.model_name,
   523→              steps: batchParams.steps,
   524→              reference_mode: batchParams.reference_mode,
   525→              ...batchReferenceParams,
   526→              ...composeOptionalFields([
   527→                { key: 'hires_scale', value: batchParams.hires_scale },
   528→                { key: 'hires_steps', value: batchParams.hires_steps },
   529→                { key: 'hires_denoise', value: batchParams.hires_denoise },
   530→                { [REDACTED], value: batchParams.lightning_lora_strength_phase_1 },
   531→                { [REDACTED], value: batchParams.lightning_lora_strength_phase_2 },
   532→                {
   533→                  [REDACTED],
   534→                  value: batchParams.additional_loras,
   535→                  include: (value) => Boolean(value && typeof value === 'object'),
   536→                },
   537→              ]),
   538→            } as ImageGenerationTaskParams;
   539→          })
   540→        ));
   541→      },
   542→      createSingleTask: createImageGenerationTask,
   543→      operationName: 'createBatchImageGenerationTasks',
   544→      onSettledResults: import.meta.env.DEV
   545→        ? (results) => {
   546→            results.forEach((result, index) => {
   547→              if (result.status === 'rejected') {
   548→                console.error(`[createBatch] task ${index} FAILED:`, result.reason);
   549→              }
   550→            });
   551→          }
   552→        : undefined,
   553→    });
   554→
   555→  } catch (error) {
   556→    if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
   557→      console.error('[createBatch] outer catch:', error);
   558→    }
   559→    rethrowTaskCreationError(error, { context: 'BatchImageGeneration' });
   560→  }
   561→}
   562→
   563→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   564→

   218→  const sidebarContent = model.isSpecialEditMode ? (

   175→function createInitialState(
   176→  editingPreset: AddNewTabProps['editingPreset'],
   177→  isOverwriting: boolean,
   178→  currentPhaseConfig: PhaseConfig | undefined,
   179→  currentSettings: AddNewTabProps['currentSettings'],

   181→  defaultIsPublic: boolean,
   182→): FormState {
   183→  const generationTypeMode = (editingPreset?.metadata?.generationTypeMode && !isOverwriting)
   184→    ? editingPreset.metadata.generationTypeMode
   185→    : initialGenerationTypeMode;
   186→
   187→  const editablePhaseConfig = (editingPreset?.metadata?.phaseConfig && !isOverwriting)
   188→    ? editingPreset.metadata.phaseConfig
   189→    : (currentPhaseConfig || DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG);
   190→
   191→  return {
   192→    fields: {
   193→      name: generatePresetName(),
   194→      description: '',
   195→      created_by_is_you: true,
   196→      created_by_username: '',
   197→      is_public: defaultIsPublic,
   198→      basePrompt: currentSettings?.basePrompt || '',
   199→      negativePrompt: currentSettings?.negativePrompt || '',
   200→      textBeforePrompts: currentSettings?.textBeforePrompts || '',
   201→      textAfterPrompts: currentSettings?.textAfterPrompts || '',
   202→      enhancePrompt: currentSettings?.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   203→      durationFrames: currentSettings?.durationFrames || 60,
   204→    },
   205→    editablePhaseConfig,
   206→    generationTypeMode,
   207→    isSubmitting: false,
   208→  };
   209→}

1→import { createTask, type BaseTaskParams, type TaskCreationResult } from '@/shared/lib/taskCreation';
     2→import { rethrowTaskCreationError } from './taskCreationError';
     3→
     4→interface TaskCreationPipelineConfig<TParams, TResult = TaskCreationResult> {
     5→  params: TParams;
     6→  context: string;
     7→  validate?: (params: TParams) => void;
     8→  buildTaskRequest: (params: TParams) => Promise<BaseTaskParams> | BaseTaskParams;
     9→  onCreated?: (result: TaskCreationResult, params: TParams) => Promise<TResult> | TResult;
    10→}
    11→
    12→export async function runTaskCreationPipeline<TParams, TResult = TaskCreationResult>(
    13→  config: TaskCreationPipelineConfig<TParams, TResult>,
    14→): Promise<TResult> {
    15→  const { params, context, validate, buildTaskRequest, onCreated } = config;
    16→
    17→  try {
    18→    validate?.(params);
    19→    const taskRequest = await buildTaskRequest(params);
    20→    const createdTask = await createTask(taskRequest);
    21→    if (!onCreated) {
    22→      return createdTask as TResult;
    23→    }
    24→    return await onCreated(createdTask, params);
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    rethrowTaskCreationError(error, { context, showToast: false });
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→

   108→    variantInvalidationDelays.delete(key);
   109→    // Coalesce superseded callers and signal skip so they do not invalidate stale paths.
   110→    existingDelay.settleCallbacks.forEach((settle) => settle(false));
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  logInvalidationEvent('schedule_variant', {
   114→    reason,
   115→    generationId,
   116→    delayMs,
   117→  });
   118→
   119→  return await new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
   120→    const settleCallbacks = [resolve];
   121→    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
   122→      variantInvalidationDelays.delete(key);
   123→      settleCallbacks.forEach((settle) => settle(true));
   124→    }, delayMs);
   125→    variantInvalidationDelays.set(key, {
   126→      timeout,
   127→      settleCallbacks,
   128→    });
   129→  });
   130→}

   146→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });

   162→    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });

    22→/**

    25→export function composeTaskParams<TSource extends object>(
    26→  input: ComposeTaskParamsInput<TSource>,

    29→    ...(input.baseParams ?? {}),

    31→

    39→    assignMappedPayloadFields(composed, input.source, input.mappedFields);
    40→  }
    41→
    42→  return composed;
    43→}

   262→export async function getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(
   263→  generationIds: string[],
   264→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   265→): Promise<Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>> {
   266→  if (generationIds.length === 0) {
   267→    return new Map();
   268→  }
   269→
   270→  const requestedIds = Array.from(new Set(generationIds));
   271→  const supabaseResult = (options?.supabaseRegistry ?? supabaseClientRegistry).getClientResult();
   272→  if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
   273→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   274→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   275→      failures.set(generationId, {
   276→        generationId,
   277→        taskId: null,
   278→        status: 'query_failed',
   279→        queryError: supabaseResult.error.message,
   280→      });
   281→    });
   282→    return failures;

   285→  const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
   286→  const query = supabase
   287→    .from('generations')
   288→    .select('id, tasks, project_id')
   289→    .in('id', requestedIds);
   290→
   291→  const { data, error } = await query;
   292→
   293→  if (error) {
   294→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   295→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   296→      failures.set(generationId, {
   297→        generationId,
   298→        taskId: null,
   299→        status: 'query_failed',
   300→        queryError: error.message,
   301→      });
   302→    });
   303→    return failures;
   304→  }
   305→
   306→  const rowsById = new Map((data || []).map((row) => [row.id, row]));
   307→
   308→  const mappings = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   309→  for (const generationId of requestedIds) {
   310→    const row = rowsById.get(generationId);
   311→
   312→    if (!row) {
   313→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   314→        generationId,
   315→        taskId: null,
   316→        status: 'missing_generation',
   317→      });
   318→      continue;

   321→    if (options?.projectId && row.project_id !== options.projectId) {

     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→

   440→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   441→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;

   446→

   247→      swipeDisabled: modeSnapshot.isMagicEditMode || (props.readOnly ?? false),
   248→    },
   249→    shots: {
   250→      shotId: props.shotId,
   251→      selectedShotId: props.shotWorkflow?.selectedShotId,
   252→      allShots: props.shotWorkflow?.allShots,
   253→      onShotChange: props.shotWorkflow?.onShotChange,
   254→      onAddToShot: props.shotWorkflow?.onAddToShot,
   255→      onAddToShotWithoutPosition: props.shotWorkflow?.onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   256→      onNavigateToShot: props.shotWorkflow?.onNavigateToShot,
   257→      onShowTick: props.shotWorkflow?.onShowTick,
   258→      onShowSecondaryTick: props.shotWorkflow?.onShowSecondaryTick,
   259→      onOptimisticPositioned: props.shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticPositioned,
   260→      onOptimisticUnpositioned: props.shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   261→      optimisticPositionedIds: props.shotWorkflow?.optimisticPositionedIds,
   262→      optimisticUnpositionedIds: props.shotWorkflow?.optimisticUnpositionedIds,
   263→      positionedInSelectedShot: props.shotWorkflow?.positionedInSelectedShot,
   264→      associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot: props.shotWorkflow?.associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot,
   265→    },
   266→    layout: {
   267→      showTaskDetails: props.features?.showTaskDetails,
   268→      isSpecialEditMode: modeSnapshot.isMagicEditMode,
   269→      isInpaintMode: modeSnapshot.isInpaintMode,
   270→      isMagicEditMode: modeSnapshot.isMagicEditMode,
   271→    },
   272→    actions: {
   273→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   274→      showDownload: props.features?.showDownload,
   275→      isDownloading: env.isDownloading,
   276→      setIsDownloading: env.setIsDownloading,
   277→      onDelete: props.actions?.onDelete,
   278→      isDeleting: props.actions?.isDeleting,
   279→      isUpscaling: env.upscaleHook.isUpscaling,
   280→      handleUpscale: () => {
   281→        void env.upscaleHook.handleUpscale({ scaleFactor: 2, noiseScale: 0.1 });
   282→      },
   283→    },
   284→    media: {
   285→      effectiveImageUrl: env.upscaleHook.effectiveImageUrl,
   286→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions || { width: 1024, height: 1024 },
   287→      projectAspectRatio: env.projectAspectRatio,
   288→    },
   289→    starred: props.actions?.starred,
   290→    onOpenExternalGeneration: props.onOpenExternalGeneration,
   291→  }), [
   292→    env.selectedProjectId,
   293→    env.isMobile,
   294→    env.variantFetchGenerationId,
   295→    env.isCloudMode,
   296→    env.isDownloading,
   297→    env.setIsDownloading,
   298→    env.upscaleHook,
   299→    env.imageDimensions,
   300→    env.projectAspectRatio,
   301→    props.media,
   302→    props.onClose,
   303→    props.readOnly,
   304→    props.initialVariantId,
   305→    props.shotId,
   306→    props.shotWorkflow,
   307→    props.features?.showTaskDetails,
   308→    props.features?.showDownload,
   309→    props.actions,
   310→    props.onOpenExternalGeneration,
   311→    navigation?.showNavigation,
   312→    navigation?.hasNext,
   313→    navigation?.hasPrevious,
   314→    handleSlotNavNext,
   315→    handleSlotNavPrev,
   316→    modeSnapshot.isMagicEditMode,
   317→    modeSnapshot.isInpaintMode,
   318→  ]);
   319→  const sharedState = useSharedLightboxState(sharedInput);
   320→
   321→  useEffect(() => {
   322→    upscaleHook.setActiveVariant(sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.location, sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.id);
   323→  }, [
   324→    sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.location,
   325→    sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.id,
   326→    upscaleHook,
   327→  ]);
   328→
   329→  return {
   330→    sharedState,
   331→    handleSlotNavNext,
   332→    handleSlotNavPrev,
   333→    modeSnapshot,
   334→    setModeSnapshot,
   335→  };
   336→}

   338→type ImageLightboxSharedModel = ReturnType<typeof useImageLightboxSharedState>;
   339→
   340→function useImageLightboxEditing(
   341→  props: ImageLightboxProps,
   342→  env: ImageLightboxEnvironment,
   343→  sharedModel: ImageLightboxSharedModel,
   344→) {
   345→  const {
   346→    media,
   347→    taskDetailsData,
   348→    initialVariantId,
   349→    toolTypeOverride,
   350→    shotId,
   351→  } = props;
   352→  const initialActive = props.features?.initialEditActive ?? false;
   353→
   354→  const {
   355→    selectedProjectId,
   356→    actualGenerationId,
   357→    imageDimensions,
   358→    imageContainerRef,
   359→    editSettingsPersistence,
   360→    effectiveEditModeLoRAs,
   361→    availableLoras,
   362→    variantFetchGenerationId,
   363→  } = env;
   364→
   365→  const {
   366→    sharedState,
   367→    setModeSnapshot,
   368→  } = sharedModel;
   369→
   370→  const editOrchestrator = useImageEditOrchestrator({
   371→    mediaContext: {
   372→      media,
   373→      selectedProjectId,
   374→      actualGenerationId,
   375→      shotId,
   376→      toolTypeOverride,
   377→      initialActive,
   378→      thumbnailUrl: sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.thumbnail_url || media.thumbUrl,
   379→    },
   380→    displayContext: {
   381→      imageDimensions,
   382→      imageContainerRef,
   383→      effectiveImageUrl: env.upscaleHook.effectiveImageUrl,
   384→    },
   385→    variantContext: {
   386→      activeVariant: sharedState.variants.activeVariant,
   387→      setActiveVariantId: sharedState.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   388→      refetchVariants: sharedState.variants.refetch,
   389→    },
   390→    settingsContext: editSettingsPersistence,
   391→    loraContext: {
   392→      effectiveEditModeLoRAs,
   393→      availableLoras,
   394→    },
   395→  });
   396→
   397→  useEffect(() => {
   398→    setModeSnapshot((current) => {
   399→      if (
   400→        current.isInpaintMode === editOrchestrator.isInpaintMode
   401→        && current.isMagicEditMode === editOrchestrator.isMagicEditMode
   402→      ) {
   403→        return current;
   404→      }
   405→      return {
   406→        isInpaintMode: editOrchestrator.isInpaintMode,
   407→        isMagicEditMode: editOrchestrator.isMagicEditMode,
   408→      };
   409→    });
   410→  }, [
   411→    editOrchestrator.isInpaintMode,
   412→    editOrchestrator.isMagicEditMode,
   413→    setModeSnapshot,
   414→  ]);
   415→
   416→  const { adjustedTaskDetailsData } = useAdjustedTaskDetails({
   417→    projectId: selectedProjectId ?? null,
   418→    activeVariant: sharedState.variants.activeVariant,
   419→    taskDetailsData,
   420→    isLoadingVariants: sharedState.variants.isLoading,
   421→    initialVariantId,
   422→  });
   423→
   424→  usePanelModeRestore({
   425→    mediaId: media.id,
   426→    persistedPanelMode: editSettingsPersistence.panelMode,
   427→    isVideo: false,
   428→    isSpecialEditMode: editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode,
   429→    isInVideoEditMode: false,
   430→    initialVideoTrimMode: false,
   431→    initialEditActive: initialActive,
   432→    handleEnterMagicEditMode: editOrchestrator.handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   433→  });
   434→
   435→  const variantBadges = useLightboxVariantBadges({
   436→    pendingTaskGenerationId: env.actualGenerationId,
   437→    selectedProjectId,
   438→    variants: sharedState.variants.list,
   439→    variantFetchGenerationId,
   440→  });
   441→
   442→  return {
   443→    editOrchestrator,
   444→    adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   445→    variantBadges,
   446→  };
   447→}

   449→type ImageLightboxEditModel = ReturnType<typeof useImageLightboxEditing>;
   450→
   451→function useImageLightboxControlsPanel(
   452→  props: ImageLightboxProps,
   453→  env: ImageLightboxEnvironment,
   454→  sharedModel: ImageLightboxSharedModel,
   455→  editModel: ImageLightboxEditModel,
   456→  showPanel: boolean,
   457→  panelVariant: 'desktop' | 'mobile',
   458→  panelTaskId: string | null,
   459→) {
   460→  const {
   461→    media,
   462→    shotId,
   463→    onOpenExternalGeneration,
   464→  } = props;
   465→  const selectedShotId = props.shotWorkflow?.selectedShotId;
   466→  const showImageEditTools = props.features?.showImageEditTools ?? true;
   467→
   468→  const {
   469→    sharedState,
   470→  } = sharedModel;
   471→
   472→  const { editOrchestrator, adjustedTaskDetailsData } = editModel;
   473→  const primaryVariantId = sharedState.variants.primaryVariant?.id;
   474→
   475→  return useMemo(() => {
   476→    if (!showPanel) {
   477→      return undefined;
   478→    }
   479→
   480→    if (editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode) {
   481→      return (
   482→        <EditModePanel
   483→          variant={panelVariant}
   484→          taskId={panelTaskId}
   485→          currentMediaId={media.id}
   486→          actions={{
   487→            handleUnifiedGenerate: editOrchestrator.handleUnifiedGenerate,
   488→            handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit: editOrchestrator.handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit,
   489→            handleGenerateReposition: editOrchestrator.handleGenerateReposition,
   490→            handleSaveAsVariant: editOrchestrator.handleSaveAsVariant,
   491→            handleGenerateImg2Img: editOrchestrator.handleGenerateImg2Img,
   492→          }}
   493→          upscale={{
   494→            isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   495→            handleUpscale: async () => {
   496→              await env.upscaleHook.handleUpscale({ scaleFactor: 2, noiseScale: 0.1 });
   497→            },
   498→            isUpscaling: env.upscaleHook.isUpscaling,
   499→            upscaleSuccess: env.upscaleHook.upscaleSuccess,
   500→          }}
   501→          lora={{
   502→            img2imgLoraManager: editOrchestrator.img2imgLoraManager,
   503→            editLoraManager: env.editLoraManager,
   504→            availableLoras: env.availableLoras,
   505→          }}
   506→          advanced={{
   507→            advancedSettings: env.editSettingsPersistence.advancedSettings,
   508→            setAdvancedSettings: env.editSettingsPersistence.setAdvancedSettings,
   509→          }}
   510→          isLocalGeneration={env.isLocalGeneration}
   511→        />
   512→      );
   513→    }
   514→
   515→    return (
   516→      <InfoPanel
   517→        variant={panelVariant}
   518→        showImageEditTools={showImageEditTools}
   519→        taskPanel={{
   520→          taskDetailsData: adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   521→          derivedItems: sharedState.lineage.derivedItems,
   522→          derivedGenerations: sharedState.lineage.derivedGenerations,
   523→          paginatedDerived: sharedState.lineage.paginatedDerived,
   524→          derivedPage: sharedState.lineage.derivedPage,
   525→          derivedTotalPages: sharedState.lineage.derivedTotalPages,
   526→          onSetDerivedPage: sharedState.lineage.setDerivedPage,
   527→          onNavigateToGeneration: onOpenExternalGeneration,
   528→          currentMediaId: media.id,
   529→          currentShotId: selectedShotId || shotId,
   530→          replaceImages: env.replaceImages,
   531→          onReplaceImagesChange: env.setReplaceImages,
   532→          onSwitchToPrimary: primaryVariantId
   533→            ? () => sharedState.variants.setActiveVariantId(primaryVariantId)
   534→            : undefined,
   535→        }}
   536→        taskId={panelTaskId}
   537→      />
   538→    );
   539→  }, [
   540→    showPanel,
   541→    editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode,
   542→    panelVariant,
   543→    onOpenExternalGeneration,
   544→    selectedShotId,
   545→    shotId,
   546→    panelTaskId,
   547→    media.id,
   548→    editOrchestrator.handleUnifiedGenerate,
   549→    editOrchestrator.handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit,
   550→    editOrchestrator.handleGenerateReposition,
   551→    editOrchestrator.handleSaveAsVariant,
   552→    editOrchestrator.handleGenerateImg2Img,
   553→    env.isCloudMode,
   554→    env.upscaleHook,
   555→    editOrchestrator.img2imgLoraManager,
   556→    env.editLoraManager,
   557→    env.availableLoras,
   558→    env.editSettingsPersistence.advancedSettings,
   559→    env.editSettingsPersistence.setAdvancedSettings,
   560→    env.isLocalGeneration,
   561→    showImageEditTools,
   562→    adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   563→    primaryVariantId,
   564→    sharedState.lineage.derivedItems,
   565→    sharedState.lineage.derivedGenerations,
   566→    sharedState.lineage.paginatedDerived,
   567→    sharedState.lineage.derivedPage,
   568→    sharedState.lineage.derivedTotalPages,
   569→    sharedState.lineage.setDerivedPage,
   570→    env.replaceImages,
   571→    env.setReplaceImages,
   572→    sharedState.variants,
   573→  ]);
   574→}
   575→
   576→function useImageLightboxRenderModel(
   577→  props: ImageLightboxProps,
   578→  env: ImageLightboxEnvironment,
   579→  sharedModel: ImageLightboxSharedModel,
   580→  editModel: ImageLightboxEditModel,
   581→) {
   582→  const {
   583→    media,
   584→    onClose,
   585→    readOnly = false,
   586→    showTickForImageId,
   587→    showTickForSecondaryImageId,
   588→    adjacentSegments,
   589→  } = props;
   590→
   591→  const navigation = props.navigation;
   592→  const shotWorkflow = props.shotWorkflow;
   593→  const features = props.features;
   594→  const actions = props.actions;
   595→
   596→  const { sharedState, handleSlotNavNext, handleSlotNavPrev } = sharedModel;
   597→  const { editOrchestrator, adjustedTaskDetailsData, variantBadges } = editModel;
   598→
   599→  const lightboxVariants = useMemo(() => ({
   600→    variants: sharedState.variants.list,
   601→    activeVariant: sharedState.variants.activeVariant,
   602→    primaryVariant: sharedState.variants.primaryVariant,
   603→    isLoadingVariants: sharedState.variants.isLoading,
   604→    handleVariantSelect: sharedState.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   605→    handleMakePrimary: sharedState.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   606→    handleDeleteVariant: sharedState.variants.deleteVariant,
   607→    onLoadVariantSettings: env.setVariantParamsToLoad,
   608→    promoteSuccess: sharedState.variants.promoteSuccess,
   609→    isPromoting: sharedState.variants.isPromoting,
   610→    handlePromoteToGeneration: sharedState.variants.handlePromoteToGeneration,
   611→    isMakingMainVariant: sharedState.makeMainVariant.isMaking,
   612→    canMakeMainVariant: sharedState.makeMainVariant.canMake,
   613→    handleMakeMainVariant: sharedState.makeMainVariant.handle,
   614→    pendingTaskCount: variantBadges.pendingTaskCount,
   615→    unviewedVariantCount: variantBadges.unviewedVariantCount,
   616→    onMarkAllViewed: variantBadges.handleMarkAllViewed,
   617→    variantsSectionRef: env.variantsSectionRef,
   618→  }), [
   619→    sharedState.variants.list,
   620→    sharedState.variants.activeVariant,
   621→    sharedState.variants.primaryVariant,
   622→    sharedState.variants.isLoading,
   623→    sharedState.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   624→    sharedState.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   625→    sharedState.variants.deleteVariant,
   626→    env.setVariantParamsToLoad,
   627→    sharedState.variants.promoteSuccess,
   628→    sharedState.variants.isPromoting,
   629→    sharedState.variants.handlePromoteToGeneration,
   630→    sharedState.makeMainVariant.isMaking,
   631→    sharedState.makeMainVariant.canMake,
   632→    sharedState.makeMainVariant.handle,
   633→    variantBadges.pendingTaskCount,
   634→    variantBadges.unviewedVariantCount,
   635→    variantBadges.handleMarkAllViewed,
   636→    env.variantsSectionRef,
   637→  ]);
   638→  const lightboxStateValue = useMemo(() => ({
   639→    core: {
   640→      onClose,
   641→      readOnly,
   642→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   643→      isTabletOrLarger: sharedState.layout.isTabletOrLarger,
   644→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   645→      actualGenerationId: env.actualGenerationId,
   646→    },
   647→    media: {
   648→      media,
   649→      isVideo: false,
   650→      effectiveMediaUrl: sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl ?? '',
   651→      effectiveVideoUrl: '',
   652→      effectiveImageDimensions: sharedState.effectiveMedia.imageDimensions,
   653→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   654→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   655→    },
   656→    variants: lightboxVariants,
   657→    navigation: {
   658→      showNavigation: navigation?.showNavigation ?? true,
   659→      hasNext: navigation?.hasNext ?? false,
   660→      hasPrevious: navigation?.hasPrevious ?? false,
   661→      handleSlotNavNext,
   662→      handleSlotNavPrev,
   663→      swipeNavigation: sharedState.navigation.swipeNavigation,
   664→    },
   665→  }), [
   666→    onClose,
   667→    readOnly,
   668→    env.isMobile,
   669→    sharedState.layout.isTabletOrLarger,
   670→    env.selectedProjectId,
   671→    env.actualGenerationId,
   672→    media,
   673→    sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl,
   674→    sharedState.effectiveMedia.imageDimensions,
   675→    env.imageDimensions,
   676→    env.setImageDimensions,
   677→    lightboxVariants,
   678→    navigation?.showNavigation,
   679→    navigation?.hasNext,
   680→    navigation?.hasPrevious,
   681→    handleSlotNavNext,
   682→    handleSlotNavPrev,
   683→    sharedState.navigation.swipeNavigation,
   684→  ]);
   685→
   686→  const handleDownload = useCallback(() => {
   687→    return handleLightboxDownload({
   688→      intendedVariantId: sharedState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef.current,
   689→      variants: sharedState.variants.list,
   690→      fallbackUrl: sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl ?? '',
   691→      media,
   692→      isVideo: false,
   693→      setIsDownloading: env.setIsDownloading,
   694→    });
   695→  }, [
   696→    sharedState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   697→    sharedState.variants.list,
   698→    sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl,
   699→    media,
   700→    env.setIsDownloading,
   701→  ]);
   702→
   703→  const handleDelete = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
   704→    if (!actions?.onDelete) {
   705→      return;
   706→    }
   707→    await invokeLightboxDelete(actions.onDelete, media.id, 'ImageLightbox.delete');
   708→  }, [actions?.onDelete, media.id]);
   709→
   710→  const onApplySettings = actions?.onApplySettings;
   711→  const handleApplySettings = useCallback(() => {
   712→    onApplySettings?.(media.metadata);
   713→  }, [onApplySettings, media.metadata]);
   714→
   715→  const onNavigateToShot = shotWorkflow?.onNavigateToShot;
   716→  const handleNavigateToShotFromSelector = useCallback((shot: { id: string; name: string }) => {
   717→    if (!onNavigateToShot) return;
   718→    const minimalShot = { id: shot.id, name: shot.name, images: [], position: 0 };
   719→    onClose();
   720→    onNavigateToShot(minimalShot);
   721→  }, [onClose, onNavigateToShot]);
   722→
   723→  const showTaskDetails = features?.showTaskDetails ?? false;
   724→
   725→  const needsFullscreenLayout = true;
   726→  const needsTasksPaneOffset = needsFullscreenLayout
   727→    && (env.effectiveTasksPaneOpen || env.isTasksPaneLocked)
   728→    && !sharedState.layout.isPortraitMode
   729→    && sharedState.layout.isTabletOrLarger;
   730→
   731→  const accessibilityTitle = `Image Lightbox - ${media?.id?.substring(0, 8)}`;
   732→  const accessibilityDescription = 'View and interact with image in full screen. Use arrow keys to navigate, Escape to close.';
   733→
   734→  const showPanel = sharedState.layout.shouldShowSidePanel
   735→    || ((showTaskDetails || editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode) && env.isMobile);
   736→
   737→  const panelVariant = (sharedState.layout.shouldShowSidePanel && !env.isMobile) ? 'desktop' as const : 'mobile' as const;
   738→  const panelTaskId = adjustedTaskDetailsData?.taskId
   739→    || media?.source_task_id
   740→    || null;
   741→
   742→  const controlsPanelContent = useImageLightboxControlsPanel(
   743→    props,
   744→    env,
   745→    sharedModel,
   746→    editModel,
   747→    showPanel,
   748→    panelVariant,
   749→    panelTaskId,
   750→  );
   751→  const allShots = useMemo(() => shotWorkflow?.allShots ?? [], [shotWorkflow?.allShots]);
   752→  const selectedShotId = shotWorkflow?.selectedShotId;
   753→  const workflowBar = useMemo(() => ({
   754→    core: {
   755→      onDelete: actions?.onDelete,
   756→      onApplySettings: actions?.onApplySettings,
   757→      isSpecialEditMode: editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode,
   758→      isVideo: false,
   759→      handleApplySettings,
   760→    },
   761→    shotSelector: shotWorkflow?.onAddToShot
   762→      ? {
   763→          mediaId: env.actualGenerationId ?? media.id,
   764→          imageUrl: sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl ?? '',
   765→          thumbUrl: media.thumbUrl,
   766→          allShots,
   767→          selectedShotId,
   768→          onShotChange: shotWorkflow?.onShotChange,
   769→          onCreateShot: shotWorkflow?.onCreateShot,
   770→          isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot: sharedState.shots.isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot,
   771→          isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition: sharedState.shots.isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition,
   772→          showTickForImageId,
   773→          showTickForSecondaryImageId,
   774→          onAddToShot: shotWorkflow.onAddToShot,
   775→          onAddToShotWithoutPosition: shotWorkflow?.onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   776→          onAddVariantAsNewGeneration: sharedState.variants.handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   777→          activeVariantId: sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.id || sharedState.variants.primaryVariant?.id,
   778→          currentTimelineFrame: media.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   779→          onShowTick: shotWorkflow?.onShowTick,
   780→          onOptimisticPositioned: shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticPositioned,
   781→          onShowSecondaryTick: shotWorkflow?.onShowSecondaryTick,
   782→          onOptimisticUnpositioned: shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   783→          isAdding: false,
   784→          isAddingWithoutPosition: false,
   785→          contentRef: env.contentRef,
   786→          onNavigateToShot: handleNavigateToShotFromSelector,
   787→          onClose,
   788→        }
   789→      : undefined,
   790→  } satisfies WorkflowControlsBarProps), [
   791→    actions?.onDelete,
   792→    actions?.onApplySettings,
   793→    editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode,
   794→    handleApplySettings,
   795→    shotWorkflow?.onAddToShot,
   796→    env.actualGenerationId,
   797→    env.contentRef,
   798→    media.id,
   799→    media.thumbUrl,
   800→    media.timeline_frame,
   801→    sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl,
   802→    allShots,
   803→    selectedShotId,
   804→    shotWorkflow?.onShotChange,
   805→    shotWorkflow?.onCreateShot,
   806→    sharedState.shots.isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot,
   807→    sharedState.shots.isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition,
   808→    showTickForImageId,
   809→    showTickForSecondaryImageId,
   810→    shotWorkflow?.onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   811→    shotWorkflow?.onShowTick,
   812→    shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticPositioned,
   813→    shotWorkflow?.onShowSecondaryTick,
   814→    shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   815→    handleNavigateToShotFromSelector,
   816→    onClose,
   817→    sharedState.variants.handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   818→    sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.id,
   819→    sharedState.variants.primaryVariant?.id,
   820→  ]);
   821→
   822→  const layoutProps = useMemo(() => ({
   823→    showPanel,
   824→    shouldShowSidePanel: sharedState.layout.shouldShowSidePanel,
   825→    effectiveTasksPaneOpen: env.effectiveTasksPaneOpen,
   826→    effectiveTasksPaneWidth: env.effectiveTasksPaneWidth,
   827→    workflowBar,
   828→    buttonGroups: {

   108→
   109→  const trailingEndFrame = framePositions.get(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   110→
   111→  const handleTrailingEndFrameChange = useCallback((endFrame: number | undefined) => {
   112→    const next = new Map(framePositions);
   113→    if (endFrame === undefined) {
   114→      next.delete(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   115→    } else {
   116→      next.set(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY, endFrame);
   117→    }
   118→    setFramePositions(next);
   119→  }, [framePositions, setFramePositions]);
   120→
   121→  useLayoutEffect(() => {
   122→    onRegisterTrailingUpdater?.(handleTrailingEndFrameChange);
   123→  }, [onRegisterTrailingUpdater, handleTrailingEndFrameChange]);
   124→
   125→  // ReadOnly path: detect trailing video synchronously from preloaded generations.
   126→  // In editing mode videoOutputs is undefined — this returns { false, null }.
   127→  const { hasTrailing: hasExistingTrailingVideo, videoUrl: computedTrailingVideoUrl } = useMemo(() => {
   128→    if (!videoOutputs || videoOutputs.length === 0 || images.length === 0) {
   129→      return { hasTrailing: false, videoUrl: null };
   130→    }
   131→    const sortedEntries = [...framePositions.entries()]
   132→      .filter(([id]) => id !== TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY)
   133→      .sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   134→    const lastImageShotGenId = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1]?.[0] || null;
   135→    return findTrailingVideoInfo(videoOutputs, lastImageShotGenId);
   136→  }, [videoOutputs, framePositions, images.length]);
   137→
   138→  // Async path: strip reports trailing video URL via callback once the slot is visible.
   139→  // Safety net when parentSegmentSlots (React Query) hasn't refreshed yet.
   140→  const [callbackTrailingVideoUrl, setCallbackTrailingVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
   141→  const hasCallbackTrailingVideo = hasExistingTrailingVideo || !!callbackTrailingVideoUrl;
   142→
   143→  // PRE-ORCHESTRATOR: does ANY image have a completed video segment?
   144→  // Proactive reservation — small cost (17 frames padding) eliminates chicken-and-egg.
   145→  const anyImageHasVideo = useMemo(() => {
   146→    if (parentSegmentSlots?.length) {
   147→      return parentSegmentSlots.some(slot =>
   148→        slot.type === 'child' &&
   149→        slot.child.type?.includes('video') &&
   150→        slot.child.location
   151→      );
   152→    }
   153→    return false;
   154→  }, [parentSegmentSlots]);
   155→
   156→  // --- Orchestrator hook (grouped domain view-model) ---
   157→  const orchestrator = useTimelineOrchestrator({
   158→    shotId,
   159→    projectId,
   160→    images,
   161→    framePositions,
   162→    setFramePositions,
   163→    onImageReorder,
   164→    onFileDrop,
   165→    onGenerationDrop,
   166→    setIsDragInProgress,
   167→    onImageDuplicate,
   168→    readOnly,
   169→    isUploadingImage,
   170→    maxFrameLimit,
   171→    structureVideos,
   172→    primaryStructureVideoType,
   173→    primaryStructureVideoTreatment,
   174→    primaryStructureVideoMotionStrength,
   175→    onAddStructureVideo,
   176→    onUpdateStructureVideo,
   177→    onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange,
   178→    hasExistingTrailingVideo: hasCallbackTrailingVideo || anyImageHasVideo,
   179→  });
   180→  const { timelineRef, containerRef } = orchestrator.refs;
   181→  const {
   182→    fullMin,
   183→    fullMax,
   184→    fullRange,
   185→    containerWidth,
   186→    zoomLevel,
   187→    handleZoomInToCenter,
   188→    handleZoomOutFromCenter,
   189→    handleZoomReset,
   190→    handleZoomToStart,
   191→    handleTimelineDoubleClick,
   192→  } = orchestrator.viewport;
   193→  const {
   194→    state: dragState,
   195→    dragOffset,
   196→    currentDragFrame,
   197→    swapTargetId,
   198→    pushMode,
   199→    handleMouseDown,
   200→  } = orchestrator.drag;
   201→  const { selectedIds, showSelectionBar, isSelected, toggleSelection, clearSelection } = orchestrator.selection;
   202→  const {
   203→    pendingDropFrame,
   204→    pendingDuplicateFrame,
   205→    pendingExternalAddFrame,
   206→    activePendingFrame,
   207→    isInternalDropProcessing,
   208→  } = orchestrator.pending;
   209→  const {
   210→    isFileOver,
   211→    dropTargetFrame,
   212→    dragType,
   213→    handleDragEnter,
   214→    handleDragOver,
   215→    handleDragLeave,
   216→    handleDrop,
   217→  } = orchestrator.drop;
   218→  const { currentPositions, pairInfo, pairDataByIndex, localShotGenPositions, showPairLabels } = orchestrator.computed;
   219→  const { handleDuplicateInterceptor, handleTimelineTapToMove, handleVideoBrowserSelect, handleEndpointMouseDown } = orchestrator.actions;
   220→  const { endpointDragFrame, isEndpointDragging: isEndpointDraggingState } = orchestrator.endpoint;
   221→  const {
   222→    resetGap,
   223→    setResetGap,
   224→    maxGap,
   225→    showVideoBrowser,
   226→    setShowVideoBrowser,
   227→    isUploadingStructureVideo,
   228→    setIsUploadingStructureVideo,
   229→  } = orchestrator.uiState;
   230→  const { isMobile, isTablet, enableTapToMove, prefetchTaskData } = orchestrator.device;
   231→
   232→  // --- Post-orchestrator trailing endpoint (needs currentPositions) ---
   233→  const {
   234→    trailingVideoUrl,
   235→    handleExtractFinalFrame,
   236→    imagePositions,
   237→  } = useTrailingEndpoint({
   238→    currentPositions,
   239→    trailingEndFrame,
   240→    computedTrailingVideoUrl,
   241→    callbackTrailingVideoUrl,
   242→    setCallbackTrailingVideoUrl,
   243→    onFileDrop,
   244→  });
   245→
   246→  // Live trailing detection: check if any completed video is anchored to the current
   247→  // live last image. Auto-reveals trailing slot during drag without waiting for DB.
   248→  const liveLastImageShotGenId = useMemo(() => {
   249→    const sorted = [...imagePositions.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   250→    return sorted[sorted.length - 1]?.[0] ?? null;
   251→  }, [imagePositions]);
   252→
   253→  const hasLiveTrailingVideo = useMemo(() => {
   254→    if (!liveLastImageShotGenId) return false;
   255→    // In editing mode, videoOutputs is undefined — use parentSegmentSlots instead.
   256→    // Segment slots know which image each video is anchored to (pairShotGenerationId).
   257→    if (parentSegmentSlots?.length) {
   258→      return parentSegmentSlots.some(slot =>
   259→        slot.type === 'child' &&
   260→        slot.pairShotGenerationId === liveLastImageShotGenId &&
   261→        slot.child.type?.includes('video') &&
   262→        slot.child.location
   263→      );
   264→    }
   265→    // Fallback for readOnly mode where videoOutputs is available
   266→    if (videoOutputs) {
   267→      return findTrailingVideoInfo(videoOutputs, liveLastImageShotGenId).hasTrailing;
   268→    }
   269→    return false;
   270→  }, [liveLastImageShotGenId, parentSegmentSlots, videoOutputs]);
   271→
   272→  // --- Derived pair data (augmented with pending items) ---
   273→  const imagePositionsWithPending = useMemo(() => {
   274→    if (activePendingFrame === null) return imagePositions;
   275→    const realItemAtFrame = [...imagePositions.values()].some(pos => pos === activePendingFrame);
   276→    if (realItemAtFrame) return imagePositions;
   277→    const augmented = new Map(imagePositions);
   278→    augmented.set(PENDING_POSITION_KEY, activePendingFrame);
   279→    return augmented;
   280→  }, [imagePositions, activePendingFrame]);
   281→
   282→  const pairInfoWithPending = useMemo(() => {
   283→    if (activePendingFrame === null) return pairInfo;
   284→    return getPairInfo(imagePositionsWithPending);
   285→  }, [pairInfo, activePendingFrame, imagePositionsWithPending]);
   286→
   287→  const numPairs = Math.max(0, images.length - 1);
   288→  const maxAllowedGap = 81;
   289→
   290→  // --- Pair settings handler ---
   291→  const { handleOpenPairSettings } = usePairSettingsHandler({
   292→    images,
   293→    imagePositions,
   294→    trailingEndFrame,
   295→    pairInfo,
   296→    pairDataByIndex,
   297→    onPairClick,
   298→  });
   299→
   300→  // --- Simple handlers ---
   301→  const handleReset = useCallback(() => {
   302→    if (images.length === 1) {
   303→      const newPositions = new Map<string, number>();
   304→      newPositions.set(images[0].id, 0);
   305→      newPositions.set(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY, resetGap);
   306→      setFramePositions(newPositions);
   307→    } else {
   308→      onResetFrames(resetGap);
   309→    }
   310→  }, [onResetFrames, resetGap, images, setFramePositions]);
   311→
   312→  const handleDeleteSelected = useCallback(() => {
   313→    selectedIds.forEach(id => onImageDelete(id));
   314→    clearSelection();
   315→  }, [selectedIds, onImageDelete, clearSelection]);
   316→
   317→  const handleNewShotFromSelection = useCallback(async () => {
   318→    if (!onNewShotFromSelection) return;
   319→    const newShotId = await onNewShotFromSelection(selectedIds);
   320→    return newShotId;
   321→  }, [onNewShotFromSelection, selectedIds]);
   322→
   323→  // --- JSX ---
   324→  return (
   325→    <div className="w-full overflow-x-hidden relative">
   326→      <div className="relative">
   327→        <TimelineControls
   328→          timeline={{
   329→            shotId,
   330→            projectId,
   331→            readOnly,
   332→            hasNoImages,
   333→            zoomLevel,
   334→            fullMax,
   335→            showDragHint: !!(dragState.isDragging && dragState.activeId && !isMobile),
   336→          }}
   337→          audio={{
   338→            audioUrl,
   339→            onAudioChange,
   340→          }}
   341→          guidance={{
   342→            primaryStructureVideoPath,
   343→            primaryStructureVideoType,
   344→            primaryStructureVideoTreatment,
   345→            primaryStructureVideoMotionStrength,
   346→            structureVideos,
   347→            onAddStructureVideo,
   348→            onUpdateStructureVideo,
   349→            onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange,
   350→            onShowVideoBrowser: () => setShowVideoBrowser(true),
   351→            isUploadingStructureVideo,
   352→            setIsUploadingStructureVideo,
   353→          }}
   354→          zoom={{
   355→            onZoomIn: handleZoomInToCenter,
   356→            onZoomOut: handleZoomOutFromCenter,
   357→            onZoomReset: handleZoomReset,
   358→            onZoomToStart: handleZoomToStart,
   359→          }}
   360→          bottom={{
   361→            resetGap,
   362→            setResetGap,
   363→            maxGap,
   364→            onReset: handleReset,
   365→            onFileDrop,
   366→            isUploadingImage,
   367→            uploadProgress,
   368→            pushMode,
   369→          }}
   370→        />
   371→
   372→        <TimelineTrack
   373→          timelineRef={timelineRef}
   374→          containerRef={containerRef}
   375→          zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   376→          isFileOver={isFileOver}
   377→          hasNoImages={hasNoImages}
   378→          enableTapToMove={enableTapToMove}
   379→          selectedCount={selectedIds.length}
   380→          onDragEnter={handleDragEnter}
   381→          onDragOver={handleDragOver}
   382→          onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
   383→          onDrop={handleDrop}
   384→          onContainerDoubleClick={handleTimelineDoubleClick}
   385→          onContainerClick={(e) => {
   386→            const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   387→            if (!target.closest('[data-item-id]') && !target.closest('button')) {
   388→              if (enableTapToMove && selectedIds.length > 0) {
   389→                e.preventDefault();
   390→                e.stopPropagation();
   391→                handleTimelineTapToMove(e.clientX);
   392→                return;
   393→              }
   394→              if (selectedIds.length > 0) clearSelection();
   395→            }
   396→          }}
   397→          containerWidth={containerWidth}
   398→          prelude={(
   399→            <>
   400→              {/* Segment output strip */}
   401→              {shotId && (projectId || (readOnly && videoOutputs)) && (() => {
   402→            const sortedEntries = imagePositions.size > 0
   403→              ? [...imagePositions.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1])
   404→              : [];
   405→            const lastEntry = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1];
   406→            const isMultiImage = images.length > 1;
   407→            const realLastFrame = lastEntry ? lastEntry[1] : undefined;
   408→            const pendingIsLast = activePendingFrame !== null &&
   409→              realLastFrame !== undefined &&
   410→              activePendingFrame > realLastFrame;
   411→            const effectiveLastFrame = pendingIsLast ? activePendingFrame : realLastFrame;
   412→
   413→            return (
   414→              <SegmentOutputStrip
   415→                shotId={shotId}
   416→                projectId={projectId}
   417→                readOnly={readOnly}
   418→                projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
   419→                pairInfo={pairInfoWithPending}
   420→                fullMin={fullMin}
   421→                fullMax={fullMax}
   422→                fullRange={fullRange}
   423→                containerWidth={containerWidth}
   424→                zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   425→                segmentSlots={parentSegmentSlots ?? []}
   426→                isLoading={isSegmentsLoading}
   427→                localShotGenPositions={localShotGenPositions}
   428→                hasPendingTask={parentHasPendingTask}
   429→                pairDataByIndex={pairDataByIndex}
   430→                onOpenPairSettings={onPairClick ? handleOpenPairSettings : undefined}
   431→                selectedParentId={selectedOutputId}
   432→                onSegmentFrameCountChange={onSegmentFrameCountChange}
   433→                trailingSegmentMode={lastEntry && (trailingEndFrame !== undefined || hasCallbackTrailingVideo || hasLiveTrailingVideo) ? (() => {
   434→                  const [imageId, imageFrame] = lastEntry;
   435→                  const resolvedEndFrame = trailingEndFrame ?? (imageFrame + (isMultiImage ? 17 : 49));
   436→                  const trailingDuration = resolvedEndFrame - imageFrame;
   437→                  const effectiveImageId = pendingIsLast ? PENDING_POSITION_KEY : imageId;
   438→                  const effectiveImageFrame = pendingIsLast ? activePendingFrame! : imageFrame;
   439→                  const effectiveEndFrame = pendingIsLast ? activePendingFrame! + trailingDuration : resolvedEndFrame;
   440→                  return { imageId: effectiveImageId, imageFrame: effectiveImageFrame, endFrame: effectiveEndFrame };
   441→                })() : undefined}
   442→                isMultiImage={isMultiImage}
   443→                lastImageFrame={effectiveLastFrame}
   444→                onAddTrailingSegment={realLastFrame !== undefined && lastEntry ? () => {
   445→                  handleTrailingEndFrameChange(realLastFrame + 17);
   446→                } : undefined}
   447→                onRemoveTrailingSegment={isMultiImage && trailingEndFrame !== undefined ? () => {
   448→                  handleTrailingEndFrameChange(undefined);
   449→                } : undefined}
   450→                onTrailingVideoInfo={setCallbackTrailingVideoUrl}
   451→              />
   452→                );
   453→              })()}
   454→
   455→              {/* Structure video strip(s) */}
   456→              {shotId && (projectId || readOnly) && (
   457→                structureVideos && onUpdateStructureVideo && onRemoveStructureVideo ? (
   458→                  <GuidanceVideosContainer
   459→                    structureVideos={structureVideos}
   460→                    isLoading={isStructureVideoLoading}
   461→                    cachedHasStructureVideo={cachedHasStructureVideo}
   462→                    shotId={shotId}
   463→                    onUpdateVideo={onUpdateStructureVideo}
   464→                    onRemoveVideo={onRemoveStructureVideo}
   465→                    fullMin={fullMin}
   466→                    fullMax={fullMax}
   467→                    fullRange={fullRange}
   468→                    containerWidth={containerWidth}
   469→                    zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   470→                    timelineFrameCount={images.length}
   471→                    readOnly={readOnly}
   472→                  />
   473→                ) : onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange && (
   474→                  primaryStructureVideoPath ? (
   475→                    <GuidanceVideoStrip
   476→                      videoUrl={primaryStructureVideoPath}
   477→                      videoMetadata={primaryStructureVideoMetadata || null}
   478→                      treatment={primaryStructureVideoTreatment}
   479→                      onTreatmentChange={(treatment) => onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange(primaryStructureVideoPath, primaryStructureVideoMetadata ?? null, treatment, primaryStructureVideoMotionStrength, primaryStructureVideoType)}
   480→                      onRemove={() => onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange(null, null, 'adjust', 1.0, 'flow')}
   481→                      onMetadataExtracted={(metadata) => onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange(primaryStructureVideoPath, metadata, primaryStructureVideoTreatment, primaryStructureVideoMotionStrength, primaryStructureVideoType)}
   482→                      fullMin={fullMin}
   483→                      fullMax={fullMax}
   484→                      fullRange={fullRange}
   485→                      containerWidth={containerWidth}
   486→                      zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   487→                      timelineFrameCount={images.length}
   488→                      readOnly={readOnly}
   489→                    />
   490→                  ) : isUploadingStructureVideo ? (
   491→                    <div className="relative h-28 -mt-1 mb-3" style={{ width: zoomLevel > 1 ? `${zoomLevel * 100}%` : '100%', minWidth: '100%' }}>
   492→                      <div className="absolute left-4 right-4 top-6 bottom-2 flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/50 dark:bg-muted-foreground/15 border border-border/30 rounded-sm">
   493→                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">Uploading video...</span>
   494→                      </div>
   495→                    </div>
   496→                  ) : !readOnly ? (
   497→                    <GuidanceVideoUploader
   498→                      shotId={shotId}
   499→                      projectId={projectId ?? ''}
   500→                      onVideoUploaded={(videoUrl, metadata) => {
   501→                        if (videoUrl && metadata) onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange(videoUrl, metadata, primaryStructureVideoTreatment, primaryStructureVideoMotionStrength, primaryStructureVideoType);
   502→                      }}
   503→                      currentVideoUrl={primaryStructureVideoPath ?? null}
   504→                      compact={false}
   505→                      zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   506→                      onZoomIn={handleZoomInToCenter}
   507→                      onZoomOut={handleZoomOutFromCenter}
   508→                      onZoomReset={handleZoomReset}
   509→                      onZoomToStart={handleZoomToStart}
   510→                      hasNoImages={hasNoImages}
   511→                    />
   512→                  ) : null
   513→                )
   514→              )}
   515→
   516→              {/* Audio strip */}
   517→              {onAudioChange && audioUrl && (
   518→                <div className="mt-1 mb-2">
   519→                  <AudioStrip
   520→                    audioUrl={audioUrl}
   521→                    audioMetadata={audioMetadata || null}
   522→                    onRemove={() => onAudioChange(null, null)}
   523→                    fullMin={fullMin}
   524→                    fullMax={fullMax}
   525→                    fullRange={fullRange}
   526→                    containerWidth={containerWidth}
   527→                    zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   528→                    readOnly={readOnly}
   529→                    compact={!!primaryStructureVideoPath}
   530→                  />
   531→                </div>
   532→              )}
   533→            </>
   534→          )}
   535→        >
   536→            <DragLayer
   537→              isFileOver={isFileOver}
   538→              dropTargetFrame={dropTargetFrame}
   539→              fullMin={fullMin}
   540→              fullRange={fullRange}
   541→              containerWidth={containerWidth}
   542→              dragType={dragType}
   543→              activePendingFrame={activePendingFrame}
   544→              pendingDropFrame={pendingDropFrame}
   545→              pendingDuplicateFrame={pendingDuplicateFrame}
   546→              pendingExternalAddFrame={pendingExternalAddFrame}
   547→              isUploadingImage={isUploadingImage}
   548→              isInternalDropProcessing={isInternalDropProcessing}
   549→              projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
   550→              imagesLength={images.length}
   551→            />
   552→
   553→            <TimelineRuler
   554→              fullMin={fullMin}
   555→              fullMax={fullMax}
   556→              fullRange={fullRange}
   557→              zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   558→              containerWidth={containerWidth}
   559→              hasNoImages={hasNoImages}
   560→            />
   561→
   562→            {/* Pair regions */}
   563→            {(() => {
   564→              const sortedDynamicPositions = [...imagePositionsWithPending.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   565→              return pairInfoWithPending.map((pair, index) => {
   566→              const [startEntry, endEntry] = [sortedDynamicPositions[index], sortedDynamicPositions[index + 1]];
   567→
   568→              const getPixel = (entry: [string, number] | undefined): number => {
   569→                if (!entry) return 0;
   570→                const [, framePos] = entry;
   571→                const effectiveWidth = containerWidth - (TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET * 2);
   572→                return TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((framePos - fullMin) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;
   573→              };
   574→
   575→              const startPixel = getPixel(startEntry);
   576→              const endPixel = getPixel(endEntry);
   577→              const actualStartFrame = startEntry?.[1] ?? pair.startFrame;
   578→              const actualEndFrame = endEntry?.[1] ?? pair.endFrame;
   579→              const actualFrames = actualEndFrame - actualStartFrame;
   580→
   581→              const startPercent = (startPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   582→              const endPercent = (endPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   583→
   584→              const contextStartFrameUnclipped = actualEndFrame;
   585→              const contextStartFrame = Math.max(0, contextStartFrameUnclipped);
   586→              const visibleContextFrames = Math.max(0, actualEndFrame - contextStartFrame);
   587→
   588→              const effectiveWidth = containerWidth - (TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET * 2);
   589→              const contextStartPixel = TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((contextStartFrame - fullMin) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;
   590→              const contextStartPercent = (contextStartPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   591→
   592→              const generationStartPixel = TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((pair.generationStart - fullMin) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;
   593→              const generationStartPercent = (generationStartPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   594→
   595→              const startImage = images.find(img => img.id === startEntry?.[0]);
   596→              const endImage = images.find(img => img.id === endEntry?.[0]);
   597→              const pairPromptData = pairPrompts?.[index];
   598→              const pairPromptFromMetadata = pairPromptData?.prompt || '';
   599→              const pairNegativePromptFromMetadata = pairPromptData?.negativePrompt || '';
   600→              const actualEnhancedPrompt = getEnhancedPromptFromMetadata(startImage?.metadata);
   601→
   602→              return (
   603→                <PairRegion
   604→                  key={`pair-${index}`}
   605→                  index={index}
   606→                  startPercent={startPercent}
   607→                  endPercent={endPercent}
   608→                  contextStartPercent={contextStartPercent}
   609→                  generationStartPercent={generationStartPercent}
   610→                  actualFrames={actualFrames}
   611→                  visibleContextFrames={visibleContextFrames}
   612→                  isDragging={dragState.isDragging}
   613→                  numPairs={numPairs}
   614→                  startFrame={pair.startFrame}
   615→                  endFrame={pair.endFrame}
   616→                  onPairClick={onPairClick ? (pairIndex, pairData) => {
   617→                    onPairClick(pairIndex, {
   618→                      ...pairData,
   619→                      startImage: startImage ? {
   620→                        id: startImage.id,
   621→                        generationId: startImage.generation_id || undefined,
   622→                        primaryVariantId: startImage.primary_variant_id || undefined,
   623→                        url: startImage.imageUrl || startImage.thumbUrl,
   624→                        thumbUrl: startImage.thumbUrl,
   625→                        position: index + 1
   626→                      } : null,
   627→                      endImage: endImage ? {
   628→                        id: endImage.id,
   629→                        generationId: endImage.generation_id || undefined,
   630→                        primaryVariantId: endImage.primary_variant_id || undefined,
   631→                        url: endImage.imageUrl || endImage.thumbUrl,
   632→                        thumbUrl: endImage.thumbUrl,
   633→                        position: index + 2
   634→                      } : null
   635→                    });
   636→                  } : undefined}
   637→                  pairPrompt={pairPromptFromMetadata}
   638→                  pairNegativePrompt={pairNegativePromptFromMetadata}
   639→                  enhancedPrompt={actualEnhancedPrompt}
   640→                  defaultPrompt={defaultPrompt}
   641→                  defaultNegativePrompt={defaultNegativePrompt}
   642→                  showLabel={showPairLabels}
   643→                  hidePairLabel={
   644→                    (enableTapToMove && selectedIds.length > 0) ||
   645→                    (isFileOver && dropTargetFrame !== null && dropTargetFrame > actualStartFrame && dropTargetFrame < actualEndFrame) ||
   646→                    (dragState.isDragging && currentDragFrame !== null && currentDragFrame > actualStartFrame && currentDragFrame < actualEndFrame)
   647→                  }
   648→                  onClearEnhancedPrompt={onClearEnhancedPrompt}
   649→                  readOnly={readOnly}
   650→                />
   651→              );
   652→            });
   653→            })()}
   654→
   655→            {/* Trailing endpoint - appears after last image */}
   656→            {imagePositions.size > 0 && (() => {
   657→              const sortedEntries = [...imagePositions.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   658→              const lastEntry = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1];
   659→              if (!lastEntry) return null;
   660→              const [id, imageFrame] = lastEntry;
   661→
   662→              const isMultiImage = images.length > 1;
   663→              const hasTrailingSegment = trailingEndFrame !== undefined;
   664→
   665→              if (isMultiImage && !hasTrailingSegment && !hasCallbackTrailingVideo && !hasLiveTrailingVideo) {
   666→                return null;
   667→              }
   668→
   669→              const defaultEndFrame = imageFrame + (isMultiImage ? 17 : 49);
   670→              const effectiveEndFrame = trailingEndFrame ?? defaultEndFrame;
   671→              const gapToImage = effectiveEndFrame - imageFrame;
   672→              const lastImageIndex = sortedEntries.length - 1;
   673→              const lastImage = images.find(img => {
   674→                const imgId = img.shot_generation_id || img.id;
   675→                return imgId === id;
   676→              }) || images[lastImageIndex];
   677→
   678→              const trailingPairIndex = Math.max(0, sortedEntries.length - 1);
   679→
   680→              return (
   681→                <TrailingEndpoint
   682→                  framePosition={effectiveEndFrame}
   683→                  imageFramePosition={imageFrame}
   684→                  isDragging={isEndpointDraggingState}
   685→                  dragOffset={null}
   686→                  onMouseDown={readOnly ? undefined : (e, endpointId) => handleEndpointMouseDown(e, endpointId)}
   687→                  timelineWidth={containerWidth}
   688→                  fullMinFrames={fullMin}
   689→                  fullRange={fullRange}
   690→                  currentDragFrame={isEndpointDraggingState ? endpointDragFrame : null}
   691→                  gapToImage={gapToImage}
   692→                  maxAllowedGap={maxAllowedGap}
   693→                  readOnly={readOnly}
   694→                  compact={isMultiImage}
   695→                  onDurationClick={onPairClick && lastImage ? () => {
   696→                    onPairClick(trailingPairIndex, {
   697→                      index: trailingPairIndex,
   698→                      frames: effectiveEndFrame - imageFrame,
   699→                      startFrame: imageFrame,
   700→                      endFrame: effectiveEndFrame,
   701→                      startImage: {
   702→                        id,
   703→                        generationId: lastImage.generation_id,
   704→                        url: lastImage.imageUrl || lastImage.thumbUrl,
   705→                        thumbUrl: lastImage.thumbUrl,
   706→                        position: sortedEntries.length,
   707→                      },
   708→                      endImage: null,
   709→                    });
   710→                  } : undefined}
   711→                  hasTrailingVideo={!!trailingVideoUrl}
   712→                  onExtractFinalFrame={trailingVideoUrl && onFileDrop ? handleExtractFinalFrame : undefined}
   713→                />
   714→              );
   715→            })()}
   716→
   717→            {/* Timeline items */}
   718→            {images.map((image, idx) => {
   719→              const imageKey = image.id;
   720→              const positionFromMap = currentPositions.get(imageKey);
   721→              const framePosition = positionFromMap ?? image.timeline_frame;
   722→              if (framePosition === undefined || framePosition === null) return null;
   723→              const isDragging = dragState.isDragging && dragState.activeId === imageKey;
   724→
   725→              return (
   726→                <TimelineItem
   727→                  key={imageKey}
   728→                  image={image}
   729→                  framePosition={framePosition}
   730→                  layout={{
   731→                    timelineWidth: containerWidth,
   732→                    fullMinFrames: fullMin,
   733→                    fullRange,
   734→                  }}
   735→                  interaction={{
   736→                    isDragging,
   737→                    isSwapTarget: swapTargetId === imageKey,
   738→                    dragOffset: isDragging ? dragOffset : null,
   739→                    onMouseDown: readOnly ? undefined : (e) => handleMouseDown(e, imageKey, containerRef),
   740→                    onDoubleClick: isMobile && !isTablet ? undefined : () => handleDesktopDoubleClick(idx),
   741→                    onMobileTap: isMobile ? () => handleMobileTap(idx) : undefined,
   742→                    currentDragFrame: isDragging ? currentDragFrame : null,
   743→                    originalFramePos: framePositions.get(imageKey) ?? 0,
   744→                    onPrefetch: !isMobile ? () => {
   745→                      const generationId = getGenerationId(image);
   746→                      if (generationId) prefetchTaskData(generationId);
   747→                    } : undefined,
   748→                  }}
   749→                  actions={{
   750→                    onDelete: onImageDelete,
   751→                    onDuplicate: handleDuplicateInterceptor,
   752→                    onInpaintClick: handleInpaintClick ? () => handleInpaintClick(idx) : undefined,
   753→                    duplicatingImageId: duplicatingImageId ?? undefined,
   754→                    duplicateSuccessImageId: duplicateSuccessImageId ?? undefined,
   755→                  }}
   756→                  selection={{
   757→                    isSelected: isSelected(imageKey),
   758→                    onSelectionClick: readOnly ? undefined : () => toggleSelection(imageKey),
   759→                    selectedCount: selectedIds.length,
   760→                  }}
   761→                  presentation={{
   762→                    projectAspectRatio,
   763→                    readOnly,
   764→                  }}
   765→                />
   766→              );
   767→            })}
   768→        </TimelineTrack>
   769→      </div>
   770→
   771→      {/* Video Browser Modal */}
   772→      <ResourceBrowserModalBase
   773→        isOpen={showVideoBrowser}
   774→        onOpenChange={setShowVideoBrowser}
   775→        resourceType="structure-video"
   776→        title="Browse Guidance Videos"
   777→        onResourceSelect={handleVideoBrowserSelect}
   778→      />
   779→
   780→      {/* Multi-select action bar */}
   781→      {showSelectionBar && selectedIds.length > 0 && !readOnly && (
   782→        <SelectionActionBar
   783→          selectedCount={selectedIds.length}
   784→          onDeselect={clearSelection}
   785→          onDelete={handleDeleteSelected}
   786→          onNewShot={onNewShotFromSelection ? handleNewShotFromSelection : undefined}
   787→          onJumpToShot={onShotChange}
   788→        />
   789→      )}
   790→    </div>
   791→  );
   792→};
   793→
   794→export default React.memo(TimelineContainer);
   795→

   238→          }

   323→function useTimelineItemOperations(
   324→  shotId: string | null,

   357→        if (error) throw error;
   358→        invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'unposition-item', scope: 'all' });
   359→      } catch (err) {

   362→    },

   376→          .insert({

   379→            timeline_frame: nextFrame,
   380→            metadata: {

   383→              frame_spacing: DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING,
   384→            },
   385→          })
   386→          .select('id')
   387→          .single();
   388→
   389→        if (error) throw error;
   390→        invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'add-item', scope: 'all' });

   392→      } catch (err) {
   393→        throw normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'useTimelineCore.addItem', toastTitle: 'Failed to add item to timeline' });
   394→      }

   399→  return { deleteItem, unpositionItem, addItem };

   402→function useTimelinePairOperations(
   403→  shotId: string | null,
   404→  positionedItems: GenerationRow[],
   405→  invalidateGenerations: InvalidateGenerationsFn,
   406→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>
   407→): TimelinePairOperations {
   408→  const pairPrompts = useMemo<TimelineCoreResult['pairPrompts']>(() => {
   409→    if (positionedItems.length === 0) return {};

   412→    for (let index = 0; index < positionedItems.length - 1; index += 1) {
