   415→
   416→      if (overrides.prompt || overrides.negativePrompt) {
   417→        promptsByPair[index] = {
   418→          prompt: overrides.prompt || '',
   419→          negativePrompt: overrides.negativePrompt || '',
   420→        };
   421→      }
   422→    }
   423→
   424→    return promptsByPair;
   425→  }, [positionedItems]);
   426→
   427→  const updatePairPrompts = useCallback<TimelineCoreResult['updatePairPrompts']>(
   428→    async (shotGenerationId, prompt, negativePrompt) => {
   429→      if (!shotId) return;
   430→
   431→      try {
   432→        const item = positionedItems.find((generation) => generation.shotImageEntryId === shotGenerationId);
   433→        if (!item) {
   434→          throw new Error(`Item ${shotGenerationId} not found`);
   435→        }
   436→
   437→        const currentOverrides = readSegmentOverrides(item.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
   438→        const updatedMetadata = writeSegmentOverrides(item.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null, {
   439→          ...currentOverrides,
   440→          prompt,
   441→          negativePrompt,
   442→        });
   443→        const { error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   444→          .update({ metadata: toJson(updatedMetadata) })
   445→          .eq('id', shotGenerationId);
   446→
   447→        if (error) throw error;
   448→        invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'update-pair-prompts', scope: 'metadata' });
   449→        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shotGenerationId) });
   450→      } catch (err) {
   451→        throw normalizeAndPresentError(err, {
   452→          context: 'useTimelineCore.updatePairPrompts',
   453→          toastTitle: 'Failed to update pair prompts',
   454→          showToast: false,
   455→        });
   456→      }
   457→    },
   458→    [shotId, positionedItems, invalidateGenerations, queryClient]
   459→  );
   460→
   461→  const updatePairPromptsByIndex = useCallback<TimelineCoreResult['updatePairPromptsByIndex']>(
   462→    async (pairIndex, prompt, negativePrompt) => {
   463→      if (pairIndex >= positionedItems.length - 1) return;
   464→
   465→      const firstItem = positionedItems[pairIndex];
   466→      if (!firstItem.shotImageEntryId) return;
   467→      await updatePairPrompts(firstItem.shotImageEntryId, prompt, negativePrompt);
   468→    },
   469→    [positionedItems, updatePairPrompts]
   470→  );
   471→
   472→  const getSegmentOverrides = useCallback<TimelineCoreResult['getSegmentOverrides']>(
   473→    (pairIndex) => {
   474→      if (pairIndex >= positionedItems.length - 1) return {};
   475→
   476→      const firstItem = positionedItems[pairIndex];
   477→      return readSegmentOverrides(firstItem.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
   478→    },
   479→    [positionedItems]
   480→  );
   481→
   482→  const updateSegmentOverrides = useCallback<TimelineCoreResult['updateSegmentOverrides']>(
   483→    async (pairIndex, overrides) => {
   484→      if (!shotId || pairIndex >= positionedItems.length - 1) return;
   485→
   486→      const firstItem = positionedItems[pairIndex];
   487→      if (!firstItem.shotImageEntryId) return;
   488→
   489→      try {
   490→        const currentOverrides = readSegmentOverrides(firstItem.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
   491→        const updatedMetadata = writeSegmentOverrides(firstItem.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null, {
   492→          ...currentOverrides,
   493→          ...overrides,
   494→        });
   495→        const { error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   496→          .update({ metadata: toJson(updatedMetadata) })
   497→          .eq('id', firstItem.shotImageEntryId);
   498→
   499→        if (error) throw error;
   500→        invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'update-segment-overrides', scope: 'metadata' });
   501→      } catch (err) {
   502→        throw normalizeAndPresentError(err, {
   503→          context: 'useTimelineCore.updateSegmentOverrides',
   504→          toastTitle: 'Failed to update segment overrides',
   505→          showToast: false,
   506→        });
   507→      }
   508→    },
   509→    [shotId, positionedItems, invalidateGenerations]
   510→  );
   511→
   512→  return {
   513→    pairPrompts,
   514→    updatePairPrompts,
   515→    updatePairPromptsByIndex,
   516→    getSegmentOverrides,
   517→    updateSegmentOverrides,
   518→  };
   519→}
   520→
   521→function useTimelineEnhancedPromptOperations(
   522→  shotId: string | null,
   523→  positionedItems: GenerationRow[],
   524→  invalidateGenerations: InvalidateGenerationsFn,
   525→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>
   526→): TimelineEnhancedPromptOperations {
   527→  const getEnhancedPrompt = useCallback<TimelineCoreResult['getEnhancedPrompt']>(
   528→    (shotGenerationId) => {
   529→      const item = positionedItems.find((generation) => generation.shotImageEntryId === shotGenerationId);
   530→      if (!item?.metadata) return undefined;
   531→
   532→      const metadata = item.metadata as Record<string, unknown>;
   533→      return metadata.enhanced_prompt as string | undefined;
   534→    },
   535→    [positionedItems]
   536→  );
   537→
   538→  const clearEnhancedPrompt = useCallback<TimelineCoreResult['clearEnhancedPrompt']>(
   539→    async (shotGenerationId) => {
   540→      if (!shotId) return;
   541→
   542→      try {
   543→        const item = positionedItems.find((generation) => generation.shotImageEntryId === shotGenerationId);
   544→        if (!item) return;
   545→
   546→        const currentMetadata = (item.metadata as Record<string, unknown>) || {};
   547→        const updatedMetadata = {
   548→          ...currentMetadata,
   549→          enhanced_prompt: '',
   550→        };
   551→
   552→        queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   553→          queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId),
   554→          (oldData) => oldData?.map((row) =>
   555→            row.id === shotGenerationId
   556→              ? { ...row, metadata: updatedMetadata }
   557→              : row
   558→          )
   559→        );
   560→
   561→        const { error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   562→          .update({ metadata: updatedMetadata })
   563→          .eq('id', shotGenerationId);
   564→
   565→        if (error) {
   566→          invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'clear-enhanced-prompt-error', scope: 'metadata' });
   567→          throw error;
   568→        }
   569→
   570→        invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'clear-enhanced-prompt', scope: 'metadata' });
   571→      } catch (err) {
   572→        throw normalizeAndPresentError(err, {
   573→          context: 'useTimelineCore.clearEnhancedPrompt',
   574→          showToast: false,
   575→        });
   576→      }
   577→    },
   578→    [shotId, positionedItems, invalidateGenerations, queryClient]
   579→  );
   580→
   581→  const clearAllEnhancedPrompts = useCallback<TimelineCoreResult['clearAllEnhancedPrompts']>(async () => {
   582→    if (!shotId) return;
   583→
   584→    try {
   585→      const itemsWithEnhancedPrompt = positionedItems.filter((generation) => {
   586→        const metadata = generation.metadata as Record<string, unknown>;
   587→        return !!metadata?.enhanced_prompt;
   588→      });
   589→
   590→      if (itemsWithEnhancedPrompt.length === 0) return;
   591→
   592→      for (const item of itemsWithEnhancedPrompt) {
   593→        if (!item.shotImageEntryId) continue;
   594→
   595→        const currentMetadata = (item.metadata as Record<string, unknown>) || {};
   596→        await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   597→          .update({
   598→            metadata: {
   599→              ...currentMetadata,
   600→              enhanced_prompt: '',
   601→            },
   602→          })
   603→          .eq('id', item.shotImageEntryId);
   604→      }
   605→
   606→      invalidateGenerations(shotId, { reason: 'clear-all-enhanced-prompts', scope: 'metadata' });
   607→    } catch (err) {
   608→      throw normalizeAndPresentError(err, {
   609→        context: 'useTimelineCore.clearAllEnhancedPrompts',
   610→        showToast: false,
   611→      });
   612→    }
   613→  }, [shotId, positionedItems, invalidateGenerations]);
   614→
   615→  return {
   616→    getEnhancedPrompt,
   617→    clearEnhancedPrompt,
   618→    clearAllEnhancedPrompts,
   619→  };
   620→}
   621→
   622→export function useTimelineCore(shotId: string | null): TimelineCoreResult {
   623→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   624→  const invalidateGenerations = useInvalidateGenerations();
   625→  const {
   626→    data: generations,
   627→    isLoading,
   628→    error,
   629→    refetch,
   630→  } = useShotImages(shotId);
   631→  const { positionedItems, unpositionedItems } = useTimelineDerivedItems(generations);
   632→  const { updatePosition, commitPositions, reorder, normalize } = useTimelinePositionOperations(
   633→    shotId,
   634→    positionedItems,
   635→    invalidateGenerations
   636→  );
   637→  const { deleteItem, unpositionItem, addItem } = useTimelineItemOperations(
   638→    shotId,
   639→    positionedItems,
   640→    invalidateGenerations
   641→  );
   642→  const {
   643→    pairPrompts,
   644→    updatePairPrompts,
   645→    updatePairPromptsByIndex,
   646→    getSegmentOverrides,
   647→    updateSegmentOverrides,
   648→  } = useTimelinePairOperations(shotId, positionedItems, invalidateGenerations, queryClient);
   649→  const {
   650→    getEnhancedPrompt,
   651→    clearEnhancedPrompt,
   652→    clearAllEnhancedPrompts,
   653→  } = useTimelineEnhancedPromptOperations(shotId, positionedItems, invalidateGenerations, queryClient);
   654→
   655→  return {
   656→    generations,
   657→    positionedItems,
   658→    unpositionedItems,
   659→    isLoading,
   660→    error: error || null,
   661→    updatePosition,
   662→    commitPositions,
   663→    reorder,
   664→    deleteItem,
   665→    unpositionItem,
   666→    addItem,
   667→    pairPrompts,
   668→    updatePairPrompts,
   669→    updatePairPromptsByIndex,
   670→    getSegmentOverrides,
   671→    updateSegmentOverrides,
   672→    getEnhancedPrompt,
   673→    clearEnhancedPrompt,
   674→    clearAllEnhancedPrompts,
   675→    normalize,
   676→    refetch: () => refetch(),
   677→  };
   678→}

   249→/**

   296→export function useAutoSaveSettings<T extends object>(

   299→  const {

   304→    debounceMs = 300,
   305→    defaults,

   311→
   312→  const isCustomMode = !!customLoadSave;

    21→function isUnifiedGenerationListData(data: unknown): data is UnifiedGenerationListData {
    22→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || !('items' in data)) {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→  const candidate = data as { items?: unknown };
    26→  return Array.isArray(candidate.items);
    27→}

    34→    queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED] }),

    37→  ]);
    38→
    39→  const previousGenerationsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    40→  const previousShotsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    41→  const previousAllShotGenerationsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    42→
    43→  const generationsQueries = queryClient.getQueriesData({ [REDACTED] });

    54→      )),

    73→        )),

    12→
    13→const NON_PRELOADABLE_URL_MARKERS = ['_joined_frame.jpg'] as const;
    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * Get the canonical generation ID from a media item.
    17→ * Handles both direct generations (id) and variants (generation_id).
    18→ * Also checks metadata.generation_id for compatibility with various data shapes.
    19→ *
    20→ * Priority: generation_id > metadata.generation_id > id
    21→ *
    22→ * @example
    23→ * // Instead of: (media as unknown).generation_id || media.id
    24→ * const genId = getGenerationId(media);
    25→ */
    26→export function getGenerationId(
    27→  media: MaybeHasGenerationId | null | undefined
    28→): string | null {
    29→  if (!media) return null;
    30→  const metadataGenerationId = typeof media.metadata?.generation_id === 'string'
    31→    ? media.metadata.generation_id
    32→    : null;
    33→  return media.generation_id || metadataGenerationId || media.id || null;

    14→
    15→interface TaskTypeConfig {

    17→  isVisible: boolean;
    18→  /** Display name for the task type (overrides the raw taskType) */
    19→  displayName?: string;

    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Convert database TaskTypeInfo to TaskTypeConfig format
    32→ */
    33→function dbConfigToTaskConfig(dbConfig: TaskTypeInfo): TaskTypeConfig {
    34→  return {
    35→    isVisible: dbConfig.is_visible ?? false,
    36→    displayName: dbConfig.display_name,
    37→    supportsProgress: dbConfig.supports_progress ?? false,
    38→    canCancel: true, // Default all tasks to cancellable
    39→    category: dbConfig.category as TaskTypeConfig['category'],
    40→  };
    41→}
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Get configuration for a specific task type
    45→ * Checks the database cache first, falls back to hardcoded defaults
    46→ */
    47→function getTaskConfig(taskType: string): TaskTypeConfig {
    48→  // Check database cache first (populated by useAllTaskTypesConfig hook)
    49→  if (isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized()) {
    50→    const cache = getTaskTypeConfigCache();
    51→    const dbConfig = cache[taskType];
    52→    if (dbConfig) {
    53→      return dbConfigToTaskConfig(dbConfig);
    54→    }
    55→  }
    56→  
    57→  // Fall back to the shared fallback snapshot.
    58→  const fallbackConfig = getTaskTypeConfigFallback(taskType);
    59→  if (fallbackConfig) {
    60→    return fallbackConfig;
    61→  }
    62→  
    63→  // Default for completely unknown task types
    64→  return {
    65→    isVisible: false, // Default to hidden for unknown types
    66→    canCancel: true,
    67→    category: 'utility'
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→/**

    74→function isTaskVisible(taskType: string): boolean {

    81→export function getTaskDisplayName(taskType: string): string {

    84→}
    85→

    97→function getTaskTypesByVisibility(visible: boolean): string[] {
    98→  if (isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized()) {

   100→    return Object.entries(cache)
   101→      .filter(([_, config]) => visible ? config.is_visible : !config.is_visible)

   105→  // Fall back to the versioned fallback snapshot.
   106→  return getTaskTypeFallbackEntries()

   111→/**

    44→function extractLoadedImageIds(data: unknown): Array<{ id: string }> {
    45→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
    46→    return [];
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  const maybeItems = (data as { items?: unknown }).items;
    50→  if (!Array.isArray(maybeItems)) {
    51→    return [];
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  return maybeItems
    55→    .map((item) => {
    56→      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') {
    57→        return null;
    58→      }
    59→      const id = (item as { id?: unknown }).id;
    60→      return typeof id === 'string' ? { id } : null;
    61→    })
    62→    .filter((item): item is { id: string } => item !== null);
    63→}
    64→
    65→export function cleanupDistantGenerationPages(
    66→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    67→  projectId: string,
    68→  currentPage: number,
    69→  keepRange: number = 2,
    70→): void {
    71→  const allQueries = queryClient.getQueryCache().getAll();
    72→
    73→  allQueries.forEach((query) => {
    74→    const key = query.queryKey;
    75→    if (!Array.isArray(key)) return;
    76→
    77→    if (!isUnifiedProjectGenerationsKey(key, projectId)) {
    78→      return;
    79→    }
    80→
    81→    const page = extractUnifiedProjectGenerationsPage(key, projectId);
    82→    if (page !== null && Math.abs(page - currentPage) > keepRange) {
    83→      const loadedImageIds = extractLoadedImageIds(query.state?.data);
    84→      if (loadedImageIds.length > 0) {
    85→        clearLoadedImages(loadedImageIds);
    86→      }
    87→      queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: query.queryKey });
    88→    }
    89→  });
    90→}
    91→
    92→export function scheduleAdjacentGenerationPagePreload({
    93→  queryClient,
    94→  projectId,
    95→  currentPage,
    96→  totalPages,
    97→  hasMorePages,
    98→  itemsPerPage,
    99→  filters,
   100→  filtersString,
   101→  keepRange = 2,
   102→}: ScheduleAdjacentGenerationPagePreloadOptions): () => void {
   103→  const config = preloadingService.getConfig();
   104→
   105→  const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
   106→    await prefetchAdjacentGenerationPages({
   107→      queryClient,
   108→      projectId,
   109→      currentPage,
   110→      totalPages,
   111→      hasMorePages,
   112→      itemsPerPage,
   113→      filters,
   114→      filtersString,
   115→      keepRange,
   116→      onError: (context, error, logData) => {
   117→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   118→          context,
   119→          showToast: false,
   120→          logData,
   121→        });
   122→      },
   123→    });
   124→  }, config.debounceMs);
   125→
   126→  return () => {
   127→    clearTimeout(timer);
   128→  };
   129→}
   130→
   131→async function prefetchPage(
   132→  context: AdjacentPreloadContext,
   133→  page: number,
   134→  priority: number,
   135→  errorContext: string,
   136→): Promise<void> {
   137→  const {
   138→    queryClient,
   139→    projectId,
   140→    itemsPerPage,
   141→    filters,
   142→    filtersString,
   143→    onError,
   144→  } = context;
   145→
   146→  try {
   147→    await queryClient.prefetchQuery({
   148→      [REDACTED](
   149→        projectId,
   150→        page,
   151→        itemsPerPage,
   152→        filtersString,
   153→      ),
   154→      queryFn: () =>
   155→        fetchGenerations(
   156→          projectId,
   157→          itemsPerPage,
   158→          (page - 1) * itemsPerPage,
   159→          filters,
   160→        ),
   161→      staleTime: 30_000,
   162→    });
   163→
   164→    const cached = queryClient.getQueryData<PaginatedResponse>(
   165→      unifiedGenerationQueryKeys.byProject(projectId, page, itemsPerPage, filtersString),
   166→    );
   167→    if (cached?.items) {
   168→      preloadingService.preloadImages(cached.items, priority);
   169→    }
   170→  } catch (error) {
   171→    onError(errorContext, error, { projectId, page });
   172→  }
   173→}
   174→
   175→export async function prefetchAdjacentGenerationPages(context: AdjacentPreloadContext): Promise<void> {
   176→  const {
   177→    currentPage,
   178→    totalPages,
   179→    hasMorePages,
   180→    keepRange = 2,
   181→  } = context;
   182→
   183→  const hasPrevPage = currentPage > 1;
   184→  const hasNextPage = totalPages === null
   185→    ? hasMorePages
   186→    : currentPage < totalPages;
   187→
   188→  if (hasNextPage) {
   189→    await prefetchPage(context, currentPage + 1, PRIORITY_VALUES.high, 'useAdjacentPagePreloader.prefetchNext');
   190→  }
   191→
   192→  if (hasPrevPage) {
   193→    await prefetchPage(context, currentPage - 1, PRIORITY_VALUES.normal, 'useAdjacentPagePreloader.prefetchPrevious');
   194→  }
   195→
   196→  cleanupDistantGenerationPages(context.queryClient, context.projectId, context.currentPage, keepRange);
   197→}

     4→

     9→function getShotListQueries(queryClient: QueryClient, projectId: string) {

    15→/**
    16→ * @param onlyExisting - If true, only update caches that already exist.

    19→export function updateAllShotsCaches(
    20→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    21→  projectId: string,
    22→  updater: (old: Shot[] | undefined) => Shot[],
    23→  onlyExisting: boolean = false
    24→): void {
    25→  const cachedQueries = getShotListQueries(queryClient, projectId);
    26→  if (cachedQueries.length === 0) {
    27→    if (!onlyExisting) {
    28→      queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>(
    29→        queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0),
    30→        (old) => updater(old)
    31→      );
    32→    }
    33→    return;
    34→  }
    35→
    36→  cachedQueries.forEach(([key, existing]) => {
    37→    if (onlyExisting && existing === undefined) {
    38→      return;
    39→    }
    40→    queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>(key, (old) => updater(old));
    41→  });
    42→}
    43→
    44→export function rollbackShotsCaches(
    45→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    46→  projectId: string,
    47→  previous: Shot[] | undefined
    48→): void {
    49→  if (!previous) return;
    50→  const cachedQueries = getShotListQueries(queryClient, projectId);
    51→  if (cachedQueries.length === 0) {
    52→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0), previous);
    53→    return;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  cachedQueries.forEach(([key]) => {
    57→    queryClient.setQueryData(key, previous);
    58→  });
    59→}

    68→export function findShotsCache(
    69→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    70→  projectId: string
    71→): Shot[] | undefined {
    72→  const cachedQueries = getShotListQueries(queryClient, projectId);
    73→  for (const [, data] of cachedQueries) {

    48→export class LineageScopeError extends Error {
    49→  readonly status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    50→  readonly variantId: string;
    51→  readonly projectId: string;
    52→  readonly queryError?: string;
    53→
    54→  constructor(params: {
    55→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    56→    variantId: string;

    58→    queryError?: string;
    59→    message: string;
    60→  }) {

    63→    this.status = params.status;

    78→function buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scopeStatus: string, queryError?: string): string {
    79→  switch (scopeStatus) {
    80→    case 'scope_mismatch':
    81→      return 'Variant exists but does not belong to the active project scope';
    82→    case 'missing_project_scope':
    83→      return 'Variant does not have project scope metadata';
    84→    case 'missing_variant':
    85→      return 'Variant not found';
    86→    case 'missing_generation':

    95→function toLineageScopeError(

   101→    queryError?: string;

   105→    return error;
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  const message = error instanceof Error

   110→    : buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(fallback.status, fallback.queryError);

   125→      queryError: scope.queryError,

   131→    .select('id, generation_id, params, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, variant_type')
   132→    .eq('id', variantId)
   133→    .eq('generation_id', scope.generationId)
   134→    .single();
   135→
   136→  if (error) {
   137→    throw toLineageScopeError(error, {
   138→      status: 'query_failed',
   139→      variantId,
   140→      projectId,
   141→      queryError: error.message,
   142→    });
   143→  }
   144→

   156→/**
   157→ * Recursively fetch the lineage chain for a variant.
   158→ * Follows `params.source_variant_id` across generation boundaries.
   159→ */
   160→async function fetchLineageChain(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<LineageItem[]> {
   161→  const chain: LineageItem[] = [];
   162→  const visited = new Set<string>();
   163→  let currentId: string | null = variantId;
   164→
   165→  while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
   166→    visited.add(currentId);
   167→    const variant = await fetchVariantById(currentId, projectId);
   168→
   169→    chain.unshift({
   170→      id: variant.id,
   171→      imageUrl: variant.location,
   172→      thumbnailUrl: variant.thumbnail_url,
   173→      createdAt: variant.created_at,
   174→      type: 'variant',
   175→      variantType: variant.variant_type,
   176→    });
   177→    currentId = readSourceVariantId(variant.params);
   178→  }
   179→
   180→  return chain;
   181→}
   182→
   183→/**
   184→ * Hook to fetch the full lineage chain for a variant.
   185→ *
   186→ * @param variantId - The variant ID to fetch lineage for
   187→ * @param projectId - Project scope required for lineage traversal
   188→ * @returns Object with chain (oldest to newest), loading state, and whether there's lineage
   189→ */
   190→export function useLineageChain(variantId: string | null, projectId: string | null): LineageChainResult {
   191→  const { data: chain = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery<LineageItem[], LineageScopeError>({
   192→    queryKey: [...generationQueryKeys.lineageChain(variantId!), projectId ?? '__no-project__'],
   193→    queryFn: async () => {
   194→      try {
   195→        return await fetchLineageChain(variantId!, projectId!);
   196→      } catch (caughtError) {
   197→        const normalizedError = toLineageScopeError(caughtError, {
   198→          status: 'query_failed',
   199→          variantId: variantId!,
   200→          projectId: projectId!,
   201→        });
   202→        normalizeAndPresentError(normalizedError, {
   203→          context: 'useLineageChain',
   204→          showToast: false,
   205→          logData: {
   206→            variantId: normalizedError.variantId,
   207→            projectId: normalizedError.projectId,
   208→            status: normalizedError.status,
   209→            queryError: normalizedError.queryError,
   210→          },
   211→        });
   212→        throw normalizedError;
   213→      }
   214→    },
   215→    enabled: !!variantId && !!projectId,
   216→    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes - lineage doesn't change
   217→    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  return {
   221→    chain,
   222→    isLoading,
   223→    // Has lineage if chain has more than 1 item (the current variant + at least one ancestor)
   224→    hasLineage: chain.length > 1,
   225→    error: error ?? null,
   226→  };
   227→}
   228→
   229→/**
   230→ * Count the lineage chain length for a variant.
   231→ * Returns the number of ancestors (0 if no lineage, 1+ if has ancestors).
   232→ * This fetches directly without caching - use sparingly for initial checks.
   233→ *
   234→ * Reuses fetchLineageChain to avoid duplicating the traversal logic.
   235→ */
   236→export async function getLineageDepth(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<number> {
   237→  const chain = await fetchLineageChain(variantId, projectId);
   238→  // chain includes the variant itself; ancestors = chain length - 1
   239→  return Math.max(0, chain.length - 1);
   240→}
   241→
   242→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { useLineageChain } instead
   243→

    91→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);

    95→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
    96→    }
    97→  }

   103→export function enhanceGenerationsWithTaskData(
   104→  generations: GenerationRow[],

   106→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   107→  return generations.map((generation) => {

   110→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),

   116→    return {

   118→      taskId,
   119→      taskData,
   120→      taskMappingStatus,

   262→export async function getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(
   263→  generationIds: string[],
   264→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   265→): Promise<Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>> {
   266→  if (generationIds.length === 0) {
   267→    return new Map();
   268→  }
   269→
   270→  const requestedIds = Array.from(new Set(generationIds));
   271→  const supabaseResult = (options?.supabaseRegistry ?? supabaseClientRegistry).getClientResult();
   272→  if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
   273→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   274→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   275→      failures.set(generationId, {
   276→        generationId,
   277→        taskId: null,
   278→        status: 'query_failed',
   279→        queryError: supabaseResult.error.message,
   280→      });
   281→    });
   282→    return failures;

   285→  const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
   286→  const query = supabase
   287→    .from('generations')
   288→    .select('id, tasks, project_id')
   289→    .in('id', requestedIds);
   290→
   291→  const { data, error } = await query;
   292→
   293→  if (error) {
   294→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   295→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   296→      failures.set(generationId, {
   297→        generationId,
   298→        taskId: null,
   299→        status: 'query_failed',
   300→        queryError: error.message,
   301→      });
   302→    });
   303→    return failures;
   304→  }
   305→
   306→  const rowsById = new Map((data || []).map((row) => [row.id, row]));
   307→
   308→  const mappings = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   309→  for (const generationId of requestedIds) {
   310→    const row = rowsById.get(generationId);
   311→
   312→    if (!row) {
   313→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   314→        generationId,
   315→        taskId: null,
   316→        status: 'missing_generation',
   317→      });

    22→  const startTime = Date.now();
    23→  const requestId = `${startTime}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
    24→  const requestContext = {
    25→    requestId,
    26→    taskType: taskParams.task_type,
    27→    projectId: taskParams.project_id,
    28→  };
    29→  const timeoutMs = 20000; // 20s safety timeout to avoid indefinite UI stall
    30→  const controller = new AbortController();
    31→  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {

    34→
    35→  try {

    52→        dependant_on: null,
    53→        idempotency_key,

    55→      signal: controller.signal,
    56→    });
    57→
    58→    if (!response.ok) {
    59→      const errorText = await response.text().catch(() => '');
    60→      throw new ServerError(errorText || 'Failed to create task', {
    61→        context: requestContext,
    62→      });
    63→    }
    64→
    65→    const data = await response.json() as unknown;
    66→    return parseTaskCreationResponse(data, requestContext);
    67→  } catch (err: unknown) {
    68→    const context = {
    69→      requestId,
    70→      taskType: taskParams.task_type,
    71→      projectId: taskParams.project_id,
    72→      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    73→    };
    74→
    75→    if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
    76→      console.error('[createTask] invoke FAILED', context, err);
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    // Normalize abort errors for better UX
    80→    if (isAbortError(err)) {
    81→      throw new NetworkError('Task creation timed out. Please try again.', {
    82→        isTimeout: true,
    83→        context,
    84→        cause: err instanceof Error ? err : undefined,
    85→      });
    86→    }

    88→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(err, {

    90→      showToast: false,
    91→      logData: context,
    92→    });
    93→  } finally {

    68→async function calculateDerivedCounts(

   304→    },
   305→    createdAt: item.created_at,

   307→    isVideo,
   308→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   309→    starred: item.starred || false,
   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access

   377→/**
   378→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   379→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   380→ */
   381→export function transformForTimeline(
   382→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   383→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   384→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   385→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;

   387→  if (!genData) {
   388→    return {

   390→      id: shotGen.id,
   391→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   392→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   393→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   394→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   395→    };
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return {
   399→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   400→    id: shotGen.id,
   401→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   402→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   403→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   404→    imageUrl: genData.location,

   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,

   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}

   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}

1→import { isAbortError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errorUtils';
     2→
     3→type TimelineWritePhase = 'queued' | 'start' | 'end';
     4→
     5→export interface TimelineWriteEventMeta {
     6→  shotId: string;
     7→  operation: string;
     8→  waitMs: number;
     9→  durationMs: number;
    10→  queueDepth: number;
    11→  requestId: number;
    12→  blockedByOperation?: string | null;
    13→  blockedByDurationMs?: number | null;
    14→}
    15→
    16→export type TimelineWriteEventHandler = (phase: TimelineWritePhase, meta: TimelineWriteEventMeta) => void;
    17→
    18→interface TimelineWriteLoggerOptions {
    19→  logPrefix: string;
    20→  log?: (...args: Parameters<typeof console.log>) => void;
    21→}
    22→
    23→function shortTimelineId(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
    24→  return value ? value.slice(0, 8) : null;
    25→}
    26→
    27→/**
    28→ * Shared queue-phase logger for timeline write serialization.
    29→ * Keeps queue observability structure consistent across timeline hooks.
    30→ */
    31→export function createTimelineWriteQueueLogger(options: TimelineWriteLoggerOptions): TimelineWriteEventHandler {
    32→  const log = options.log ?? console.log;
    33→  return (phase, meta) => {
    34→    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    35→      shotId: shortTimelineId(meta.shotId),
    36→      requestId: meta.requestId,
    37→      operation: meta.operation,
    38→      waitMs: meta.waitMs,
    39→      queueDepth: meta.queueDepth,
    40→      blockedByOperation: meta.blockedByOperation ?? null,
    41→      blockedByDurationMs: meta.blockedByDurationMs ?? null,
    42→    };
    43→
    44→    if (phase !== 'start') {
    45→      payload.durationMs = meta.durationMs;
    46→    }
    47→
    48→    log(`${options.logPrefix} write queue ${phase}`, payload);
    49→  };
    50→}
    51→
    52→const DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
    53→const TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE = 'TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT';
    54→
    55→interface TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions {
    56→  timeoutMs?: number;
    57→  onTimeout?: (meta: { operation: string; timeoutMs: number; pendingMs: number }) => void;
    58→}
    59→
    60→class TimelineWriteTimeoutError extends Error {
    61→  readonly code = TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE;
    62→
    63→  constructor(operation: string, timeoutMs: number, cause?: unknown) {
    64→    super(`Timeline write "${operation}" timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
    65→    this.name = 'TimelineWriteTimeoutError';
    66→    if (cause !== undefined) {
    67→      (this as { cause?: unknown }).cause = cause;
    68→    }
    69→  }
    70→}
    71→
    72→export function isTimelineWriteTimeoutError(error: unknown): error is TimelineWriteTimeoutError {
    73→  return (
    74→    error instanceof TimelineWriteTimeoutError
    75→    || (
    76→      typeof error === 'object'
    77→      && error !== null
    78→      && 'code' in error
    79→      && (error as { code?: unknown }).code === TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE
    80→    )
    81→  );
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Guard a write request with an abortable timeout so stalled network calls
    86→ * cannot block the serialized per-shot queue forever.
    87→ */
    88→export async function runTimelineWriteWithTimeout<T>(
    89→  operation: string,
    90→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
    91→  options?: TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions,
    92→): Promise<T> {
    93→  const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    94→  const startedAt = Date.now();
    95→  const controller = new AbortController();
    96→  let timedOut = false;
    97→
    98→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
    99→    timedOut = true;
   100→    options?.onTimeout?.({
   101→      operation,
   102→      timeoutMs,
   103→      pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   104→    });
   105→    controller.abort();
   106→  }, timeoutMs);
   107→
   108→  try {
   109→    return await task(controller.signal);
   110→  } catch (error) {
   111→    if (timedOut || (controller.signal.aborted && isAbortError(error))) {
   112→      throw new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs, error);
   113→    }
   114→    throw error;
   115→  } finally {
   116→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   117→  }
   118→}
   119→
   120→const shotWriteTail = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
   121→const shotWriteDepth = new Map<string, number>();
   122→const shotWriteActive = new Map<string, { requestId: number; operation: string; startedAt: number }>();
   123→let writeRequestCounter = 0;
   124→const DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
   125→
   126→interface TimelineSerializedWriteOptions {
   127→  timeoutMs?: number;
   128→  onTimeout?: (meta: {
   129→    shotId: string;
   130→    operation: string;
   131→    timeoutMs: number;
   132→    pendingMs: number;
   133→    requestId: number;
   134→  }) => void;
   135→}
   136→
   137→function runSerializedTaskWithTimeout<T>(
   138→  operation: string,
   139→  task: () => Promise<T>,
   140→  timeoutMs: number,
   141→  onTimeout: () => void,
   142→): Promise<T> {
   143→  if (timeoutMs <= 0) {
   144→    return task();
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
   148→    let settled = false;
   149→    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
   150→      if (settled) {
   151→        return;
   152→      }
   153→      settled = true;
   154→      onTimeout();
   155→      reject(new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs));
   156→    }, timeoutMs);
   157→
   158→    Promise.resolve()
   159→      .then(task)
   160→      .then(
   161→        (result) => {
   162→          if (settled) {
   163→            return;
   164→          }
   165→          settled = true;
   166→          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   167→          resolve(result);
   168→        },
   169→        (error) => {
   170→          if (settled) {
   171→            return;
   172→          }
   173→          settled = true;
   174→          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   175→          reject(error);
   176→        },
   177→      );
   178→  });
   179→}
   180→
   181→/**
   182→ * Returns true if any serialized timeline write is active or queued for the
   183→ * given shot. Both the timeline drag path and the batch editor path go through
   184→ * runSerializedTimelineWrite, so this covers all writes across both paths.
   185→ * Used by useTimelinePositions.syncFromDatabase to suppress stale syncs while
   186→ * the batch editor is writing (the batch editor does not set isLockedRef, so
   187→ * without this check a background refetch during the midpoint RPC would snap
   188→ * positions back to pre-edit values).
   189→ */
   190→export function isTimelineWriteActive(shotId: string): boolean {
   191→  return (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) > 0;
   192→}
   193→
   194→/**
   195→ * Serialize timeline writes per shot to avoid overlapping updates from
   196→ * different UI flows (batch reorder, timeline drag, etc.).
   197→ */
   198→export async function runSerializedTimelineWrite<T>(
   199→  shotId: string,
   200→  operation: string,
   201→  task: () => Promise<T>,
   202→  onEvent?: TimelineWriteEventHandler,
   203→  options?: TimelineSerializedWriteOptions,
   204→): Promise<T> {
   205→  const requestId = ++writeRequestCounter;
   206→  const queuedAt = Date.now();
   207→  const previousTail = shotWriteTail.get(shotId) ?? Promise.resolve();
   208→  const nextDepth = (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) + 1;
   209→  shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, nextDepth);
   210→  const blockedBy = shotWriteActive.get(shotId);
   211→  const blockedByDurationMs = blockedBy ? Math.max(0, queuedAt - blockedBy.startedAt) : null;
   212→
   213→  onEvent?.('queued', {
   214→    shotId,
   215→    operation,
   216→    waitMs: 0,
   217→    durationMs: 0,
   218→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, nextDepth - 1),
   219→    requestId,
   220→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   221→    blockedByDurationMs,
   222→  });
   223→
   224→  let releaseTail!: () => void;
   225→  const currentTail = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   226→    releaseTail = resolve;
   227→  });
   228→
   229→  const chainedTail = previousTail.catch(() => undefined).then(() => currentTail);
   230→  shotWriteTail.set(shotId, chainedTail);
   231→
   232→  await previousTail.catch(() => undefined);
   233→
   234→  const startedAt = Date.now();
   235→  shotWriteActive.set(shotId, {
   236→    requestId,
   237→    operation,
   238→    startedAt,
   239→  });
   240→  onEvent?.('start', {
   241→    shotId,
   242→    operation,
   243→    waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   244→    durationMs: 0,
   245→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1),
   246→    requestId,
   247→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   248→    blockedByDurationMs,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  try {
   252→    const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS;
   253→    return await runSerializedTaskWithTimeout(
   254→      operation,
   255→      task,
   256→      timeoutMs,
   257→      () => {
   258→        options?.onTimeout?.({
   259→          shotId,
   260→          operation,
   261→          timeoutMs,
   262→          pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   263→          requestId,
   264→        });
   265→      },
   266→    );
   267→  } finally {
   268→    releaseTail();
   269→
   270→    const remainingDepth = Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1);
   271→    if (remainingDepth === 0) {
   272→      shotWriteDepth.delete(shotId);
   273→    } else {
   274→      shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, remainingDepth);
   275→    }
   276→
   277→    if (shotWriteTail.get(shotId) === chainedTail) {
   278→      shotWriteTail.delete(shotId);
   279→    }
   280→    if (shotWriteActive.get(shotId)?.requestId === requestId) {
   281→      shotWriteActive.delete(shotId);
   282→    }
   283→
   284→    onEvent?.('end', {
   285→      shotId,
   286→      operation,
   287→      waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   288→      durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   289→      queueDepth: Math.max(0, remainingDepth - 1),
   290→      requestId,
   291→      blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   292→      blockedByDurationMs,
   293→    });
   294→  }
   295→}

   398→    defaultSettings,
   399→    userSettings,
   400→    projectSettings,

   419→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabase(
   420→  toolId: string,
   421→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,

   423→): Promise<OperationResult<SettingsFetchResult>> {

   431→      }));
   432→    }

   434→    // Single-flight dedupe key for concurrent identical requests
   435→    const singleFlightKey = JSON.stringify({ toolId, projectId: ctx.projectId ?? null, shotId: ctx.shotId ?? null });
   436→    const existingPromise = inflightSettingsFetches.get(singleFlightKey);
   437→    if (existingPromise) {

   439→      return operationSuccess(value);

   443→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   444→

   454→      const [userResult, projectResult, shotResult] = await fetchAllScopes(supabaseClient, user.id, ctx, signal);

   459→    inflightSettingsFetches.set(singleFlightKey, promise);

   461→    // Suppress its rejection to avoid unhandled rejection warnings — the original
   462→    // `promise` reference (returned below) handles propagation to the caller.

   467→    return operationSuccess(value);
   468→

   471→      return toOperationFailure(error);
   472→    }
   473→    if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   474→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   475→        recoverable: true,
   476→        cause: error,
   477→      }));

   498→          cause: error,
   499→          metadata: { ...contextInfo, reason: 'auth_timeout' },
   500→        },
   501→      ));
   502→    }
   503→
   504→    if (errorMsg.includes('Failed to fetch')) {
   505→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.network', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });

   507→        'network',
   508→        'Network connection issue. Please check your internet connection.',
   509→        {
   510→          recoverable: true,
   511→          cause: error,
   512→          metadata: contextInfo,
   513→        },
   514→      ));
   515→    }
   516→
   517→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });

   519→  }
   520→}

   522→/**

   526→ * (for example React Query query functions and mutation pipelines) so read/write
   527→ * settings flows share the same error contract.
   528→ */
   529→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(
   530→  toolId: string,
   531→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,

   534→  const result = await fetchToolSettingsSupabase(toolId, ctx, signal);
   535→  if (!result.ok) {
   536→    throw toToolSettingsErrorFromOperationFailure(result);

     2→ * Clip initialization and pending-clip consumption for the Join Clips tool.
     3→ *
     4→ * Extracted from clipManagerService to isolate:
     5→ * - localStorage cache helpers (skeleton sizing)
     6→ * - Poster preloading
     7→ * - Video duration extraction from URLs
     8→ * - Pending join clips (lightbox "Add to Join" localStorage polling)
     9→ * - Building initial clips from persisted settings
    10→ * - Padding clips with empty slots
    11→ */
    12→
    13→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    14→import {
    15→  getPendingJoinClipsCandidateKeys,
    16→  isPendingJoinClipInScope,
    17→  type PendingJoinClipEntry,
    18→} from '@/shared/lib/joinClipsPendingQueue';
    19→import { generateUUID } from '@/shared/lib/taskCreation';
    20→import { readUserIdFromStorage } from '@/shared/lib/supabaseSession';
    21→import {
    22→  operationFailure,
    23→  operationSuccess,
    24→  type OperationResult,
    25→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
    26→import type { VideoClip, TransitionPrompt } from '../types';
    27→import type { JoinClipsSettings } from '@/shared/lib/joinClipsDefaults';
    28→
    29→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    30→// Empty clip factory (canonical location — re-exported by clipManagerService)
    31→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    32→
    33→export function createEmptyClip(): VideoClip {
    34→  return { id: generateUUID(), url: '', loaded: false, playing: false };
    35→}
    36→
    37→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    38→// localStorage cache helpers (skeleton sizing)
    39→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    40→
    41→function getLocalStorageKey(projectId: string): string {
    42→  return `join-clips-count-${projectId}`;
    43→}
    44→
    45→const MAX_CACHED_CLIPS_COUNT = 500;
    46→
    47→export function getCachedClipsCount(projectId: string | null): number {
    48→  if (!projectId) return 0;
    49→  try {
    50→    const cached = localStorage.getItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId));
    51→    if (!cached) return 0;
    52→
    53→    const parsed = Number.parseInt(cached, 10);
    54→    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed < 0 || parsed > MAX_CACHED_CLIPS_COUNT) {
    55→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Invalid join-clips cached count'), {
    56→        context: 'JoinClipsCache.read.invalid',
    57→        showToast: false,
    58→        logData: { projectId, cached },
    59→      });
    60→      return 0;
    61→    }
    62→    return parsed;
    63→  } catch (error) {
    64→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    65→      context: 'JoinClipsCache.read.error',
    66→      showToast: false,
    67→      logData: { projectId },
    68→    });
    69→    return 0;
    70→  }
    71→}
    72→
    73→export function setCachedClipsCount(projectId: string | null, count: number): void {
    74→  if (!projectId) return;
    75→  try {
    76→    const normalizedCount = Number.isFinite(count) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(count)) : 0;
    77→    if (normalizedCount > 0) {
    78→      localStorage.setItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId), normalizedCount.toString());
    79→    } else {
    80→      localStorage.removeItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId));
    81→    }
    82→  } catch (error) {
    83→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    84→      context: 'JoinClipsCache.write.error',
    85→      showToast: false,
    86→      logData: { projectId, count },
    87→    });
    88→  }
    89→}
    90→
    91→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    92→// Poster preloading
    93→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    94→
    95→/**
    96→ * Warm the browser image cache for the given poster URLs.
    97→ * Returns a promise that resolves when all images have loaded (or errored).
    98→ */
    99→export function preloadPosterImages(
   100→  posterUrls: string[],
   101→  alreadyPreloaded: Set<string>,
   102→): Promise<void[]> {
   103→  const promises = posterUrls
   104→    .filter(url => url && !alreadyPreloaded.has(url))
   105→    .map(
   106→      url =>
   107→        new Promise<void>(resolve => {
   108→          const img = new Image();
   109→          img.onload = () => {
   110→            alreadyPreloaded.add(url);
   111→            resolve();
   112→          };
   113→          img.onerror = () => resolve();
   114→          img.src = url;
   115→        }),
   116→    );
   117→  return Promise.all(promises);
   118→}
   119→
   120→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   121→// Video duration extraction
   122→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   123→
   124→/** Create a throwaway <video> to read duration from a URL. */
   125→function getVideoDurationFromUrl(videoUrl: string): Promise<number> {
   126→  return new Promise<number>(resolve => {
   127→    const videoElement = document.createElement('video');
   128→    videoElement.preload = 'metadata';
   129→    videoElement.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(videoElement.duration);
   130→    videoElement.onerror = () => resolve(0);
   131→    videoElement.src = videoUrl;
   132→  });
   133→}
   134→
   135→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   136→// Pending join clips (lightbox "Add to Join" localStorage polling)
   137→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   138→
   139→const PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
   140→
   141→interface PendingJoinClipParseResult {
   142→  entries: PendingJoinClipEntry[];
   143→  invalidCount: number;
   144→}
   145→
   146→function parsePendingJoinClips(raw: string): PendingJoinClipParseResult | null {
   147→  let parsed: unknown;
   148→  try {
   149→    parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
   150→  } catch {
   151→    return null;
   152→  }
   153→
   154→  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
   155→    return null;
   156→  }
   157→
   158→  const entries: PendingJoinClipEntry[] = [];
   159→  let invalidCount = 0;
   160→  for (const value of parsed) {
   161→    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
   162→      invalidCount += 1;
   163→      continue;
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    const candidate = value as Record<string, unknown>;
   167→    if (
   168→      typeof candidate.videoUrl !== 'string'
   169→      || typeof candidate.generationId !== 'string'
   170→      || typeof candidate.timestamp !== 'number'
   171→      || !Number.isFinite(candidate.timestamp)
   172→    ) {
   173→      invalidCount += 1;
   174→      continue;
   175→    }
   176→
   177→    entries.push({
   178→      videoUrl: candidate.videoUrl,
   179→      generationId: candidate.generationId,
   180→      timestamp: candidate.timestamp,
   181→      ...(typeof candidate.thumbnailUrl === 'string' && candidate.thumbnailUrl.length > 0
   182→        ? { thumbnailUrl: candidate.thumbnailUrl }
   183→        : {}),
   184→      ...(typeof candidate.projectId === 'string' && candidate.projectId.length > 0
   185→        ? { projectId: candidate.projectId }
   186→        : {}),
   187→      ...(typeof candidate.userId === 'string' && candidate.userId.length > 0
   188→        ? { userId: candidate.userId }
   189→        : {}),
   190→    });
   191→  }
   192→
   193→  return { entries, invalidCount };
   194→}
   195→
   196→/**
   197→ * Reads and consumes pending join clips from localStorage.
   198→ * Returns deferred actions that are applied to clip state later.
   199→ * Placement is intentionally not resolved here because only the consumer has
   200→ * the previous clip array needed to choose fill-vs-append.
   201→ */
   202→export type PendingClipAction = {
   203→  type: 'deferred_insert';
   204→  clip: VideoClip;
   205→};
   206→
   207→interface ConsumePendingJoinClipsOptions {
   208→  projectId?: string | null;
   209→  readVideoDuration?: (videoUrl: string) => Promise<number>;
   210→}
   211→
   212→export async function consumePendingJoinClips(
   213→  options: ConsumePendingJoinClipsOptions = {},
   214→): Promise<OperationResult<PendingClipAction[]>> {
   215→  const projectId = options.projectId ?? null;
   216→  const readVideoDuration = options.readVideoDuration ?? getVideoDurationFromUrl;
   217→
   218→  try {
   219→    const userId = readUserIdFromStorage();
   220→    const pendingKeys = getPendingJoinClipsCandidateKeys({ projectId, userId });
   221→    const pendingSource = pendingKeys
   222→      .map((key) => ({ key, raw: localStorage.getItem(key) }))
   223→      .find((item) => typeof item.raw === 'string' && item.raw.length > 0);
   224→
   225→    if (!pendingSource || !pendingSource.raw) {
   226→      return operationSuccess([]);
   227→    }
   228→
   229→    const parsedPendingClips = parsePendingJoinClips(pendingSource.raw);
   230→    if (!parsedPendingClips) {
   231→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   232→        context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsInvalid',
   233→        showToast: false,
   234→        logData: { [REDACTED] },
   235→      });
   236→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   237→      return operationFailure(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   238→        policy: 'degrade',
   239→        errorCode: 'pending_join_clips_invalid_payload',
   240→        message: 'Invalid pending join clips payload',
   241→        recoverable: true,
   242→        cause: { [REDACTED] },
   243→      });
   244→    }
   245→
   246→    if (parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0) {
   247→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Dropped invalid pending join clip entries'), {
   248→        context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsPartialRecovery',
   249→        showToast: false,
   250→        logData: {
   251→          [REDACTED],
   252→          totalEntries: parsedPendingClips.entries.length + parsedPendingClips.invalidCount,
   253→          invalidEntries: parsedPendingClips.invalidCount,
   254→        },
   255→      });
   256→    }
   257→
   258→    const now = Date.now();
   259→    const recentClips = parsedPendingClips.entries.filter(
   260→      clip => now - clip.timestamp < PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS,
   261→    );
   262→    const scopedRecentClips = recentClips.filter((clip) =>
   263→      isPendingJoinClipInScope(clip, { projectId, userId }),
   264→    );
   265→
   266→    if (scopedRecentClips.length === 0) {
   267→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   268→      return operationSuccess([], {
   269→        ...(parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0 ? { policy: 'degrade' } : {}),
   270→      });
   271→    }
   272→
   273→    const actions: PendingClipAction[] = [];
   274→
   275→    for (const { videoUrl, thumbnailUrl, generationId } of scopedRecentClips) {
   276→      if (!videoUrl) continue;
   277→
   278→      const durationSeconds = await readVideoDuration(videoUrl);
   279→
   280→      const clip: VideoClip = {
   281→        id: generateUUID(),
   282→        url: videoUrl,
   283→        posterUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   284→        durationSeconds,
   285→        loaded: false,
   286→        playing: false,
   287→        generationId,
   288→      };
   289→
   290→      actions.push({ type: 'deferred_insert', clip });
   291→    }
   292→
   293→    localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   294→    return operationSuccess(actions, {
   295→      ...(parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0 ? { policy: 'degrade' } : {}),
   296→    });
   297→  } catch (error) {
   298→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'JoinClipsPage', showToast: false });
   299→    return operationFailure(error, {
   300→      policy: 'degrade',
   301→      errorCode: 'pending_join_clips_read_failed',
   302→      message: 'Failed to consume pending join clips',
   303→      recoverable: true,
   304→      cause: error,
   305→    });
   306→  }
   307→}
   308→
   309→/**
   310→ * Apply pending clip actions to an existing clips array.
   311→ * Resolves each deferred action by filling the first available empty slot,
   312→ * or appending when no empty slots remain.
   313→ */
   314→export function applyPendingClipActions(
   315→  prevClips: VideoClip[],
   316→  actions: PendingClipAction[],
   317→): VideoClip[] {
   318→  let clips = [...prevClips];
   319→  // Track which indices have been filled by previous actions in this batch
   320→  const filledIndices = new Set<number>();
   321→
   322→  for (const action of actions) {
   323→    const emptyIndex = clips.findIndex(
   324→      (clip, idx) => !clip.url && !filledIndices.has(idx),
   325→    );
   326→
   327→    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
   328→      clips = clips.map((clip, idx) =>
   329→        idx === emptyIndex
   330→          ? {
   331→              ...clip,
   332→              url: action.clip.url,
   333→              posterUrl: action.clip.posterUrl,
   334→              durationSeconds: action.clip.durationSeconds,
   335→              loaded: false,
   336→              playing: false,
   337→              generationId: action.clip.generationId,
   338→            }
   339→          : clip,
   340→      );
   341→      filledIndices.add(emptyIndex);
   342→    } else {
   343→      clips = [...clips, action.clip];
   344→    }
   345→  }
   346→
   347→  return clips;
   348→}
   349→
   350→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   351→// Build initial clips from persisted settings
   352→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   353→
   354→interface InitialClipsResult {
   355→  clips: VideoClip[];
   356→  transitionPrompts: TransitionPrompt[];
   357→  posterUrlsToPreload: string[];
   358→}
   359→
   360→export function buildInitialClipsFromSettings(
   361→  settings: JoinClipsSettings,
   362→): InitialClipsResult {
   363→  const initialClips: VideoClip[] = [];
   364→  const posterUrlsToPreload: string[] = [];
   365→  let transitionPrompts: TransitionPrompt[] = [];
   366→
   367→  // Try loading from new multi-clip format
   368→  if (settings.clips && settings.clips.length > 0) {
   369→    settings.clips.forEach(clip => {
   370→      if (clip.url) {
   371→        initialClips.push({
   372→          id: generateUUID(),
   373→          url: clip.url,
   374→          posterUrl: clip.posterUrl,
   375→          finalFrameUrl: clip.finalFrameUrl,
   376→          durationSeconds: clip.durationSeconds,
   377→          loaded: false,
   378→          playing: false,
   379→        });
   380→        if (clip.posterUrl) posterUrlsToPreload.push(clip.posterUrl);
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→
   384→    // Load transition prompts
   385→    if (settings.transitionPrompts && settings.transitionPrompts.length > 0) {
   386→      transitionPrompts = settings.transitionPrompts
   387→        .map(tp => ({
   388→          id: initialClips[tp.clipIndex]?.id || '',
   389→          prompt: tp.prompt,
   390→        }))
   391→        .filter(p => p.id);
   392→    }
   393→  }
   394→  // Fallback to legacy two-video format
   395→  else if (settings.startingVideoUrl || settings.endingVideoUrl) {
   396→    if (settings.startingVideoUrl) {
   397→      initialClips.push({
   398→        id: generateUUID(),
   399→        url: settings.startingVideoUrl,
   400→        posterUrl: settings.startingVideoPosterUrl,
   401→        loaded: false,
   402→        playing: false,
   403→      });
   404→      if (settings.startingVideoPosterUrl) {
   405→        posterUrlsToPreload.push(settings.startingVideoPosterUrl);
   406→      }
   407→    }
   408→
   409→    if (settings.endingVideoUrl) {
   410→      initialClips.push({
   411→        id: generateUUID(),
   412→        url: settings.endingVideoUrl,
   413→        posterUrl: settings.endingVideoPosterUrl,
   414→        loaded: false,
   415→        playing: false,
   416→      });
   417→      if (settings.endingVideoPosterUrl) {
   418→        posterUrlsToPreload.push(settings.endingVideoPosterUrl);
   419→      }
   420→    }
   421→
   422→    // Initialize transition prompts from legacy format
   423→    // The `prompt` field existed in an older settings schema and may still
   424→    // be present in persisted data even though it's not in the current type.
   425→    const legacyPrompt = (settings as JoinClipsSettings & { prompt?: string }).prompt;
   426→    if (initialClips.length >= 2 && legacyPrompt) {
   427→      transitionPrompts = [
   428→        {
   429→          id: initialClips[1].id,
   430→          prompt: legacyPrompt,
   431→        },
   432→      ];
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→
   436→  return { clips: initialClips, transitionPrompts, posterUrlsToPreload };
   437→}
   438→
   439→/**
   440→ * Pad initialClips to have at least 2 slots plus one trailing empty slot.
   441→ * This matches the original hook behavior exactly.
   442→ */
   443→export function padClipsWithEmptySlots(initialClips: VideoClip[]): VideoClip[] {
   444→  if (initialClips.length === 0) {
   445→    return [createEmptyClip(), createEmptyClip()];
   446→  }
   447→
   448→  if (initialClips.length < 2) {
   449→    const clipsToAdd = 2 - initialClips.length;
   450→    const emptyClips = Array.from({ length: clipsToAdd }, () => createEmptyClip());
   451→    return [...initialClips, ...emptyClips];
   452→  }
   453→
   454→  // >= 2 clips: add one trailing empty slot
   455→  return [...initialClips, createEmptyClip()];
   456→}
   457→

    95→async function waitForVariantDelay(

    98→}: BuildCanonicalUpdatesInput): CanonicalTimelineFrameUpdate[] {
    99→  return updates
   100→    .map(({ shotGenerationId, newFrame }) => {
   101→      const shotGen = shotGenerations.find((sg) => sg.id === shotGenerationId);
   102→      if (!shotGen?.id || !shotGen.generation_id) {
   103→        return null;
   104→      }
   105→      return {
   106→        shotGenerationId: shotGen.id,
   107→        generationId: shotGen.generation_id,
   108→        newFrame,
   109→      } satisfies CanonicalTimelineFrameUpdate;
   110→    })
   111→    .filter((update): update is CanonicalTimelineFrameUpdate => update !== null);
   112→}
   113→
   114→export interface TimelineFrameBatchUpdate {
   115→  shotGenerationId: string;
   116→  timelineFrame: number;
   117→}
   118→
   119→interface PersistTimelineFrameBatchUpdatesInput {
   120→  shotId: string;

   122→  operationLabel: string;

   128→
   129→export async function persistTimelineFrameBatchUpdates({
   130→  shotId,
   131→  updates,
   132→  operationLabel,
   133→  timeoutOperationName,
   134→  dragSource,
   135→  logPrefix,
   136→  log,
   137→}: PersistTimelineFrameBatchUpdatesInput): Promise<void> {
   138→  await persistTimelineFrameBatch({
   139→    shotId,
   140→    updates: updates.map((update) => ({

   142→      timelineFrame: update.timelineFrame,
   143→      metadata: {

   153→}
   154→
   155→interface SyncTimelineGenerationFramesInput {
   156→  shotId: string;
   157→  targets: Array<{ generationId: string; frame: number }>;
   158→  syncShotData: (generationId: string, targetShotId: string, frame: number) => Promise<void>;
   159→  logPrefix: string;
   160→  log: TimelineLogFn;
   161→  ignoreTimeout?: boolean;
   162→}
   163→
   164→export async function syncTimelineGenerationFrames({
   165→  shotId,
   166→  targets,
   167→  syncShotData,
   168→  logPrefix,
   169→  log,
   170→  ignoreTimeout = false,
   171→}: SyncTimelineGenerationFramesInput): Promise<void> {
   172→  if (targets.length === 0) {
   173→    return;
   174→  }
   175→
   176→  try {
   177→    await runTimelineWriteWithTimeout(
   178→      'timeline-frame-sync-shot-data',
   179→      async () => {
   180→        await Promise.all(
   181→          targets.map(({ generationId, frame }) => syncShotData(generationId, shotId, frame)),
   182→        );
   183→      },
   184→      {
   185→        timeoutMs: 10_000,
   186→        onTimeout: ({ pendingMs, timeoutMs }) => {
   187→          log(`${logPrefix} shot_data sync timed out`, {
   188→            shotId: shortNullableId(shotId),
   189→            syncCount: targets.length,
   190→            timeoutMs,
   191→            pendingMs,
   192→          });
   193→        },
   194→      },
   195→    );
   196→  } catch (error) {
   197→    if (ignoreTimeout && isTimelineWriteTimeoutError(error)) {
   198→      log(`${logPrefix} shot_data sync timeout ignored`, {
   199→        shotId: shortNullableId(shotId),
   200→        syncCount: targets.length,
   201→      });
   202→      return;
   203→    }
   204→    throw error;
   205→  }
   206→}

1→/**
     2→ * useLineageChain Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Fetches the full lineage chain for a variant by following the `source_variant_id` field in params.
     5→ * Returns an array ordered from oldest ancestor to newest (the provided variant).
     6→ *

    40→  location: string;
    41→  thumbnail_url: string | null;
    42→  created_at: string;
    43→  variant_type: string | null;
    44→}
    45→
    46→type LineageScopeFailureStatus = Exclude<VariantProjectScopeStatus, 'ok'>;
    47→
    48→export class LineageScopeError extends Error {
    49→  readonly status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    50→  readonly variantId: string;
    51→  readonly projectId: string;
    52→  readonly queryError?: string;
    53→
    54→  constructor(params: {
    55→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    56→    variantId: string;
    57→    projectId: string;
    58→    queryError?: string;
    59→    message: string;
    60→  }) {
    61→    super(params.message);
    62→    this.name = 'LineageScopeError';
    63→    this.status = params.status;
    64→    this.variantId = params.variantId;
    65→    this.projectId = params.projectId;
    66→    this.queryError = params.queryError;
    67→  }
    68→}
    69→
    70→export function isLineageScopeError(error: unknown): error is LineageScopeError {
    71→  return error instanceof LineageScopeError;
    72→}
    73→
    74→function readSourceVariantId(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
    75→  return typeof params?.source_variant_id === 'string' ? params.source_variant_id : null;
    76→}
    77→
    78→function buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scopeStatus: string, queryError?: string): string {
    79→  switch (scopeStatus) {
    80→    case 'scope_mismatch':
    81→      return 'Variant exists but does not belong to the active project scope';
    82→    case 'missing_project_scope':
    83→      return 'Variant does not have project scope metadata';
    84→    case 'missing_variant':
    85→      return 'Variant not found';
    86→    case 'missing_generation':
    87→      return 'Variant generation was not found';
    88→    case 'query_failed':
    89→      return `Variant scope lookup failed${queryError ? `: ${queryError}` : ''}`;
    90→    default:
    91→      return `Variant scope validation failed (${scopeStatus})`;
    92→  }
    93→}
    94→
    95→function toLineageScopeError(
    96→  error: unknown,
    97→  fallback: {
    98→    variantId: string;
    99→    projectId: string;
   100→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
   101→    queryError?: string;
   102→  },
   103→): LineageScopeError {
   104→  if (isLineageScopeError(error)) {
   105→    return error;
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  const message = error instanceof Error
   109→    ? error.message
   110→    : buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(fallback.status, fallback.queryError);
   111→
   112→  return new LineageScopeError({
   113→    ...fallback,
   114→    message,
   115→  });
   116→}
   117→
   118→async function fetchVariantById(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<VariantRecord> {
   119→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
   120→  if (scope.status !== 'ok' || !scope.generationId) {
   121→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   122→      status: scope.status as LineageScopeFailureStatus,
   123→      variantId,
   124→      projectId,
   125→      queryError: scope.queryError,
   126→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scope.status, scope.queryError),
   127→    });
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseClient().from('generation_variants')
   131→    .select('id, generation_id, params, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, variant_type')
   132→    .eq('id', variantId)
   133→    .eq('generation_id', scope.generationId)
   134→    .single();
   135→
   136→  if (error) {
   137→    throw toLineageScopeError(error, {
   138→      status: 'query_failed',
   139→      variantId,
   140→      projectId,
   141→      queryError: error.message,
   142→    });
   143→  }
   144→
   145→  if (!data) {
   146→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   147→      status: 'missing_variant',
   148→      variantId,
   149→      projectId,
   150→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage('missing_variant'),
   151→    });
   152→  }
   153→  return data as VariantRecord;
   154→}
   155→
   156→/**
   157→ * Recursively fetch the lineage chain for a variant.
   158→ * Follows `params.source_variant_id` across generation boundaries.
   159→ */
   160→async function fetchLineageChain(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<LineageItem[]> {
   161→  const chain: LineageItem[] = [];
   162→  const visited = new Set<string>();
   163→  let currentId: string | null = variantId;
   164→
   165→  while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
   166→    visited.add(currentId);
   167→    const variant = await fetchVariantById(currentId, projectId);
   168→
   169→    chain.unshift({
   170→      id: variant.id,
   171→      imageUrl: variant.location,
   172→      thumbnailUrl: variant.thumbnail_url,
   173→      createdAt: variant.created_at,
   174→      type: 'variant',
   175→      variantType: variant.variant_type,
   176→    });
   177→    currentId = readSourceVariantId(variant.params);
   178→  }
   179→
   180→  return chain;
   181→}
   182→
   183→/**
   184→ * Hook to fetch the full lineage chain for a variant.
   185→ *
   186→ * @param variantId - The variant ID to fetch lineage for
   187→ * @param projectId - Project scope required for lineage traversal
   188→ * @returns Object with chain (oldest to newest), loading state, and whether there's lineage
   189→ */
   190→export function useLineageChain(variantId: string | null, projectId: string | null): LineageChainResult {
   191→  const { data: chain = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery<LineageItem[], LineageScopeError>({
   192→    queryKey: [...generationQueryKeys.lineageChain(variantId!), projectId ?? '__no-project__'],
   193→    queryFn: async () => {
   194→      try {
   195→        return await fetchLineageChain(variantId!, projectId!);
   196→      } catch (caughtError) {
   197→        const normalizedError = toLineageScopeError(caughtError, {
   198→          status: 'query_failed',
   199→          variantId: variantId!,
   200→          projectId: projectId!,
   201→        });
   202→        normalizeAndPresentError(normalizedError, {
   203→          context: 'useLineageChain',
   204→          showToast: false,
   205→          logData: {
   206→            variantId: normalizedError.variantId,
   207→            projectId: normalizedError.projectId,
   208→            status: normalizedError.status,
   209→            queryError: normalizedError.queryError,
   210→          },
   211→        });
   212→        throw normalizedError;
   213→      }
   214→    },
   215→    enabled: !!variantId && !!projectId,
   216→    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes - lineage doesn't change
   217→    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  return {
   221→    chain,
   222→    isLoading,
   223→    // Has lineage if chain has more than 1 item (the current variant + at least one ancestor)
   224→    hasLineage: chain.length > 1,
   225→    error: error ?? null,
   226→  };
   227→}
   228→
   229→/**
   230→ * Count the lineage chain length for a variant.
   231→ * Returns the number of ancestors (0 if no lineage, 1+ if has ancestors).
   232→ * This fetches directly without caching - use sparingly for initial checks.
   233→ *
   234→ * Reuses fetchLineageChain to avoid duplicating the traversal logic.
   235→ */
   236→export async function getLineageDepth(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<number> {
   237→  const chain = await fetchLineageChain(variantId, projectId);
   238→  // chain includes the variant itself; ancestors = chain length - 1
   239→  return Math.max(0, chain.length - 1);
   240→}
   241→
   242→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { useLineageChain } instead
   243→
