   244→      if (video) {
   245→        video.removeEventListener('play', handlePlay);
   246→        video.removeEventListener('pause', handlePause);
   247→        video.removeEventListener('seeked', handleSeeked);
   248→        video.pause();
   249→      }
   250→    };
   251→  // NOTE: scrubbing.reset is a stable callback, no need to include the entire scrubbing object
   252→  // Including scrubbing would cause cleanup to run on every state change (e.g., isPlaying),
   253→  // which would pause the video immediately after play() is called
   254→  }, [src, isMobile, disableScrubbing, thumbnailMode, resetScrubbing, videoRef]);
   255→
   256→  // Additional mobile protection - use Intersection Observer to detect when video becomes visible
   257→  // Only for gallery thumbnails, not lightbox
   258→  useEffect(() => {
   259→    if (!isMobile || !videoRef.current || disableScrubbing || thumbnailMode) return;
   260→
   261→    const video = videoRef.current;
   262→    
   263→    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
   264→      (entries) => {
   265→        entries.forEach((entry) => {
   266→          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
   267→            // Ensure video thumbnail is paused when it comes into view on mobile
   268→            if (!video.paused) {
   269→              video.pause();
   270→            }
   271→          }
   272→        });
   273→      },
   274→      { threshold: 0.1 }
   275→    );
   276→
   277→    observer.observe(video);
   278→
   279→    return () => {
   280→      observer.disconnect();
   281→    };
   282→  }, [isMobile, disableScrubbing, thumbnailMode, videoRef]);
   283→
   284→  // Periodic mobile check to catch any unexpected play states - but only for gallery thumbnails
   285→  useEffect(() => {
   286→    if (!isMobile || disableScrubbing || thumbnailMode) return;
   287→
   288→    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
   289→      if (videoRef.current && !videoRef.current.paused) {
   290→        videoRef.current.pause();
   291→      }
   292→    }, 1000);
   293→
   294→    return () => {
   295→      clearInterval(intervalId);
   296→    };
   297→  }, [isMobile, disableScrubbing, thumbnailMode, videoRef]);
   298→
   299→  return (
   300→    <div
   301→      ref={containerRef}
   302→      className={cn('relative group', className)}
   303→      onMouseEnter={isMobile || disableScrubbing || thumbnailMode ? undefined : handleMouseEnter}
   304→      onMouseLeave={isMobile || disableScrubbing || thumbnailMode ? undefined : handleMouseLeave}
   305→      onMouseMove={isMobile || disableScrubbing || thumbnailMode ? undefined : handleMouseMove}
   306→      {...rest}
   307→    >
   308→      <video
   309→        ref={videoRefCallback}
   310→        src={hasValidVideoSrc ? displaySrc : undefined}
   311→        poster={poster ? getDisplayUrl(poster) : undefined}
   312→        preload={thumbnailMode ? 'none' : (isMobile ? 'metadata' : preloadProp)}
   313→        controls={showNativeControls}
   314→        onLoadedMetadata={handleLoadedMetadata}
   315→        loop={loop}
   316→        muted={muted}
   317→        autoPlay={false}
   318→        playsInline
   319→        className={cn('w-full h-full object-contain', videoClassName, {

   322→        onDoubleClick={onDoubleClick}
   323→        onTouchEnd={(e) => {

   325→        }}
   326→        onLoadStart={(e) => {
   327→          onLoadStart?.(e);
   328→        }}
   329→        onLoadedData={(e) => {
   330→          onLoadedData?.(e);
   331→        }}
   332→        onCanPlay={() => {

   348→          });
   349→          onVideoError?.(e);
   350→        }}
   351→      >

   353→      </video>

   355→      <HoverScrubVideoOverlays
   356→        posterOnlyUntilClick={posterOnlyUntilClick}
   357→        isActivated={isActivated}
   358→        onActivate={() => setIsActivated(true)}

   368→        playbackRate={playbackRate}

     2→import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';

     7→import { isTaskDbRow, mapTaskDbRowToTask } from '@/shared/lib/taskRowMapper';
     8→import {
     9→  getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations,
    10→  toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    11→  type GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    12→  type GenerationTaskMappingStatus,
    13→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    14→
    15→interface PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions {
    16→  batchSize?: number;
    17→  delayBetweenBatches?: number;
    18→  preloadFullTaskData?: boolean;
    19→  projectId?: string;
    20→}
    21→
    22→export interface GenerationWithTaskData extends GenerationRow {
    23→  taskId?: string | null;
    24→  taskData?: Task | null;
    25→  taskMappingStatus?: GenerationTaskMappingStatus;
    26→  taskMappingError?: string;
    27→}
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    31→ */
    32→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    33→  generationIds: string[],
    34→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    35→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    36→) {
    37→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    38→  const {
    39→    batchSize = 5,
    40→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    41→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    42→    projectId,
    43→  } = options;
    44→
    45→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    46→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    47→
    48→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId });
    49→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    50→
    51→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    52→
    53→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    54→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    55→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    56→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    57→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    58→        cacheEntry,
    59→      );
    60→
    61→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    62→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    63→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    64→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    65→          showToast: false,
    66→        });
    67→      }
    68→
    69→      if (preloadFullTaskData && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    70→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    71→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId),
    72→          queryFn: async () => {
    73→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    74→              .from('tasks')
    75→              .select('*')
    76→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    77→              .single();
    78→
    79→            if (error) throw error;
    80→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    81→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    82→            }
    83→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    84→          },
    85→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    86→        }));
    87→      }
    88→    });
    89→
    90→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
    91→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
    92→    }
    93→
    94→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
    95→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
    96→    }
    97→  }
    98→}
    99→
   100→/**
   101→ * Enhance generations with task data from cache.
   102→ */
   103→export function enhanceGenerationsWithTaskData(
   104→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   105→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   106→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   107→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   108→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   109→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   110→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   111→    );
   112→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   113→    const taskData = taskId ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId)) : null;
   114→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   115→
   116→    return {
   117→      ...generation,
   118→      taskId,
   119→      taskData,
   120→      taskMappingStatus,
   121→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   122→    };
   123→  });
   124→}

   262→export async function getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(
   263→  generationIds: string[],
   264→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   265→): Promise<Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>> {
   266→  if (generationIds.length === 0) {
   267→    return new Map();
   268→  }
   269→
   270→  const requestedIds = Array.from(new Set(generationIds));
   271→  const supabaseResult = (options?.supabaseRegistry ?? supabaseClientRegistry).getClientResult();
   272→  if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
   273→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   274→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   275→      failures.set(generationId, {
   276→        generationId,
   277→        taskId: null,
   278→        status: 'query_failed',
   279→        queryError: supabaseResult.error.message,
   280→      });
   281→    });
   282→    return failures;

   286→  const query = supabase
   287→    .from('generations')
   288→    .select('id, tasks, project_id')
   289→    .in('id', requestedIds);

   291→  const { data, error } = await query;
   292→
   293→  if (error) {
   294→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   295→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   296→      failures.set(generationId, {
   297→        generationId,
   298→        taskId: null,
   299→        status: 'query_failed',
   300→        queryError: error.message,
   301→      });
   302→    });
   303→    return failures;
   304→  }
   305→
   306→  const rowsById = new Map((data || []).map((row) => [row.id, row]));
   307→
   308→  const mappings = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   309→  for (const generationId of requestedIds) {
   310→    const row = rowsById.get(generationId);
   311→
   312→    if (!row) {
   313→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   314→        generationId,
   315→        taskId: null,
   316→        status: 'missing_generation',
   317→      });
   318→      continue;
   319→    }
   320→
   321→    if (options?.projectId && row.project_id !== options.projectId) {
   322→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   323→        generationId,
   324→        taskId: null,
   325→        status: 'scope_mismatch',
   326→      });
   327→      continue;
   328→    }
   329→
   330→    const parsed = parseGenerationTaskId(row.tasks);
   331→    mappings.set(generationId, {
   332→      generationId,
   333→      taskId: parsed.taskId,
   334→      status: parsed.status,
   335→    });
   336→  }
   337→
   338→  return mappings;
   339→}

   348→  };

    48→
    49→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    50→  return {
    51→    derivedCounts: {},
    52→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    53→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},

    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    59→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    60→ *
    61→ * Queries both:
    62→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    63→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    64→ *
    65→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    66→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    67→ */
    68→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    69→  generationIds: string[]
    70→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    71→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    72→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    73→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    77→
    78→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    79→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    80→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    81→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    82→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    83→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    84→
    85→  if (variantCountsError) {
    86→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    87→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    88→      cause: variantCountsError,
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (variantCountsData) {
    93→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    94→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    95→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;

    97→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    98→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;

   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };

   280→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {

   282→    contentType = 'image/png';
   283→  }

   285→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison

   287→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   288→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);

   294→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   295→    urlIdentity,
   296→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   297→    prompt,
   298→    metadata: {
   299→      ...(item.params || {}),
   300→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   301→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   302→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   303→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   304→    },
   305→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   306→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   307→    isVideo,
   308→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   309→    starred: item.starred || false,
   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   311→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   312→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    name: item.name || (item.params?.name as string | undefined) || undefined,
   314→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   315→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   316→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip

   320→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,

   327→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {

   330→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   331→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   332→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   333→    };
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   337→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   338→    // Single shot optimization
   339→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   340→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   341→      return {

   346→      };
   347→    }
   348→

   350→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   351→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   352→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   353→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   354→    }));
   355→    
   356→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   357→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   358→    if (options.shotId) {
   359→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);

   361→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   362→      }
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    return {
   366→      ...baseItem,
   367→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   368→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),

   370→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   371→    };
   372→  }
   373→  
   374→  return baseItem;
   375→}

   377→/**
   378→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   379→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   380→ */
   381→export function transformForTimeline(
   382→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   383→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   384→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   385→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   386→  
   387→  if (!genData) {
   388→    return {
   389→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   390→      id: shotGen.id,
   391→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   392→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   393→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   394→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   395→    };
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return {
   399→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   400→    id: shotGen.id,
   401→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   402→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   403→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   404→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   405→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   408→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}

   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}

    27→/**

    29→ * Keeps queue observability structure consistent across timeline hooks.
    30→ */
    31→export function createTimelineWriteQueueLogger(options: TimelineWriteLoggerOptions): TimelineWriteEventHandler {
    32→  const log = options.log ?? console.log;
    33→  return (phase, meta) => {
    34→    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    35→      shotId: shortTimelineId(meta.shotId),
    36→      requestId: meta.requestId,
    37→      operation: meta.operation,
    38→      waitMs: meta.waitMs,
    39→      queueDepth: meta.queueDepth,
    40→      blockedByOperation: meta.blockedByOperation ?? null,
    41→      blockedByDurationMs: meta.blockedByDurationMs ?? null,
    42→    };
    43→
    44→    if (phase !== 'start') {
    45→      payload.durationMs = meta.durationMs;
    46→    }
    47→
    48→    log(`${options.logPrefix} write queue ${phase}`, payload);
    49→  };
    50→}
    51→
    52→const DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
    53→const TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE = 'TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT';
    54→
    55→interface TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions {
    56→  timeoutMs?: number;
    57→  onTimeout?: (meta: { operation: string; timeoutMs: number; pendingMs: number }) => void;
    58→}
    59→
    60→class TimelineWriteTimeoutError extends Error {
    61→  readonly code = TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE;
    62→
    63→  constructor(operation: string, timeoutMs: number, cause?: unknown) {
    64→    super(`Timeline write "${operation}" timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
    65→    this.name = 'TimelineWriteTimeoutError';
    66→    if (cause !== undefined) {
    67→      (this as { cause?: unknown }).cause = cause;
    68→    }
    69→  }
    70→}
    71→
    72→export function isTimelineWriteTimeoutError(error: unknown): error is TimelineWriteTimeoutError {
    73→  return (
    74→    error instanceof TimelineWriteTimeoutError
    75→    || (
    76→      typeof error === 'object'
    77→      && error !== null
    78→      && 'code' in error
    79→      && (error as { code?: unknown }).code === TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE
    80→    )
    81→  );
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Guard a write request with an abortable timeout so stalled network calls
    86→ * cannot block the serialized per-shot queue forever.
    87→ */
    88→export async function runTimelineWriteWithTimeout<T>(
    89→  operation: string,
    90→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
    91→  options?: TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions,
    92→): Promise<T> {
    93→  const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    94→  const startedAt = Date.now();
    95→  const controller = new AbortController();
    96→  let timedOut = false;
    97→
    98→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
    99→    timedOut = true;
   100→    options?.onTimeout?.({
   101→      operation,
   102→      timeoutMs,
   103→      pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   104→    });
   105→    controller.abort();
   106→  }, timeoutMs);
   107→
   108→  try {
   109→    return await task(controller.signal);
   110→  } catch (error) {
   111→    if (timedOut || (controller.signal.aborted && isAbortError(error))) {
   112→      throw new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs, error);
   113→    }
   114→    throw error;
   115→  } finally {
   116→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   117→  }
   118→}
   119→
   120→const shotWriteTail = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
   121→const shotWriteDepth = new Map<string, number>();
   122→const shotWriteActive = new Map<string, { requestId: number; operation: string; startedAt: number }>();
   123→let writeRequestCounter = 0;
   124→const DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
   125→
   126→interface TimelineSerializedWriteOptions {
   127→  timeoutMs?: number;
   128→  onTimeout?: (meta: {
   129→    shotId: string;
   130→    operation: string;
   131→    timeoutMs: number;
   132→    pendingMs: number;
   133→    requestId: number;
   134→  }) => void;
   135→}
   136→
   137→function runSerializedTaskWithTimeout<T>(
   138→  operation: string,
   139→  task: () => Promise<T>,
   140→  timeoutMs: number,
   141→  onTimeout: () => void,
   142→): Promise<T> {
   143→  if (timeoutMs <= 0) {
   144→    return task();
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
   148→    let settled = false;
   149→    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
   150→      if (settled) {
   151→        return;
   152→      }
   153→      settled = true;
   154→      onTimeout();
   155→      reject(new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs));
   156→    }, timeoutMs);
   157→
   158→    Promise.resolve()
   159→      .then(task)
   160→      .then(
   161→        (result) => {
   162→          if (settled) {
   163→            return;
   164→          }
   165→          settled = true;
   166→          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   167→          resolve(result);
   168→        },
   169→        (error) => {
   170→          if (settled) {
   171→            return;
   172→          }
   173→          settled = true;
   174→          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   175→          reject(error);
   176→        },
   177→      );
   178→  });
   179→}
   180→
   181→/**
   182→ * Returns true if any serialized timeline write is active or queued for the
   183→ * given shot. Both the timeline drag path and the batch editor path go through
   184→ * runSerializedTimelineWrite, so this covers all writes across both paths.
   185→ * Used by useTimelinePositions.syncFromDatabase to suppress stale syncs while
   186→ * the batch editor is writing (the batch editor does not set isLockedRef, so
   187→ * without this check a background refetch during the midpoint RPC would snap
   188→ * positions back to pre-edit values).
   189→ */
   190→export function isTimelineWriteActive(shotId: string): boolean {
   191→  return (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) > 0;
   192→}
   193→
   194→/**
   195→ * Serialize timeline writes per shot to avoid overlapping updates from
   196→ * different UI flows (batch reorder, timeline drag, etc.).
   197→ */
   198→export async function runSerializedTimelineWrite<T>(
   199→  shotId: string,
   200→  operation: string,
   201→  task: () => Promise<T>,
   202→  onEvent?: TimelineWriteEventHandler,
   203→  options?: TimelineSerializedWriteOptions,
   204→): Promise<T> {
   205→  const requestId = ++writeRequestCounter;
   206→  const queuedAt = Date.now();
   207→  const previousTail = shotWriteTail.get(shotId) ?? Promise.resolve();
   208→  const nextDepth = (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) + 1;
   209→  shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, nextDepth);
   210→  const blockedBy = shotWriteActive.get(shotId);
   211→  const blockedByDurationMs = blockedBy ? Math.max(0, queuedAt - blockedBy.startedAt) : null;
   212→
   213→  onEvent?.('queued', {
   214→    shotId,
   215→    operation,
   216→    waitMs: 0,
   217→    durationMs: 0,
   218→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, nextDepth - 1),
   219→    requestId,
   220→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   221→    blockedByDurationMs,
   222→  });
   223→
   224→  let releaseTail!: () => void;
   225→  const currentTail = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   226→    releaseTail = resolve;
   227→  });
   228→
   229→  const chainedTail = previousTail.catch(() => undefined).then(() => currentTail);
   230→  shotWriteTail.set(shotId, chainedTail);
   231→
   232→  await previousTail.catch(() => undefined);
   233→
   234→  const startedAt = Date.now();
   235→  shotWriteActive.set(shotId, {
   236→    requestId,
   237→    operation,
   238→    startedAt,
   239→  });
   240→  onEvent?.('start', {
   241→    shotId,
   242→    operation,
   243→    waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   244→    durationMs: 0,
   245→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1),
   246→    requestId,
   247→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   248→    blockedByDurationMs,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  try {
   252→    const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS;
   253→    return await runSerializedTaskWithTimeout(
   254→      operation,
   255→      task,
   256→      timeoutMs,
   257→      () => {
   258→        options?.onTimeout?.({
   259→          shotId,
   260→          operation,
   261→          timeoutMs,
   262→          pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   263→          requestId,
   264→        });
   265→      },
   266→    );
   267→  } finally {
   268→    releaseTail();
   269→
   270→    const remainingDepth = Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1);
   271→    if (remainingDepth === 0) {
   272→      shotWriteDepth.delete(shotId);
   273→    } else {
   274→      shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, remainingDepth);
   275→    }
   276→
   277→    if (shotWriteTail.get(shotId) === chainedTail) {
   278→      shotWriteTail.delete(shotId);
   279→    }
   280→    if (shotWriteActive.get(shotId)?.requestId === requestId) {
   281→      shotWriteActive.delete(shotId);
   282→    }
   283→
   284→    onEvent?.('end', {
   285→      shotId,
   286→      operation,
   287→      waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   288→      durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   289→      queueDepth: Math.max(0, remainingDepth - 1),
   290→      requestId,
   291→      blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   292→      blockedByDurationMs,
   293→    });
   294→  }
   295→}
   296→

   376→  }
   377→  if (ctx.shotId && shotResult.error) {
   378→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   379→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   380→      `Failed to load shot settings: ${describeScopeError(shotResult.error)}`,
   381→      { recoverable: true, cause: shotResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'shot', shotId: ctx.shotId } },
   382→    );
   383→  }
   384→
   385→  const userSettingsData = userResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   386→  const projectSettingsData = projectResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   387→  const shotSettingsData = shotResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   388→  const userSettings = (userSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   389→  const projectSettings = (projectSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   390→  const shotSettings = (shotSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   391→  const defaultSettings = (toolDefaultsRegistry[toolId] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) ?? {};
   392→
   393→  const hasShotSettings = shotSettings && Object.keys(shotSettings).length > 0;
   394→
   395→  // Merge in priority order: defaults -> user -> project -> shot
   396→  const merged = deepMerge(
   397→    {},
   398→    defaultSettings,
   399→    userSettings,
   400→    projectSettings,
   401→    shotSettings
   402→  );
   403→
   404→  return { settings: merged, hasShotSettings };
   405→}
   406→
   407→// ============================================================================
   408→// Settings fetch
   409→// ============================================================================
   410→
   411→/**
   412→ * Fetch and merge tool settings from all scopes using direct Supabase calls.
   413→ *
   414→ * Pipeline: dedup → auth → fetchAllScopes → extractAndMerge.
   415→ * Uses single-flight deduplication for concurrent identical requests.
   416→ *
   417→ * @returns `{ settings, hasShotSettings }` wrapper
   418→ */
   419→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabase(
   420→  toolId: string,
   421→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   422→  signal?: AbortSignal
   423→): Promise<OperationResult<SettingsFetchResult>> {
   424→  try {
   425→    reportUnknownSettingsId(toolId);
   426→
   427→    // Check if request was cancelled before starting
   428→    if (signal?.aborted) {
   429→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   430→        recoverable: true,
   431→      }));
   432→    }
   433→
   434→    // Single-flight dedupe key for concurrent identical requests
   435→    const singleFlightKey = JSON.stringify({ toolId, projectId: ctx.projectId ?? null, shotId: ctx.shotId ?? null });
   436→    const existingPromise = inflightSettingsFetches.get(singleFlightKey);
   437→    if (existingPromise) {
   438→      const value = await raceWithAbort(existingPromise as Promise<SettingsFetchResult>, signal);
   439→      return operationSuccess(value);
   440→    }
   441→
   442→    const promise = (async (): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   443→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   444→
   445→      const { data: { user } } = await getUserWithTimeout();
   446→
   447→      if (!user) {
   448→        throw new ToolSettingsError('auth_required', 'Authentication required');
   449→      }
   450→
   451→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   452→
   453→      const supabaseClient = getSupabaseClient();
   454→      const [userResult, projectResult, shotResult] = await fetchAllScopes(supabaseClient, user.id, ctx, signal);
   455→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   456→      return extractAndMergeSettings(userResult, projectResult, shotResult, toolId, ctx);
   457→    })();
   458→
   459→    inflightSettingsFetches.set(singleFlightKey, promise);
   460→    // The .finally cleanup promise is intentionally not awaited or returned.
   461→    // Suppress its rejection to avoid unhandled rejection warnings — the original
   462→    // `promise` reference (returned below) handles propagation to the caller.
   463→    promise.finally(() => {
   464→      inflightSettingsFetches.delete(singleFlightKey);
   465→    }).catch(() => {});
   466→    const value = await raceWithAbort(promise, signal);
   467→    return operationSuccess(value);
   468→
   469→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   470→    if (isToolSettingsError(error) && error.code === 'cancelled') {
   471→      return toOperationFailure(error);
   472→    }
   473→    if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   474→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   475→        recoverable: true,
   476→        cause: error,
   477→      }));
   478→    }
   479→    // Build context info without calling getSession() — can block during token refresh
   480→    const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
   481→    const contextInfo = {
   482→      visibilityState: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.visibilityState : 'unknown',
   483→      hidden: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.hidden : false,
   484→      online: typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true,
   485→    };
   486→
   487→    if (errorMsg.includes('Auth timeout') || errorMsg.includes('Auth request was cancelled')) {
   488→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   489→        context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.authTimeout',
   490→        showToast: false,
   491→        logData: contextInfo,
   492→      });
   493→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   494→        'network',
   495→        'Authentication check timed out. Please retry.',
   496→        {
   497→          recoverable: true,
   498→          cause: error,
   499→          metadata: { ...contextInfo, reason: 'auth_timeout' },
   500→        },
   501→      ));
   502→    }
   503→
   504→    if (errorMsg.includes('Failed to fetch')) {
   505→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.network', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   506→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   507→        'network',
   508→        'Network connection issue. Please check your internet connection.',
   509→        {
   510→          recoverable: true,
   511→          cause: error,
   512→          metadata: contextInfo,
   513→        },
   514→      ));
   515→    }
   516→
   517→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   518→    return toOperationFailure(classifyToolSettingsError(error));
   519→  }
   520→}
   521→
   522→/**
   523→ * Fetch tool settings and throw `ToolSettingsError` on failure.
   524→ *
   525→ * Use this from hook boundaries that already model errors as thrown exceptions
   526→ * (for example React Query query functions and mutation pipelines) so read/write
   527→ * settings flows share the same error contract.
   528→ */
   529→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(
   530→  toolId: string,
   531→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   532→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   533→): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> {
   534→  const result = await fetchToolSettingsSupabase(toolId, ctx, signal);
   535→  if (!result.ok) {
   536→    throw toToolSettingsErrorFromOperationFailure(result);
   537→  }
   538→  return result.value;
   539→}
   540→

1→/**
     2→ * Clip initialization and pending-clip consumption for the Join Clips tool.
     3→ *
     4→ * Extracted from clipManagerService to isolate:
     5→ * - localStorage cache helpers (skeleton sizing)
     6→ * - Poster preloading
     7→ * - Video duration extraction from URLs
     8→ * - Pending join clips (lightbox "Add to Join" localStorage polling)

    10→ * - Padding clips with empty slots

    12→
    13→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    14→import {

    16→  isPendingJoinClipInScope,

    29→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    30→// Empty clip factory (canonical location — re-exported by clipManagerService)

    36→
    37→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    38→// localStorage cache helpers (skeleton sizing)
    39→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    40→
    41→function getLocalStorageKey(projectId: string): string {
    42→  return `join-clips-count-${projectId}`;
    43→}
    44→
    45→const MAX_CACHED_CLIPS_COUNT = 500;
    46→
    47→export function getCachedClipsCount(projectId: string | null): number {
    48→  if (!projectId) return 0;
    49→  try {
    50→    const cached = localStorage.getItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId));
    51→    if (!cached) return 0;
    52→
    53→    const parsed = Number.parseInt(cached, 10);
    54→    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed < 0 || parsed > MAX_CACHED_CLIPS_COUNT) {
    55→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Invalid join-clips cached count'), {
    56→        context: 'JoinClipsCache.read.invalid',
    57→        showToast: false,
    58→        logData: { projectId, cached },
    59→      });
    60→      return 0;
    61→    }
    62→    return parsed;
    63→  } catch (error) {
    64→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    65→      context: 'JoinClipsCache.read.error',
    66→      showToast: false,
    67→      logData: { projectId },
    68→    });
    69→    return 0;
    70→  }
    71→}
    72→
    73→export function setCachedClipsCount(projectId: string | null, count: number): void {
    74→  if (!projectId) return;
    75→  try {
    76→    const normalizedCount = Number.isFinite(count) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(count)) : 0;
    77→    if (normalizedCount > 0) {
    78→      localStorage.setItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId), normalizedCount.toString());
    79→    } else {
    80→      localStorage.removeItem(getLocalStorageKey(projectId));
    81→    }
    82→  } catch (error) {
    83→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    84→      context: 'JoinClipsCache.write.error',
    85→      showToast: false,
    86→      logData: { projectId, count },
    87→    });
    88→  }
    89→}

    91→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    92→// Poster preloading
    93→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    94→
    95→/**
    96→ * Warm the browser image cache for the given poster URLs.
    97→ * Returns a promise that resolves when all images have loaded (or errored).
    98→ */
    99→export function preloadPosterImages(
   100→  posterUrls: string[],
   101→  alreadyPreloaded: Set<string>,
   102→): Promise<void[]> {
   103→  const promises = posterUrls
   104→    .filter(url => url && !alreadyPreloaded.has(url))
   105→    .map(
   106→      url =>
   107→        new Promise<void>(resolve => {
   108→          const img = new Image();
   109→          img.onload = () => {
   110→            alreadyPreloaded.add(url);
   111→            resolve();
   112→          };
   113→          img.onerror = () => resolve();
   114→          img.src = url;
   115→        }),
   116→    );
   117→  return Promise.all(promises);
   118→}
   119→
   120→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   121→// Video duration extraction
   122→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   123→
   124→/** Create a throwaway <video> to read duration from a URL. */
   125→function getVideoDurationFromUrl(videoUrl: string): Promise<number> {
   126→  return new Promise<number>(resolve => {
   127→    const videoElement = document.createElement('video');
   128→    videoElement.preload = 'metadata';
   129→    videoElement.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(videoElement.duration);
   130→    videoElement.onerror = () => resolve(0);
   131→    videoElement.src = videoUrl;
   132→  });
   133→}

   136→// Pending join clips (lightbox "Add to Join" localStorage polling)
   137→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   138→
   139→const PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
   140→
   141→interface PendingJoinClipParseResult {
   142→  entries: PendingJoinClipEntry[];
   143→  invalidCount: number;
   144→}
   145→
   146→function parsePendingJoinClips(raw: string): PendingJoinClipParseResult | null {
   147→  let parsed: unknown;
   148→  try {
   149→    parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
   150→  } catch {
   151→    return null;
   152→  }
   153→
   154→  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
   155→    return null;
   156→  }
   157→
   158→  const entries: PendingJoinClipEntry[] = [];
   159→  let invalidCount = 0;
   160→  for (const value of parsed) {
   161→    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
   162→      invalidCount += 1;
   163→      continue;
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    const candidate = value as Record<string, unknown>;
   167→    if (
   168→      typeof candidate.videoUrl !== 'string'
   169→      || typeof candidate.generationId !== 'string'
   170→      || typeof candidate.timestamp !== 'number'
   171→      || !Number.isFinite(candidate.timestamp)
   172→    ) {
   173→      invalidCount += 1;
   174→      continue;
   175→    }
   176→
   177→    entries.push({
   178→      videoUrl: candidate.videoUrl,
   179→      generationId: candidate.generationId,
   180→      timestamp: candidate.timestamp,
   181→      ...(typeof candidate.thumbnailUrl === 'string' && candidate.thumbnailUrl.length > 0
   182→        ? { thumbnailUrl: candidate.thumbnailUrl }
   183→        : {}),
   184→      ...(typeof candidate.projectId === 'string' && candidate.projectId.length > 0
   185→        ? { projectId: candidate.projectId }
   186→        : {}),
   187→      ...(typeof candidate.userId === 'string' && candidate.userId.length > 0
   188→        ? { userId: candidate.userId }
   189→        : {}),
   190→    });
   191→  }
   192→
   193→  return { entries, invalidCount };
   194→}
   195→
   196→/**
   197→ * Reads and consumes pending join clips from localStorage.
   198→ * Returns deferred actions that are applied to clip state later.
   199→ * Placement is intentionally not resolved here because only the consumer has
   200→ * the previous clip array needed to choose fill-vs-append.
   201→ */
   202→export type PendingClipAction = {
   203→  type: 'deferred_insert';
   204→  clip: VideoClip;
   205→};
   206→
   207→interface ConsumePendingJoinClipsOptions {
   208→  projectId?: string | null;
   209→  readVideoDuration?: (videoUrl: string) => Promise<number>;
   210→}
   211→
   212→export async function consumePendingJoinClips(
   213→  options: ConsumePendingJoinClipsOptions = {},
   214→): Promise<OperationResult<PendingClipAction[]>> {
   215→  const projectId = options.projectId ?? null;
   216→  const readVideoDuration = options.readVideoDuration ?? getVideoDurationFromUrl;
   217→
   218→  try {
   219→    const userId = readUserIdFromStorage();
   220→    const pendingKeys = getPendingJoinClipsCandidateKeys({ projectId, userId });
   221→    const pendingSource = pendingKeys
   222→      .map((key) => ({ key, raw: localStorage.getItem(key) }))
   223→      .find((item) => typeof item.raw === 'string' && item.raw.length > 0);
   224→
   225→    if (!pendingSource || !pendingSource.raw) {
   226→      return operationSuccess([]);
   227→    }
   228→
   229→    const parsedPendingClips = parsePendingJoinClips(pendingSource.raw);
   230→    if (!parsedPendingClips) {
   231→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   232→        context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsInvalid',
   233→        showToast: false,
   234→        logData: { [REDACTED] },
   235→      });
   236→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   237→      return operationFailure(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   238→        policy: 'degrade',
   239→        errorCode: 'pending_join_clips_invalid_payload',
   240→        message: 'Invalid pending join clips payload',
   241→        recoverable: true,
   242→        cause: { [REDACTED] },
   243→      });
   244→    }
   245→
   246→    if (parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0) {
   247→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Dropped invalid pending join clip entries'), {
   248→        context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsPartialRecovery',
   249→        showToast: false,
   250→        logData: {
   251→          [REDACTED],
   252→          totalEntries: parsedPendingClips.entries.length + parsedPendingClips.invalidCount,
   253→          invalidEntries: parsedPendingClips.invalidCount,
   254→        },
   255→      });
   256→    }
   257→
   258→    const now = Date.now();
   259→    const recentClips = parsedPendingClips.entries.filter(
   260→      clip => now - clip.timestamp < PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS,
   261→    );
   262→    const scopedRecentClips = recentClips.filter((clip) =>
   263→      isPendingJoinClipInScope(clip, { projectId, userId }),
   264→    );
   265→
   266→    if (scopedRecentClips.length === 0) {
   267→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   268→      return operationSuccess([], {
   269→        ...(parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0 ? { policy: 'degrade' } : {}),
   270→      });
   271→    }
   272→
   273→    const actions: PendingClipAction[] = [];
   274→
   275→    for (const { videoUrl, thumbnailUrl, generationId } of scopedRecentClips) {
   276→      if (!videoUrl) continue;
   277→
   278→      const durationSeconds = await readVideoDuration(videoUrl);
   279→
   280→      const clip: VideoClip = {
   281→        id: generateUUID(),
   282→        url: videoUrl,
   283→        posterUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   284→        durationSeconds,
   285→        loaded: false,
   286→        playing: false,
   287→        generationId,
   288→      };
   289→
   290→      actions.push({ type: 'deferred_insert', clip });
   291→    }
   292→
   293→    localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   294→    return operationSuccess(actions, {
   295→      ...(parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0 ? { policy: 'degrade' } : {}),
   296→    });
   297→  } catch (error) {
   298→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'JoinClipsPage', showToast: false });
   299→    return operationFailure(error, {
   300→      policy: 'degrade',
   301→      errorCode: 'pending_join_clips_read_failed',
   302→      message: 'Failed to consume pending join clips',
   303→      recoverable: true,
   304→      cause: error,
   305→    });
   306→  }
   307→}
   308→
   309→/**
   310→ * Apply pending clip actions to an existing clips array.
   311→ * Resolves each deferred action by filling the first available empty slot,
   312→ * or appending when no empty slots remain.
   313→ */
   314→export function applyPendingClipActions(
   315→  prevClips: VideoClip[],
   316→  actions: PendingClipAction[],
   317→): VideoClip[] {
   318→  let clips = [...prevClips];
   319→  // Track which indices have been filled by previous actions in this batch
   320→  const filledIndices = new Set<number>();
   321→
   322→  for (const action of actions) {
   323→    const emptyIndex = clips.findIndex(
   324→      (clip, idx) => !clip.url && !filledIndices.has(idx),
   325→    );
   326→
   327→    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
   328→      clips = clips.map((clip, idx) =>
   329→        idx === emptyIndex
   330→          ? {
   331→              ...clip,
   332→              url: action.clip.url,
   333→              posterUrl: action.clip.posterUrl,
   334→              durationSeconds: action.clip.durationSeconds,
   335→              loaded: false,
   336→              playing: false,
   337→              generationId: action.clip.generationId,
   338→            }
   339→          : clip,
   340→      );
   341→      filledIndices.add(emptyIndex);
   342→    } else {
   343→      clips = [...clips, action.clip];
   344→    }
   345→  }
   346→
   347→  return clips;
   348→}
   349→
   350→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   351→// Build initial clips from persisted settings
   352→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   353→
   354→interface InitialClipsResult {
   355→  clips: VideoClip[];
   356→  transitionPrompts: TransitionPrompt[];
   357→  posterUrlsToPreload: string[];
   358→}
   359→
   360→export function buildInitialClipsFromSettings(
   361→  settings: JoinClipsSettings,
   362→): InitialClipsResult {
   363→  const initialClips: VideoClip[] = [];
   364→  const posterUrlsToPreload: string[] = [];
   365→  let transitionPrompts: TransitionPrompt[] = [];
   366→
   367→  // Try loading from new multi-clip format
   368→  if (settings.clips && settings.clips.length > 0) {
   369→    settings.clips.forEach(clip => {
   370→      if (clip.url) {
   371→        initialClips.push({
   372→          id: generateUUID(),
   373→          url: clip.url,
   374→          posterUrl: clip.posterUrl,
   375→          finalFrameUrl: clip.finalFrameUrl,
   376→          durationSeconds: clip.durationSeconds,
   377→          loaded: false,
   378→          playing: false,
   379→        });
   380→        if (clip.posterUrl) posterUrlsToPreload.push(clip.posterUrl);
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→
   384→    // Load transition prompts
   385→    if (settings.transitionPrompts && settings.transitionPrompts.length > 0) {
   386→      transitionPrompts = settings.transitionPrompts
   387→        .map(tp => ({
   388→          id: initialClips[tp.clipIndex]?.id || '',
   389→          prompt: tp.prompt,
   390→        }))
   391→        .filter(p => p.id);
   392→    }
   393→  }
   394→  // Fallback to legacy two-video format
   395→  else if (settings.startingVideoUrl || settings.endingVideoUrl) {
   396→    if (settings.startingVideoUrl) {
   397→      initialClips.push({
   398→        id: generateUUID(),
   399→        url: settings.startingVideoUrl,
   400→        posterUrl: settings.startingVideoPosterUrl,
   401→        loaded: false,
   402→        playing: false,
   403→      });
   404→      if (settings.startingVideoPosterUrl) {
   405→        posterUrlsToPreload.push(settings.startingVideoPosterUrl);
   406→      }
   407→    }
   408→
   409→    if (settings.endingVideoUrl) {
   410→      initialClips.push({
   411→        id: generateUUID(),
   412→        url: settings.endingVideoUrl,
   413→        posterUrl: settings.endingVideoPosterUrl,
   414→        loaded: false,
   415→        playing: false,
   416→      });
   417→      if (settings.endingVideoPosterUrl) {
   418→        posterUrlsToPreload.push(settings.endingVideoPosterUrl);
   419→      }
   420→    }
   421→
   422→    // Initialize transition prompts from legacy format
   423→    // The `prompt` field existed in an older settings schema and may still
   424→    // be present in persisted data even though it's not in the current type.
   425→    const legacyPrompt = (settings as JoinClipsSettings & { prompt?: string }).prompt;
   426→    if (initialClips.length >= 2 && legacyPrompt) {
   427→      transitionPrompts = [
   428→        {
   429→          id: initialClips[1].id,
   430→          prompt: legacyPrompt,
   431→        },
   432→      ];
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→
   436→  return { clips: initialClips, transitionPrompts, posterUrlsToPreload };
   437→}
   438→
   439→/**
   440→ * Pad initialClips to have at least 2 slots plus one trailing empty slot.
   441→ * This matches the original hook behavior exactly.
   442→ */
   443→export function padClipsWithEmptySlots(initialClips: VideoClip[]): VideoClip[] {
   444→  if (initialClips.length === 0) {
   445→    return [createEmptyClip(), createEmptyClip()];
   446→  }
   447→
   448→  if (initialClips.length < 2) {
   449→    const clipsToAdd = 2 - initialClips.length;
   450→    const emptyClips = Array.from({ length: clipsToAdd }, () => createEmptyClip());
   451→    return [...initialClips, ...emptyClips];
   452→  }
   453→
   454→  // >= 2 clips: add one trailing empty slot
   455→  return [...initialClips, createEmptyClip()];
   456→}
   457→

    50→/**

    54→export function useRepositionVariantSave({

    56→  selectedProjectId,

    58→  toolTypeOverride,

    98→      const outputCtx = outputCanvas.getContext('2d');

   123→        thumbHeight = Math.round(thumbWidth / aspectRatio);

   134→      if (thumbCtx) {

   138→      // Convert thumbnail to blob

   189→        if (genError) {

1→/**
     2→ * Image Preloader
     3→ *
     4→ * Core preloading logic - takes images and loads them via the queue.
     5→ * Marks images as loaded when they complete.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import type { PreloadableImage, PreloadConfig } from './types';
     9→import { PreloadQueue } from './queue';
    10→import { setImageLoadStatus, hasLoadedImage, markImageLoaded } from './tracker';
    11→import { getDisplayUrl } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    12→import { isPreloadableMediaUrl } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaTypeHelpers';
    13→
    14→function hasImageId(image: PreloadableImage): image is PreloadableImage & { id: string } {
    15→  return typeof image.id === 'string' && image.id.length > 0;
    16→}
    17→
    18→/**
    19→ * Preload a batch of images using the provided queue.
    20→ * Marks images as loaded in the tracker when they complete.
    21→ *
    22→ * @param images - Images to preload
    23→ * @param queue - The preload queue to use
    24→ * @param config - Preload configuration
    25→ * @param priority - Base priority for these images (higher = load first)
    26→ */
    27→export async function preloadImages(
    28→  images: PreloadableImage[],
    29→  queue: PreloadQueue,
    30→  config: PreloadConfig,
    31→  priority = 0
    32→): Promise<void> {
    33→  // Limit to max images per page
    34→  const limitedImages = images.slice(0, config.maxImagesPerPage);
    35→
    36→  // Filter out already-loaded images
    37→  const toPreload = limitedImages.filter((img) => !hasImageId(img) || !hasLoadedImage(img));
    38→
    39→  if (toPreload.length === 0) {
    40→    return;
    41→  }
    42→
    43→  // Create promises for each image
    44→  const promises = toPreload.map(async (img, idx) => {
    45→    const url = getImageUrl(img, config.preloadThumbnailsOnly);
    46→
    47→    if (!url) {
    48→      return;
    49→    }
    50→
    51→    // Skip known non-preloadable media URLs (e.g., join-clips placeholder outputs).
    52→    if (!isPreloadableMediaUrl(url)) {
    53→      return;
    54→    }
    55→
    56→    try {
    57→      // Slightly decrease priority for later images in the batch
    58→      const element = await queue.add(url, priority - idx);
    59→
    60→      // Track by ID if available
    61→      if (hasImageId(img)) {
    62→        setImageLoadStatus(img, true);
    63→      }
    64→
    65→      // Track by URL with element ref (for browser cache persistence)
    66→      markImageLoaded(url, { element });
    67→    } catch {
    68→      // Preloading is best-effort - don't throw on failure
    69→    }
    70→  });
    71→
    72→  // Wait for all to settle (don't fail if some images fail)
    73→  await Promise.allSettled(promises);
    74→}
    75→
    76→/**

1→/**
     2→ * Centralized task configuration system
     3→ * 
     4→ * This module provides synchronous access to task type configuration.
     5→ * Configuration is loaded from the database (task_types table) and cached globally.
     6→ * Hardcoded fallbacks exist for backwards compatibility and offline scenarios.
     7→ */
     8→
     9→import { getTaskTypeConfigCache, isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized, type TaskTypeInfo } from '@/shared/lib/taskTypeCache';
    10→import {
    11→  getTaskTypeConfigFallback,
    12→  getTaskTypeFallbackEntries,
    13→} from '@/shared/lib/taskTypeConfigFallback';
    14→
    15→interface TaskTypeConfig {
    16→  /** Whether this task type should be visible in the UI */
    17→  isVisible: boolean;
    18→  /** Display name for the task type (overrides the raw taskType) */
    19→  displayName?: string;
    20→  /** Whether this task type supports progress checking */
    21→  supportsProgress?: boolean;
    22→  /** Whether this task type can be manually cancelled by users */
    23→  canCancel?: boolean;
    24→  /** Category for grouping related task types */
    25→  category?: 'generation' | 'processing' | 'orchestration' | 'utility';
    26→  /** Description for documentation/debugging */
    27→  description?: string;
    28→}
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Convert database TaskTypeInfo to TaskTypeConfig format
    32→ */
    33→function dbConfigToTaskConfig(dbConfig: TaskTypeInfo): TaskTypeConfig {
    34→  return {
    35→    isVisible: dbConfig.is_visible ?? false,
    36→    displayName: dbConfig.display_name,
    37→    supportsProgress: dbConfig.supports_progress ?? false,
    38→    canCancel: true, // Default all tasks to cancellable
    39→    category: dbConfig.category as TaskTypeConfig['category'],
    40→  };
    41→}
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Get configuration for a specific task type
    45→ * Checks the database cache first, falls back to hardcoded defaults
    46→ */
    47→function getTaskConfig(taskType: string): TaskTypeConfig {
    48→  // Check database cache first (populated by useAllTaskTypesConfig hook)
    49→  if (isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized()) {
    50→    const cache = getTaskTypeConfigCache();
    51→    const dbConfig = cache[taskType];
    52→    if (dbConfig) {
    53→      return dbConfigToTaskConfig(dbConfig);
    54→    }
    55→  }
    56→  
    57→  // Fall back to the shared fallback snapshot.
    58→  const fallbackConfig = getTaskTypeConfigFallback(taskType);
    59→  if (fallbackConfig) {
    60→    return fallbackConfig;
    61→  }
    62→  
    63→  // Default for completely unknown task types
    64→  return {
    65→    isVisible: false, // Default to hidden for unknown types
    66→    canCancel: true,
    67→    category: 'utility'
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→/**
    72→ * Check if a task type should be visible in the UI
    73→ */
    74→function isTaskVisible(taskType: string): boolean {
    75→  return getTaskConfig(taskType).isVisible;
    76→}
    77→
    78→/**
    79→ * Get the display name for a task type
    80→ */
    81→export function getTaskDisplayName(taskType: string): string {
    82→  const config = getTaskConfig(taskType);
    83→  return config.displayName || taskType;
    84→}
    85→
    86→/**
    87→ * Check if a task type supports progress checking
    88→ */
    89→export function taskSupportsProgress(taskType: string): boolean {
    90→  return getTaskConfig(taskType).supportsProgress || false;
    91→}
    92→
    93→/**
    94→ * Get task types filtered by visibility
    95→ * Uses database cache if available, falls back to hardcoded list
    96→ */
    97→function getTaskTypesByVisibility(visible: boolean): string[] {
    98→  if (isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized()) {
    99→    const cache = getTaskTypeConfigCache();
   100→    return Object.entries(cache)
   101→      .filter(([_, config]) => visible ? config.is_visible : !config.is_visible)
   102→      .map(([taskType]) => taskType);
   103→  }
   104→
   105→  // Fall back to the versioned fallback snapshot.
   106→  return getTaskTypeFallbackEntries()
   107→    .filter(([_, config]) => visible ? config.isVisible : !config.isVisible)
   108→    .map(([taskType]) => taskType);
   109→}
   110→
   111→/**
   112→ * Get all visible task types
   113→ */
   114→export function getVisibleTaskTypes(): string[] {
   115→  return getTaskTypesByVisibility(true);
   116→}
   117→
   118→/**
   119→ * Get all hidden task types
   120→ */
   121→export function getHiddenTaskTypes(): string[] {
   122→  return getTaskTypesByVisibility(false);
   123→}
   124→
   125→/**
   126→ * Filter tasks to only include visible ones
   127→ */
   128→export function filterVisibleTasks<T extends { taskType: string }>(tasks: T[]): T[] {
   129→  return tasks.filter(task => isTaskVisible(task.taskType));
   130→}

   323→   * Update positions with optimistic UI and database persistence
   324→   * This is the main entry point for position changes
   325→   * NOTE: Positions are automatically quantized to ensure 4N+1 gaps for Wan model compatibility
   326→   */
   327→  const updatePositions = useCallback(async (
   328→    newPositions: Map<string, number>,
   329→    options: UpdateOptions = {}
   330→  ) => {
   331→    const {
   332→      operation = 'reorder',
   333→      skipOptimistic = false,
   334→      skipDatabase = false,
   335→      metadata = {},
   336→      externalRollback,
   337→    } = options;
   338→
   339→    if (!shotId) {
   340→      return;
   341→    }
   342→
   343→    // Drag/tap paths already quantize in timeline utils; re-quantizing here can
   344→    // rewrite the full timeline and unnecessarily inflate persisted update count.
   345→    const shouldQuantize = operation !== 'drag';
   346→    const quantizedPositions = shouldQuantize ? quantizePositions(newPositions) : new Map(newPositions);
   347→
   348→    const operationId = `op-${++operationIdRef.current}-${operation}`;
   349→
   350→    // Calculate what changed (using quantized positions).
   351→    // When skipOptimistic=true an external caller already applied the optimistic
   352→    // update before this function runs, so positionsRef.current already reflects
   353→    // the new positions. Use the pre-optimistic snapshot (set synchronously by
   354→    // applyOptimistic) to correctly compute the diff; otherwise changes.length===0
   355→    // and the DB write is skipped entirely.
   356→    const basePositions =
   357→      skipOptimistic && snapshotRef.current ? snapshotRef.current : positionsRef.current;
   358→    const changes = detectPositionChanges(basePositions, quantizedPositions);
   359→
   360→    // Detect trailing endpoint removal (was in old positions, not in new)
   361→    const trailingRemoved = positionsRef.current.has(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY) && !quantizedPositions.has(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   362→
   363→    if (changes.length === 0 && !trailingRemoved) {
   364→      return;
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    // Validate: no duplicate positions
   368→    if (hasDuplicatePositionValues(quantizedPositions)) {
   369→      toast.error('Position conflict detected - operation cancelled');
   370→      return;
   371→    }
   372→    
   373→    // Apply optimistic update.
   374→    // When skipOptimistic=true, the caller already applied the optimistic update
   375→    // externally (before entering the write queue) for instant visual feedback.
   376→    // In that case we reuse the caller's rollback function so errors still revert.
   377→    let rollback: (() => void) | null = null;
   378→    if (!skipOptimistic) {
   379→      const optimisticUpdates = changes.map(c => ({
   380→        id: c.id,
   381→        position: c.newPos,
   382→        operation: (c.oldPos === null ? 'add' : 'move') as 'add' | 'move' | 'remove',
   383→      }));
   384→      if (trailingRemoved) {
   385→        optimisticUpdates.push({
   386→          id: TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY,
   387→          position: 0,
   388→          operation: 'remove',
   389→        });
   390→      }
   391→      rollback = applyOptimistic(optimisticUpdates);
   392→    } else if (externalRollback !== undefined) {
   393→      rollback = externalRollback;
   394→    }
   395→    
   396→    // If skipping database, we're done
   397→    if (skipDatabase) {
   398→      clearPendingUpdates(changes.map(c => c.id));
   399→      return;
   400→    }
   401→    
   402→    // Mark a DB write in flight BEFORE the try block so the finally block always
   403→    // decrements it. This counter is the hard guard in syncFromDatabase — even if
   404→    // isLockedRef/isUpdatingRef are mysteriously cleared, writeInFlightRef > 0
   405→    // blocks any sync from applying stale server data over our optimistic state.
   406→    writeInFlightRef.current++;
   407→
   408→    // Set status to updating
   409→    isUpdatingRef.current = true;
   410→    setStatus({
   411→      type: 'updating',
   412→      operationId,
   413→      description: `${operation}: ${changes.length} items`,
   414→    });
   415→
   416→    // Lock positions to prevent sync interference
   417→    isLockedRef.current = true;
   418→
   419→    try {
   420→      // Partition changes: trailing endpoint vs. normal images
   421→      const trailingChange = changes.find(c => c.id === TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   422→      const imageChanges = changes.filter(c => c.id !== TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   423→
   424→      // Build database updates for normal image changes
   425→      const dbUpdates: Array<{ shot_generation_id: string; timeline_frame: number }> = [];
   426→      const unmatchedChangeIds: string[] = [];
   427→
   428→      for (const change of imageChanges) {
   429→        // Find the shot_generation record for this item
   430→        // change.id is shot_generations.id which matches sg.id directly
   431→        const shotGen = shotGenerations.find(sg => {
   432→          // Direct match on shot_generations.id
   433→          return sg.id === change.id;
   434→        });
   435→
   436→        if (shotGen) {
   437→          dbUpdates.push({
   438→            shot_generation_id: shotGen.id,
   439→            timeline_frame: change.newPos
   440→          });
   441→        } else {
   442→          unmatchedChangeIds.push(change.id);
   443→        }
   444→      }
   445→
   446→      if (trailingChange) {
   447→        await setTrailingEndpointFrame(
   448→          {
   449→            shotId,
   450→            operationId,
   451→            shotGenerations,
   452→            logPrefix: '',
   453→            log: () => {},
   454→          },
   455→          trailingChange.newPos,
   456→        );
   457→      }
   458→
   459→      if (trailingRemoved) {
   460→        await clearTrailingEndpointFrame({
   461→          shotId,
   462→          operationId,
   463→          shotGenerations,
   464→          logPrefix: '',
   465→          log: () => {},
   466→        });
   467→      }
   468→
   469→      if (dbUpdates.length === 0 && !trailingChange && !trailingRemoved) {
   470→        clearPendingUpdates(changes.map(c => c.id));
   471→        return;
   472→      }
   473→
   474→      // Batch-update normal image positions (skip if only trailing changed)
   475→      if (dbUpdates.length > 0) {
   476→        try {
   477→          await persistTimelineFrameBatch({
   478→            shotId,
   479→            updates: dbUpdates.map((update) => ({
   480→              shotGenerationId: update.shot_generation_id,
   481→              timelineFrame: update.timeline_frame,
   482→              metadata: {
   483→                user_positioned: true,
   484→                drag_source: operation,
   485→                ...metadata,
   486→              },
   487→            })),
   488→            operationLabel: `timeline-positions-${operation}`,
   489→            timeoutOperationName: 'timeline-positions-batch-rpc',
   490→            logPrefix: '',
   491→            log: () => {},
   492→          });
   493→        } catch (rpcError) {
   494→          throw rpcError;
   495→        }
   496→      }
   497→      
   498→      // Success!
   499→      // NOTE: We do NOT clear pending updates here anymore.
   500→      // We leave them in pendingUpdatesRef until syncFromDatabase verifies that
   501→      // the server data has actually caught up. This prevents "flash of stale content".
   502→      // clearPendingUpdates(changes.map(c => c.id));
   503→      
   504→      // Invalidate cache after a short delay to allow UI to settle
   505→      invalidateGenerations(shotId, {
   506→        reason: 'timeline-position-batch-persist',
   507→        scope: 'images',
   508→        delayMs: 100
   509→      });
   510→      
   511→    } catch (error) {
   512→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'TimelinePositions', showToast: false, logData: { operationId } });
   513→
   514→      // Rollback optimistic update
   515→      if (rollback) {
   516→        rollback();
   517→      }
   518→
   519→      setStatus({
   520→        type: 'error',
   521→        message: (error as Error).message,
   522→        canRetry: true
   523→      });
   524→
   525→      toast.error('Failed to update positions');
   526→      throw error;
   527→
   528→    } finally {
   529→      // Decrement write-in-flight counter (incremented before the try block).
   530→      // Must happen before unlocking so syncFromDatabase stays blocked until
   531→      // both the counter AND the lock are cleared.
   532→      writeInFlightRef.current = Math.max(0, writeInFlightRef.current - 1);
   533→
   534→      // Unlock positions — clear ref first so syncFromDatabase guards fire
   535→      // correctly before the state re-render triggers the useEffect.
   536→      isLockedRef.current = false;
   537→
   538→      // Reset status
   539→      isUpdatingRef.current = false;
   540→      setTimeout(() => {
   541→        setStatus(current =>
   542→          current.type === 'updating' && current.operationId === operationId
   543→            ? { type: 'idle' }
   544→            : current,
   545→        );
   546→      }, 50);
   547→    }
   548→    
   549→  }, [
   550→    shotId,
   551→    shotGenerations,
   552→    applyOptimistic,
   553→    clearPendingUpdates,
   554→    invalidateGenerations,
   555→  ]);
   556→  
   557→  /**
   558→   * Add new items at specific positions (for drops)
   559→   * Returns a rollback function
   560→   */
   561→  const addItemsAtPositions = useCallback((
   562→    items: Array<{ id: string; position: number }>
   563→  ): (() => void) => {
   564→    
   565→    // Apply optimistic update
   566→    const rollback = applyOptimistic(
   567→      items.map(({ id, position }) => ({ 
   568→        id, 
   569→        position, 
   570→        operation: 'add' as const 
   571→      }))
   572→    );
   573→    
   574→    return rollback;
   575→  }, [applyOptimistic]);
   576→  
   577→  /**
   578→   * Remove items from positions (for deletions)
   579→   * Returns a rollback function
   580→   */
   581→  const removeItems = useCallback((ids: string[]): (() => void) => {
   582→    
   583→    // Apply optimistic update
   584→    const rollback = applyOptimistic(
   585→      ids.map(id => ({ 
   586→        id, 
   587→        position: 0, // Position doesn't matter for remove
   588→        operation: 'remove' as const 
   589→      }))
   590→    );
   591→    
   592→    return rollback;
   593→  }, [applyOptimistic]);
   594→  
   595→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   596→  // LOCK CONTROLS
   597→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   598→  
   599→  const lockPositions = useCallback(() => {
   600→    isLockedRef.current = true;
   601→  }, []);
   602→
   603→  const unlockPositions = useCallback(() => {
   604→    // Don't release the lock while a write is in progress — the updatePositions
   605→    // finally block owns that lock and will release it. Without this guard, the
   606→    // external isDragInProgress effect in usePositionManagement fires unlockPositions()
   607→    // on drop (after the render that follows the drop event), which races with and
   608→    // overrides the internal lock acquired synchronously by updatePositions.
   609→    if (isUpdatingRef.current) {
   610→      return;
   611→    }
   612→    isLockedRef.current = false;
   613→  }, []);
   614→  
   615→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   616→  // HELPERS
   617→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   618→  
   619→  const getPosition = useCallback((id: string): number | undefined => {
   620→    return positions.get(id);
   621→  }, [positions]);
   622→  
   623→  const hasPosition = useCallback((id: string): boolean => {
   624→    return positions.has(id);
   625→  }, [positions]);
   626→  
   627→  const hasPendingUpdate = useCallback((id: string): boolean => {
   628→    return pendingUpdatesRef.current.has(id);
   629→  }, []);
   630→  
   631→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   632→  // DERIVED STATE
   633→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   634→  
   635→  const isUpdating = status.type === 'updating';
   636→  const isIdle = status.type === 'idle';
   637→  
   638→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   639→  // PRE-QUEUE OPTIMISTIC HELPER
   640→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   641→
   642→  /**
   643→   * Apply an optimistic visual update immediately, without entering the write
   644→   * queue or touching the DB. Designed to be called in setFramePositions BEFORE
   645→   * runSerializedTimelineWrite so the user sees the drag result at once, even
   646→   * when the queue is blocked by a concurrent batch-editor RPC.
   647→   *
   648→   * Returns the rollback function from applyOptimistic (null if nothing changed).
   649→   * Pass this as UpdateOptions.externalRollback to the subsequent updatePositions
   650→   * call so errors can revert the visual state.
   651→   *
   652→   * Uses the drag-path rule: no quantization (matches updatePositions 'drag').
   653→   */
   654→  const applyOptimisticPositionUpdate = useCallback((
   655→    newPositions: Map<string, number>,
   656→  ): (() => void) | null => {
   657→    const updates: Array<{ id: string; position: number; operation: 'add' | 'move' | 'remove' }> = [];
   658→    for (const [id, newPos] of newPositions) {
   659→      const oldPos = positionsRef.current.get(id);
   660→      if (oldPos !== newPos) {
   661→        updates.push({
   662→          id,
   663→          position: newPos,
   664→          operation: oldPos === undefined ? 'add' : 'move',
   665→        });
   666→      }
   667→    }
   668→    if (updates.length === 0) return null;
   669→    return applyOptimistic(updates);
   670→  }, [applyOptimistic]);
   671→
   672→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   673→  // BACKWARDS COMPATIBILITY
   674→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   675→
   676→  // For backwards compatibility, expose the same interface as the old hook
   677→  const setFramePositions = useCallback(async (newPositions: Map<string, number>) => {
   678→    await updatePositions(newPositions, { operation: 'drag' });
   679→  }, [updatePositions]);
   680→  
   681→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   682→  // RETURN
   683→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   684→  
   685→  return {
   686→    // The single source of truth
   687→    positions,
   688→
   689→    // Status
   690→    status,
   691→    isUpdating,
   692→    isIdle,
   693→
   694→    // Core operations
   695→    updatePositions,
   696→    addItemsAtPositions,
   697→    removeItems,
   698→    applyOptimisticPositionUpdate,
   699→
   700→    // Sync control
   701→    syncFromDatabase,
   702→    lockPositions,
   703→    unlockPositions,
   704→
   705→    // Helpers
   706→    getPosition,
   707→    hasPosition,
   708→    hasPendingUpdate,
   709→
   710→    // Backwards compatibility
   711→    displayPositions: positions,
   712→    framePositions: positions,
   713→    setFramePositions,
   714→  };
   715→}
   716→
   717→// Export types
   718→export type { UseTimelinePositionsReturn, UpdateOptions, PositionStatus };
   719→
