     4→import { getDeprecationPolicy } from '@/shared/lib/governance/deprecationPolicy';
     5→import { signalPastRemovalTargetUsage } from '@/shared/lib/governance/deprecationEnforcement';
     6→import type {
     7→  StructureVideoConfig,
     8→  TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput,
     9→} from './types';
    10→
    11→const legacyStructurePolicy = getDeprecationPolicy('travel_structure_legacy');
    12→export const LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_OWNER = legacyStructurePolicy.owner;
    13→export const LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_REMOVE_BY = legacyStructurePolicy.removeBy;
    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * Compatibility shim for legacy travel-between-images payload fields.
    17→ *
    18→ * Sunset contract:
    19→ * - Owner: see LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_OWNER
    20→ * - Remove by: see LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_REMOVE_BY
    21→ * - Removal gate: no callers emitting or parsing deprecated structure video fields.
    22→ */
    23→
    24→/** Legacy read-shape for structure videos used only at adapter boundaries. */
    25→export interface LegacyStructureVideoConfig extends StructureVideoConfig {
    26→  /** @deprecated Use structure_guidance.strength instead */
    27→  motion_strength?: number;
    28→  /** @deprecated Use structure_guidance.target + preprocessing instead */
    29→  structure_type?: 'uni3c' | 'flow' | 'canny' | 'depth';
    30→  /** @deprecated Use structure_guidance.step_window[0] instead */
    31→  uni3c_start_percent?: number;
    32→  /** @deprecated Use structure_guidance.step_window[1] instead */
    33→  uni3c_end_percent?: number;
    34→}
    35→
    36→export interface LegacyTravelBetweenImagesTaskParams {
    37→  /** Legacy LoRA format - prefer phase_config.phases[].loras */
    38→  loras?: PathLoraConfig[];
    39→
    40→  /** @deprecated Use structure_guidance + structure_videos array format instead */
    41→  structure_video_path?: string | null;
    42→  /** @deprecated Use structure_guidance + structure_videos array format instead */
    43→  structure_video_treatment?: 'adjust' | 'clip';
    44→  /** @deprecated Use structure_guidance + structure_videos array format instead */
    45→  structure_video_motion_strength?: number;
    46→  /** @deprecated Use structure_guidance + structure_videos array format instead */
    47→  structure_video_type?: 'uni3c' | 'flow' | 'canny' | 'depth';
    48→  /** @deprecated Use structure_guidance.step_window[0] instead */
    49→  uni3c_start_percent?: number;
    50→  /** @deprecated Use structure_guidance.step_window[1] instead */
    51→  uni3c_end_percent?: number;
    52→  /** @deprecated Use structure_guidance.target === 'uni3c' instead */
    53→  use_uni3c?: boolean;
    54→
    55→  // Retained until the shim sunset contract above is fulfilled.
    56→  phase_config?: PhaseConfig;
    57→}
    58→
    59→/** Legacy read-shape used only at migration/adapter boundaries. */
    60→export interface TravelBetweenImagesLegacyTaskInput extends
    61→  Omit<TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput, 'structure_videos'> {
    62→  structure_videos?: LegacyStructureVideoConfig[];
    63→}
    64→
    65→export const LEGACY_TRAVEL_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS = [
    66→  'structure_video_path',
    67→  'structure_video_treatment',
    68→  'structure_video_motion_strength',
    69→  'structure_video_type',
    70→  'uni3c_start_percent',
    71→  'uni3c_end_percent',
    72→  'use_uni3c',
    73→] as const;
    74→
    75→export const LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_VIDEO_FIELDS = [
    76→  'motion_strength',
    77→  'structure_type',
    78→  'uni3c_start_percent',
    79→  'uni3c_end_percent',
    80→] as const;
    81→
    82→export type LegacyTopLevelField = (typeof LEGACY_TRAVEL_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS)[number];
    83→export type LegacyStructureVideoField = (typeof LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_VIDEO_FIELDS)[number];
    84→
    85→type StructureVideoType = 'uni3c' | 'flow' | 'canny' | 'depth';
    86→
    87→export interface MigratedLegacyStructureVideo extends LegacyStructureVideoConfig {
    88→  metadata?: VideoMetadata | null;
    89→  resource_id?: string | null;
    90→}
    91→
    92→export interface LegacyStructureVideoMigrationOptions {
    93→  defaultEndFrame: number;
    94→  defaultVideoTreatment: 'adjust' | 'clip';
    95→  defaultMotionStrength: number;
    96→  defaultStructureType: StructureVideoType;
    97→  defaultUni3cEndPercent: number;
    98→}
    99→
   100→function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   101→  return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
   102→    ? value as Record<string, unknown>
   103→    : null;
   104→}
   105→
   106→function parseStructureType(value: unknown): StructureVideoType | undefined {
   107→  return value === 'uni3c' || value === 'flow' || value === 'canny' || value === 'depth'
   108→    ? value
   109→    : undefined;
   110→}
   111→
   112→function parseTreatment(value: unknown): 'adjust' | 'clip' | undefined {
   113→  return value === 'adjust' || value === 'clip' ? value : undefined;
   114→}
   115→
   116→function parseNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {
   117→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
   118→}
   119→
   120→function parseString(value: unknown): string | undefined {
   121→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined;
   122→}
   123→
   124→function hasLegacyField(
   125→  value: unknown,
   126→  field: string,
   127→): boolean {
   128→  return Boolean(
   129→    value
   130→    && typeof value === 'object'
   131→    && !Array.isArray(value)
   132→    && field in (value as Record<string, unknown>)
   133→    && (value as Record<string, unknown>)[field] !== undefined,
   134→  );
   135→}
   136→
   137→export interface TravelStructureLegacyUsage {
   138→  topLevelFields: LegacyTopLevelField[];
   139→  structureVideoFields: LegacyStructureVideoField[];
   140→}
   141→
   142→export function collectTravelStructureLegacyUsage(
   143→  value: unknown,
   144→): TravelStructureLegacyUsage {
   145→  const record = value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
   146→    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
   147→    : {};
   148→
   149→  const topLevelFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS.filter(
   150→    (field) => record[field] !== undefined,
   151→  );
   152→
   153→  const structureVideos = Array.isArray(record.structure_videos)
   154→    ? record.structure_videos
   155→    : [];
   156→  const structureVideoFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_VIDEO_FIELDS.filter((field) =>
   157→    structureVideos.some((entry) => hasLegacyField(entry, field)),
   158→  );
   159→
   160→  return { topLevelFields, structureVideoFields };
   161→}
   162→
   163→export function enforceTravelStructureLegacyPolicy(
   164→  usage: TravelStructureLegacyUsage,
   165→  options?: {
   166→    context?: string;
   167→    enforcement?: 'warn' | 'throw' | 'auto';
   168→  },
   169→): boolean {
   170→  const usedFields = [...usage.topLevelFields, ...usage.structureVideoFields];
   171→  if (usedFields.length === 0) {
   172→    return false;
   173→  }
   174→
   175→  const details = usedFields.join(', ');
   176→  return signalPastRemovalTargetUsage({
   177→    alias: 'travel_between_images.legacy_structure_fields',
   178→    policy: legacyStructurePolicy,
   179→    remediation: `Migrate to structure_guidance + canonical structure_videos. Legacy fields seen: ${details}.` +
   180→      (options?.context ? ` Context: ${options.context}.` : ''),
   181→    enforcement: options?.enforcement ?? 'auto',
   182→  });
   183→}
   184→
   185→/**
   186→ * Canonical migration adapter for legacy structure-video settings.
   187→ * Preserves explicit structure_type values and only falls back to defaults
   188→ * when legacy payloads omit type information.
   189→ */
   190→export function migrateLegacyStructureVideos(
   191→  value: unknown,
   192→  options: LegacyStructureVideoMigrationOptions,
   193→): MigratedLegacyStructureVideo[] {
   194→  const settings = asRecord(value);
   195→  if (!settings) {
   196→    return [];
   197→  }
   198→
   199→  const topLevelStructureType = parseStructureType(
   200→    settings.structure_video_type ?? settings.structureType,
   201→  );
   202→  const topLevelTreatment = parseTreatment(
   203→    settings.structure_video_treatment ?? settings.treatment,
   204→  );
   205→  const topLevelMotionStrength = parseNumber(
   206→    settings.structure_video_motion_strength ?? settings.motionStrength,
   207→  );
   208→  const topLevelUni3cEndPercent = parseNumber(settings.uni3c_end_percent);
   209→
   210→  const rawStructureVideos = Array.isArray(settings.structure_videos)
   211→    ? settings.structure_videos
   212→    : null;
   213→  if (rawStructureVideos) {
   214→    return rawStructureVideos
   215→      .map((entry) => {
   216→        const record = asRecord(entry);
   217→        if (!record) {
   218→          return null;
   219→        }
   220→
   221→        const path = parseString(record.path);
   222→        if (!path) {
   223→          return null;
   224→        }
   225→
   226→        const metadata = asRecord(record.metadata);
   227→        const resourceId = parseString(record.resource_id);
   228→        return {
   229→          path,
   230→          start_frame: parseNumber(record.start_frame) ?? 0,
   231→          end_frame: parseNumber(record.end_frame) ?? options.defaultEndFrame,
   232→          treatment: parseTreatment(record.treatment) ?? topLevelTreatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   233→          motion_strength: parseNumber(record.motion_strength) ?? topLevelMotionStrength ?? options.defaultMotionStrength,
   234→          structure_type: parseStructureType(record.structure_type) ?? topLevelStructureType ?? options.defaultStructureType,
   235→          uni3c_end_percent: parseNumber(record.uni3c_end_percent) ?? topLevelUni3cEndPercent ?? options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   236→          metadata: metadata as VideoMetadata | null ?? null,
   237→          resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
   238→        } satisfies MigratedLegacyStructureVideo;
   239→      })
   240→      .filter((entry): entry is MigratedLegacyStructureVideo => entry !== null);
   241→  }
   242→
   243→  const singlePath = parseString(settings.structure_video_path ?? settings.path);
   244→  if (!singlePath) {
   245→    return [];
   246→  }
   247→
   248→  const metadata = asRecord(settings.metadata);
   249→  const resourceId = parseString(settings.resource_id ?? settings.resourceId);
   250→  return [{
   251→    path: singlePath,
   252→    start_frame: 0,
   253→    end_frame: options.defaultEndFrame,
   254→    treatment: topLevelTreatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   255→    motion_strength: topLevelMotionStrength ?? options.defaultMotionStrength,
   256→    structure_type: topLevelStructureType ?? options.defaultStructureType,
   257→    uni3c_end_percent: topLevelUni3cEndPercent ?? options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   258→    metadata: metadata as VideoMetadata | null ?? null,
   259→    resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
   260→  }];
   261→}
   262→

1→/**
     2→ * Image Preloader
     3→ *
     4→ * Core preloading logic - takes images and loads them via the queue.
     5→ * Marks images as loaded when they complete.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import type { PreloadableImage, PreloadConfig } from './types';
     9→import { PreloadQueue } from './queue';
    10→import { setImageLoadStatus, hasLoadedImage, markImageLoaded } from './tracker';
    11→import { getDisplayUrl } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    12→import { isPreloadableMediaUrl } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaTypeHelpers';
    13→
    14→function hasImageId(image: PreloadableImage): image is PreloadableImage & { id: string } {
    15→  return typeof image.id === 'string' && image.id.length > 0;
    16→}
    17→
    18→/**
    19→ * Preload a batch of images using the provided queue.
    20→ * Marks images as loaded in the tracker when they complete.
    21→ *
    22→ * @param images - Images to preload
    23→ * @param queue - The preload queue to use
    24→ * @param config - Preload configuration
    25→ * @param priority - Base priority for these images (higher = load first)
    26→ */
    27→export async function preloadImages(
    28→  images: PreloadableImage[],
    29→  queue: PreloadQueue,
    30→  config: PreloadConfig,
    31→  priority = 0
    32→): Promise<void> {
    33→  // Limit to max images per page
    34→  const limitedImages = images.slice(0, config.maxImagesPerPage);
    35→
    36→  // Filter out already-loaded images
    37→  const toPreload = limitedImages.filter((img) => !hasImageId(img) || !hasLoadedImage(img));
    38→
    39→  if (toPreload.length === 0) {
    40→    return;
    41→  }
    42→
    43→  // Create promises for each image
    44→  const promises = toPreload.map(async (img, idx) => {
    45→    const url = getImageUrl(img, config.preloadThumbnailsOnly);
    46→
    47→    if (!url) {
    48→      return;
    49→    }
    50→
    51→    // Skip known non-preloadable media URLs (e.g., join-clips placeholder outputs).
    52→    if (!isPreloadableMediaUrl(url)) {
    53→      return;
    54→    }
    55→
    56→    try {
    57→      // Slightly decrease priority for later images in the batch
    58→      const element = await queue.add(url, priority - idx);
    59→
    60→      // Track by ID if available
    61→      if (hasImageId(img)) {
    62→        setImageLoadStatus(img, true);
    63→      }
    64→
    65→      // Track by URL with element ref (for browser cache persistence)
    66→      markImageLoaded(url, { element });
    67→    } catch {
    68→      // Preloading is best-effort - don't throw on failure
    69→    }
    70→  });
    71→
    72→  // Wait for all to settle (don't fail if some images fail)
    73→  await Promise.allSettled(promises);
    74→}
    75→
    76→/**
    77→ * Get the URL to preload for an image (thumbnail or full based on config)
    78→ */
    79→function getImageUrl(img: PreloadableImage, thumbnailOnly: boolean): string | null {
    80→  const rawUrl = thumbnailOnly
    81→    ? (img.thumbUrl || img.thumbnail_url || null)
    82→    : (img.url || null);
    83→
    84→  if (!rawUrl) {
    85→    return null;
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  return getDisplayUrl(rawUrl);
    89→}
    90→

1→/**
     2→ * Centralized task configuration system
     3→ * 
     4→ * This module provides synchronous access to task type configuration.
     5→ * Configuration is loaded from the database (task_types table) and cached globally.
     6→ * Hardcoded fallbacks exist for backwards compatibility and offline scenarios.
     7→ */
     8→
     9→import { getTaskTypeConfigCache, isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized, type TaskTypeInfo } from '@/shared/lib/taskTypeCache';
    10→import {
    11→  getTaskTypeConfigFallback,
    12→  getTaskTypeFallbackEntries,
    13→} from '@/shared/lib/taskTypeConfigFallback';
    14→
    15→interface TaskTypeConfig {
    16→  /** Whether this task type should be visible in the UI */
    17→  isVisible: boolean;
    18→  /** Display name for the task type (overrides the raw taskType) */
    19→  displayName?: string;
    20→  /** Whether this task type supports progress checking */
    21→  supportsProgress?: boolean;
    22→  /** Whether this task type can be manually cancelled by users */
    23→  canCancel?: boolean;
    24→  /** Category for grouping related task types */
    25→  category?: 'generation' | 'processing' | 'orchestration' | 'utility';
    26→  /** Description for documentation/debugging */
    27→  description?: string;
    28→}
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Convert database TaskTypeInfo to TaskTypeConfig format
    32→ */
    33→function dbConfigToTaskConfig(dbConfig: TaskTypeInfo): TaskTypeConfig {
    34→  return {
    35→    isVisible: dbConfig.is_visible ?? false,
    36→    displayName: dbConfig.display_name,
    37→    supportsProgress: dbConfig.supports_progress ?? false,
    38→    canCancel: true, // Default all tasks to cancellable
    39→    category: dbConfig.category as TaskTypeConfig['category'],
    40→  };
    41→}
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Get configuration for a specific task type
    45→ * Checks the database cache first, falls back to hardcoded defaults
    46→ */
    47→function getTaskConfig(taskType: string): TaskTypeConfig {
    48→  // Check database cache first (populated by useAllTaskTypesConfig hook)
    49→  if (isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized()) {
    50→    const cache = getTaskTypeConfigCache();
    51→    const dbConfig = cache[taskType];
    52→    if (dbConfig) {
    53→      return dbConfigToTaskConfig(dbConfig);
    54→    }
    55→  }
    56→  
    57→  // Fall back to the shared fallback snapshot.
    58→  const fallbackConfig = getTaskTypeConfigFallback(taskType);
    59→  if (fallbackConfig) {
    60→    return fallbackConfig;
    61→  }
    62→  
    63→  // Default for completely unknown task types
    64→  return {
    65→    isVisible: false, // Default to hidden for unknown types
    66→    canCancel: true,
    67→    category: 'utility'
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→/**
    72→ * Check if a task type should be visible in the UI
    73→ */
    74→function isTaskVisible(taskType: string): boolean {
    75→  return getTaskConfig(taskType).isVisible;
    76→}
    77→
    78→/**
    79→ * Get the display name for a task type
    80→ */
    81→export function getTaskDisplayName(taskType: string): string {
    82→  const config = getTaskConfig(taskType);
    83→  return config.displayName || taskType;
    84→}
    85→
    86→/**
    87→ * Check if a task type supports progress checking
    88→ */
    89→export function taskSupportsProgress(taskType: string): boolean {
    90→  return getTaskConfig(taskType).supportsProgress || false;
    91→}
    92→
    93→/**
    94→ * Get task types filtered by visibility
    95→ * Uses database cache if available, falls back to hardcoded list
    96→ */
    97→function getTaskTypesByVisibility(visible: boolean): string[] {
    98→  if (isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized()) {
    99→    const cache = getTaskTypeConfigCache();
   100→    return Object.entries(cache)
   101→      .filter(([_, config]) => visible ? config.is_visible : !config.is_visible)
   102→      .map(([taskType]) => taskType);
   103→  }
   104→
   105→  // Fall back to the versioned fallback snapshot.
   106→  return getTaskTypeFallbackEntries()
   107→    .filter(([_, config]) => visible ? config.isVisible : !config.isVisible)
   108→    .map(([taskType]) => taskType);
   109→}
   110→
   111→/**
   112→ * Get all visible task types
   113→ */
   114→export function getVisibleTaskTypes(): string[] {
   115→  return getTaskTypesByVisibility(true);
   116→}
   117→
   118→/**
   119→ * Get all hidden task types
   120→ */
   121→export function getHiddenTaskTypes(): string[] {
   122→  return getTaskTypesByVisibility(false);
   123→}
   124→
   125→/**
   126→ * Filter tasks to only include visible ones
   127→ */
   128→export function filterVisibleTasks<T extends { taskType: string }>(tasks: T[]): T[] {
   129→  return tasks.filter(task => isTaskVisible(task.taskType));
   130→}
   131→

     2→ * useTimelinePositions - Single Source of Truth for Timeline Positions
     3→ *
     4→ * This hook serves the TIMELINE DRAG path: the user drags a node on the
     5→ * timeline ruler and positions update optimistically while the RPC runs.
     6→ *
     7→ * The BATCH EDITOR path (drag-to-reorder in the image grid) is handled
     8→ * separately by useTimelineFrameUpdates, which does a DB-first write and
     9→ * relies on the React Query cache refetch to update the UI. The two paths
    10→ * share the same serialization queue (runSerializedTimelineWrite) and the
    11→ * same RPC (persistTimelineFrameBatch) so their writes are ordered correctly.

    13→ * State machine:

   124→export function useTimelinePositions({

   141→  // in callbacks without positions being in their dep arrays (which would cause
   142→  // recreation on every drag frame, cascading through the entire call chain).
   143→  const positionsRef = useRef<Map<string, number>>(new Map());
   144→  positionsRef.current = positions;

   169→  const isLockedRef = useRef(false);
   170→  const isUpdatingRef = useRef(false);

   176→  // in-flight optimistic positions.
   177→  const writeInFlightRef = useRef(0);

   182→
   183→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   184→  // DATABASE SYNC
   185→  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   186→
   187→  /**
   188→   * Sync positions from database data

   191→  const syncFromDatabase = useCallback(() => {

   194→    if (isLockedRef.current) {

   196→    }

   101→  return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
   102→    ? value as Record<string, unknown>
   103→    : null;
   104→}
   105→
   106→function parseStructureType(value: unknown): StructureVideoType | undefined {
   107→  return value === 'uni3c' || value === 'flow' || value === 'canny' || value === 'depth'
   108→    ? value
   109→    : undefined;
   110→}
   111→
   112→function parseTreatment(value: unknown): 'adjust' | 'clip' | undefined {
   113→  return value === 'adjust' || value === 'clip' ? value : undefined;
   114→}
   115→
   116→function parseNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {
   117→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
   118→}
   119→
   120→function parseString(value: unknown): string | undefined {
   121→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined;
   122→}
   123→
   124→function hasLegacyField(
   125→  value: unknown,
   126→  field: string,
   127→): boolean {
   128→  return Boolean(
   129→    value
   130→    && typeof value === 'object'
   131→    && !Array.isArray(value)
   132→    && field in (value as Record<string, unknown>)
   133→    && (value as Record<string, unknown>)[field] !== undefined,
   134→  );
   135→}
   136→
   137→export interface TravelStructureLegacyUsage {
   138→  topLevelFields: LegacyTopLevelField[];
   139→  structureVideoFields: LegacyStructureVideoField[];
   140→}
   141→
   142→export function collectTravelStructureLegacyUsage(
   143→  value: unknown,
   144→): TravelStructureLegacyUsage {
   145→  const record = value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
   146→    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
   147→    : {};
   148→
   149→  const topLevelFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS.filter(
   150→    (field) => record[field] !== undefined,
   151→  );
   152→
   153→  const structureVideos = Array.isArray(record.structure_videos)
   154→    ? record.structure_videos
   155→    : [];
   156→  const structureVideoFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_VIDEO_FIELDS.filter((field) =>
   157→    structureVideos.some((entry) => hasLegacyField(entry, field)),
   158→  );
   159→
   160→  return { topLevelFields, structureVideoFields };
   161→}
   162→
   163→export function enforceTravelStructureLegacyPolicy(
   164→  usage: TravelStructureLegacyUsage,
   165→  options?: {
   166→    context?: string;
   167→    enforcement?: 'warn' | 'throw' | 'auto';
   168→  },
   169→): boolean {
   170→  const usedFields = [...usage.topLevelFields, ...usage.structureVideoFields];
   171→  if (usedFields.length === 0) {
   172→    return false;
   173→  }
   174→
   175→  const details = usedFields.join(', ');
   176→  return signalPastRemovalTargetUsage({
   177→    alias: 'travel_between_images.legacy_structure_fields',
   178→    policy: legacyStructurePolicy,
   179→    remediation: `Migrate to structure_guidance + canonical structure_videos. Legacy fields seen: ${details}.` +
   180→      (options?.context ? ` Context: ${options.context}.` : ''),
   181→    enforcement: options?.enforcement ?? 'auto',
   182→  });
   183→}
   184→
   185→/**
   186→ * Canonical migration adapter for legacy structure-video settings.
   187→ * Preserves explicit structure_type values and only falls back to defaults
   188→ * when legacy payloads omit type information.
   189→ */
   190→export function migrateLegacyStructureVideos(
   191→  value: unknown,
   192→  options: LegacyStructureVideoMigrationOptions,
   193→): MigratedLegacyStructureVideo[] {
   194→  const settings = asRecord(value);
   195→  if (!settings) {
   196→    return [];
   197→  }
   198→
   199→  const topLevelStructureType = parseStructureType(
   200→    settings.structure_video_type ?? settings.structureType,
   201→  );
   202→  const topLevelTreatment = parseTreatment(
   203→    settings.structure_video_treatment ?? settings.treatment,
   204→  );
   205→  const topLevelMotionStrength = parseNumber(
   206→    settings.structure_video_motion_strength ?? settings.motionStrength,
   207→  );
   208→  const topLevelUni3cEndPercent = parseNumber(settings.uni3c_end_percent);
   209→
   210→  const rawStructureVideos = Array.isArray(settings.structure_videos)
   211→    ? settings.structure_videos
   212→    : null;
   213→  if (rawStructureVideos) {
   214→    return rawStructureVideos
   215→      .map((entry) => {
   216→        const record = asRecord(entry);
   217→        if (!record) {
   218→          return null;
   219→        }
   220→
   221→        const path = parseString(record.path);
   222→        if (!path) {
   223→          return null;
   224→        }
   225→
   226→        const metadata = asRecord(record.metadata);
   227→        const resourceId = parseString(record.resource_id);
   228→        return {
   229→          path,
   230→          start_frame: parseNumber(record.start_frame) ?? 0,
   231→          end_frame: parseNumber(record.end_frame) ?? options.defaultEndFrame,
   232→          treatment: parseTreatment(record.treatment) ?? topLevelTreatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   233→          motion_strength: parseNumber(record.motion_strength) ?? topLevelMotionStrength ?? options.defaultMotionStrength,
   234→          structure_type: parseStructureType(record.structure_type) ?? topLevelStructureType ?? options.defaultStructureType,
   235→          uni3c_end_percent: parseNumber(record.uni3c_end_percent) ?? topLevelUni3cEndPercent ?? options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   236→          metadata: metadata as VideoMetadata | null ?? null,
   237→          resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
   238→        } satisfies MigratedLegacyStructureVideo;
   239→      })
   240→      .filter((entry): entry is MigratedLegacyStructureVideo => entry !== null);
   241→  }
   242→
   243→  const singlePath = parseString(settings.structure_video_path ?? settings.path);
   244→  if (!singlePath) {
   245→    return [];
   246→  }
   247→
   248→  const metadata = asRecord(settings.metadata);
   249→  const resourceId = parseString(settings.resource_id ?? settings.resourceId);
   250→  return [{
   251→    path: singlePath,
   252→    start_frame: 0,
   253→    end_frame: options.defaultEndFrame,
   254→    treatment: topLevelTreatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   255→    motion_strength: topLevelMotionStrength ?? options.defaultMotionStrength,
   256→    structure_type: topLevelStructureType ?? options.defaultStructureType,
   257→    uni3c_end_percent: topLevelUni3cEndPercent ?? options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   258→    metadata: metadata as VideoMetadata | null ?? null,
   259→    resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
   260→  }];
   261→}

1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→

1→export const fileToDataURL = (file: File): Promise<string> =>
     2→  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     3→    const reader = new FileReader();
     4→    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
     5→    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
     6→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
     7→  });
     8→
     9→export const dataURLtoFile = (
    10→  dataUrl: string,
    11→  filename: string,
    12→  fileType?: string
    13→): File | null => {
    14→  try {
    15→    const [metadata, payload] = dataUrl.split(',');
    16→    if (!metadata || !payload) {
    17→      throw new Error('Invalid Data URL format');
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    const mimeMatch = metadata.match(/:(.*?);/);
    21→    const mimeType =
    22→      fileType ||
    23→      (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) ||
    24→      'application/octet-stream';
    25→    const decodedPayload = atob(payload);
    26→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(decodedPayload.length);
    27→
    28→    for (let i = 0; i < decodedPayload.length; i += 1) {
    29→      bytes[i] = decodedPayload.charCodeAt(i);
    30→    }
    31→
    32→    return new File([bytes], filename, { type: mimeType });
    33→  } catch {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→};

     3→type Listener = () => void;
     4→
     5→let openCount = 0;
     6→const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
     7→
     8→function notifyListeners(): void {
     9→  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
    10→}
    11→
    12→function getSnapshot(): boolean {
    13→  return openCount > 0;
    14→}
    15→
    16→function subscribe(listener: Listener): () => void {
    17→  listeners.add(listener);
    18→  return () => {
    19→    listeners.delete(listener);
    20→  };
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function acquireLightboxOpenState(): () => void {
    24→  openCount += 1;
    25→  notifyListeners();
    26→
    27→  let released = false;
    28→  return () => {
    29→    if (released) {
    30→      return;
    31→    }
    32→    released = true;
    33→    openCount = Math.max(0, openCount - 1);
    34→    notifyListeners();
    35→  };
    36→}
    37→
    38→export function useLightboxOpenState(): boolean {
    39→  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
    40→}

    43→  openCount = 0;

    21→

    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    31→ */
    32→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    33→  generationIds: string[],
    34→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    35→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    36→) {
    37→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    38→  const {
    39→    batchSize = 5,
    40→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    41→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    42→    projectId,
    43→  } = options;
    44→
    45→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    46→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    47→
    48→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId });
    49→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    50→
    51→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    52→
    53→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    54→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    55→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    56→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    57→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    58→        cacheEntry,
    59→      );
    60→
    61→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    62→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    63→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    64→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    65→          showToast: false,
    66→        });
    67→      }
    68→
    69→      if (preloadFullTaskData && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    70→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    71→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId),
    72→          queryFn: async () => {
    73→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    74→              .from('tasks')
    75→              .select('*')
    76→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    77→              .single();
    78→
    79→            if (error) throw error;
    80→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    81→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    82→            }
    83→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    84→          },
    85→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    86→        }));
    87→      }
    88→    });
    89→
    90→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
    91→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
    92→    }
    93→
    94→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
    95→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
    96→    }
    97→  }
    98→}

   103→export function enhanceGenerationsWithTaskData(
   104→  generations: GenerationRow[],

   106→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {

   116→    return {

   118→      taskId,
   119→      taskData,
   120→      taskMappingStatus,
   121→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   122→    };
   123→  });

1→import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
     2→
     3→const DEFAULT_ACCEPTED_TYPES = ['Files'];
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Track drag enter/leave events with proper nesting counter.
     7→ * Returns drag state and handlers.
     8→ *
     9→ * @param acceptedTypes - dataTransfer types to recognize (default: `['Files']`).
    10→ *   When a drag matches, `matchedType` will be set to the first matching type.
    11→ */
    12→export function useFileDragTracking(acceptedTypes: string[] = DEFAULT_ACCEPTED_TYPES) {
    13→  const [isDraggingOver, setIsDraggingOver] = useState(false);
    14→  const [matchedType, setMatchedType] = useState<string | null>(null);
    15→  const dragCounterRef = useRef(0);
    16→
    17→  const handleDragEnter = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
    18→    e.preventDefault();
    19→    e.stopPropagation();
    20→    dragCounterRef.current++;
    21→    const matched = acceptedTypes.find(t => e.dataTransfer.types.includes(t));
    22→    if (matched) {
    23→      setIsDraggingOver(true);
    24→      setMatchedType(matched);
    25→    }
    26→  }, [acceptedTypes]);
    27→
    28→  const handleDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
    29→    e.preventDefault();
    30→    e.stopPropagation();
    31→    dragCounterRef.current--;
    32→    if (dragCounterRef.current === 0) {
    33→      setIsDraggingOver(false);
    34→      setMatchedType(null);
    35→    }
    36→  }, []);
    37→
    38→  const resetDrag = useCallback(() => {
    39→    dragCounterRef.current = 0;
    40→    setIsDraggingOver(false);
    41→    setMatchedType(null);
    42→  }, []);
    43→
    44→  return { isDraggingOver, matchedType, handleDragEnter, handleDragLeave, resetDrag };
    45→}
    46→

1→/**
     2→ * useLineageChain Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Fetches the full lineage chain for a variant by following the `source_variant_id` field in params.
     5→ * Returns an array ordered from oldest ancestor to newest (the provided variant).
     6→ *
     7→ * Note: Lineage is tracked at the variant level via params.source_variant_id,
     8→ * not at the generation level via based_on.
     9→ */
    10→
    11→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    12→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    13→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    14→import { generationQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/generations';
    15→import {
    16→  resolveVariantProjectScope,
    17→  type VariantProjectScopeStatus,
    18→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    19→
    20→interface LineageItem {
    21→  id: string;
    22→  imageUrl: string;
    23→  thumbnailUrl: string | null;
    24→  createdAt: string;
    25→  type: 'variant';
    26→  variantType: string | null;

    28→
    29→interface LineageChainResult {
    30→  chain: LineageItem[];
    31→  isLoading: boolean;
    32→  hasLineage: boolean;
    33→  error: LineageScopeError | null;
    34→}
    35→
    36→interface VariantRecord {
    37→  id: string;
    38→  generation_id: string;
    39→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    40→  location: string;
    41→  thumbnail_url: string | null;
    42→  created_at: string;
    43→  variant_type: string | null;
    44→}
    45→
    46→type LineageScopeFailureStatus = Exclude<VariantProjectScopeStatus, 'ok'>;
    47→
    48→export class LineageScopeError extends Error {
    49→  readonly status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    50→  readonly variantId: string;
    51→  readonly projectId: string;
    52→  readonly queryError?: string;
    53→
    54→  constructor(params: {
    55→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    56→    variantId: string;
    57→    projectId: string;
    58→    queryError?: string;
    59→    message: string;
    60→  }) {
    61→    super(params.message);
    62→    this.name = 'LineageScopeError';
    63→    this.status = params.status;
    64→    this.variantId = params.variantId;
    65→    this.projectId = params.projectId;
    66→    this.queryError = params.queryError;
    67→  }
    68→}
    69→
    70→export function isLineageScopeError(error: unknown): error is LineageScopeError {
    71→  return error instanceof LineageScopeError;
    72→}
    73→
    74→function readSourceVariantId(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
    75→  return typeof params?.source_variant_id === 'string' ? params.source_variant_id : null;
    76→}
    77→
    78→function buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scopeStatus: string, queryError?: string): string {
    79→  switch (scopeStatus) {
    80→    case 'scope_mismatch':
    81→      return 'Variant exists but does not belong to the active project scope';
    82→    case 'missing_project_scope':
    83→      return 'Variant does not have project scope metadata';
    84→    case 'missing_variant':
    85→      return 'Variant not found';
    86→    case 'missing_generation':
    87→      return 'Variant generation was not found';
    88→    case 'query_failed':
    89→      return `Variant scope lookup failed${queryError ? `: ${queryError}` : ''}`;
    90→    default:
    91→      return `Variant scope validation failed (${scopeStatus})`;
    92→  }
    93→}
    94→
    95→function toLineageScopeError(
    96→  error: unknown,
    97→  fallback: {
    98→    variantId: string;
    99→    projectId: string;
   100→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
   101→    queryError?: string;
   102→  },
   103→): LineageScopeError {
   104→  if (isLineageScopeError(error)) {
   105→    return error;
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  const message = error instanceof Error
   109→    ? error.message
   110→    : buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(fallback.status, fallback.queryError);
   111→
   112→  return new LineageScopeError({
   113→    ...fallback,
   114→    message,
   115→  });
   116→}
   117→
   118→async function fetchVariantById(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<VariantRecord> {
   119→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
   120→  if (scope.status !== 'ok' || !scope.generationId) {
   121→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   122→      status: scope.status as LineageScopeFailureStatus,
   123→      variantId,
   124→      projectId,
   125→      queryError: scope.queryError,
   126→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scope.status, scope.queryError),
   127→    });
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseClient().from('generation_variants')
   131→    .select('id, generation_id, params, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, variant_type')
   132→    .eq('id', variantId)
   133→    .eq('generation_id', scope.generationId)
   134→    .single();
   135→
   136→  if (error) {
   137→    throw toLineageScopeError(error, {
   138→      status: 'query_failed',
   139→      variantId,
   140→      projectId,
   141→      queryError: error.message,
   142→    });
   143→  }
   144→
   145→  if (!data) {
   146→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   147→      status: 'missing_variant',
   148→      variantId,
   149→      projectId,
   150→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage('missing_variant'),
   151→    });
   152→  }
   153→  return data as VariantRecord;
   154→}
   155→
   156→/**
   157→ * Recursively fetch the lineage chain for a variant.
   158→ * Follows `params.source_variant_id` across generation boundaries.
   159→ */
   160→async function fetchLineageChain(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<LineageItem[]> {
   161→  const chain: LineageItem[] = [];
   162→  const visited = new Set<string>();
   163→  let currentId: string | null = variantId;
   164→
   165→  while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
   166→    visited.add(currentId);
   167→    const variant = await fetchVariantById(currentId, projectId);
   168→
   169→    chain.unshift({
   170→      id: variant.id,
   171→      imageUrl: variant.location,
   172→      thumbnailUrl: variant.thumbnail_url,
   173→      createdAt: variant.created_at,
   174→      type: 'variant',
   175→      variantType: variant.variant_type,
   176→    });
   177→    currentId = readSourceVariantId(variant.params);
   178→  }
   179→
   180→  return chain;
   181→}
   182→
   183→/**
   184→ * Hook to fetch the full lineage chain for a variant.
   185→ *
   186→ * @param variantId - The variant ID to fetch lineage for
   187→ * @param projectId - Project scope required for lineage traversal
   188→ * @returns Object with chain (oldest to newest), loading state, and whether there's lineage
   189→ */
   190→export function useLineageChain(variantId: string | null, projectId: string | null): LineageChainResult {
   191→  const { data: chain = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery<LineageItem[], LineageScopeError>({
   192→    queryKey: [...generationQueryKeys.lineageChain(variantId!), projectId ?? '__no-project__'],
   193→    queryFn: async () => {
   194→      try {
   195→        return await fetchLineageChain(variantId!, projectId!);
   196→      } catch (caughtError) {
   197→        const normalizedError = toLineageScopeError(caughtError, {
   198→          status: 'query_failed',
   199→          variantId: variantId!,
   200→          projectId: projectId!,
   201→        });
   202→        normalizeAndPresentError(normalizedError, {
   203→          context: 'useLineageChain',
   204→          showToast: false,
   205→          logData: {
   206→            variantId: normalizedError.variantId,
   207→            projectId: normalizedError.projectId,
   208→            status: normalizedError.status,
   209→            queryError: normalizedError.queryError,
   210→          },
   211→        });
   212→        throw normalizedError;
   213→      }
   214→    },
   215→    enabled: !!variantId && !!projectId,
   216→    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes - lineage doesn't change
   217→    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  return {
   221→    chain,
   222→    isLoading,
   223→    // Has lineage if chain has more than 1 item (the current variant + at least one ancestor)
   224→    hasLineage: chain.length > 1,
   225→    error: error ?? null,
   226→  };
   227→}
   228→
   229→/**
   230→ * Count the lineage chain length for a variant.
   231→ * Returns the number of ancestors (0 if no lineage, 1+ if has ancestors).
   232→ * This fetches directly without caching - use sparingly for initial checks.
   233→ *
   234→ * Reuses fetchLineageChain to avoid duplicating the traversal logic.
   235→ */
   236→export async function getLineageDepth(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<number> {
   237→  const chain = await fetchLineageChain(variantId, projectId);
   238→  // chain includes the variant itself; ancestors = chain length - 1
   239→  return Math.max(0, chain.length - 1);
   240→}
   241→
   242→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { useLineageChain } instead
   243→

    70→    const handleAuthStateChange = (event: string, session: Session | null) => {
    71→      // Seed the toolSettingsService user cache IMMEDIATELY — before the 150ms debounce.
    72→      // Without this, there's a race: setIsLoading(false) can open AuthGate while
    73→      // cachedUser is still null (debounce hasn't fired processAuthChange yet).
    74→      if (session?.user?.id) {
    75→        setCachedUserId(session.user.id);
    76→      }
    77→
    78→      // Store the latest auth state
    79→      pendingAuthState = { event, session };
    80→
    81→      // Clear existing debounce timer
    82→      if (debounceTimeout) {
    83→        clearTimeout(debounceTimeout);
    84→      }
    85→
    86→      // [AuthDebounce] Wait 150ms for additional auth events before processing
    87→      debounceTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    88→        if (pendingAuthState) {
    89→          const { event: pendingEvent, session: pendingSession } = pendingAuthState;
    90→          React.startTransition(() => {
    91→            processAuthChange(pendingEvent, pendingSession);
    92→          });
    93→          pendingAuthState = null;
    94→        }
    95→        debounceTimeout = null;
    96→      }, 150);
    97→    };
    98→
    99→    supabase().auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session } }) => {
   100→      // Seed toolSettingsService cache BEFORE opening AuthGate (setIsLoading(false)).
   101→      // This guarantees getUserWithTimeout() returns from cache (no navigator.locks)
   102→      // for all components that mount after the gate opens.
   103→      if (session?.user?.id) {
   104→        setCachedUserId(session.user.id);
   105→      }
   106→      setUserId(session?.user?.id);
   107→      setIsLoading(false);
   108→      lastProcessedState = { event: 'INITIAL_SESSION', userId: session?.user?.id };
   109→    });
   110→
   111→    // Use centralized auth manager instead of direct listener
   112→    const authManager = getAuthStateManager();
   113→    let unsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null;
   114→
   115→    if (authManager) {
   116→      unsubscribe = authManager.subscribe('AuthContext', handleAuthStateChange);
   117→    } else {
   118→      // Fallback to direct listener if auth manager not available
   119→      const { data: listener } = supabase().auth.onAuthStateChange(handleAuthStateChange);
   120→      unsubscribe = () => listener.subscription.unsubscribe();
   121→    }
   122→
   123→    return () => {
   124→      if (unsubscribe) unsubscribe();
   125→      if (debounceTimeout) {
   126→        clearTimeout(debounceTimeout);
   127→        // Process final pending state on cleanup if needed
   128→        if (pendingAuthState) {
   129→          processAuthChange(pendingAuthState.event, pendingAuthState.session);
   130→        }
   131→      }
   132→    };
   133→  }, []);
   134→
   135→  const contextValue = useMemo(
   136→    () => ({
   137→      userId: userId ?? null,
   138→      isAuthenticated: !!userId,
   139→      isLoading,
   140→    }),
   141→    [userId, isLoading]
   142→  );
   143→
   144→  return (
   145→    <AuthContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
   146→      {children}
   147→    </AuthContext.Provider>
   148→  );
   149→};
   150→
   151→/**
   152→ * Hook to access authentication state.
   153→ *
   154→ * @returns { userId, isAuthenticated }
   155→ */
   156→export const useAuth = () => {
   157→  return requireContextValue(useContext(AuthContext), 'useAuth', 'AuthProvider');
   158→};
   159→

1→import { debugConfig } from './debugConfig';
     2→
     3→const CHANNEL_FLAGS = {
     4→  cache: 'tasksPaneDebug',
     5→  render: 'renderLogging',
     6→} as const;
     7→
     8→type DebugChannel = keyof typeof CHANNEL_FLAGS;
     9→type DebugFlag = Parameters<typeof debugConfig.isEnabled>[0];
    10→
    11→const overrides: Partial<Record<DebugChannel, boolean>> = {};
    12→
    13→const isDev = Boolean(import.meta.env.DEV);
    14→
    15→function channelFlag(channel: DebugChannel): DebugFlag {
    16→  return CHANNEL_FLAGS[channel];
    17→}
    18→
    19→function isChannelEnabled(channel: DebugChannel): boolean {
    20→  if (!isDev) {
    21→    return false;
    22→  }
    23→
    24→  const override = overrides[channel];
    25→  if (override !== undefined) {
    26→    return override;
    27→  }
    28→
    29→  return debugConfig.isEnabled(channelFlag(channel));
    30→}
    31→
    32→function shouldLog(channel: DebugChannel, force: boolean): boolean {
    33→  return force ? isDev : isChannelEnabled(channel);
    34→}
    35→
    36→function withTag(channel: DebugChannel, message: string): string {
    37→  return `[${channel}] ${message}`;

    39→
    40→export function enableDebugChannel(channel: DebugChannel): void {
    41→  overrides[channel] = true;

    45→  overrides[channel] = false;

    47→

   110→/**

   113→function validateIndividualTravelSegmentParams(params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams): void {
   114→  const errors: string[] = [];
   115→
   116→  if (!params.project_id) {

   136→
   137→  // Enforce 81-frame limit per segment
   138→  const numFrames = (
   139→    typeof params.num_frames === 'number'

   700→
   701→function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   702→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   703→  finalResolution: string
   704→): Record<string, unknown> {
   705→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   706→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   707→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   708→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   709→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   710→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   711→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   712→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id)
   713→    ?? asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref);
   714→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   715→    ?? legacyRunId
   716→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id)
   717→    ?? asString(state.orig.run_id);
   718→
   719→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   720→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   721→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   722→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   723→  );
   724→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   725→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   726→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   727→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   728→    ? 'variant_child'
   729→    : 'child_generation';
   730→
   731→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   732→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   733→    generationRouting,
   734→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   735→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   736→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   737→  });
   738→
   739→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   740→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   741→    orchestratorDetails,
   742→    orchestrationInput: {
   743→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   744→      orchestratorTaskId,
   745→      runId,
   746→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   747→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   748→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   749→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   750→      generationRouting,
   751→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   752→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   753→    },
   754→    taskViewInput: {
   755→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   756→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   757→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   758→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   759→      modelName: state.modelName,
   760→      resolution: finalResolution,
   761→    },
   762→    familyContract,
   763→  });
   764→  const taskParams = {
   765→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   766→    ...composedPayload,
   767→  };
   768→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   769→  return taskParams;
   770→}
   771→
   772→/**
   773→ * Creates an individual travel segment regeneration task
   774→ * 
   775→ * This creates a standalone task (visible in TasksPane) that regenerates
   776→ * a single segment and creates a variant on the parent generation when complete.
   777→ * The task params match the exact structure of travel_segment for GPU worker compatibility.
   778→ * 
   779→ * @param params - Individual travel segment parameters
   780→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   781→ */
   782→export async function createIndividualTravelSegmentTask(params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   783→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   784→    params,
   785→    context: 'IndividualTravelSegment',
   786→    validate: validateIndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   787→    buildTaskRequest: async (requestParams) => {
   788→      const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
   789→
   790→      const effectiveParentGenerationId = await ensureShotParentGenerationId({
   791→        projectId: requestParams.project_id,
   792→        shotId: requestParams.shot_id,
   793→        parentGenerationId: requestParams.parent_generation_id,
   794→        context: 'IndividualTravelSegment',
   795→      });
   796→
   797→      let effectiveChildGenerationId = requestParams.child_generation_id;
   798→
   799→      if (!effectiveChildGenerationId && effectiveParentGenerationId) {
   800→        if (requestParams.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   801→          const { data: childByPairId, error: pairIdError } = await supabase
   802→            .from('generations')
   803→            .select('id')
   804→            .eq('parent_generation_id', effectiveParentGenerationId)
   805→            .eq('pair_shot_generation_id', requestParams.pair_shot_generation_id)
   806→            .limit(1)
   807→            .maybeSingle();
   808→
   809→          if (pairIdError) {
   810→            throw new Error(
   811→              `IndividualTravelSegment.lookupChildByPairId failed: ${pairIdError.message}`,
   812→            );
   813→          }
   814→
   815→          if (childByPairId) {
   816→            effectiveChildGenerationId = childByPairId.id;
   817→          }
   818→        }
   819→
   820→        if (!effectiveChildGenerationId && requestParams.segment_index !== undefined && !requestParams.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   821→          const { data: childByOrder, error: orderError } = await supabase
   822→            .from('generations')
   823→            .select('id')
   824→            .eq('parent_generation_id', effectiveParentGenerationId)
   825→            .eq('child_order', requestParams.segment_index)
   826→            .limit(1)
   827→            .maybeSingle();
   828→
   829→          if (orderError) {
   830→            throw new Error(
   831→              `IndividualTravelSegment.lookupChildByOrder failed: ${orderError.message}`,
   832→            );
   833→          }
   834→
   835→          if (childByOrder) {
   836→            effectiveChildGenerationId = childByOrder.id;
   837→          }
   838→        }
   839→      }
   840→
   841→      const paramsWithIds = {
   842→        ...requestParams,
   843→        parent_generation_id: effectiveParentGenerationId,
   844→        child_generation_id: effectiveChildGenerationId,
   845→      };
   846→
   847→      const directResolution = asString(requestParams.parsed_resolution_wh);
   848→      const originalParams = toRecordOrEmpty(requestParams.originalParams);
   849→      const originalOrchestratorDetails = toRecordOrEmpty(originalParams.orchestrator_details);
   850→      const origResolutionValue =
   851→        originalParams.parsed_resolution_wh ?? originalOrchestratorDetails.parsed_resolution_wh;
   852→      const origResolution = directResolution
   853→        ?? (typeof origResolutionValue === 'string' ? origResolutionValue : undefined);
   854→      const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   855→        requestParams.project_id,
   856→        origResolution,
   857→      );
   858→
   859→      const taskParams = buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(paramsWithIds, finalResolution);
   860→
   861→      return composeTaskRequest({
   862→        source: requestParams,
   863→        taskType: 'individual_travel_segment',
   864→        params: taskParams,
   865→      });
   866→    },
   867→  });
   868→}
   869→
   870→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   871→

   304→/**
   305→ * Variants sub-facade: variant loading, selection, promotion.
   306→ * Usable standalone when callers only need variant state.
   307→ */
   308→export function useSharedVariantsState(input: SharedVariantsInput): SharedVariantsStateResult {
   309→  const {
   310→    media,
   311→    isFormOnlyMode,
   312→    variantFetchGenerationId,
   313→    initialVariantId,
   314→    selectedProjectId,
   315→  } = input.core;
   316→  const {
   317→    variants,
   318→    primaryVariant,
   319→    activeVariant,
   320→    isLoading: isLoadingVariants,
   321→    setActiveVariantId: rawSetActiveVariantId,
   322→    refetch: refetchVariants,
   323→    setPrimaryVariant,
   324→    deleteVariant,
   325→  } = useVariants({
   326→    generationId: variantFetchGenerationId,
   327→    enabled: !isFormOnlyMode,
   328→  });
   329→  const { setActiveVariantId: baseSetActiveVariantId, isViewingNonPrimaryVariant } = useVariantSelection({
   330→    media,
   331→    viewedGenerationId: variantFetchGenerationId,
   332→    rawSetActiveVariantId,
   333→    activeVariant,
   334→    variants,
   335→    initialVariantId,
   336→  });
   337→  const intendedActiveVariantIdRef = useRef<string | null>(activeVariant?.id || null);
   338→  const {
   339→    promoteSuccess,
   340→    isPromoting,
   341→    handlePromoteToGeneration,
   342→    handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   343→  } = useVariantPromotion({
   344→    selectedProjectId,
   345→  });
   346→
   347→  useEffect(() => {
   348→    if (activeVariant?.id && activeVariant.id !== intendedActiveVariantIdRef.current) {
   349→      intendedActiveVariantIdRef.current = activeVariant.id;
   350→    }
   351→  }, [activeVariant?.id]);
   352→
   353→  const setActiveVariantId = useCallback((variantId: string) => {
   354→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef.current = variantId;
   355→    baseSetActiveVariantId(variantId);
   356→  }, [baseSetActiveVariantId]);
   357→
   358→  return {
   359→    section: {
   360→      list: variants || [],
   361→      primaryVariant,
   362→      activeVariant,
   363→      isLoading: isLoadingVariants,
   364→      setActiveVariantId,
   365→      refetch: refetchVariants,
   366→      setPrimaryVariant,
   367→      deleteVariant,
   368→      isViewingNonPrimaryVariant,
   369→      promoteSuccess,
   370→      isPromoting,
   371→      handlePromoteToGeneration,
   372→      handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   373→    },
   374→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   375→    activeVariant,
   376→    primaryVariant,
   377→    isViewingNonPrimaryVariant,
   378→    setPrimaryVariant,
   379→    refetchVariants,
   380→  };
   381→}
   382→
   383→/**
   384→ * Navigation sub-facade: keyboard nav, swipe nav, safe close.
   385→ * Usable standalone when callers only need navigation controls.
   386→ */
   387→export function useLightboxNavigationModel(input: SharedNavigationInput): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['navigation'] {
   388→  const { onClose, readOnly } = input.core;
   389→  const {
   390→    hasNext = false,
   391→    hasPrevious = false,
   392→    handleSlotNavNext,
   393→    handleSlotNavPrev,
   394→    swipeDisabled,
   395→    showNavigation,
   396→  } = input.navigation;
   397→  const { safeClose, activateClickShield } = useLightboxNavigation({
   398→    onNext: handleSlotNavNext,
   399→    onPrevious: handleSlotNavPrev,
   400→    onClose,
   401→  });
   402→  const swipeNavigation = useSwipeNavigation({
   403→    onSwipeLeft: () => {
   404→      if (hasNext) handleSlotNavNext();
   405→    },
   406→    onSwipeRight: () => {
   407→      if (hasPrevious) handleSlotNavPrev();
   408→    },
   409→    disabled: swipeDisabled || readOnly || !showNavigation,
   410→    hasNext,
   411→    hasPrevious,
   412→    threshold: 50,
   413→    velocityThreshold: 0.3,
   414→  });
   415→
   416→  return {
   417→    safeClose,
   418→    activateClickShield,
   419→    swipeNavigation,
   420→  };
   421→}
   422→
   423→/**
   424→ * Shot management sub-facade: positioning, creation, association state.
   425→ * Usable standalone when callers only need shot management.
   426→ */
   427→export function useLightboxShotActions(input: SharedShotActionsInput): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['shots'] {
   428→  const { media, selectedProjectId, onClose } = input.core;
   429→  const {
   430→    allShots,
   431→    onNavigateToShot,
   432→    onShotChange,
   433→    selectedShotId,
   434→    positionedInSelectedShot,
   435→    associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot,
   436→    optimisticPositionedIds,
   437→    optimisticUnpositionedIds,
   438→    onAddToShot,
   439→    onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   440→    onShowTick,
   441→    onShowSecondaryTick,
   442→    onOptimisticPositioned,
   443→    onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   444→  } = input.shots;
   445→  const {
   446→    isCreatingShot,
   447→    quickCreateSuccess,
   448→    handleQuickCreateAndAdd,
   449→    handleQuickCreateSuccess,
   450→  } = useShotCreation({
   451→    media,
   452→    selectedProjectId,
   453→    allShots: allShots || [],
   454→    onNavigateToShot,
   455→    onClose,
   456→    onShotChange,
   457→  });
   458→  const computedPositionedInSelectedShot = useMemo(() => (
   459→    typeof positionedInSelectedShot === 'boolean' ? positionedInSelectedShot : undefined
   460→  ), [positionedInSelectedShot]);
   461→  const {
   462→    isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot,
   463→    isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition,
   464→    handleAddToShot,
   465→    handleAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   466→  } = useShotPositioning({
   467→    media,
   468→    selectedShotId,
   469→    allShots: allShots || [],
   470→    positionedInSelectedShot: computedPositionedInSelectedShot,
   471→    associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot,
   472→    optimisticPositionedIds,
   473→    optimisticUnpositionedIds,
   474→    onNavigateToShot,
   475→    onClose,
   476→    onAddToShot,
   477→    onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   478→    onShowTick,
   479→    onShowSecondaryTick,
   480→    onOptimisticPositioned,
   481→    onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   482→  });
   483→
   484→  return {
   485→    isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot,
   486→    isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition,
   487→    handleAddToShot,
   488→    handleAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   489→    isCreatingShot,
   490→    quickCreateSuccess,
   491→    handleQuickCreateAndAdd,
   492→    handleQuickCreateSuccess,
   493→  };
   494→}
   495→
   496→function useSharedMakeMainVariantState(params: {
   497→  media: GenerationRow;
   498→  sourceGenerationData: GenerationRow | null;
   499→  isViewingNonPrimaryVariant: boolean;
   500→  activeVariant: GenerationVariant | null;
   501→  setPrimaryVariant: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
   502→  refetchVariants: () => void;
   503→  shotId?: string;
   504→  selectedShotId?: string;
   505→  onClose: () => void;
   506→}): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['makeMainVariant'] {
   507→  const {
   508→    media,
   509→    sourceGenerationData,
   510→    isViewingNonPrimaryVariant,
   511→    activeVariant,
   512→    setPrimaryVariant,
   513→    refetchVariants,
   514→    shotId,
   515→    selectedShotId,
   516→    onClose,
   517→  } = params;
   518→  const canMakeMainVariantFromChild = !!sourceGenerationData && !!media.location;
   519→  const canMakeMainVariantFromVariant = isViewingNonPrimaryVariant && !!activeVariant?.location;
   520→  const canMakeMainVariant = canMakeMainVariantFromChild || canMakeMainVariantFromVariant;
   521→  const { isMakingMainVariant, handleMakeMainVariant } = useMakeMainVariant({
   522→    media,
   523→    sourceGenerationData,
   524→    canMakeMainVariantFromChild,
   525→    canMakeMainVariantFromVariant,
   526→    activeVariant,
   527→    setPrimaryVariant,
   528→    refetchVariants,
   529→    shotId,
   530→    selectedShotId,
   531→    onClose,
   532→  });
   533→
   534→  return {
   535→    canMake: canMakeMainVariant,
   536→    canMakeFromChild: canMakeMainVariantFromChild,
   537→    canMakeFromVariant: canMakeMainVariantFromVariant,
   538→    isMaking: isMakingMainVariant,
   539→    handle: handleMakeMainVariant,
   540→  };
   541→}
   542→
   543→function useSharedButtonGroupState(params: {
   544→  input: UseSharedLightboxStateInput;
   545→  localStarred: boolean;
   546→  handleToggleStar: () => void;
   547→  toggleStarPending: boolean;
   548→  isAddingToReferences: boolean;
   549→  addToReferencesSuccess: boolean;
   550→  handleAddToReferences: () => Promise<void>;
   551→  handleAddToJoin: () => void;
   552→  isAddingToJoin: boolean;
   553→  addToJoinSuccess: boolean;
   554→  handleGoToJoin: () => void;
   555→}) {
   556→  const {
   557→    input,
   558→    localStarred,
   559→    handleToggleStar,
   560→    toggleStarPending,
   561→    isAddingToReferences,
   562→    addToReferencesSuccess,
   563→    handleAddToReferences,
   564→    handleAddToJoin,
   565→    isAddingToJoin,
   566→    addToJoinSuccess,
   567→    handleGoToJoin,
   568→  } = params;
   569→  const { media, onClose } = input.core;
   570→  const {
   571→    showDownload,
   572→    isDownloading,
   573→    onDelete,
   574→    isDeleting,
   575→    isUpscaling,
   576→    handleUpscale,
   577→  } = input.actions;
   578→  const handleDelete = useCallback(async () => {
   579→    if (!onDelete) return;
   580→    await invokeLightboxDelete(onDelete, media.id, 'MediaLightbox.delete');
   581→  }, [onDelete, media.id]);
   582→
   583→  return useMemo<LightboxButtonGroupProps>(() => ({
   584→    topRight: {
   585→      showDownload: !!showDownload,
   586→      isDownloading,
   587→      onDelete,
   588→      handleDelete,
   589→      isDeleting,
   590→      onClose,
   591→    },
   592→    bottomLeft: {
   593→      isUpscaling,
   594→      handleUpscale: async () => {
   595→        await Promise.resolve(handleUpscale());
   596→      },
   597→      localStarred,
   598→      handleToggleStar,
   599→      toggleStarPending,
   600→    },
   601→    bottomRight: {
   602→      isAddingToReferences,
   603→      addToReferencesSuccess,
   604→      handleAddToReferences,
   605→      handleAddToJoin,
   606→      isAddingToJoin,
   607→      addToJoinSuccess,
   608→      onGoToJoin: handleGoToJoin,
   609→    },
   610→  }), [
   611→    showDownload,
   612→    isDownloading,
   613→    onDelete,
   614→    handleDelete,
   615→    isDeleting,
   616→    onClose,
   617→    isUpscaling,
   618→    handleUpscale,
   619→    localStarred,
   620→    handleToggleStar,
   621→    toggleStarPending,
   622→    isAddingToReferences,
   623→    addToReferencesSuccess,
   624→    handleAddToReferences,
   625→    handleAddToJoin,
   626→    isAddingToJoin,
   627→    addToJoinSuccess,
   628→    handleGoToJoin,
   629→  ]);
   630→}
   631→
   632→export function useSharedLightboxState(input: UseSharedLightboxStateInput): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn {
   633→  const variantsState = useSharedVariantsState({ core: input.core });
   634→  const interactionState = useSharedLightboxInteractionState({
   635→    core: input.core,
   636→    shots: input.shots,
   637→    starred: input.starred,
   638→    onOpenExternalGeneration: input.onOpenExternalGeneration,
   639→  }, variantsState);
   640→  const presentationState = useLightboxPanelModel({
   641→    core: input.core,
   642→    navigation: input.navigation,
   643→    layout: input.layout,
   644→    actions: input.actions,
   645→    media: input.media,
   646→  }, variantsState, interactionState);
   647→
   648→  return {
   649→    variants: presentationState.variants,
   650→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef: presentationState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   651→    navigation: presentationState.navigation,
   652→    star: interactionState.star,
   653→    references: interactionState.references,
   654→    lineage: interactionState.lineage,
   655→    shots: interactionState.shots,
   656→    sourceGeneration: interactionState.sourceGeneration,
   657→    makeMainVariant: interactionState.makeMainVariant,
   658→    effectiveMedia: presentationState.effectiveMedia,
   659→    layout: presentationState.layout,
   660→    buttonGroupProps: presentationState.buttonGroupProps,
   661→  };
   662→}

   664→export interface SharedLightboxInteractionState {
   665→  star: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['star'];
   666→  references: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['references'];
   667→  lineage: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['lineage'];
   668→  shots: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['shots'];
   669→  sourceGeneration: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['sourceGeneration'];
   670→  makeMainVariant: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['makeMainVariant'];
   671→}
   672→
   673→export function useSharedLightboxInteractionState(
   674→  input: SharedInteractionInput,
   675→  variantsState: SharedVariantsStateResult,
   676→): SharedLightboxInteractionState {
   677→  const star = useStarToggle({
   678→    media: input.core.media,
   679→    starred: input.starred,
   680→    shotId: input.shots.shotId,
   681→  });
   682→  const referencesState = useReferences({
   683→    media: input.core.media,
   684→    selectedProjectId: input.core.selectedProjectId,
   685→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,
   686→    selectedShotId: input.shots.selectedShotId,
   687→  });
   688→  const joinState = useJoinClips({
   689→    media: input.core.media,
   690→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,
   691→    selectedProjectId: input.core.selectedProjectId,
   692→  });
   693→  const lineageState = useGenerationLineage({
   694→    media: input.core.media,
   695→    enabled: !input.core.isFormOnlyMode,
   696→  });
   697→  const shots = useLightboxShotActions(input);
   698→  const { sourceGenerationData, sourcePrimaryVariant } = useSourceGeneration({
   699→    media: input.core.media,
   700→    onOpenExternalGeneration: input.onOpenExternalGeneration,
   701→  });
   702→  const makeMainVariant = useSharedMakeMainVariantState({
   703→    media: input.core.media,
   704→    sourceGenerationData,
   705→    isViewingNonPrimaryVariant: variantsState.isViewingNonPrimaryVariant,
   706→    activeVariant: variantsState.activeVariant,
   707→    setPrimaryVariant: variantsState.setPrimaryVariant,
   708→    refetchVariants: variantsState.refetchVariants,
   709→    shotId: input.shots.shotId,
   710→    selectedShotId: input.shots.selectedShotId,
   711→    onClose: input.core.onClose,
   712→  });
   713→
   714→  return {
   715→    star: {
   716→      localStarred: star.localStarred,
   717→      setLocalStarred: star.setLocalStarred,
   718→      toggleStarMutation: star.toggleStarMutation,
   719→      handleToggleStar: star.handleToggleStar,
   720→    },
   721→    references: {
   722→      isAddingToReferences: referencesState.isAddingToReferences,
   723→      addToReferencesSuccess: referencesState.addToReferencesSuccess,
   724→      handleAddToReferences: referencesState.handleAddToReferences,
   725→      isAddingToJoin: joinState.isAddingToJoin,
   726→      addToJoinSuccess: joinState.addToJoinSuccess,
   727→      handleAddToJoin: joinState.handleAddToJoin,
   728→      handleGoToJoin: joinState.handleGoToJoin,
   729→    },
   730→    lineage: {
   731→      derivedItems: lineageState.derivedItems || [],
   732→      derivedGenerations: lineageState.derivedGenerations || [],
   733→      derivedPage: lineageState.derivedPage,
   734→      derivedTotalPages: lineageState.derivedTotalPages,
   735→      paginatedDerived: lineageState.paginatedDerived || [],
   736→      setDerivedPage: lineageState.setDerivedPage,
   737→    },
   738→    shots,
   739→    sourceGeneration: {
   740→      data: sourceGenerationData,

   433→
   434→export function useInlineEditState(
   435→  media: GenerationRow,
   436→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   437→): InlineEditStateResult {
   438→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   439→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   440→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   441→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   442→
   443→  useEffect(() => {
   444→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   445→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   446→
   447→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   448→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   449→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   450→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   451→
   452→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   453→
   454→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   455→    media,
   456→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   457→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   458→      : undefined,
   459→  });
   460→
   461→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   462→
   463→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   464→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   465→  };
   466→
   467→  const {
   468→    inpaintingState,
   469→    transformState,
   470→    generationState,
   471→    imageEditValue,
   472→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   473→    env,
   474→    persistence,
   475→    inpainting,
   476→    magic,
   477→    reposition,
   478→    img2img,
   479→    starToggle,
   480→    handleDownload,
   481→  });
   482→
   483→  return {
   484→    media,
   485→    canvasEnvironment: {
   486→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   487→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   488→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   489→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   490→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   491→      effectiveImageUrl,
   492→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   493→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   494→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   495→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   496→    },
   497→    inpaintingState,
   498→    transformState,
   499→    generationState,
   500→    variants: {
   501→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   502→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   503→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   504→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   505→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   506→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   507→    },
   508→    sourceGenerationData,
   509→    availableLoras,
   510→    imageEditValue,
   511→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   512→}
