    97→    const clampedTime = Math.min(Math.max(0.001, time), video.duration - 0.01);
    98→
    99→    if (!Number.isFinite(clampedTime)) {
   100→      callback(null);
   101→      isExtractingRef.current = false;
   102→      processExtractionQueue();
   103→      return;
   104→    }
   105→
   106→    const handleSeeked = () => {
   107→      video.removeEventListener('seeked', handleSeeked);
   108→
   109→      // Set canvas size to match video aspect ratio
   110→      const aspectRatio = video.videoWidth / video.videoHeight;
   111→      if (!Number.isFinite(aspectRatio) || aspectRatio <= 0) {
   112→        callback(null);
   113→        isExtractingRef.current = false;
   114→        processExtractionQueue();
   115→        return;
   116→      }
   117→
   118→      canvas.width = 160;
   119→      canvas.height = Math.round(160 / aspectRatio);
   120→
   121→      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   122→      const frame = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.8);
   123→      callback(frame);
   124→      isExtractingRef.current = false;
   125→      // Process next in queue
   126→      processExtractionQueue();
   127→    };
   128→
   129→    video.addEventListener('seeked', handleSeeked);
   130→    video.currentTime = clampedTime;
   131→  }, []);
   132→
   133→  // Queue a frame extraction (returns via callback to ensure sequential processing)
   134→  const queueFrameExtraction = useCallback((time: number, callback: (frame: string | null) => void) => {
   135→    extractionQueueRef.current.push({ time, callback });
   136→    processExtractionQueue();
   137→  }, [processExtractionQueue]);
   138→
   139→  // Throttle refs for live updates while dragging
   140→  const lastStartUpdateRef = useRef<number>(0);
   141→  const lastEndUpdateRef = useRef<number>(0);
   142→  const pendingStartUpdateRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   143→  const pendingEndUpdateRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   144→  const prevStartTrimRef = useRef<number>(trimState.startTrim);
   145→  const prevEndTrimRef = useRef<number>(trimState.endTrim);
   146→  const initialExtractionDoneRef = useRef(false);
   147→
   148→  // Initial extraction - extract both frames sequentially when video becomes ready
   149→  useEffect(() => {
   150→    if (!videoUrl || !isVideoReady || trimState.videoDuration === 0) return;
   151→    if (initialExtractionDoneRef.current) return;
   152→
   153→    initialExtractionDoneRef.current = true;
   154→
   155→    // Queue start frame first, then end frame (sequential processing)
   156→    const startTime = trimState.startTrim;
   157→    const endTime = Math.max(0.001, trimState.videoDuration - trimState.endTrim - 0.1);
   158→
   159→    if (Number.isFinite(startTime)) {
   160→      queueFrameExtraction(startTime, (frame) => {
   161→        setStartFrame(frame);
   162→        lastStartUpdateRef.current = Date.now();
   163→      });
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    if (Number.isFinite(endTime)) {
   167→      queueFrameExtraction(endTime, (frame) => {
   168→        setEndFrame(frame);
   169→        lastEndUpdateRef.current = Date.now();
   170→      });
   171→    }
   172→  }, [videoUrl, isVideoReady, trimState.videoDuration, trimState.startTrim, trimState.endTrim, queueFrameExtraction]);
   173→
   174→  // Reset initial extraction flag when URL changes
   175→  useEffect(() => {
   176→    initialExtractionDoneRef.current = false;
   177→  }, [videoUrl]);
   178→
   179→  // Update START frame when startTrim changes (after initial extraction)
   180→  useEffect(() => {
   181→    if (!videoUrl || !isVideoReady || trimState.videoDuration === 0) return;
   182→    if (!initialExtractionDoneRef.current) return; // Wait for initial extraction
   183→
   184→    // Skip if startTrim hasn't actually changed
   185→    if (prevStartTrimRef.current === trimState.startTrim) return;
   186→    prevStartTrimRef.current = trimState.startTrim;
   187→
   188→    const updateStartFrame = () => {
   189→      const keepStartTime = trimState.startTrim;
   190→
   191→      if (!Number.isFinite(keepStartTime)) return;
   192→
   193→      queueFrameExtraction(keepStartTime, (frame) => {
   194→        setStartFrame(frame);
   195→        lastStartUpdateRef.current = Date.now();
   196→      });
   197→    };
   198→
   199→    // Clear any pending update
   200→    if (pendingStartUpdateRef.current) {
   201→      clearTimeout(pendingStartUpdateRef.current);
   202→      pendingStartUpdateRef.current = null;
   203→    }
   204→
   205→    const now = Date.now();
   206→    const timeSinceLastUpdate = now - lastStartUpdateRef.current;
   207→    const throttleMs = 60;
   208→
   209→    if (timeSinceLastUpdate >= throttleMs) {
   210→      updateStartFrame();
   211→    } else {
   212→      pendingStartUpdateRef.current = setTimeout(updateStartFrame, throttleMs - timeSinceLastUpdate);
   213→    }
   214→
   215→    return () => {
   216→      if (pendingStartUpdateRef.current) {
   217→        clearTimeout(pendingStartUpdateRef.current);
   218→        pendingStartUpdateRef.current = null;
   219→      }
   220→    };
   221→  }, [videoUrl, isVideoReady, trimState.startTrim, trimState.videoDuration, queueFrameExtraction]);
   222→
   223→  // Update END frame when endTrim changes (after initial extraction)
   224→  useEffect(() => {
   225→    if (!videoUrl || !isVideoReady || trimState.videoDuration === 0) return;
   226→    if (!initialExtractionDoneRef.current) return; // Wait for initial extraction
   227→
   228→    // Skip if endTrim hasn't actually changed
   229→    if (prevEndTrimRef.current === trimState.endTrim) return;
   230→    prevEndTrimRef.current = trimState.endTrim;
   231→
   232→    const updateEndFrame = () => {
   233→      const keepEndTime = trimState.videoDuration - trimState.endTrim;
   234→
   235→      if (!Number.isFinite(keepEndTime)) return;
   236→
   237→      queueFrameExtraction(Math.max(0.001, keepEndTime - 0.1), (frame) => {
   238→        setEndFrame(frame);
   239→        lastEndUpdateRef.current = Date.now();
   240→      });
   241→    };
   242→
   243→    // Clear any pending update
   244→    if (pendingEndUpdateRef.current) {
   245→      clearTimeout(pendingEndUpdateRef.current);
   246→      pendingEndUpdateRef.current = null;
   247→    }
   248→
   249→    const now = Date.now();
   250→    const timeSinceLastUpdate = now - lastEndUpdateRef.current;
   251→    const throttleMs = 60;
   252→
   253→    if (timeSinceLastUpdate >= throttleMs) {
   254→      updateEndFrame();
   255→    } else {
   256→      pendingEndUpdateRef.current = setTimeout(updateEndFrame, throttleMs - timeSinceLastUpdate);
   257→    }
   258→
   259→    return () => {
   260→      if (pendingEndUpdateRef.current) {
   261→        clearTimeout(pendingEndUpdateRef.current);
   262→        pendingEndUpdateRef.current = null;
   263→      }
   264→    };
   265→  }, [videoUrl, isVideoReady, trimState.endTrim, trimState.videoDuration, queueFrameExtraction]);

   324→
   325→        {/* Frame previews */}
   326→        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
   327→          <div className="space-y-2">
   328→            <span className={cn(labelSize, 'text-muted-foreground block text-center')}>First frame</span>
   329→            <div className="aspect-video bg-muted/30 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border relative">
   330→              {startFrame ? (
   331→                <img src={startFrame} alt="Start frame" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
   332→              ) : (
   333→                <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
   334→                  {isExtractingFrames ? (
   335→                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
   336→                  ) : (
   337→                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No frame</span>
   338→                  )}
   339→                </div>
   340→              )}
   341→            </div>
   342→            <span className={cn(labelSize, 'text-primary block text-center font-medium')}>

   344→            </span>
   345→          </div>
   346→          <div className="space-y-2">
   347→            <span className={cn(labelSize, 'text-muted-foreground block text-center')}>Last frame</span>
   348→            <div className="aspect-video bg-muted/30 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border relative">
   349→              {endFrame ? (

   351→              ) : (

   353→                  {isExtractingFrames ? (

   406→            </>

   409→              <Scissors className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
   410→              Save trimmed video
   411→            </>
   412→          )}
   413→        </Button>
   414→      </div>
   415→    </div>
   416→  );
   417→};

   234→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   235→      isFormOnlyMode: false,
   236→      onClose: props.onClose,
   237→      readOnly: props.readOnly ?? false,
   238→      variantFetchGenerationId: env.variantFetchGenerationId,
   239→      initialVariantId: props.initialVariantId,
   240→    },
   241→    navigation: {
   242→      showNavigation: navigation?.showNavigation,
   243→      hasNext: navigation?.hasNext ?? false,
   244→      hasPrevious: navigation?.hasPrevious ?? false,
   245→      handleSlotNavNext,
   246→      handleSlotNavPrev,
   247→      swipeDisabled: modeSnapshot.isMagicEditMode || (props.readOnly ?? false),
   248→    },
   249→    shots: {
   250→      shotId: props.shotId,
   251→      selectedShotId: props.shotWorkflow?.selectedShotId,
   252→      allShots: props.shotWorkflow?.allShots,
   253→      onShotChange: props.shotWorkflow?.onShotChange,
   254→      onAddToShot: props.shotWorkflow?.onAddToShot,
   255→      onAddToShotWithoutPosition: props.shotWorkflow?.onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   256→      onNavigateToShot: props.shotWorkflow?.onNavigateToShot,
   257→      onShowTick: props.shotWorkflow?.onShowTick,
   258→      onShowSecondaryTick: props.shotWorkflow?.onShowSecondaryTick,
   259→      onOptimisticPositioned: props.shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticPositioned,
   260→      onOptimisticUnpositioned: props.shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   261→      optimisticPositionedIds: props.shotWorkflow?.optimisticPositionedIds,
   262→      optimisticUnpositionedIds: props.shotWorkflow?.optimisticUnpositionedIds,
   263→      positionedInSelectedShot: props.shotWorkflow?.positionedInSelectedShot,
   264→      associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot: props.shotWorkflow?.associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot,
   265→    },
   266→    layout: {
   267→      showTaskDetails: props.features?.showTaskDetails,
   268→      isSpecialEditMode: modeSnapshot.isMagicEditMode,
   269→      isInpaintMode: modeSnapshot.isInpaintMode,
   270→      isMagicEditMode: modeSnapshot.isMagicEditMode,
   271→    },
   272→    actions: {
   273→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   274→      showDownload: props.features?.showDownload,
   275→      isDownloading: env.isDownloading,
   276→      setIsDownloading: env.setIsDownloading,
   277→      onDelete: props.actions?.onDelete,
   278→      isDeleting: props.actions?.isDeleting,
   279→      isUpscaling: env.upscaleHook.isUpscaling,
   280→      handleUpscale: () => {
   281→        void env.upscaleHook.handleUpscale({ scaleFactor: 2, noiseScale: 0.1 });
   282→      },
   283→    },
   284→    media: {
   285→      effectiveImageUrl: env.upscaleHook.effectiveImageUrl,
   286→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions || { width: 1024, height: 1024 },
   287→      projectAspectRatio: env.projectAspectRatio,
   288→    },
   289→    starred: props.actions?.starred,
   290→    onOpenExternalGeneration: props.onOpenExternalGeneration,
   291→  }), [
   292→    env.selectedProjectId,
   293→    env.isMobile,
   294→    env.variantFetchGenerationId,
   295→    env.isCloudMode,
   296→    env.isDownloading,
   297→    env.setIsDownloading,
   298→    env.upscaleHook,
   299→    env.imageDimensions,
   300→    env.projectAspectRatio,
   301→    props.media,
   302→    props.onClose,
   303→    props.readOnly,
   304→    props.initialVariantId,
   305→    props.shotId,
   306→    props.shotWorkflow,
   307→    props.features?.showTaskDetails,
   308→    props.features?.showDownload,
   309→    props.actions,
   310→    props.onOpenExternalGeneration,
   311→    navigation?.showNavigation,
   312→    navigation?.hasNext,
   313→    navigation?.hasPrevious,
   314→    handleSlotNavNext,
   315→    handleSlotNavPrev,
   316→    modeSnapshot.isMagicEditMode,
   317→    modeSnapshot.isInpaintMode,
   318→  ]);
   319→  const sharedState = useSharedLightboxState(sharedInput);
   320→
   321→  useEffect(() => {
   322→    upscaleHook.setActiveVariant(sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.location, sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.id);
   323→  }, [
   324→    sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.location,
   325→    sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.id,

   328→
   329→  return {
   330→    sharedState,

   333→    modeSnapshot,
   334→    setModeSnapshot,
   335→  };

   338→type ImageLightboxSharedModel = ReturnType<typeof useImageLightboxSharedState>;
   339→
   340→function useImageLightboxEditing(
   341→  props: ImageLightboxProps,
   342→  env: ImageLightboxEnvironment,
   343→  sharedModel: ImageLightboxSharedModel,
   344→) {
   345→  const {
   346→    media,
   347→    taskDetailsData,
   348→    initialVariantId,
   349→    toolTypeOverride,
   350→    shotId,
   351→  } = props;
   352→  const initialActive = props.features?.initialEditActive ?? false;
   353→
   354→  const {
   355→    selectedProjectId,
   356→    actualGenerationId,
   357→    imageDimensions,
   358→    imageContainerRef,
   359→    editSettingsPersistence,
   360→    effectiveEditModeLoRAs,
   361→    availableLoras,
   362→    variantFetchGenerationId,
   363→  } = env;
   364→
   365→  const {
   366→    sharedState,
   367→    setModeSnapshot,
   368→  } = sharedModel;
   369→
   370→  const editOrchestrator = useImageEditOrchestrator({
   371→    mediaContext: {
   372→      media,
   373→      selectedProjectId,
   374→      actualGenerationId,
   375→      shotId,
   376→      toolTypeOverride,
   377→      initialActive,
   378→      thumbnailUrl: sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.thumbnail_url || media.thumbUrl,
   379→    },
   380→    displayContext: {
   381→      imageDimensions,
   382→      imageContainerRef,
   383→      effectiveImageUrl: env.upscaleHook.effectiveImageUrl,
   384→    },
   385→    variantContext: {
   386→      activeVariant: sharedState.variants.activeVariant,
   387→      setActiveVariantId: sharedState.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   388→      refetchVariants: sharedState.variants.refetch,
   389→    },
   390→    settingsContext: editSettingsPersistence,
   391→    loraContext: {
   392→      effectiveEditModeLoRAs,
   393→      availableLoras,
   394→    },
   395→  });
   396→
   397→  useEffect(() => {
   398→    setModeSnapshot((current) => {
   399→      if (
   400→        current.isInpaintMode === editOrchestrator.isInpaintMode
   401→        && current.isMagicEditMode === editOrchestrator.isMagicEditMode
   402→      ) {
   403→        return current;
   404→      }
   405→      return {
   406→        isInpaintMode: editOrchestrator.isInpaintMode,
   407→        isMagicEditMode: editOrchestrator.isMagicEditMode,
   408→      };
   409→    });
   410→  }, [
   411→    editOrchestrator.isInpaintMode,
   412→    editOrchestrator.isMagicEditMode,
   413→    setModeSnapshot,
   414→  ]);
   415→
   416→  const { adjustedTaskDetailsData } = useAdjustedTaskDetails({
   417→    projectId: selectedProjectId ?? null,
   418→    activeVariant: sharedState.variants.activeVariant,
   419→    taskDetailsData,
   420→    isLoadingVariants: sharedState.variants.isLoading,
   421→    initialVariantId,
   422→  });
   423→
   424→  usePanelModeRestore({
   425→    mediaId: media.id,
   426→    persistedPanelMode: editSettingsPersistence.panelMode,
   427→    isVideo: false,
   428→    isSpecialEditMode: editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode,
   429→    isInVideoEditMode: false,
   430→    initialVideoTrimMode: false,
   431→    initialEditActive: initialActive,
   432→    handleEnterMagicEditMode: editOrchestrator.handleEnterMagicEditMode,
   433→  });
   434→
   435→  const variantBadges = useLightboxVariantBadges({
   436→    pendingTaskGenerationId: env.actualGenerationId,
   437→    selectedProjectId,
   438→    variants: sharedState.variants.list,
   439→    variantFetchGenerationId,
   440→  });
   441→
   442→  return {
   443→    editOrchestrator,
   444→    adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   445→    variantBadges,
   446→  };
   447→}

   449→type ImageLightboxEditModel = ReturnType<typeof useImageLightboxEditing>;
   450→
   451→function useImageLightboxControlsPanel(
   452→  props: ImageLightboxProps,
   453→  env: ImageLightboxEnvironment,
   454→  sharedModel: ImageLightboxSharedModel,
   455→  editModel: ImageLightboxEditModel,
   456→  showPanel: boolean,
   457→  panelVariant: 'desktop' | 'mobile',
   458→  panelTaskId: string | null,
   459→) {
   460→  const {
   461→    media,
   462→    shotId,
   463→    onOpenExternalGeneration,
   464→  } = props;
   465→  const selectedShotId = props.shotWorkflow?.selectedShotId;
   466→  const showImageEditTools = props.features?.showImageEditTools ?? true;
   467→
   468→  const {
   469→    sharedState,
   470→  } = sharedModel;
   471→
   472→  const { editOrchestrator, adjustedTaskDetailsData } = editModel;
   473→  const primaryVariantId = sharedState.variants.primaryVariant?.id;
   474→
   475→  return useMemo(() => {
   476→    if (!showPanel) {
   477→      return undefined;
   478→    }
   479→
   480→    if (editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode) {
   481→      return (
   482→        <EditModePanel
   483→          variant={panelVariant}
   484→          taskId={panelTaskId}
   485→          currentMediaId={media.id}
   486→          actions={{
   487→            handleUnifiedGenerate: editOrchestrator.handleUnifiedGenerate,
   488→            handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit: editOrchestrator.handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit,
   489→            handleGenerateReposition: editOrchestrator.handleGenerateReposition,
   490→            handleSaveAsVariant: editOrchestrator.handleSaveAsVariant,
   491→            handleGenerateImg2Img: editOrchestrator.handleGenerateImg2Img,
   492→          }}
   493→          upscale={{
   494→            isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   495→            handleUpscale: async () => {
   496→              await env.upscaleHook.handleUpscale({ scaleFactor: 2, noiseScale: 0.1 });
   497→            },
   498→            isUpscaling: env.upscaleHook.isUpscaling,
   499→            upscaleSuccess: env.upscaleHook.upscaleSuccess,
   500→          }}
   501→          lora={{
   502→            img2imgLoraManager: editOrchestrator.img2imgLoraManager,
   503→            editLoraManager: env.editLoraManager,
   504→            availableLoras: env.availableLoras,
   505→          }}
   506→          advanced={{
   507→            advancedSettings: env.editSettingsPersistence.advancedSettings,
   508→            setAdvancedSettings: env.editSettingsPersistence.setAdvancedSettings,
   509→          }}
   510→          isLocalGeneration={env.isLocalGeneration}
   511→        />
   512→      );
   513→    }
   514→
   515→    return (
   516→      <InfoPanel
   517→        variant={panelVariant}
   518→        showImageEditTools={showImageEditTools}
   519→        taskPanel={{
   520→          taskDetailsData: adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   521→          derivedItems: sharedState.lineage.derivedItems,
   522→          derivedGenerations: sharedState.lineage.derivedGenerations,
   523→          paginatedDerived: sharedState.lineage.paginatedDerived,
   524→          derivedPage: sharedState.lineage.derivedPage,
   525→          derivedTotalPages: sharedState.lineage.derivedTotalPages,
   526→          onSetDerivedPage: sharedState.lineage.setDerivedPage,
   527→          onNavigateToGeneration: onOpenExternalGeneration,
   528→          currentMediaId: media.id,
   529→          currentShotId: selectedShotId || shotId,
   530→          replaceImages: env.replaceImages,
   531→          onReplaceImagesChange: env.setReplaceImages,
   532→          onSwitchToPrimary: primaryVariantId
   533→            ? () => sharedState.variants.setActiveVariantId(primaryVariantId)
   534→            : undefined,
   535→        }}
   536→        taskId={panelTaskId}
   537→      />
   538→    );
   539→  }, [
   540→    showPanel,
   541→    editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode,
   542→    panelVariant,
   543→    onOpenExternalGeneration,
   544→    selectedShotId,
   545→    shotId,
   546→    panelTaskId,
   547→    media.id,
   548→    editOrchestrator.handleUnifiedGenerate,
   549→    editOrchestrator.handleGenerateAnnotatedEdit,
   550→    editOrchestrator.handleGenerateReposition,
   551→    editOrchestrator.handleSaveAsVariant,
   552→    editOrchestrator.handleGenerateImg2Img,
   553→    env.isCloudMode,
   554→    env.upscaleHook,
   555→    editOrchestrator.img2imgLoraManager,
   556→    env.editLoraManager,
   557→    env.availableLoras,
   558→    env.editSettingsPersistence.advancedSettings,
   559→    env.editSettingsPersistence.setAdvancedSettings,
   560→    env.isLocalGeneration,
   561→    showImageEditTools,
   562→    adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   563→    primaryVariantId,
   564→    sharedState.lineage.derivedItems,
   565→    sharedState.lineage.derivedGenerations,
   566→    sharedState.lineage.paginatedDerived,
   567→    sharedState.lineage.derivedPage,
   568→    sharedState.lineage.derivedTotalPages,
   569→    sharedState.lineage.setDerivedPage,
   570→    env.replaceImages,
   571→    env.setReplaceImages,
   572→    sharedState.variants,
   573→  ]);
   574→}
   575→
   576→function useImageLightboxRenderModel(
   577→  props: ImageLightboxProps,
   578→  env: ImageLightboxEnvironment,
   579→  sharedModel: ImageLightboxSharedModel,
   580→  editModel: ImageLightboxEditModel,
   581→) {
   582→  const {
   583→    media,
   584→    onClose,
   585→    readOnly = false,
   586→    showTickForImageId,
   587→    showTickForSecondaryImageId,
   588→    adjacentSegments,
   589→  } = props;
   590→
   591→  const navigation = props.navigation;
   592→  const shotWorkflow = props.shotWorkflow;
   593→  const features = props.features;
   594→  const actions = props.actions;
   595→
   596→  const { sharedState, handleSlotNavNext, handleSlotNavPrev } = sharedModel;
   597→  const { editOrchestrator, adjustedTaskDetailsData, variantBadges } = editModel;
   598→
   599→  const lightboxVariants = useMemo(() => ({
   600→    variants: sharedState.variants.list,
   601→    activeVariant: sharedState.variants.activeVariant,
   602→    primaryVariant: sharedState.variants.primaryVariant,
   603→    isLoadingVariants: sharedState.variants.isLoading,
   604→    handleVariantSelect: sharedState.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   605→    handleMakePrimary: sharedState.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   606→    handleDeleteVariant: sharedState.variants.deleteVariant,
   607→    onLoadVariantSettings: env.setVariantParamsToLoad,
   608→    promoteSuccess: sharedState.variants.promoteSuccess,
   609→    isPromoting: sharedState.variants.isPromoting,
   610→    handlePromoteToGeneration: sharedState.variants.handlePromoteToGeneration,
   611→    isMakingMainVariant: sharedState.makeMainVariant.isMaking,
   612→    canMakeMainVariant: sharedState.makeMainVariant.canMake,
   613→    handleMakeMainVariant: sharedState.makeMainVariant.handle,
   614→    pendingTaskCount: variantBadges.pendingTaskCount,
   615→    unviewedVariantCount: variantBadges.unviewedVariantCount,
   616→    onMarkAllViewed: variantBadges.handleMarkAllViewed,
   617→    variantsSectionRef: env.variantsSectionRef,
   618→  }), [
   619→    sharedState.variants.list,
   620→    sharedState.variants.activeVariant,
   621→    sharedState.variants.primaryVariant,
   622→    sharedState.variants.isLoading,
   623→    sharedState.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   624→    sharedState.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   625→    sharedState.variants.deleteVariant,
   626→    env.setVariantParamsToLoad,
   627→    sharedState.variants.promoteSuccess,
   628→    sharedState.variants.isPromoting,
   629→    sharedState.variants.handlePromoteToGeneration,
   630→    sharedState.makeMainVariant.isMaking,
   631→    sharedState.makeMainVariant.canMake,
   632→    sharedState.makeMainVariant.handle,
   633→    variantBadges.pendingTaskCount,
   634→    variantBadges.unviewedVariantCount,
   635→    variantBadges.handleMarkAllViewed,
   636→    env.variantsSectionRef,
   637→  ]);
   638→  const lightboxStateValue = useMemo(() => ({
   639→    core: {
   640→      onClose,
   641→      readOnly,
   642→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   643→      isTabletOrLarger: sharedState.layout.isTabletOrLarger,
   644→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   645→      actualGenerationId: env.actualGenerationId,
   646→    },
   647→    media: {
   648→      media,
   649→      isVideo: false,
   650→      effectiveMediaUrl: sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl ?? '',
   651→      effectiveVideoUrl: '',
   652→      effectiveImageDimensions: sharedState.effectiveMedia.imageDimensions,
   653→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   654→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   655→    },
   656→    variants: lightboxVariants,
   657→    navigation: {
   658→      showNavigation: navigation?.showNavigation ?? true,
   659→      hasNext: navigation?.hasNext ?? false,
   660→      hasPrevious: navigation?.hasPrevious ?? false,
   661→      handleSlotNavNext,
   662→      handleSlotNavPrev,
   663→      swipeNavigation: sharedState.navigation.swipeNavigation,
   664→    },
   665→  }), [
   666→    onClose,
   667→    readOnly,
   668→    env.isMobile,
   669→    sharedState.layout.isTabletOrLarger,
   670→    env.selectedProjectId,
   671→    env.actualGenerationId,
   672→    media,
   673→    sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl,
   674→    sharedState.effectiveMedia.imageDimensions,
   675→    env.imageDimensions,
   676→    env.setImageDimensions,
   677→    lightboxVariants,
   678→    navigation?.showNavigation,
   679→    navigation?.hasNext,
   680→    navigation?.hasPrevious,
   681→    handleSlotNavNext,
   682→    handleSlotNavPrev,
   683→    sharedState.navigation.swipeNavigation,
   684→  ]);
   685→
   686→  const handleDownload = useCallback(() => {
   687→    return handleLightboxDownload({
   688→      intendedVariantId: sharedState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef.current,
   689→      variants: sharedState.variants.list,
   690→      fallbackUrl: sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl ?? '',
   691→      media,
   692→      isVideo: false,
   693→      setIsDownloading: env.setIsDownloading,
   694→    });
   695→  }, [
   696→    sharedState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   697→    sharedState.variants.list,
   698→    sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl,
   699→    media,
   700→    env.setIsDownloading,
   701→  ]);
   702→
   703→  const handleDelete = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
   704→    if (!actions?.onDelete) {
   705→      return;
   706→    }
   707→    await invokeLightboxDelete(actions.onDelete, media.id, 'ImageLightbox.delete');
   708→  }, [actions?.onDelete, media.id]);
   709→
   710→  const onApplySettings = actions?.onApplySettings;
   711→  const handleApplySettings = useCallback(() => {
   712→    onApplySettings?.(media.metadata);
   713→  }, [onApplySettings, media.metadata]);
   714→
   715→  const onNavigateToShot = shotWorkflow?.onNavigateToShot;
   716→  const handleNavigateToShotFromSelector = useCallback((shot: { id: string; name: string }) => {
   717→    if (!onNavigateToShot) return;
   718→    const minimalShot = { id: shot.id, name: shot.name, images: [], position: 0 };
   719→    onClose();
   720→    onNavigateToShot(minimalShot);
   721→  }, [onClose, onNavigateToShot]);
   722→
   723→  const showTaskDetails = features?.showTaskDetails ?? false;
   724→
   725→  const needsFullscreenLayout = true;
   726→  const needsTasksPaneOffset = needsFullscreenLayout
   727→    && (env.effectiveTasksPaneOpen || env.isTasksPaneLocked)
   728→    && !sharedState.layout.isPortraitMode
   729→    && sharedState.layout.isTabletOrLarger;
   730→
   731→  const accessibilityTitle = `Image Lightbox - ${media?.id?.substring(0, 8)}`;
   732→  const accessibilityDescription = 'View and interact with image in full screen. Use arrow keys to navigate, Escape to close.';
   733→
   734→  const showPanel = sharedState.layout.shouldShowSidePanel
   735→    || ((showTaskDetails || editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode) && env.isMobile);
   736→
   737→  const panelVariant = (sharedState.layout.shouldShowSidePanel && !env.isMobile) ? 'desktop' as const : 'mobile' as const;
   738→  const panelTaskId = adjustedTaskDetailsData?.taskId
   739→    || media?.source_task_id
   740→    || null;
   741→
   742→  const controlsPanelContent = useImageLightboxControlsPanel(
   743→    props,
   744→    env,
   745→    sharedModel,
   746→    editModel,
   747→    showPanel,
   748→    panelVariant,
   749→    panelTaskId,
   750→  );
   751→  const allShots = useMemo(() => shotWorkflow?.allShots ?? [], [shotWorkflow?.allShots]);
   752→  const selectedShotId = shotWorkflow?.selectedShotId;
   753→  const workflowBar = useMemo(() => ({
   754→    core: {
   755→      onDelete: actions?.onDelete,
   756→      onApplySettings: actions?.onApplySettings,
   757→      isSpecialEditMode: editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode,
   758→      isVideo: false,
   759→      handleApplySettings,
   760→    },
   761→    shotSelector: shotWorkflow?.onAddToShot
   762→      ? {
   763→          mediaId: env.actualGenerationId ?? media.id,
   764→          imageUrl: sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl ?? '',
   765→          thumbUrl: media.thumbUrl,
   766→          allShots,
   767→          selectedShotId,
   768→          onShotChange: shotWorkflow?.onShotChange,
   769→          onCreateShot: shotWorkflow?.onCreateShot,
   770→          isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot: sharedState.shots.isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot,
   771→          isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition: sharedState.shots.isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition,
   772→          showTickForImageId,
   773→          showTickForSecondaryImageId,
   774→          onAddToShot: shotWorkflow.onAddToShot,
   775→          onAddToShotWithoutPosition: shotWorkflow?.onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   776→          onAddVariantAsNewGeneration: sharedState.variants.handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   777→          activeVariantId: sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.id || sharedState.variants.primaryVariant?.id,
   778→          currentTimelineFrame: media.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   779→          onShowTick: shotWorkflow?.onShowTick,
   780→          onOptimisticPositioned: shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticPositioned,
   781→          onShowSecondaryTick: shotWorkflow?.onShowSecondaryTick,
   782→          onOptimisticUnpositioned: shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   783→          isAdding: false,
   784→          isAddingWithoutPosition: false,
   785→          contentRef: env.contentRef,
   786→          onNavigateToShot: handleNavigateToShotFromSelector,
   787→          onClose,
   788→        }
   789→      : undefined,
   790→  } satisfies WorkflowControlsBarProps), [
   791→    actions?.onDelete,
   792→    actions?.onApplySettings,
   793→    editOrchestrator.isSpecialEditMode,
   794→    handleApplySettings,
   795→    shotWorkflow?.onAddToShot,
   796→    env.actualGenerationId,
   797→    env.contentRef,
   798→    media.id,
   799→    media.thumbUrl,
   800→    media.timeline_frame,
   801→    sharedState.effectiveMedia.mediaUrl,
   802→    allShots,
   803→    selectedShotId,
   804→    shotWorkflow?.onShotChange,
   805→    shotWorkflow?.onCreateShot,
   806→    sharedState.shots.isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot,
   807→    sharedState.shots.isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition,
   808→    showTickForImageId,
   809→    showTickForSecondaryImageId,
   810→    shotWorkflow?.onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   811→    shotWorkflow?.onShowTick,
   812→    shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticPositioned,
   813→    shotWorkflow?.onShowSecondaryTick,
   814→    shotWorkflow?.onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   815→    handleNavigateToShotFromSelector,
   816→    onClose,
   817→    sharedState.variants.handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   818→    sharedState.variants.activeVariant?.id,

   308→export function useSharedVariantsState(input: SharedVariantsInput): SharedVariantsStateResult {
   309→  const {
   310→    media,
   311→    isFormOnlyMode,
   312→    variantFetchGenerationId,
   313→    initialVariantId,
   314→    selectedProjectId,
   315→  } = input.core;

   317→    variants,
   318→    primaryVariant,

   322→    refetch: refetchVariants,
   323→    setPrimaryVariant,
   324→    deleteVariant,
   325→  } = useVariants({
   326→    generationId: variantFetchGenerationId,
   327→    enabled: !isFormOnlyMode,
   328→  });
   329→  const { setActiveVariantId: baseSetActiveVariantId, isViewingNonPrimaryVariant } = useVariantSelection({
   330→    media,
   331→    viewedGenerationId: variantFetchGenerationId,
   332→    rawSetActiveVariantId,
   333→    activeVariant,
   334→    variants,
   335→    initialVariantId,
   336→  });
   337→  const intendedActiveVariantIdRef = useRef<string | null>(activeVariant?.id || null);
   338→  const {
   339→    promoteSuccess,
   340→    isPromoting,

   387→export function useLightboxNavigationModel(input: SharedNavigationInput): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['navigation'] {

   402→  const swipeNavigation = useSwipeNavigation({
   403→    onSwipeLeft: () => {
   404→      if (hasNext) handleSlotNavNext();
   405→    },
   406→    onSwipeRight: () => {
   407→      if (hasPrevious) handleSlotNavPrev();

   409→    disabled: swipeDisabled || readOnly || !showNavigation,
   410→    hasNext,
   411→    hasPrevious,
   412→    threshold: 50,
   413→    velocityThreshold: 0.3,
   414→  });
   415→
   416→  return {
   417→    safeClose,
   418→    activateClickShield,
   419→    swipeNavigation,
   420→  };

   551→                setLastAffectedShotId,
   552→              }}
   553→              status={{

   565→                quickCreateSuccess,
   566→                handleQuickCreateAndAdd,
   567→                handleQuickCreateSuccess,
   568→              }}
   569→              actions={{
   570→                onCreateShot,
   571→                onNavigateToShot: (shot) => navigateToShot(shot, { scrollToTop: true }),
   572→                onAddToShot: addToShot,
   573→                onAddToShotWithoutPosition: addToShotWithoutPosition,
   574→              }}
   575→            />
   576→          )}
   577→
   578→          {/* Timestamp - Top Right (hides on hover for images, stays visible for videos) */}
   579→          <TimeStamp
   580→            createdAt={image.createdAt}
   581→            position="top-right"
   582→            showOnHover={false}
   583→            hideOnHover={!isVideoContent}
   584→            className="z-30"
   585→          />
   586→
   587→          {/* Action buttons - Top Right (Info & Variants) - below shot selector on mobile */}
   588→          <div className={cn(
   589→            "absolute right-1.5 flex flex-col items-end gap-1.5 z-20",
   590→            isMobile ? "top-12" : "top-1.5 mt-8"
   591→          )}>
   592→              {/* Info Button + Variant Count + NEW badge Row (for non-video content) */}
   593→              <div className="flex flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
   594→                <InfoTooltip
   595→                image={image}
   596→                taskData={taskData}
   597→                inputImages={inputImages}
   598→                shouldShowMetadata={shouldShowMetadata}
   599→                shouldShowTaskDetails={shouldShowTaskDetails}
   600→                setIsInfoOpen={setIsInfoOpen}
   601→                isMobile={isMobile}
   602→              />
   603→
   604→                {/* "X new" badge + Variant Count - positioned to the right of Info button */}
   605→                {!isVideoContent && (
   606→                  <VariantBadge
   607→                    derivedCount={image.derivedCount}
   608→                    unviewedVariantCount={image.unviewedVariantCount}
   609→                    hasUnviewedVariants={image.hasUnviewedVariants}
   610→                    variant="inline"
   611→                    size="md"
   612→                    tooltipSide="right"
   613→                    onMarkAllViewed={handleMarkAllVariantsViewed}
   614→                  />
   615→                )}
   616→              </div>
   617→
   618→              {/* Share Button */}
   619→              {showShare && taskId && (
   620→                <TooltipProvider delayDuration={300}>
   621→                  <Tooltip>
   622→                    <TooltipTrigger asChild>
   623→                      <Button
   624→                        variant="secondary"
   625→                        size="icon"
   626→                        onClick={handleShare}
   627→                        disabled={isCreatingShare}
   628→                        className={`h-7 w-7 p-0 rounded-full text-white transition-all opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 ${
   629→                          shareCopied
   630→                            ? 'bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600'
   631→                            : 'bg-black/50 hover:bg-black/70'
   632→                        }`}
   633→                      >
   634→                        {isCreatingShare ? (
   635→                          <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
   636→                        ) : shareCopied ? (
   637→                          <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
   638→                        ) : shareSlug ? (
   639→                          <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
   640→                        ) : (
   641→                          <Share2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
   642→                        )}
   643→                      </Button>
   644→                    </TooltipTrigger>
   645→                    <TooltipContent side="left">
   646→                      <p>{shareCopied ? 'Link copied!' : shareSlug ? 'Copy share link' : 'Share this generation'}</p>
   647→                    </TooltipContent>
   648→                  </Tooltip>
   649→                </TooltipProvider>
   650→              )}
   651→          </div>
   652→
   653→          {/* Bottom Buttons - Star (left), Edit (center), Delete (right) */}
   654→          <ActionButtons
   655→            image={image}
   656→            localStarred={localStarred}
   657→            isTogglingStar={isTogglingStar}
   658→            isDeleting={isCurrentDeleting}
   659→            showStar={showStar}
   660→            showEdit={showEdit}
   661→            showDelete={showDelete}
   662→            onToggleStar={onToggleStar}
   663→            setIsTogglingStar={setIsTogglingStar}
   664→            setLocalStarred={setLocalStarred}
   665→            onOpenLightbox={onOpenLightbox}
   666→            onDelete={onDelete}
   667→          />
   668→      </>)
   669→      }
   670→    </div>
   671→  );
   672→
   673→  // On mobile, drag is already disabled by using the non-draggable branch.
   674→  return isMobile ? (
   675→    <React.Fragment key={imageKey}>
   676→      {imageContent}
   677→      {onCreateShot && (
   678→        <CreateShotModal
   679→          isOpen={isCreateShotModalOpen}
   680→          onClose={() => setIsCreateShotModalOpen(false)}
   681→          onSubmit={handleCreateShot}
   682→          isLoading={isCreatingShot}
   683→          projectId={selectedProjectId ?? undefined}
   684→        />
   685→      )}
   686→    </React.Fragment>
   687→  ) : (
   688→    <DraggableImage key={`draggable-${imageKey}`} image={image} onDoubleClick={() => onOpenLightbox(image)}>
   689→      {imageContent}
   690→      {onCreateShot && (
   691→        <CreateShotModal
   692→          isOpen={isCreateShotModalOpen}
   693→          onClose={() => setIsCreateShotModalOpen(false)}
   694→          onSubmit={handleCreateShot}
   695→          isLoading={isCreatingShot}
   696→          projectId={selectedProjectId ?? undefined}
   697→        />
   698→      )}
   699→    </DraggableImage>
   700→  );
   701→};
   702→

    99→  useEffect(() => {

   102→    const projectIdAtRequestStart = selectedProjectId;

   104→    pendingConsumeVersionRef.current = requestVersion;
   105→    let cancelled = false;
   106→
   107→    void consumePendingJoinClips({ projectId: projectIdAtRequestStart }).then(result => {
   108→      if (cancelled) {

   110→      }
   111→      const isCurrentRequest = (

   118→

   125→      }
   126→      const actions = result.value;
   127→      if (actions.length > 0) {
   128→        setClips(prev => applyPendingClipActions(prev, actions));
   129→      }
   130→    });

   106→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((p, i) =>
   107→            i === action.phaseIdx ? { ...p, ...action.updates } : p
   108→          ),
   109→        },
   110→      };
   111→
   112→    case 'UPDATE_PHASE_LORA':
   113→      return {
   114→        ...state,
   115→        editablePhaseConfig: {
   116→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
   117→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((p, i) => {
   118→            if (i !== action.phaseIdx) return p;
   119→            return { ...p, loras: p.loras.map((l, j) => j === action.loraIdx ? { ...l, ...action.updates } : l) };
   120→          }),
   121→        },
   122→      };
   123→
   124→    case 'ADD_LORA_TO_PHASE':
   125→      return {
   126→        ...state,
   127→        editablePhaseConfig: {
   128→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
   129→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((p, i) => {
   130→            if (i !== action.phaseIdx) return p;
   131→            return { ...p, loras: [...p.loras.filter(l => l.url?.trim()), { url: action.url, multiplier: action.multiplier }] };
   132→          }),
   133→        },
   134→      };
   135→
   136→    case 'REMOVE_LORA_FROM_PHASE':
   137→      return {
   138→        ...state,
   139→        editablePhaseConfig: {
   140→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
   141→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((p, i) => {
   142→            if (i !== action.phaseIdx) return p;
   143→            return { ...p, loras: p.loras.filter((_, j) => j !== action.loraIdx) };
   144→          }),
   145→        },
   146→      };
   147→
   148→    case 'SET_GENERATION_TYPE_MODE':
   149→      return { ...state, generationTypeMode: action.mode };
   150→
   151→    case 'SET_SUBMISSION_STATE':
   152→      return { ...state, isSubmitting: action.isSubmitting };
   153→
   154→    case 'RESET_FORM':
   155→      return {
   156→        ...state,
   157→        fields: {
   158→          name: '',
   159→          description: '',
   160→          created_by_is_you: true,
   161→          created_by_username: '',
   162→          is_public: action.defaultIsPublic,
   163→          basePrompt: '',
   164→          negativePrompt: '',
   165→          textBeforePrompts: '',
   166→          textAfterPrompts: '',
   167→          enhancePrompt: false,
   168→          durationFrames: 60,
   169→        },
   170→        editablePhaseConfig: action.phaseConfig,
   171→      };
   172→  }
   173→}
   174→
   175→function createInitialState(
   176→  editingPreset: AddNewTabProps['editingPreset'],
   177→  isOverwriting: boolean,
   178→  currentPhaseConfig: PhaseConfig | undefined,
   179→  currentSettings: AddNewTabProps['currentSettings'],
   180→  initialGenerationTypeMode: 'i2v' | 'vace',
   181→  defaultIsPublic: boolean,
   182→): FormState {
   183→  const generationTypeMode = (editingPreset?.metadata?.generationTypeMode && !isOverwriting)
   184→    ? editingPreset.metadata.generationTypeMode
   185→    : initialGenerationTypeMode;
   186→
   187→  const editablePhaseConfig = (editingPreset?.metadata?.phaseConfig && !isOverwriting)
   188→    ? editingPreset.metadata.phaseConfig
   189→    : (currentPhaseConfig || DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG);
   190→
   191→  return {
   192→    fields: {
   193→      name: generatePresetName(),
   194→      description: '',
   195→      created_by_is_you: true,
   196→      created_by_username: '',
   197→      is_public: defaultIsPublic,
   198→      basePrompt: currentSettings?.basePrompt || '',
   199→      negativePrompt: currentSettings?.negativePrompt || '',
   200→      textBeforePrompts: currentSettings?.textBeforePrompts || '',
   201→      textAfterPrompts: currentSettings?.textAfterPrompts || '',
   202→      enhancePrompt: currentSettings?.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   203→      durationFrames: currentSettings?.durationFrames || 60,
   204→    },
   205→    editablePhaseConfig,
   206→    generationTypeMode,
   207→    isSubmitting: false,
   208→  };
   209→}
   210→
   211→// --- Component ---
   212→
   213→export const AddNewPresetTab: React.FC<AddNewTabProps> = ({
   214→  createResource,
   215→  updateResource,
   216→  onSwitchToBrowse,
   217→  currentPhaseConfig,
   218→  editingPreset,
   219→  onClearEdit,
   220→  currentSettings,
   221→  isOverwriting = false,
   222→  availableLoras = [],
   223→  generationTypeMode: initialGenerationTypeMode = 'i2v',
   224→  defaultIsPublic
   225→}) => {
   226→  const isEditMode = !!editingPreset;
   227→
   228→  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
   229→    formReducer,
   230→    { editingPreset, isOverwriting, currentPhaseConfig, currentSettings, initialGenerationTypeMode, defaultIsPublic },
   231→    (args) => createInitialState(args.editingPreset, args.isOverwriting, args.currentPhaseConfig, args.currentSettings, args.initialGenerationTypeMode, args.defaultIsPublic),
   232→  );
   233→
   234→  const { fields: addForm, editablePhaseConfig, generationTypeMode, isSubmitting } = state;
   235→
   236→  const sampleFilesHook = usePresetSampleFiles();
   237→
   238→  // Phase config update helpers (stable callbacks dispatching to reducer)
   239→  const updatePhaseConfig = useCallback(<K extends keyof PhaseConfig>(field: K, value: PhaseConfig[K]) => {

   242→
   243→  const updatePhase = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, updates: Partial<PhaseConfig['phases'][0]>) => {
   244→    dispatch({ type: 'UPDATE_PHASE', phaseIdx, updates });
   245→  }, []);
   246→
   247→  const updatePhaseLora = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, loraIdx: number, updates: Partial<{ url: string; multiplier: string }>) => {
   248→    dispatch({ type: 'UPDATE_PHASE_LORA', phaseIdx, loraIdx, updates });
   249→  }, []);
   250→
   251→  const addLoraToPhase = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, url: string = '', multiplier: string = '1.0') => {
   252→    dispatch({ type: 'ADD_LORA_TO_PHASE', phaseIdx, url, multiplier });
   253→  }, []);
   254→
   255→  const removeLoraFromPhase = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, loraIdx: number) => {
   256→    dispatch({ type: 'REMOVE_LORA_FROM_PHASE', phaseIdx, loraIdx });
   257→  }, []);
   258→
   259→  // Form reset helper
   260→  const resetForm = useCallback(() => {
   261→    dispatch({ type: 'RESET_FORM', defaultIsPublic, phaseConfig: currentPhaseConfig || DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG });
   262→    sampleFilesHook.resetSampleFiles();

   264→
   265→  // Update editable phase config when editing preset changes or mode changes
   266→  useEffect(() => {

   272→        }

   275→        dispatch({ type: 'SET_GENERATION_TYPE_MODE', mode: initialGenerationTypeMode });
   276→      }
   277→    } else if (currentPhaseConfig) {

   279→    } else {

   281→    }
   282→  }, [editingPreset, isOverwriting, currentPhaseConfig, initialGenerationTypeMode]);
   283→
   284→  // Update form from current settings when they change (and not editing)
   285→  useEffect(() => {
   286→    if (!editingPreset && currentSettings) {
   287→      dispatch({
   288→        type: 'SET_FORM_FIELDS',
   289→        fields: {

   319→            is_public: metadata.is_public ?? true,
   320→            basePrompt: currentSettings.basePrompt || '',
   321→            negativePrompt: currentSettings.negativePrompt || '',
   322→            textBeforePrompts: currentSettings.textBeforePrompts || '',
   323→            textAfterPrompts: currentSettings.textAfterPrompts || '',
   324→            enhancePrompt: currentSettings.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   325→            durationFrames: currentSettings.durationFrames || 60,
   326→          },
   327→        });
   328→
   329→        sampleFilesHook.resetSampleFiles();
   330→      } else {
   331→        dispatch({
   332→          type: 'SET_ALL_FORM_FIELDS',
   333→          fields: {
   334→            name: metadata.name || '',
   335→            description: metadata.description || '',
   336→            created_by_is_you: metadata.created_by?.is_you ?? true,
   337→            created_by_username: metadata.created_by?.username || '',
   338→            is_public: metadata.is_public ?? true,
   339→            basePrompt: metadata.basePrompt || '',
   340→            negativePrompt: metadata.negativePrompt || '',
   341→            textBeforePrompts: metadata.textBeforePrompts || '',
   342→            textAfterPrompts: metadata.textAfterPrompts || '',
   343→            enhancePrompt: metadata.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   344→            durationFrames: metadata.durationFrames || 60,
   345→          },
   346→        });
   347→      }
   348→
   349→      sampleFilesHook.resetSampleFiles();
   350→
   351→      if (isOverwriting && currentSettings?.lastGeneratedVideoUrl) {
   352→        sampleFilesHook.setInitialVideo(currentSettings.lastGeneratedVideoUrl);
   353→      } else if (!isOverwriting) {
   354→        sampleFilesHook.setInitialVideo(null);
   355→      }

   358→
   359→  const handleFormChange = useCallback((field: string, value: string | boolean | number) => {
   360→    dispatch({ type: 'SET_FORM_FIELD', field, value });
   361→  }, []);
   362→
   363→  const handleAddPresetFromForm = async () => {
   364→    if (!addForm.name.trim()) {

   366→      return;
   367→    }
   368→
   369→    if (!editablePhaseConfig) {

   371→      return;
   372→    }
   373→
   374→    dispatch({ type: 'SET_SUBMISSION_STATE', isSubmitting: true });
   375→
   376→    try {

   378→
   379→      for (const file of sampleFilesHook.sampleFiles) {
   380→        const uploadedUrl = await uploadImageToStorage(file);
   381→        uploadedSamples.push({

   388→      const existingSamples = isEditMode

   391→

   395→
   396→      const finalSamples = [...initialSample, ...existingSamples, ...uploadedSamples];

   408→

     2→import type { Database } from '@/integrations/supabase/types';
     3→import { createSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/bootstrap/createSupabaseClient';
     4→import { initializeSupabaseRuntime } from '@/integrations/supabase/bootstrap/initializeSupabaseRuntime';
     5→
     6→type SupabaseClientInstance = SupabaseClient<Database>;
     7→const SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE =
     8→  'Supabase runtime is not initialized. Call initializeSupabaseClientRuntime() during app bootstrap.';
     9→
    10→let runtimeClient: SupabaseClientInstance | null = null;
    11→let runtimeError: Error | null = null;
    12→
    13→export type SupabaseClientAccessResult =
    14→  | { ok: true; client: SupabaseClientInstance }
    15→  | { ok: false; error: Error };
    16→
    17→export function normalizeSupabaseError(error: unknown): Error {
    18→  return error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseClientRuntime(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    22→  if (runtimeClient) {
    23→    return runtimeClient;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  try {
    27→    const client = createSupabaseClient();
    28→    initializeSupabaseRuntime(client);
    29→    runtimeClient = client;
    30→    runtimeError = null;
    31→    return client;
    32→  } catch (error) {
    33→    const normalized = normalizeSupabaseError(error);
    34→    runtimeClient = null;
    35→    runtimeError = normalized;
    36→    throw normalized;
    37→  }
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    41→  if (runtimeClient) {
    42→    return { ok: true, client: runtimeClient };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (runtimeError) {
    46→    return { ok: false, error: runtimeError };
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    ok: false,
    51→    error: new Error(SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE),
    52→  };
    53→}
    54→
    55→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClient(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    56→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    57→  if (!result.ok) {
    58→    throw result.error;
    59→  }
    60→  return result.client;
    61→}

     2→import {

     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}

1→/**
     2→ * Project-Wide Generation Queries
     3→ * ================================
     4→ *
     5→ * This module provides hooks for querying generations at the PROJECT level.
     6→ * Mutations live in `useGenerationMutations.ts` (re-exported here for compatibility).
     7→ *
     8→ * ## When to Use
     9→ * - Displaying a gallery of generations across the project (GenerationsPane, MediaGallery)
    10→ * - Filtering by tool type, media type, starred, search term
    11→ * - Fetching derived items (edits based on a generation)
    12→ *
    13→ * ## When NOT to Use
    14→ * - Querying images within a specific shot → use `useShotImages.ts` instead
    15→ * - Timeline-specific data (frame positions, pair prompts) → use `useShotImages.ts`
    16→ * - Page-level state management (filters, pagination) → use `useGalleryPageState.ts`
    17→ * - Mutations (create, delete, star) → import from `useGenerationMutations.ts` directly
    18→ *
    19→ * ## Key Exports
    20→ * - `useProjectGenerations(projectId, page, limit, filters)` - Paginated gallery data
    21→ * - `fetchGenerations(projectId, limit, offset, filters)` - Direct fetch function
    22→ * - `GenerationsPaginatedResponse` - Response type
    23→ *
    24→ * ## Data Source
    25→ * Queries `generations` table directly (project-scoped, not shot-scoped)
    26→ *
    27→ * @module useProjectGenerations
    28→ */
    29→
    30→import { useQuery, keepPreviousData } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    31→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    32→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    33→import { useSmartPollingConfig } from '../useSmartPolling';
    34→import { unifiedGenerationQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/unified';
    35→import { transformGeneration, transformVariant, type RawGeneration, type RawVariant } from '@/shared/lib/generationTransformers';
    36→import type { PostgrestFilterBuilder } from '@supabase/postgrest-js';
    37→import { SHOT_FILTER } from '@/shared/constants/filterConstants';
    38→import { TOOL_IDS } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    39→import { getProjectSelectionFallbackId } from '@/shared/contexts/projectSelectionStore';
    40→
    41→/** Cache garbage collection time for paginated generation queries */
    42→const GENERATIONS_GC_TIME_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000; // 10 minutes
    43→
    44→type AnyPostgrestFilterBuilder = PostgrestFilterBuilder<unknown, unknown, unknown, unknown, unknown>;
    45→
    46→/** Common filter options for generation queries */
    47→interface GenerationBaseFilters {
    48→  toolType?: string;
    49→  mediaType?: 'all' | 'image' | 'video';
    50→  shotId?: string;
    51→  excludePositioned?: boolean;
    52→  starredOnly?: boolean;
    53→  searchTerm?: string;
    54→  editsOnly?: boolean;
    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Apply common filters to a generations query.
    59→ * Used by both count and data queries to ensure consistency.
    60→ */
    61→// TODO: type properly - PostgrestFilterBuilder generics are complex Supabase internals
    62→function applyGenerationFilters<T extends AnyPostgrestFilterBuilder>(
    63→  query: T,
    64→  filters: GenerationBaseFilters | undefined
    65→): T {
    66→  if (!filters) return query;
    67→
    68→  // Tool type filter (skip when shot filter is active - shot filter takes precedence)
    69→  if (filters.toolType && !filters.shotId) {
    70→    if (filters.toolType === TOOL_IDS.IMAGE_GENERATION) {
    71→      query = query.eq('params->>tool_type', TOOL_IDS.IMAGE_GENERATION) as T;
    72→    } else {
    73→      query = query.or(`params->>tool_type.eq.${filters.toolType},params->>tool_type.eq.${filters.toolType}-reconstructed-client`) as T;
    74→    }
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  // Media type filter
    78→  if (filters.mediaType && filters.mediaType !== 'all') {
    79→    if (filters.mediaType === 'video') {
    80→      query = query.like('type', '%video%') as T;
    81→    } else if (filters.mediaType === 'image') {
    82→      query = query.not('type', 'like', '%video%') as T;
    83→    }
    84→  }
    85→
    86→  // Starred filter
    87→  if (filters.starredOnly) {
    88→    query = query.eq('starred', true) as T;
    89→  }
    90→
    91→  // Edits only filter (generations derived from another)
    92→  if (filters.editsOnly) {
    93→    query = query.not('based_on', 'is', null) as T;
    94→  }
    95→
    96→  // Search filter
    97→  if (filters.searchTerm?.trim()) {
    98→    const searchPattern = `%${filters.searchTerm.trim()}%`;
    99→    query = query.ilike('params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>prompt', searchPattern) as T;
   100→  }
   101→
   102→  // Shot filter
   103→  if (filters.shotId === SHOT_FILTER.NO_SHOT) {
   104→    query = query.or('shot_data.is.null,shot_data.eq.{}') as T;
   105→  } else if (filters.shotId) {
   106→    query = query.not(`shot_data->${filters.shotId}`, 'is', null) as T;
   107→    if (filters.excludePositioned) {
   108→      query = query.or(`shot_data->${filters.shotId}.eq.null,shot_data->${filters.shotId}.eq.-1,shot_data->${filters.shotId}.cs.[null],shot_data->${filters.shotId}.cs.[-1]`) as T;
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→
   112→  return query;
   113→}
   114→
   115→/**
   116→ * Fetch edit variants from generation_variants table for a project
   117→ * Filters by tool_type in params (set by complete_task)
   118→ * 
   119→ * NOTE: Requires the project_id column on generation_variants (added via migration)
   120→ * The column is auto-populated by a trigger from the parent generation
   121→ */
   122→async function fetchEditVariants(
   123→  projectId: string,
   124→  limit: number,
   125→  offset: number,
   126→  filters?: {
   127→    toolType?: string;
   128→    mediaType?: 'all' | 'image' | 'video';
   129→    sort?: 'newest' | 'oldest';
   130→    parentsOnly?: boolean; // Exclude child variants (those with parent_variant_id in params)
   131→  }
   132→): Promise<{
   133→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   134→  total: number;
   135→  hasMore: boolean;
   136→}> {
   137→  const toolType = filters?.toolType;
   138→  const sort = filters?.sort || 'newest';
   139→  const mediaType = filters?.mediaType || 'all';
   140→  const parentsOnly = filters?.parentsOnly ?? true;
   141→
   142→  // Build count query
   143→  let countQuery = supabase().from('generation_variants')
   144→    .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   145→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   146→  
   147→  // Only filter by toolType if specified
   148→  if (toolType) {
   149→    countQuery = countQuery.eq('params->>tool_type', toolType);
   150→  }
   151→  
   152→  // Filter by media type - variants don't have a type column, so filter by URL extension
   153→  if (mediaType === 'video') {
   154→    countQuery = countQuery.or('location.ilike.%.mp4,location.ilike.%.webm,location.ilike.%.mov');
   155→  } else if (mediaType === 'image') {
   156→    countQuery = countQuery.not('location', 'ilike', '%.mp4').not('location', 'ilike', '%.webm').not('location', 'ilike', '%.mov');
   157→  }
   158→  
   159→  // Exclude child variants (those created from another variant)
   160→  if (parentsOnly) {
   161→    countQuery = countQuery.is('params->>parent_variant_id', null);
   162→  }
   163→
   164→  const { count, error: countError } = await countQuery;
   165→
   166→  if (countError) {
   167→    throw countError;
   168→  }
   169→
   170→  const totalCount = count || 0;
   171→
   172→  if (totalCount === 0) {
   173→    return { items: [], total: 0, hasMore: false };
   174→  }
   175→
   176→  // Data query with pagination
   177→  const ascending = sort === 'oldest';
   178→  let dataQuery = supabase().from('generation_variants')
   179→    .select(`
   180→      id,
   181→      generation_id,
   182→      location,
   183→      thumbnail_url,
   184→      params,
   185→      variant_type,
   186→      name,
   187→      created_at
   188→    `)
   189→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   190→  
   191→  // Only filter by toolType if specified
   192→  if (toolType) {
   193→    dataQuery = dataQuery.eq('params->>tool_type', toolType);
   194→  }
   195→  
   196→  // Filter by media type in data query too
   197→  if (mediaType === 'video') {
   198→    dataQuery = dataQuery.or('location.ilike.%.mp4,location.ilike.%.webm,location.ilike.%.mov');
   199→  } else if (mediaType === 'image') {
   200→    dataQuery = dataQuery.not('location', 'ilike', '%.mp4').not('location', 'ilike', '%.webm').not('location', 'ilike', '%.mov');
   201→  }
   202→  
   203→  // Exclude child variants in data query too
   204→  if (parentsOnly) {
   205→    dataQuery = dataQuery.is('params->>parent_variant_id', null);
   206→  }
   207→  
   208→  dataQuery = dataQuery
   209→    .order('created_at', { ascending })
   210→    .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
   211→
   212→  const { data, error } = await dataQuery;
   213→
   214→  if (error) {
   215→    throw error;
   216→  }
   217→
   218→  // Transform variants using shared transformer
   219→  const items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[] = (data || []).map((variant) =>
   220→    transformVariant(variant as unknown as RawVariant, { toolType })
   221→  );
   222→
   223→  return {
   224→    items,
   225→    total: totalCount,
   226→    hasMore: offset + items.length < totalCount,
   227→  };
   228→}
   229→
   230→export type GenerationFilters = GenerationBaseFilters & {
   231→  includeChildren?: boolean;
   232→  parentGenerationId?: string;
   233→  sort?: 'newest' | 'oldest';
   234→  editsOnly?: boolean; // Filter for images with based_on set (derived/edited images)
   235→  parentsOnly?: boolean; // For variants: exclude child variants (those with parent_variant_id)
   236→  variantsOnly?: boolean; // Fetch edit variants from generation_variants table
   237→};
   238→
   239→async function fetchGenerationsForProject(
   240→  projectId: string,
   241→  limit: number = 100,
   242→  offset: number = 0,
   243→  filters?: GenerationFilters
   244→): Promise<{
   245→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   246→  total: number;
   247→  hasMore: boolean;
   248→}> {
   249→  // Special path for variantsOnly - fetch from generation_variants table
   250→  if (filters?.variantsOnly) {
   251→    return fetchEditVariants(projectId, limit, offset, {
   252→      toolType: filters.toolType,
   253→      mediaType: filters.mediaType,
   254→      sort: filters.sort,
   255→      parentsOnly: filters.parentsOnly ?? true, // Default to parents only
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  // Build count query
   260→  let countQuery = supabase().from('generations')
   261→    .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
   262→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   263→  
   264→  // Only include generations with valid output URLs - UNLESS fetching children of a specific parent
   265→  // (children may still be processing and need to show as placeholders)
   266→  if (!filters?.parentGenerationId) {
   267→    countQuery = countQuery.not('location', 'is', null);
   268→  }
   269→
   270→  // Parent/Child filtering (count query specific)
   271→  if (filters?.parentGenerationId) {
   272→    countQuery = countQuery.eq('parent_generation_id', filters.parentGenerationId);
   273→  } else if (!filters?.includeChildren) {
   274→    countQuery = countQuery.eq('is_child', false);
   275→  }
   276→
   277→  // Apply common filters (toolType, mediaType, starred, edits, search, shot)
   278→  countQuery = applyGenerationFilters(countQuery, filters);
   279→
   280→  const { count, error: countError } = await countQuery;
   281→  if (countError) {
   282→    throw countError;
   283→  }
   284→  const totalCount = count || 0;
   285→
   286→  // Select only the fields needed for the gallery view
   287→  let dataQuery = supabase().from('generations')
   288→    .select(`
   289→      id,
   290→      location,
   291→      thumbnail_url,
   292→      type,
   293→      created_at,
   294→      updated_at,
   295→      params,
   296→      starred,
   297→      tasks,
   298→      based_on,
   299→      shot_data,
   300→      name,
   301→      is_child,
   302→      parent_generation_id,
   303→      child_order
   304→    `)
   305→    .eq('project_id', projectId);
   306→
   307→  // Parent/Child filtering - apply BEFORE location filter since parentGenerationId affects whether we filter by location
   308→  // Parent/Child filtering (data query specific - has ordering)
   309→  if (filters?.parentGenerationId) {
   310→    dataQuery = dataQuery.eq('parent_generation_id', filters.parentGenerationId);
   311→    dataQuery = dataQuery.order('child_order', { ascending: true });
   312→  } else {
   313→    dataQuery = dataQuery.not('location', 'is', null);
   314→    if (!filters?.includeChildren) {
   315→      dataQuery = dataQuery.eq('is_child', false);
   316→    }
   317→  }
   318→
   319→  // Apply common filters (toolType, mediaType, starred, edits, search, shot)
   320→  dataQuery = applyGenerationFilters(dataQuery, filters);
   321→
   322→
   323→  // Determine sort order
   324→  const sort = filters?.sort || 'newest';
   325→  const ascending = sort === 'oldest';
   326→
   327→  // Execute query with standard server-side pagination
   328→  const { data, error } = await dataQuery
   329→    .order('created_at', { ascending })
   330→    .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
   331→
   332→  if (error) {
   333→    throw error;
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  if (!data) {
   337→    return { items: [], total: totalCount, hasMore: false };
   338→  }
   339→
   340→
   341→  const finalData = data || [];
   342→  const hasMore = (offset + limit) < totalCount;
   343→
   344→  // Badge data (derivedCount, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCount) is now loaded
   345→  // lazily via useVariantBadges hook to avoid blocking gallery display
   346→
   347→  // Use shared transformer instead of inline transformation logic
   348→  const items = finalData?.map((item) => {
   349→    // Transform using shared function - handles all the complex logic
   350→    return transformGeneration(item as unknown as RawGeneration, {
   351→      shotId: filters?.shotId,
   352→    });
   353→  }) || [];
   354→
   355→  return { items, total: totalCount, hasMore };
   356→}
   357→
   358→export function fetchGenerations(
   359→  projectId: string | null,
   360→  limit: number = 100,
   361→  offset: number = 0,
   362→  filters?: GenerationFilters
   363→): Promise<{
   364→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   365→  total: number;
   366→  hasMore: boolean;
   367→}> {
   368→  if (!projectId) {
   369→    return Promise.resolve({ items: [], total: 0, hasMore: false });
   370→  }
   371→  return fetchGenerationsForProject(projectId, limit, offset, filters);
   372→}
   373→
   374→
   375→export type GenerationsPaginatedResponse = {
   376→  items: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   377→  total: number;
   378→  hasMore: boolean;
   379→};
   380→
   381→export function useProjectGenerations(
   382→  projectId: string | null,
   383→  page: number = 1,
   384→  limit: number = 100,
   385→  enabled: boolean = true,
   386→  filters?: GenerationFilters,
   387→  options?: {
   388→    disablePolling?: boolean; // Disable smart polling (useful for long-running tasks)
   389→  }
   390→) {
   391→  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
   392→  const effectiveProjectId = projectId ?? getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
   393→  const filtersKey = filters ? JSON.stringify(filters) : null;
   394→  const [REDACTED](
   395→    effectiveProjectId ?? '__no-project__',
   396→    page,
   397→    limit,
   398→    filtersKey
   399→  );
   400→
   401→
   402→  // Use DataFreshnessManager for intelligent polling decisions.
   403→  // Can be disabled for tools with long-running tasks to prevent gallery flicker.
   404→  const smartPollingConfig = useSmartPollingConfig(['generations', effectiveProjectId ?? '__no-project__']);
   405→  const pollingDisabled = Boolean(options?.disablePolling);
   406→  const pollingConfig: { refetchInterval: number | false; staleTime: number } = pollingDisabled
   407→    ? { refetchInterval: false, staleTime: Infinity }
   408→    : smartPollingConfig;
   409→
   410→  const result = useQuery<GenerationsPaginatedResponse, Error>({
   411→    queryKey: queryKey,
   412→    queryFn: () => fetchGenerationsForProject(effectiveProjectId!, limit, offset, filters),
   413→    enabled: !!effectiveProjectId && enabled,
   414→    // Use `placeholderData` with `keepPreviousData` to prevent UI flashes on pagination/filter changes
   415→    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
   416→    // Cache management to prevent memory leaks as pagination grows
   417→    gcTime: GENERATIONS_GC_TIME_MS,
   418→    refetchOnWindowFocus: false, // Prevent double-fetches
   419→
   420→    // Intelligent polling based on realtime health (or disabled)
   421→    ...pollingConfig,
   422→    refetchIntervalInBackground: !pollingDisabled, // Only poll in background if polling is enabled
   423→    refetchOnReconnect: false, // Prevent double-fetches
   424→  });
   425→
   426→  return result;
   427→}
   428→
   429→// ===== MUTATIONS =====
   430→// These hooks live in useGenerationMutations.ts — import directly from there.
   431→
   432→// ===== DERIVED ITEMS =====
   433→// DerivedItem and useDerivedItems live in useDerivedItems.ts — import directly from there.
   434→

1→import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { useDeleteGeneration } from '@/domains/generation/hooks/useGenerationMutations';
     3→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     4→
     5→interface UseDeleteGenerationActionResult {
     6→  pendingDeleteId: string | null;
     7→  deletingId: string | null;
     8→  isPending: boolean;
     9→  requestDelete: (id: string) => void;
    10→  cancelDelete: () => void;
    11→  confirmDelete: () => Promise<void>;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseDeleteGenerationActionOptions {
    15→  projectId: string | null | undefined;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteGenerationAction({
    19→  projectId,
    20→}: UseDeleteGenerationActionOptions): UseDeleteGenerationActionResult {
    21→  const deleteGenerationMutation = useDeleteGeneration();
    22→  const [pendingDeleteId, setPendingDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    23→  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    24→
    25→  const requestDelete = useCallback((id: string) => {
    26→    setPendingDeleteId(id);
    27→  }, []);
    28→
    29→  const cancelDelete = useCallback(() => {
    30→    setPendingDeleteId(null);
    31→  }, []);
    32→
    33→  const confirmDelete = useCallback(async () => {
    34→    if (!pendingDeleteId || !projectId) {
    35→      setPendingDeleteId(null);
    36→      return;
    37→    }
    38→
    39→    const targetId = pendingDeleteId;
    40→    setDeletingId(targetId);
    41→    try {
    42→      await deleteGenerationMutation.mutateAsync({ id: targetId, projectId });
    43→      setPendingDeleteId((current) => (current === targetId ? null : current));
    44→    } catch (error) {
    45→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    46→        context: 'useDeleteGenerationAction.confirmDelete',
    47→        toastTitle: 'Delete failed',
    48→      });
    49→      // Keep the dialog open so users can retry or cancel after a failed delete.
    50→    } finally {
    51→      setDeletingId((current) => (current === targetId ? null : current));
    52→    }
    53→  }, [deleteGenerationMutation, pendingDeleteId, projectId]);
    54→
    55→  return {
    56→    pendingDeleteId,
    57→    deletingId,
    58→    isPending: deleteGenerationMutation.isPending,
    59→    requestDelete,
    60→    cancelDelete,
    61→    confirmDelete,
    62→  };
    63→}
    64→
