   131→    thumbUrl: gen.thumbnail_url || gen.location || '',
   132→    type: gen.type || 'video',
   133→    created_at: gen.updated_at || gen.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
   134→    createdAt: gen.updated_at || gen.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
   135→    params: gen.params as GenerationRow['params'],
   136→    parent_generation_id: gen.parent_generation_id,
   137→    child_order: gen.child_order,
   138→    starred: gen.starred,
   139→    // Include pair_shot_generation_id column (for FK-based slot matching)
   140→    pair_shot_generation_id: gen.pair_shot_generation_id,
   141→  };
   142→}
   143→
   144→export function useSegmentOutputsForShot(
   145→  shotId: string | null,
   146→  projectId: string | null,
   147→  /** Local shot_generation positions for instant updates during drag */
   148→  localShotGenPositions?: Map<string, number>,
   149→  /** Optional controlled selected parent ID (lifted state from parent) */
   150→  controlledSelectedParentId?: string | null,
   151→  /** Optional callback when selected parent changes (for controlled mode) */
   152→  onSelectedParentChange?: (id: string | null) => void,
   153→  /** Optional preloaded generations for readOnly mode (bypasses database queries) */
   154→  preloadedGenerations?: GenerationRow[],
   155→  /** Optional trailing segment shot_generation_id (allows videos at end position to show) */
   156→  trailingShotGenId?: string
   157→): UseSegmentOutputsReturn {
   158→  // [TrailingDebug] Log when trailingShotGenId is passed
   159→
   160→  // Debug: Log when local positions are passed
   161→
   162→  // Track selected parent generation - use controlled value if provided, otherwise internal state
   163→  const [internalSelectedParentId, setInternalSelectedParentId] = useState<string | null>(null);
   164→
   165→  // Determine if we're in controlled mode
   166→  const isControlled = controlledSelectedParentId !== undefined;
   167→  const selectedParentId = isControlled ? controlledSelectedParentId : internalSelectedParentId;
   168→  const setSelectedParentId = useCallback((id: string | null) => {
   169→    if (isControlled && onSelectedParentChange) {
   170→      onSelectedParentChange(id);
   171→    } else {
   172→      setInternalSelectedParentId(id);
   173→    }
   174→  }, [isControlled, onSelectedParentChange]);
   175→
   176→  // Derive parent generations from preloaded data if available
   177→  // Parent generations are videos that:
   178→  // 1. type = 'video'
   179→  // 2. parent_generation_id IS NULL (not a child itself)
   180→  // 3. Has orchestrator_details OR has children pointing to it
   181→  const preloadedParentGenerations = useMemo(() => {
   182→    if (!preloadedGenerations) return undefined;
   183→
   184→    // First, find all generation IDs that are referenced as parents
   185→    const parentIds = new Set<string>();
   186→    preloadedGenerations.forEach(gen => {
   187→      const parentId = gen.parent_generation_id;
   188→      if (parentId) parentIds.add(parentId);
   189→    });
   190→
   191→    const parents = preloadedGenerations.filter(gen => {
   192→      const isVideo = gen.type?.includes('video');
   193→      // Check if this is NOT a child (no parent_generation_id)
   194→      const isNotChild = !gen.parent_generation_id;
   195→      // Has orchestrator_details OR is referenced as a parent by other generations
   196→      const hasOrchestratorDetails = !!(gen.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.orchestrator_details;
   197→      // Use generation_id for parent lookup (shot_generations.generation_id -> generations.id)
   198→      const genId = getGenerationId(gen);
   199→      const hasChildren = typeof genId === 'string' ? parentIds.has(genId) : false;
   200→
   201→      return isVideo && isNotChild && (hasOrchestratorDetails || hasChildren);
   202→    });
   203→
   204→    // Sort by created_at descending (most recent first) to match actual page behavior
   205→    // This ensures auto-select picks the most recent parent
   206→    parents.sort((a, b) => {
   207→      const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || a.createdAt || 0).getTime();
   208→      const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || b.createdAt || 0).getTime();
   209→      return dateB - dateA; // Descending - most recent first
   210→    });
   211→
   212→    return parents;
   213→  }, [preloadedGenerations]);
   214→
   215→  // Memoize query keys to prevent React Query observer.setOptions() from seeing
   216→  // "changed" options on every render (shallowEqualObjects compares by reference).
   217→  // Without this, unstable keys + staleTime: 0 cause a fetch→render→fetch loop.
   218→  const parentQueryKey = useMemo(
   219→    () => segmentQueryKeys.parents(shotId!, projectId ?? undefined),
   220→    [shotId, projectId]
   221→  );
   222→
   223→  // Fetch parent generations using the shot_final_videos view (single query, all filtering server-side)
   224→  // Skip query when preloaded data is available
   225→  const {
   226→    data: parentGenerationsData,
   227→    isLoading: isLoadingParents,
   228→    isFetching: isFetchingParents,
   229→    refetch: refetchParents,
   230→  } = useQuery({
   231→    queryKey: parentQueryKey,
   232→    queryFn: async () => {
   233→      if (!shotId || !projectId) return [];
   234→
   235→      // Single query using the shot_final_videos view
   236→      // This replaces 3 queries + client-side filtering with 1 indexed query
   237→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_final_videos')
   238→        .select('*')
   239→        .eq('shot_id', shotId)
   240→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
   241→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
   242→
   243→      if (error) {
   244→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   245→          context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchParents',
   246→          showToast: false,
   247→          logData: { shotId, projectId },
   248→        });
   249→        throw error;
   250→      }
   251→
   252→      return ((data || []) as unknown as RawGenerationDbRow[]).map(transformToGenerationRow);
   253→    },
   254→    enabled: !!shotId && !!projectId && !preloadedGenerations,
   255→    staleTime: 30000, // 30 seconds
   256→  });
   257→
   258→  // Use preloaded data if available, otherwise use query data
   259→  const parentGenerations = useMemo(
   260→    () => (preloadedParentGenerations ?? parentGenerationsData) || [],
   261→    [preloadedParentGenerations, parentGenerationsData],
   262→  );
   263→
   264→  // Auto-select the first (most recent) parent if none selected
   265→  // IMPORTANT: Only auto-select when:
   266→  // 1. The query is enabled (shotId exists) - prevents controlled components with disabled queries from clearing selection
   267→  // 2. NOT in controlled mode - parent component manages selection
   268→  // 3. There are parent generations to select from
   269→  useEffect(() => {
   270→    // Don't auto-select if query is disabled (we're just using controlled state passthrough)
   271→    if (!shotId) return;
   272→
   273→    // Don't auto-select if in controlled mode - parent component manages selection
   274→    if (isControlled) return;
   275→
   276→    if (parentGenerations.length > 0 && !selectedParentId) {
   277→      setSelectedParentId(parentGenerations[0].id);
   278→    } else if (parentGenerations.length > 0 && selectedParentId) {
   279→      // Validate that current selection exists in the list
   280→      const selectionExists = parentGenerations.some(p => p.id === selectedParentId);
   281→      if (!selectionExists) {
   282→        setSelectedParentId(parentGenerations[0].id);
   283→      }
   284→    }
   285→    // Note: We don't set to null when parentGenerations is empty - keep last selection
   286→  }, [parentGenerations, selectedParentId, shotId, isControlled, setSelectedParentId]);
   287→
   288→  // Get the selected parent
   289→  const selectedParent = useMemo(() => {
   290→    if (!selectedParentId) return null;
   291→    return parentGenerations.find(p => p.id === selectedParentId) || null;
   292→  }, [parentGenerations, selectedParentId]);
   293→
   294→  // Derive children from preloaded data if available
   295→  // Children are generations with parent_generation_id pointing to the selected parent
   296→  const preloadedChildren = useMemo(() => {
   297→    if (!preloadedGenerations || !selectedParentId) return undefined;
   298→
   299→    // The selected parent might be a shot_generations.id or a generations.id
   300→    // We need to find the generation_id for the selected parent
   301→    const selectedParent = parentGenerations.find(p => p.id === selectedParentId || p.generation_id === selectedParentId);
   302→    const parentGenId = selectedParent?.generation_id || selectedParentId;
   303→
   304→    const children = preloadedGenerations.filter(gen => {
   305→      // Check if this generation's parent_generation_id matches the selected parent
   306→      const parentId = gen.parent_generation_id;
   307→      return parentId === parentGenId || parentId === selectedParentId;
   308→    });
   309→
   310→    return children;
   311→  }, [preloadedGenerations, selectedParentId, parentGenerations]);
   312→
   313→  // Smart polling for segment children - allows new segments to appear after task completion
   314→  // CRITICAL: Memoize query key — an unstable array reference here was the root cause of a
   315→  // 15/sec render loop. React Query's setOptions() uses shallowEqualObjects which compares
   316→  // queryKey by reference. New array + staleTime: 0 → fetch→render→fetch infinite loop.
   317→  const childrenQueryKey = useMemo(
   318→    () => [...segmentQueryKeys.children(selectedParentId!)] as string[],
   319→    [selectedParentId]
   320→  );
   321→  const childrenPollingConfig = useSmartPollingConfig(childrenQueryKey);
   322→
   323→  // Fetch children for selected parent - skip if preloaded data available
   324→  const {
   325→    data: childGenerationsData,
   326→    isLoading: isLoadingChildren,
   327→    isFetching: isFetchingChildren,
   328→    refetch: refetchChildren,
   329→  } = useQuery({
   330→    [REDACTED],
   331→    queryFn: async () => {
   332→      if (!selectedParentId) return [];
   333→
   334→      // [TrailingDebug] Also check if there are ANY videos with matching pair_shot_generation_id
   335→      // This helps diagnose if videos exist but under a different parent
   336→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('generations')
   337→        .select('*')
   338→        .eq('parent_generation_id', selectedParentId)
   339→        .order('child_order', { ascending: true })
   340→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
   341→
   342→      if (error) {
   343→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→          context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchChildren',
   345→          showToast: false,
   346→          logData: { selectedParentId },
   347→        });
   348→        throw error;
   349→      }
   350→
   351→      return ((data || []) as unknown as RawGenerationDbRow[]).map(transformToGenerationRow);
   352→    },
   353→    enabled: !!selectedParentId && !preloadedGenerations,
   354→    // Smart polling config - polls when realtime is unhealthy, otherwise relies on invalidation
   355→    ...childrenPollingConfig,
   356→    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
   357→  });
   358→
   359→  // Use preloaded children if available
   360→  const childGenerations = useMemo(
   361→    () => (preloadedChildren ?? childGenerationsData) || [],
   362→    [preloadedChildren, childGenerationsData],
   363→  );
   364→
   365→  // Filter to only segments (not join outputs)
   366→  const segments = useMemo(() => {
   367→    const filtered = childGenerations.filter(child => isSegment(child.params as Record<string, unknown> | null));
   368→
   369→    return filtered;
   370→  }, [childGenerations]);
   371→
   372→  // Derive timeline data from preloaded generations if available
   373→  const preloadedTimelineData = useMemo(() => {
   374→    if (!preloadedGenerations) return undefined;
   375→    // Filter to positioned items and map to timeline format
   376→    return preloadedGenerations
   377→      .filter(gen => gen.timeline_frame !== null && gen.timeline_frame !== undefined && gen.timeline_frame >= 0)
   378→      .sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame ?? 0) - (b.timeline_frame ?? 0))
   379→      .map(gen => ({
   380→        id: gen.id,  // shot_generations.id
   381→        generation_id: gen.generation_id,
   382→        timeline_frame: gen.timeline_frame,
   383→      }));
   384→  }, [preloadedGenerations]);
   385→
   386→  const liveTimelineQueryKey = useMemo(
   387→    () => segmentQueryKeys.liveTimeline(shotId!),
   388→    [shotId]
   389→  );
   390→
   391→  // Fetch LIVE shot_generations to get current timeline order
   392→  // This is the source of truth for video positioning - videos move with their images
   393→  // Skip if preloaded data available
   394→  const {
   395→    data: liveTimelineData,
   396→    refetch: refetchTimeline,
   397→  } = useQuery({
   398→    [REDACTED],
   399→    queryFn: async () => {
   400→      if (!shotId) return [];
   401→
   402→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   403→        .select('id, generation_id, timeline_frame')
   404→        .eq('shot_id', shotId)
   405→        .gte('timeline_frame', 0) // Only positioned images
   406→        .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
   407→
   408→      if (error) {
   409→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   410→          context: 'useSegmentOutputsForShot.fetchLiveTimeline',
   411→          showToast: false,
   412→          logData: { shotId },
   413→        });
   414→        throw error;
   415→      }
   416→
   417→      return data || [];
   418→    },
   419→    enabled: !!shotId && !preloadedGenerations,
   420→    staleTime: 10000, // Refresh more frequently to catch timeline changes
   421→  });
   422→
   423→  // Use preloaded timeline if available
   424→  const effectiveTimelineData = preloadedTimelineData ?? liveTimelineData;
   425→
   426→  // Build map of shot_generation.id → current position (live, not snapshot)
   427→  const liveShotGenIdToPosition = useMemo(() => {
   428→    const map = new Map<string, number>();
   429→    (effectiveTimelineData || []).forEach((sg, index) => {
   430→      map.set(sg.id, index);
   431→    });
   432→
   433→    return map;
   434→  }, [effectiveTimelineData, shotId, preloadedTimelineData]);
   435→
   436→  // Extract expected segment data from selected parent
   437→  const expectedSegmentData = useMemo(() => {
   438→    if (!selectedParent) return null;
   439→    return extractExpectedSegmentData(selectedParent.params as Record<string, unknown> | null);
   440→  }, [selectedParent]);
   441→
   442→  // Build segment slots
   443→  // Uses LOCAL positions (instant during drag) or LIVE timeline (from DB) for slot assignment
   444→  const segmentSlots = useMemo((): SegmentSlot[] => {
   445→    const hasLocalPositions = !!localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0;
   446→    const localPositionCount = localShotGenPositions?.size ?? 0;
   447→    const useLocalPositions = hasLocalPositions;
   448→
   449→    const positionMap = useLocalPositions ? localShotGenPositions : liveShotGenIdToPosition;
   450→    const baseSlotCount = useLocalPositions
   451→      ? localPositionCount - 1  // N images = N-1 pairs
   452→      : (effectiveTimelineData?.length ? effectiveTimelineData.length - 1 : 0);
   453→    // Add extra slot for trailing segment if provided
   454→    const slotCount = trailingShotGenId ? baseSlotCount + 1 : baseSlotCount;
   455→
   456→    // Use slotCount (current timeline) for positioning, not expectedCount (original generation)
   457→    if (slotCount === 0) {
   458→      if (!effectiveTimelineData) {
   459→        // Timeline still loading — return empty to avoid collision/shift artifacts.
   460→        // The child_order fallback below causes two problems when timeline data arrives:
   461→        // (1) segments with the same child_order collide, making one permanently invisible,
   462→        // (2) segments visually shift position when the FK-based layout kicks in.
   463→        return [];
   464→      }
   465→      // Genuinely no timeline images — show what we have at child_order positions
   466→      const fallbackSlots = segments.map((child, index) => ({
   467→        type: 'child' as const,
   468→        child,
   469→        index: child.child_order ?? index,
   470→      }));
   471→      return fallbackSlots;
   472→    }
   473→
   474→    // Create slots for all expected segments
   475→    const slots: SegmentSlot[] = [];
   476→    const childrenBySlot = new Map<number, GenerationRow>();
   477→    const usedSlots = new Set<number>();
   478→    const childrenWithoutValidSlot: GenerationRow[] = [];
   479→    // Priority chain for slot mapping:
   480→    // 1. pair_shot_generation_id → position (LOCAL for instant, LIVE as fallback)
   481→    // 2. child_order (fallback ONLY for videos without pair_shot_generation_id)
   482→    segments.forEach(child => {
   483→      const childParams = child.params as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   484→      const { pairShotGenId } = getPairIdentifiers(child, childParams);
   485→      const childOrder = child.child_order;
   486→
   487→      // Extract end image generation_id for pair validation
   488→      const individualParams = (childParams?.individual_segment_params || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   489→      const endGenId = (individualParams.end_image_generation_id || childParams?.end_image_generation_id) as string | undefined;
   490→
   491→      let derivedSlot: number | undefined;
   492→      let slotSource = 'NONE';
   493→      let pairShotGenPosition: number | undefined;
   494→
   495→      // Priority 1: pair_shot_generation_id → look up position (instant from local, or from DB)
   496→      // Videos should move with their images
   497→      if (pairShotGenId && positionMap.has(pairShotGenId)) {
   498→        pairShotGenPosition = positionMap.get(pairShotGenId)!;
   499→        // Only validate against slot count (current timeline)
   500→        // Position N means "start of pair N", but pair N only exists if there's an image at N+1
   501→        // EXCEPTION: If this is a trailing segment (pairShotGenId matches trailingShotGenId),
   502→        // allow it even at the end position
   503→        const isTrailingSegment = trailingShotGenId && pairShotGenId === trailingShotGenId;
   504→
   505→        if (pairShotGenPosition < slotCount || isTrailingSegment) {
   506→          derivedSlot = pairShotGenPosition;
   507→          slotSource = isTrailingSegment ? 'TRAILING_SEGMENT' : (useLocalPositions ? 'LOCAL_POSITION' : 'PAIR_SHOT_GEN_ID_LIVE');
   508→        } else {
   509→          // Image is at last position - no valid pair starts there
   510→          slotSource = 'PAIR_AT_END_NO_SLOT';
   511→        }
   512→
   513→        // Verify end image still matches — catches insertion between pair images.
   514→        // ONLY run against LIVE positions (not during local drag). During drag,
   515→        // derivedSlot comes from localShotGenPositions but effectiveTimelineData
   516→        // still has LIVE (pre-drag) order — the mixed coordinate systems cause
   517→        // false demotions on swap/reorder. After commit, LIVE data refreshes and
   518→        // this check runs against consistent positions.
   519→        if (!useLocalPositions && derivedSlot !== undefined && endGenId && effectiveTimelineData) {
   520→          const endImageInTimeline = effectiveTimelineData[derivedSlot + 1];
   521→          if (endImageInTimeline && endImageInTimeline.generation_id !== endGenId) {
   522→            // Only demote if the end image is still AFTER this slot (X inserted between A and B)
   523→            // or is gone entirely (end image deleted). If the end image moved BEFORE this slot
   524→            // (swap/reorder), the video should follow its start image — ambiguous order > lost data.
   525→            const endImageNewSlot = effectiveTimelineData.findIndex(
   526→              item => item.generation_id === endGenId
   527→            );
   528→            if (endImageNewSlot === -1 || endImageNewSlot > derivedSlot) {
   529→              derivedSlot = undefined;
   530→              slotSource = 'STALE_END_IMAGE';
   531→            }
   532→          }
   533→        }
   534→      }
   535→
   536→      // Priority 2: child_order fallback (legacy segments only)
   537→      // Fall back to child_order ONLY when there's no pairShotGenId at all.
   538→      // A stale FK (pairShotGenId exists but not in positionMap) means the source
   539→      // image was removed from the timeline — the segment is orphaned and should
   540→      // NOT claim a slot. Letting it fall back to child_order would block valid
   541→      // segments from their correct positions.
   542→      if (derivedSlot === undefined && !pairShotGenId &&
   543→          typeof childOrder === 'number' && childOrder >= 0 && childOrder < slotCount) {
   544→        derivedSlot = childOrder;
   545→        slotSource = 'CHILD_ORDER';
   546→      }
   547→
   548→      // Skip videos whose pair_shot_gen is at an invalid position (e.g., last image)
   549→      // These videos can't be shown because their start image has no following image
   550→      if (slotSource === 'PAIR_AT_END_NO_SLOT') {
   551→        return; // Skip this video entirely
   552→      }
   553→
   554→      // Check if slot is valid and not already used
   555→      if (derivedSlot !== undefined && !usedSlots.has(derivedSlot)) {
   556→        childrenBySlot.set(derivedSlot, child);
   557→        usedSlots.add(derivedSlot);
   558→      } else if (derivedSlot !== undefined && usedSlots.has(derivedSlot)) {
   559→        // Slot collision — prefer the segment with actual content (location).
   560→        // This prevents demoted/empty segments from blocking valid ones,
   561→        // even in timing windows where demote hasn't cleared location yet.
   562→        const existing = childrenBySlot.get(derivedSlot)!;
   563→        if (!existing.location && child.location) {
   564→          childrenBySlot.set(derivedSlot, child);
   565→          childrenWithoutValidSlot.push(existing);
   566→        } else {
   567→          childrenWithoutValidSlot.push(child);
   568→        }
   569→      } else {
   570→        childrenWithoutValidSlot.push(child);
   571→      }
   572→    });
   573→
   574→    // DON'T assign orphans to available slots - this was causing deleted segments
   575→    // to be replaced by other segments. Orphan segments (without valid pair_shot_generation_id)
   576→    // should NOT be displayed. They'll remain hidden until regenerated for the correct slot.
   577→
   578→    // Fill in slots using LIVE timeline data for placeholders
   579→    for (let i = 0; i < slotCount; i++) {
   580→      const child = childrenBySlot.get(i);
   581→      // Use live timeline for pair_shot_generation_id (shot_generations.id of start image)
   582→      const liveStartImage = effectiveTimelineData?.[i];
   583→      const liveEndImage = effectiveTimelineData?.[i + 1];
   584→      // Get pair_shot_generation_id: prefer live data, fall back to expected data
   585→      const pairShotGenerationId = liveStartImage?.id || expectedSegmentData?.pairShotGenIds?.[i];
   586→
   587→      if (child) {
   588→        // Use the child's own pair_shot_generation_id for the key.
   589→        // liveStartImage?.id is wrong when LOCAL and LIVE orders diverge (e.g. after a drag reorder),
   590→        // causing buildDisplaySlots to fail to match this slot to the correct LOCAL pair.
   591→        const childPsgId = getPairIdentifiers(child, child.params as Record<string, unknown> | null).pairShotGenId;
   592→        slots.push({ type: 'child', child, index: i, pairShotGenerationId: childPsgId || pairShotGenerationId });
   593→      } else {
   594→        slots.push({
   595→          type: 'placeholder',
   596→          index: i,
   597→          expectedFrames: expectedSegmentData?.frames[i],
   598→          expectedPrompt: expectedSegmentData?.prompts[i],
   599→          startImage: liveStartImage?.generation_id || expectedSegmentData?.inputImages[i],
   600→          endImage: liveEndImage?.generation_id || expectedSegmentData?.inputImages[i + 1],
   601→          pairShotGenerationId,
   602→        });
   603→      }
   604→    }
   605→
   606→    return slots;
   607→  }, [segments, expectedSegmentData, effectiveTimelineData, liveShotGenIdToPosition, localShotGenPositions, trailingShotGenId]);
   608→
   609→  // Calculate progress
   610→  const segmentProgress = useMemo(() => {
   611→    const completed = segmentSlots.filter(s => s.type === 'child' && s.child.location).length;
   612→    const total = segmentSlots.length;
   613→
   614→    return { completed, total };
   615→  }, [segmentSlots]);
   616→
   617→  // Combined refetch
   618→  const refetch = useCallback(() => {
   619→    refetchParents();
   620→    refetchChildren();
   621→    refetchTimeline();
   622→  }, [refetchParents, refetchChildren, refetchTimeline]);
   623→
   624→  return {
   625→    parentGenerations,
   626→    selectedParentId,
   627→    setSelectedParentId,
   628→    selectedParent,
   629→    hasFinalOutput: !!(selectedParent?.location),
   630→    segmentSlots,
   631→    segments, // Actual segment children (for join functionality)
   632→    segmentProgress,
   633→    expectedSegmentData,
   634→    isLoading: isLoadingParents || isLoadingChildren,
   635→    isRefetching: isFetchingParents || isFetchingChildren,
   636→    refetch,
   637→  };
   638→}
   639→

   247→ * @param options - Resolution calculation options
   248→ * @returns Promise resolving to the final resolution string
   249→ */
   250→async function calculateTaskResolution(
   251→  options: CalculateTaskResolutionOptions
   252→): Promise<string> {
   253→  const { projectId, resolution_scale, resolution_mode, custom_aspect_ratio } = options;
   254→
   255→  // 1. If explicit custom resolution is provided, use it as-is (assumes it's already final)
   256→  if (options.customResolution?.trim()) {
   257→    return options.customResolution.trim();
   258→  }
   259→
   260→  // 2. Determine base resolution
   261→  let baseResolution: string;
   262→
   263→  if (resolution_mode === 'custom' && custom_aspect_ratio) {
   264→    // Use custom aspect ratio
   265→    baseResolution = ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[custom_aspect_ratio] ?? '902x508';
   266→  } else {
   267→    // Use project resolution
   268→    const { resolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(projectId);
   269→    baseResolution = resolution;
   270→  }
   271→
   272→  // 3. Apply scaling for image generation models
   273→  const isImageGenerationModel = options.modelName === 'qwen-image' || options.modelName === 'qwen-image-2512' || options.modelName === 'z-image';
   274→  if (isImageGenerationModel) {
   275→    const scale = resolution_scale ?? 1.5; // Default to 1.5 if not specified
   276→    const [width, height] = baseResolution.split('x').map(Number);
   277→    const scaledWidth = Math.round(width * scale);
   278→    const scaledHeight = Math.round(height * scale);
   279→    const scaledResolution = `${scaledWidth}x${scaledHeight}`;
   280→    return scaledResolution;
   281→  }
   282→
   283→  return baseResolution;
   284→}

1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
     6→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     7→import { isTaskDbRow, mapTaskDbRowToTask } from '@/shared/lib/taskRowMapper';
     8→import {
     9→  getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations,
    10→  toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    11→  type GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    12→  type GenerationTaskMappingStatus,
    13→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    14→
    15→interface PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions {
    16→  batchSize?: number;
    17→  delayBetweenBatches?: number;
    18→  preloadFullTaskData?: boolean;
    19→  projectId?: string;
    20→}
    21→
    22→export interface GenerationWithTaskData extends GenerationRow {
    23→  taskId?: string | null;
    24→  taskData?: Task | null;
    25→  taskMappingStatus?: GenerationTaskMappingStatus;
    26→  taskMappingError?: string;
    27→}
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    31→ */
    32→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    33→  generationIds: string[],
    34→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    35→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    36→) {
    37→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    38→  const {
    39→    batchSize = 5,
    40→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    41→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    42→    projectId,
    43→  } = options;
    44→
    45→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    46→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    47→
    48→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId });
    49→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    50→
    51→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    52→
    53→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    54→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    55→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    56→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    57→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    58→        cacheEntry,
    59→      );
    60→
    61→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    62→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    63→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    64→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    65→          showToast: false,
    66→        });
    67→      }
    68→
    69→      if (preloadFullTaskData && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    70→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    71→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId),
    72→          queryFn: async () => {
    73→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    74→              .from('tasks')
    75→              .select('*')
    76→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    77→              .single();
    78→
    79→            if (error) throw error;
    80→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    81→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    82→            }
    83→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    84→          },
    85→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    86→        }));
    87→      }
    88→    });
    89→
    90→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
    91→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
    92→    }
    93→
    94→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
    95→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
    96→    }
    97→  }
    98→}
    99→
   100→/**
   101→ * Enhance generations with task data from cache.
   102→ */
   103→export function enhanceGenerationsWithTaskData(
   104→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   105→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   106→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   107→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   108→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   109→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   110→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   111→    );
   112→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   113→    const taskData = taskId ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId)) : null;
   114→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   115→
   116→    return {
   117→      ...generation,
   118→      taskId,
   119→      taskData,
   120→      taskMappingStatus,
   121→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   122→    };
   123→  });
   124→}
   125→

   158→  const keyboardSensor = useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {
   159→    coordinateGetter: sortableKeyboardCoordinates,
   160→  });
   161→  
   162→  const sensors = useSensors(
   163→    useSensor(MouseSensor, {
   164→      activationConstraint: {
   165→        distance: 8, // 8px of movement required before drag starts
   166→      },
   167→    }),
   168→    useSensor(TouchSensor, {
   169→      activationConstraint: {
   170→        delay: 250,
   171→        tolerance: 5,
   172→      },
   173→    }),
   174→    keyboardSensor
   175→  );
   176→
   177→  const handleDragStart = (_event: DragStartEvent) => {
   178→    // Prevent drag if an input is focused
   179→    if (isInputFocused) {
   180→      return false;
   181→    }
   182→  };
   183→
   184→  const handleDragEnd = (event: DragEndEvent) => {
   185→    const { active, over } = event;
   186→
   187→    if (!over || !shots || !effectiveProjectId) {
   188→      return;
   189→    }
   190→
   191→    if (active.id !== over.id) {
   192→      const oldIndex = shots.findIndex((shot) => shot.id === active.id);
   193→      const newIndex = shots.findIndex((shot) => shot.id === over.id);
   194→
   195→      if (oldIndex === -1 || newIndex === -1) {
   196→        return;
   197→      }
   198→
   199→      // Create new order array
   200→      const reorderedShots = arrayMove(shots, oldIndex, newIndex);
   201→
   202→      // Update positions on the reordered shots
   203→      const shotsWithNewPositions = reorderedShots.map((shot, index) => ({
   204→        ...shot,
   205→        position: index + 1,
   206→      }));
   207→
   208→      // Apply local optimistic overlay for immediate visual feedback
   209→      setOptimisticShots(shotsWithNewPositions);
   210→
   211→      // Optimistically update the unlimited shots cache (used by ShotsContext -> useListShots(projectId))
   212→      queryClient.setQueryData(shotQueryKeys.list(effectiveProjectId, 0), shotsWithNewPositions);
   213→
   214→      // Generate position updates for database
   215→      const shotOrders = reorderedShots.map((shot, index) => ({
   216→        shotId: shot.id,
   217→        position: index + 1,
   218→      }));
   219→
   220→      // Update positions in database
   221→      reorderShotsMutation.mutate(
   222→        { projectId: effectiveProjectId, shotOrders },
   223→        {
   224→          onError: (error) => {
   225→            // Revert optimistic updates across all shot-list cache variants for this project.
   226→            queryClient.setQueriesData(
   227→              { queryKey: [...shotQueryKeys.all, effectiveProjectId] },
   228→              shots
   229→            );
   230→            toast.error(`Failed to reorder shots: ${error.message}`);
   231→          },
   232→        }
   233→      );
   234→    }
   235→  };
   236→
   237→  // Memoize sortable items
   238→  const sortableItems = React.useMemo(() => {
   239→    if (!shots) return [];
   240→    const items = shots.map((shot) => shot.id);
   241→    return items;
   242→  }, [shots]);
   243→  const currentShotIds = React.useMemo(() => shots?.map((s) => s.id) ?? [], [shots]);
   244→  const pendingNewShot = usePendingNewShotDrop({
   245→    currentShotIds,
   246→    shots,
   247→    onGenerationDropForNewShot,
   248→    onFilesDropForNewShot,
   249→    onSkeletonSetupReady,
   250→  });
   251→
   252→  // Show loading skeleton while data is being fetched
   253→  if (shotsLoading || shots === undefined) {
   254→    return <ShotListLoadingState />;
   255→  }
   256→
   257→  // Show error state if there's an error loading shots
   258→  if (shotsError) {
   259→    return <ShotListErrorState errorMessage={shotsError.message} onCreateNewShot={onCreateNewShot} />;
   260→  }
   261→
   262→  // Show empty state only when we definitively have no shots
   263→  if (!shots || shots.length === 0) {
   264→    return <ShotListEmptyState onCreateNewShot={onCreateNewShot} />;
   265→  }
   266→
   267→  // TEMPORARILY DISABLED: Dragging is always disabled (Task 20)
   268→  // To restore: const isDragDisabled = sortMode !== 'ordered' || reorderShotsMutation.isPending;
   269→  const isDragDisabled = true; // Ordered mode & reordering temporarily disabled
   270→
   271→  return (
   272→    <DndContext
   273→      sensors={sensors}
   274→      collisionDetection={closestCenter}
   275→      onDragStart={handleDragStart}
   276→      onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
   277→    >
   278→      <SortableContext 
   279→        items={sortableItems}
   280→        strategy={rectSortingStrategy}
   281→      >
   282→        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 md:gap-x-6 md:gap-y-5 pb-6 md:pb-8 px-4 pt-4 pb-2">
   283→          {(onGenerationDropForNewShot || onFilesDropForNewShot) && (
   284→            <NewShotDropZoneCard
   285→              isNewShotProcessing={pendingNewShot.isNewShotProcessing}
   286→              isNewShotDropTarget={pendingNewShot.isNewShotDropTarget}
   287→              newShotDropType={pendingNewShot.newShotDropType}
   288→              onDragEnter={pendingNewShot.handleNewShotDragEnter}
   289→              onDragOver={pendingNewShot.handleNewShotDragOver}
   290→              onDragLeave={pendingNewShot.handleNewShotDragLeave}
   291→              onDrop={pendingNewShot.handleNewShotDrop}
   292→              onClick={pendingNewShot.isNewShotProcessing ? undefined : onCreateNewShot}
   293→            />
   294→          )}
   295→
   296→          {pendingNewShot.pendingSkeletonShot && (
   297→            <PendingSkeletonShotCard pendingSkeletonShot={pendingNewShot.pendingSkeletonShot} />
   298→          )}
   299→          
   300→          {shots.map((shot, index) => {
   301→            return (
   302→              <SortableShotItem
   303→                key={shot.id}
   304→                shot={shot}
   305→                onSelectShot={() => onSelectShot(shot)}
   306→                onDuplicateShot={() => onSortModeChange?.('newest')}
   307→                currentProjectId={effectiveProjectId}
   308→                isDragDisabled={isDragDisabled}
   309→                disabledReason={sortMode !== 'ordered' ? 'Only available in ordered mode' : undefined}
   310→                shouldLoadImages={true} // Always load images since they're from context
   311→                shotIndex={index}
   312→                projectAspectRatio={currentProject?.aspectRatio}
   313→                isHighlighted={highlightedShotId === shot.id}
   314→                onGenerationDrop={onGenerationDropOnShot}
   315→                onFilesDrop={onFilesDropOnShot}
   316→                initialPendingUploads={shot.id === pendingNewShot.newlyCreatedShotId ? pendingNewShot.newlyCreatedShotExpectedImages : 0}
   317→                initialPendingBaselineNonVideoCount={shot.id === pendingNewShot.newlyCreatedShotId ? pendingNewShot.newlyCreatedShotBaselineNonVideoCount : undefined}
   318→                onInitialPendingUploadsConsumed={shot.id === pendingNewShot.newlyCreatedShotId ? pendingNewShot.clearNewlyCreatedShot : undefined}
   319→                dataTour={index === 0 ? 'first-shot' : undefined}
   320→                finalVideo={finalVideoMap.get(shot.id)}
   321→              />
   322→            );
   323→          })}
   324→        </div>
   325→      </SortableContext>
   326→    </DndContext>
   327→  );
   328→};
   329→
   330→export default ShotListDisplay;

   262→export async function getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(
   263→  generationIds: string[],
   264→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   265→): Promise<Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>> {
   266→  if (generationIds.length === 0) {
   267→    return new Map();
   268→  }
   269→
   270→  const requestedIds = Array.from(new Set(generationIds));
   271→  const supabaseResult = (options?.supabaseRegistry ?? supabaseClientRegistry).getClientResult();
   272→  if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
   273→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   274→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   275→      failures.set(generationId, {
   276→        generationId,
   277→        taskId: null,
   278→        status: 'query_failed',
   279→        queryError: supabaseResult.error.message,
   280→      });
   281→    });
   282→    return failures;
   283→  }
   284→
   285→  const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
   286→  const query = supabase
   287→    .from('generations')
   288→    .select('id, tasks, project_id')
   289→    .in('id', requestedIds);
   290→
   291→  const { data, error } = await query;
   292→
   293→  if (error) {
   294→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   295→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   296→      failures.set(generationId, {
   297→        generationId,
   298→        taskId: null,
   299→        status: 'query_failed',
   300→        queryError: error.message,
   301→      });
   302→    });
   303→    return failures;
   304→  }
   305→
   306→  const rowsById = new Map((data || []).map((row) => [row.id, row]));
   307→
   308→  const mappings = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   309→  for (const generationId of requestedIds) {
   310→    const row = rowsById.get(generationId);
   311→
   312→    if (!row) {
   313→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   314→        generationId,
   315→        taskId: null,
   316→        status: 'missing_generation',
   317→      });
   318→      continue;
   319→    }
   320→
   321→    if (options?.projectId && row.project_id !== options.projectId) {
   322→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   323→        generationId,
   324→        taskId: null,
   325→        status: 'scope_mismatch',
   326→      });
   327→      continue;
   328→    }
   329→
   330→    const parsed = parseGenerationTaskId(row.tasks);
   331→    mappings.set(generationId, {
   332→      generationId,
   333→      taskId: parsed.taskId,
   334→      status: parsed.status,
   335→    });
   336→  }
   337→
   338→  return mappings;
   339→}

    97→
    98→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
    99→    new Error(`Variant scope validation failed (${scope.status})`),
   100→    {
   101→      context,
   102→      showToast: false,
   103→      logData: {
   104→        variantId,
   105→        projectId,
   106→        generationId: scope.generationId,
   107→        scopeStatus: scope.status,
   108→        queryError: scope.queryError,
   109→      },
   110→    },

   271→// ===== Mutation Hooks =====
   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Shared delete mutation factory for generations and variants.
   275→ * @internal
   276→ */
   277→function useDeleteFromTable(table: 'generations' | 'generation_variants', entityLabel: string) {
   278→  return useMutation({
   279→    mutationFn: async (input: ScopedGenerationInput | ScopedVariantInput) => {
   280→      const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   281→        input.projectId,
   282→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.projectScope`,
   283→      );
   284→
   285→      if (table === 'generations') {
   286→        await verifyGenerationScope(
   287→          input.id,
   288→          projectId,
   289→          `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   290→        );
   291→
   292→        const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   293→          id: input.id,
   294→          projectId,
   295→        });
   296→
   297→        if (error) {
   298→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   299→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   300→            showToast: false,
   301→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   302→          });
   303→        }
   304→
   305→        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   306→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   307→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   308→            showToast: false,
   309→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   310→          });
   311→        }
   312→
   313→        return;
   314→      }
   315→
   316→      const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   317→        input.id,
   318→        projectId,
   319→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   320→      );
   321→      const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   322→        id: input.id,
   323→        generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   324→      });
   325→
   326→      if (error) {
   327→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   328→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   329→          showToast: false,
   330→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   331→        });
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   335→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   336→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   337→          showToast: false,
   338→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   339→        });
   340→      }
   341→    },
   342→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   343→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→        context: `useDelete${entityLabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + entityLabel.slice(1)}`,
   345→        toastTitle: `Failed to delete ${entityLabel}`,
   346→      });
   347→    },
   348→  });
   349→}

   352→  return useDeleteFromTable('generations', 'generation');
   353→}

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';

    26→import { TOOL_IDS, isToolId } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';

    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';
    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    35→ */
    36→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    37→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    38→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    39→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    40→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    41→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    42→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    43→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    44→  degraded?: boolean;
    45→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    46→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    47→}
    48→
    49→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    50→  return {
    51→    derivedCounts: {},
    52→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    53→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    54→  };
    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    59→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    60→ *
    61→ * Queries both:
    62→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    63→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    64→ *
    65→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    66→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    67→ */
    68→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    69→  generationIds: string[]
    70→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    71→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    72→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    73→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    77→
    78→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    79→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    80→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    81→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    82→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    83→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    84→
    85→  if (variantCountsError) {
    86→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    87→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    88→      cause: variantCountsError,
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (variantCountsData) {
    93→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    94→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    95→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    96→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    97→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    98→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    99→      }
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   104→}
   105→
   106→/**
   107→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   108→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   109→ */
   110→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   111→  generationIds: string[]
   112→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {

   115→  } catch (error) {
   116→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });

   118→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   119→      degraded: true,
   120→      errorCode: 'query_failed',

   200→/**
   201→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   202→ */
   203→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   204→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   205→
   206→  const originalParams = params.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   207→  const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   208→  const metadataBlock = params.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   209→
   210→  return (
   211→    (orchestratorDetails?.prompt as string) ||
   212→    (params.prompt as string) ||
   213→    (metadataBlock?.prompt as string) ||
   214→    'No prompt'
   215→  );
   216→}

   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = item.params?.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   231→    const fullPayload = item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   232→    const originalFullPayload = originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl =
   235→      (item.params?.thumbnailUrl as string) ||
   236→      (orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   237→      (fullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   238→      (originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string);
   239→  }
   240→  
   241→  // Final fallback to main URL
   242→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   243→}

   247→ */
   248→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   249→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   250→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);

   253→/**

   255→ *

   262→export function transformGeneration(
   263→  item: RawGeneration,

   266→  const mainUrl = item.location;

   272→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions

   275→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   276→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   277→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   278→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   279→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   280→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   281→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   282→    contentType = 'image/png';
   283→  }
   284→  
   285→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   286→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   287→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   288→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   289→
   290→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   291→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   292→    id: item.id,
   293→    url: mainUrl,
   294→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   295→    urlIdentity,
   296→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   297→    prompt,
   298→    metadata: {
   299→      ...(item.params || {}),
   300→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   301→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   302→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   303→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   304→    },
   305→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   306→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   307→    isVideo,
   308→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   309→    starred: item.starred || false,
   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   311→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   312→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    name: item.name || (item.params?.name as string | undefined) || undefined,
   314→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   315→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   316→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   317→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   318→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   319→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   320→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   321→  };
   322→
   323→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   324→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(item.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined);
   325→  
   326→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   327→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   328→    return {
   329→      ...baseItem,
   330→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   331→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   332→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   333→    };
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   337→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   338→    // Single shot optimization
   339→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   340→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   341→      return {
   342→        ...baseItem,
   343→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   344→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   345→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   346→      };
   347→    }
   348→    
   349→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   350→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   351→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   352→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   353→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   354→    }));
   355→    
   356→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   357→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   358→    if (options.shotId) {
   359→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   360→      if (matchingShot) {
   361→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   362→      }
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    return {
   366→      ...baseItem,
   367→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   368→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   369→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   370→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   371→    };
   372→  }
   373→  
   374→  return baseItem;
   375→}
   376→
   377→/**
   378→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   379→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   380→ */
   381→export function transformForTimeline(
   382→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   383→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   384→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   385→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   386→  
   387→  if (!genData) {
   388→    return {
   389→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   390→      id: shotGen.id,
   391→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   392→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   393→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   394→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   395→    };
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return {
   399→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   400→    id: shotGen.id,
   401→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   402→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   403→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   404→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   405→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   408→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}
   416→
   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}

   427→    // Check if request was cancelled before starting
   428→    if (signal?.aborted) {
   429→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   430→        recoverable: true,
   431→      }));
   432→    }
   433→
   434→    // Single-flight dedupe key for concurrent identical requests
   435→    const singleFlightKey = JSON.stringify({ toolId, projectId: ctx.projectId ?? null, shotId: ctx.shotId ?? null });
   436→    const existingPromise = inflightSettingsFetches.get(singleFlightKey);
   437→    if (existingPromise) {
   438→      const value = await raceWithAbort(existingPromise as Promise<SettingsFetchResult>, signal);
   439→      return operationSuccess(value);
   440→    }
   441→
   442→    const promise = (async (): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   443→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   444→
   445→      const { data: { user } } = await getUserWithTimeout();
   446→
   447→      if (!user) {
   448→        throw new ToolSettingsError('auth_required', 'Authentication required');
   449→      }
   450→
   451→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   452→
   453→      const supabaseClient = getSupabaseClient();
   454→      const [userResult, projectResult, shotResult] = await fetchAllScopes(supabaseClient, user.id, ctx, signal);
   455→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   456→      return extractAndMergeSettings(userResult, projectResult, shotResult, toolId, ctx);
   457→    })();
   458→
   459→    inflightSettingsFetches.set(singleFlightKey, promise);
   460→    // The .finally cleanup promise is intentionally not awaited or returned.
   461→    // Suppress its rejection to avoid unhandled rejection warnings — the original
   462→    // `promise` reference (returned below) handles propagation to the caller.
   463→    promise.finally(() => {
   464→      inflightSettingsFetches.delete(singleFlightKey);
   465→    }).catch(() => {});
   466→    const value = await raceWithAbort(promise, signal);
   467→    return operationSuccess(value);
   468→
   469→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   470→    if (isToolSettingsError(error) && error.code === 'cancelled') {
   471→      return toOperationFailure(error);
   472→    }
   473→    if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   474→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   475→        recoverable: true,
   476→        cause: error,
   477→      }));
   478→    }
   479→    // Build context info without calling getSession() — can block during token refresh
   480→    const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
   481→    const contextInfo = {
   482→      visibilityState: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.visibilityState : 'unknown',
   483→      hidden: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.hidden : false,
   484→      online: typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true,
   485→    };
   486→
   487→    if (errorMsg.includes('Auth timeout') || errorMsg.includes('Auth request was cancelled')) {
   488→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   489→        context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.authTimeout',
   490→        showToast: false,
   491→        logData: contextInfo,
   492→      });
   493→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   494→        'network',
   495→        'Authentication check timed out. Please retry.',
   496→        {
   497→          recoverable: true,
   498→          cause: error,
   499→          metadata: { ...contextInfo, reason: 'auth_timeout' },
   500→        },
   501→      ));
   502→    }
   503→
   504→    if (errorMsg.includes('Failed to fetch')) {
   505→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.network', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   506→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   507→        'network',
   508→        'Network connection issue. Please check your internet connection.',
   509→        {
   510→          recoverable: true,
   511→          cause: error,
   512→          metadata: contextInfo,
   513→        },
   514→      ));
   515→    }
   516→
   517→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   518→    return toOperationFailure(classifyToolSettingsError(error));
   519→  }
   520→}
   521→
   522→/**
   523→ * Fetch tool settings and throw `ToolSettingsError` on failure.
   524→ *
   525→ * Use this from hook boundaries that already model errors as thrown exceptions
   526→ * (for example React Query query functions and mutation pipelines) so read/write
   527→ * settings flows share the same error contract.
   528→ */
   529→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(
   530→  toolId: string,
   531→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   532→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   533→): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> {
   534→  const result = await fetchToolSettingsSupabase(toolId, ctx, signal);
   535→  if (!result.ok) {
   536→    throw toToolSettingsErrorFromOperationFailure(result);
   537→  }
   538→  return result.value;
   539→}

   209→export function useHuggingFaceUpload() {

   211→    stage: 'idle',
   212→    message: '',

   214→
   215→  /**
   216→   * Upload a file to the temporary storage bucket
   217→   */
   218→  const uploadToTempStorage = async (file: File, userId: string): Promise<string> => {
   219→    const fileName = `${uuidv4()}-${file.name}`;
   220→    const filePath = `${userId}/${fileName}`;
   221→    const { error } = await supabase().storage
   222→      .from('temporary')
   223→      .upload(filePath, file, {
   224→        cacheControl: '3600',
   225→        upsert: false,
   226→      });
   227→
   228→    if (error) {
   229→      throw new Error(`Failed to upload file: ${error.message}`);
   230→    }
   231→
   232→    return filePath;
   233→  };

   237→   * Supports both single-stage (one file) and multi-stage (high_noise + low_noise) LoRAs.

   243→    options: {

   245→      repoName?: string;

   248→    try {
   249→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase().auth.getUser();
   250→      if (!user) {

   253→
   254→      const storagePaths = await uploadLoraFilesToTempStorage({
   255→        loraFiles,
   256→        userId: user.id,
   257→        setUploadProgress,
   258→        uploadToTempStorage,
   259→      });
   260→
   261→      if (!storagePaths) {
   262→        return { success: false, error: 'No LoRA file provided' };
   263→      }
   264→
   265→      const sampleVideoMeta = await uploadSampleVideosToTempStorage({
   266→        sampleVideos,
   267→        userId: user.id,
   268→        setUploadProgress,
   269→        uploadToTempStorage,
   270→      });
   271→
   272→      setUploadProgress({
   273→        stage: 'processing',
   274→        message: 'Uploading to HuggingFace...',
   275→        progress: 60,
   276→      });
   277→
   278→      const response = await invokeHuggingFaceUpload({
   279→        storagePaths,
   280→        loraDetails,
   281→        sampleVideoMeta,
   282→        options,
   283→      });
   284→
   285→      setUploadProgress({
   286→        stage: 'complete',
   287→        message: 'Upload complete!',
   288→        progress: 100,
   289→      });

   297→      });

   308→    uploadProgress,

   311→  };

    15→interface AuthContextType {
    16→  /** Current authenticated user ID, null if not logged in */
    17→  userId: string | null;
    18→  /** Whether the user is authenticated */
    19→  isAuthenticated: boolean;
    20→  /** Whether the initial auth check is still in progress */
    21→  isLoading: boolean;
    22→}
    23→
    24→const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);
    25→
    26→/**
    27→ * AuthProvider handles authentication state and event debouncing.
    28→ *
    29→ * Features:
    30→ * - [AuthDebounce] Debounces duplicate auth events to prevent cascading updates
    31→ * - [MobileStallFix] Resets loading states on meaningful auth transitions
    32→ * - [FastResume] Provides immediate auth state for fast tab resume
    33→ */
    34→export const AuthProvider = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => {
    35→  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
    36→  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
    37→
    38→  // [MobileStallFix] Enhanced auth state tracking with mobile recovery
    39→  // [AuthDebounce] Prevent cascading updates from duplicate auth events
    40→  useEffect(() => {
    41→    let debounceTimeout: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
    42→    let lastProcessedState: { event: string; userId: string | undefined } | null = null;
    43→    let pendingAuthState: { event: string; session: Session | null } | null = null;
    44→
    45→    const processAuthChange = (event: string, session: Session | null) => {
    46→      const currentUserId = session?.user?.id;
    47→
    48→      // Check if this is a meaningful state transition
    49→      const isDuplicateEvent = lastProcessedState &&
    50→        lastProcessedState.event === event &&
    51→        lastProcessedState.userId === currentUserId;
    52→
    53→      if (isDuplicateEvent) {
    54→        return;
    55→      }
    56→
    57→      // Keep toolSettingsService user cache in sync so it never needs to
    58→      // acquire navigator.locks when called from within AuthGate
    59→      if (currentUserId) {
    60→        setCachedUserId(currentUserId);
    61→      }
    62→
    63→      // Update user ID
    64→      setUserId(currentUserId);
    65→
    66→      // Track the processed state
    67→      lastProcessedState = { event, userId: currentUserId };
    68→    };
    69→
    70→    const handleAuthStateChange = (event: string, session: Session | null) => {
    71→      // Seed the toolSettingsService user cache IMMEDIATELY — before the 150ms debounce.
    72→      // Without this, there's a race: setIsLoading(false) can open AuthGate while
    73→      // cachedUser is still null (debounce hasn't fired processAuthChange yet).
    74→      if (session?.user?.id) {
    75→        setCachedUserId(session.user.id);
    76→      }
    77→
    78→      // Store the latest auth state
    79→      pendingAuthState = { event, session };
    80→
    81→      // Clear existing debounce timer
    82→      if (debounceTimeout) {
    83→        clearTimeout(debounceTimeout);
    84→      }
    85→
    86→      // [AuthDebounce] Wait 150ms for additional auth events before processing
    87→      debounceTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    88→        if (pendingAuthState) {
    89→          const { event: pendingEvent, session: pendingSession } = pendingAuthState;
    90→          React.startTransition(() => {
    91→            processAuthChange(pendingEvent, pendingSession);
    92→          });
    93→          pendingAuthState = null;
    94→        }
    95→        debounceTimeout = null;
    96→      }, 150);
    97→    };
    98→
    99→    supabase().auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session } }) => {
   100→      // Seed toolSettingsService cache BEFORE opening AuthGate (setIsLoading(false)).
   101→      // This guarantees getUserWithTimeout() returns from cache (no navigator.locks)
   102→      // for all components that mount after the gate opens.
   103→      if (session?.user?.id) {
   104→        setCachedUserId(session.user.id);
   105→      }
   106→      setUserId(session?.user?.id);
   107→      setIsLoading(false);
   108→      lastProcessedState = { event: 'INITIAL_SESSION', userId: session?.user?.id };
   109→    });
   110→
   111→    // Use centralized auth manager instead of direct listener
   112→    const authManager = getAuthStateManager();
   113→    let unsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null;
   114→
   115→    if (authManager) {
   116→      unsubscribe = authManager.subscribe('AuthContext', handleAuthStateChange);
   117→    } else {
   118→      // Fallback to direct listener if auth manager not available
   119→      const { data: listener } = supabase().auth.onAuthStateChange(handleAuthStateChange);
   120→      unsubscribe = () => listener.subscription.unsubscribe();
   121→    }
   122→
   123→    return () => {
   124→      if (unsubscribe) unsubscribe();
   125→      if (debounceTimeout) {
   126→        clearTimeout(debounceTimeout);
   127→        // Process final pending state on cleanup if needed
   128→        if (pendingAuthState) {
   129→          processAuthChange(pendingAuthState.event, pendingAuthState.session);
   130→        }
   131→      }
   132→    };
   133→  }, []);
   134→
   135→  const contextValue = useMemo(
   136→    () => ({
   137→      userId: userId ?? null,
   138→      isAuthenticated: !!userId,
   139→      isLoading,
   140→    }),
   141→    [userId, isLoading]
   142→  );
   143→
   144→  return (
   145→    <AuthContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
   146→      {children}
   147→    </AuthContext.Provider>
   148→  );
   149→};
   150→
   151→/**
   152→ * Hook to access authentication state.
   153→ *
   154→ * @returns { userId, isAuthenticated }
   155→ */
   156→export const useAuth = () => {
   157→  return requireContextValue(useContext(AuthContext), 'useAuth', 'AuthProvider');

     3→import {
     4→  type SupabaseClientAccessResult,
     5→  getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult,
     6→  initializeSupabaseClientRuntime,
     7→  normalizeSupabaseError,

     9→
    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };
    11→
    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
    34→}
    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {
    42→  const result = supabaseClientRegistry.getClientResult();
    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;
    45→  }
    46→  return result.client;
    47→}

1→import type { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import {
     3→  reportError,
     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
