   164→def _sync_plan_after_review_change(
   165→    state: dict, diff: dict, *, assessment_mode: str | None = None,
   166→) -> None:
   167→    """Best-effort: sync living plan after review import introduces new findings.
   168→
   169→    Also auto-resolves subjective dimension queue items that were covered
   170→    by this import and injects ``workflow::create-plan`` when all initial
   171→    reviews are complete.
   172→    """
   173→    try:
   174→        from desloppify.engine.plan import (
   175→            append_log_entry,
   176→            has_living_plan,
   177→            load_plan,
   178→            purge_ids,
   179→            save_plan,
   180→            sync_create_plan_needed,
   181→            sync_plan_after_review_import,
   182→            sync_score_checkpoint_needed,
   183→        )
   184→        from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
   185→            sync_communicate_score_needed,
   186→            sync_import_scores_needed,
   187→        )
   188→
   189→        if not has_living_plan():
   190→            return
   191→
   192→        plan = load_plan()
   193→        result = sync_plan_after_review_import(plan, state)
   194→
   195→        # Auto-resolve subjective dimension items that are no longer unscored
   196→        from desloppify.engine.plan import current_unscored_ids
   197→        still_unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   198→        order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   199→        subjective_in_queue = [
   200→            fid for fid in order if fid.startswith("subjective::")
   201→        ]
   202→        covered_ids = [
   203→            fid for fid in subjective_in_queue
   204→            if fid not in still_unscored
   205→        ]
   206→        if covered_ids:
   207→            purge_ids(plan, covered_ids)
   208→
   209→        # Check if score checkpoint and create-plan items should be injected
   210→        checkpoint_result = sync_score_checkpoint_needed(plan, state)
   211→        create_plan_result = sync_create_plan_needed(plan, state)
   212→
   213→        # Check if import-scores workflow item should be injected
   214→        # (only when findings were imported without scores)
   215→        scores_imported = assessment_mode in ("trusted_internal", "attested_external")
   216→        import_scores_result = sync_import_scores_needed(
   217→            plan, state, assessment_mode=assessment_mode,
   218→        )
   219→        # Check if communicate-score workflow item should be injected
   220→        # (only when scores were just imported via trusted/attested path)
   221→        communicate_result = sync_communicate_score_needed(
   222→            plan, state, scores_just_imported=scores_imported,
   223→        )
   224→
   225→        injected_parts = []
   226→        if checkpoint_result.injected:
   227→            injected_parts.append("`workflow::score-checkpoint`")
   228→        if import_scores_result.injected:
   229→            injected_parts.append("`workflow::import-scores`")
   230→        if communicate_result.injected:
   231→            injected_parts.append("`workflow::communicate-score`")
   232→        if create_plan_result.injected:
   233→            injected_parts.append("`workflow::create-plan`")
   234→        if injected_parts:
   235→            print(colorize(
   236→                f"  Plan: reviews complete — {' and '.join(injected_parts)} queued. Run `desloppify next`.",
   237→                "cyan",
   238→            ))
   239→
   240→        if result is not None:
   241→            append_log_entry(
   242→                plan,
   243→                "review_import_sync",
   244→                actor="system",
   245→                detail={
   246→                    "trigger": "review_import",
   247→                    "new_ids": sorted(result.new_ids),
   248→                    "added_to_queue": result.added_to_queue,
   249→                    "diff_new": diff.get("new", 0),
   250→                    "diff_reopened": diff.get("reopened", 0),
   251→                    "covered_subjective": covered_ids,
   252→                },
   253→            )
   254→
   255→        save_plan(plan)
   256→        if result is not None:
   257→            _print_review_import_sync(state, result)
   258→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   259→        print(
   260→            colorize(
   261→                f"  Note: skipped plan sync after review import ({exc}).",
   262→                "dim",
   263→            )
   264→        )

   338→    state_path = Path(state_file) if state_file is not None else None

   344→    label = "Holistic review"

   352→    elif assessment_policy.mode in {"trusted_internal", "attested_external"}:

   371→    if assessment_policy.assessments_present:

   151→    """
   152→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
   153→    from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
   154→        all_subjective_entries,
   155→    )
   156→
   157→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   158→    if not dim_scores:
   159→        return set()
   160→
   161→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   162→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   163→
   164→    under_target: set[str] = set()
   165→    for entry in all_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores):
   166→        if entry.get("placeholder") or entry.get("stale"):
   167→            continue
   168→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   169→        if strict_val >= target_strict:
   170→            continue
   171→        dim_key = entry.get("dimension_key", "")
   172→        if not dim_key:
   173→            continue
   174→        fid = f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}"
   175→        if fid not in stale_ids and fid not in unscored_ids:
   176→            under_target.add(fid)
   177→    return under_target
   178→
   179→
   180→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   181→# Promoted-aware insertion helper
   182→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   183→
   184→def _after_promoted(order: list[str], plan: PlanModel) -> int:
   185→    """Return the insertion index just after the last promoted item in *order*.
   186→
   187→    When no promoted items are present (or none are in *order*), returns 0
   188→    so callers fall back to existing front-of-queue behavior.
   189→    """
   190→    promoted = set(plan.get("promoted_ids", []))
   191→    if not promoted:
   192→        return 0
   193→    last_idx = -1
   194→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   195→        if fid in promoted:
   196→            last_idx = i
   197→    return last_idx + 1 if last_idx >= 0 else 0
   198→
   199→
   200→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   201→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   202→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   203→
   204→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   205→    plan: PlanModel,
   206→    state: StateModel,
   207→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   208→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   209→
   210→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   211→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   212→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   213→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   214→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   215→    """
   216→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   217→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   218→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   219→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   220→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   221→
   222→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   223→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   224→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   225→        fid for fid in order
   226→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   227→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   228→        and fid not in stale_ids
   229→    ]
   230→    for fid in to_remove:
   231→        order.remove(fid)
   232→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   233→
   234→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs after any promoted items -------------
   235→    existing = set(order)
   236→    insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   237→    for uid in reversed(sorted(unscored_ids)):
   238→        if uid not in existing:
   239→            order.insert(insert_at, uid)
   240→            result.injected.append(uid)
   241→
   242→    return result
   243→
   244→
   245→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   246→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   247→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   248→
   249→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   250→    plan: PlanModel,
   251→    state: StateModel,
   252→    *,
   253→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   254→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,
   255→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   256→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale and under-target subjective dimensions.
   257→
   258→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   259→       longer stale/under-target and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned
   260→       by ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   261→    2. Inject stale and under-target dimension IDs when either:
   262→       a. No objective items remain (mid-cycle: append to back), OR
   263→       b. A cycle just completed (post-cycle: insert at front so subjective
   264→          review takes priority over new objective findings).
   265→    """
   266→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   267→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   268→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   269→    under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state)
   270→    injectable_ids = stale_ids | under_target_ids
   271→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   272→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   273→
   274→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   275→    # Only prune IDs that are no longer injectable and not unscored.
   276→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   277→        fid for fid in order
   278→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   279→        and fid not in injectable_ids
   280→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   281→    ]
   282→    for fid in to_remove:
   283→        order.remove(fid)
   284→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   285→
   286→    # --- Inject or evict stale + under-target dimensions -----------------
   287→    if policy is not None:
   288→        has_real_items = policy.has_objective_backlog
   289→    else:
   290→        has_real_items = any(
   291→            f.get("status") == "open"
   292→            and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   293→            and not f.get("suppressed")
   294→            for f in state.get("findings", {}).values()
   295→        )
   296→
   297→    should_inject = not has_real_items or cycle_just_completed
   298→
   299→    if not should_inject:
   300→        # Mid-cycle with objective backlog: evict any stale/under-target IDs
   301→        # that are present in the queue.  They may have been grandfathered from
   302→        # the unscored phase and should not be visible until the objective
   303→        # backlog clears or a cycle completes.
   304→        to_evict = [
   305→            fid for fid in order
   306→            if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   307→            and fid in injectable_ids
   308→        ]
   309→        for fid in to_evict:
   310→            order.remove(fid)
   311→            result.pruned.append(fid)
   312→
   313→    if should_inject and injectable_ids:
   314→        existing = set(order)
   315→        if cycle_just_completed and has_real_items:
   316→            # Post-cycle: front-of-queue after promoted items so subjective
   317→            # review happens before the new objective cycle begins.
   318→            insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   319→            for sid in reversed(sorted(injectable_ids)):
   320→                if sid not in existing:
   321→                    order.insert(insert_at, sid)
   322→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   323→        else:
   324→            # Mid-cycle or no objective backlog: append to back.
   325→            for sid in sorted(injectable_ids):
   326→                if sid not in existing:
   327→                    order.append(sid)
   328→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   329→
   330→    return result
   331→
   332→
   333→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   334→# Triage snapshot hash + sync
   335→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   336→
   337→def review_finding_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   338→    """Hash open review finding IDs to detect changes.
   339→
   340→    Returns empty string when there are no open review findings.
   341→    """
   342→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   343→    review_ids = sorted(
   344→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   345→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   346→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   347→    )
   348→    if not review_ids:
   349→        return ""
   350→    return hashlib.sha256("|".join(review_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
   351→
   352→
   353→@dataclass
   354→class TriageSyncResult:
   355→    """What changed during a triage sync."""
   356→
   357→    injected: bool = False
   358→    pruned: bool = False
   359→
   360→    @property
   361→    def changes(self) -> int:
   362→        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
   363→
   364→
   365→def sync_triage_needed(
   366→    plan: PlanModel,
   367→    state: StateModel,
   368→) -> TriageSyncResult:
   369→    """Inject 4 triage stage IDs at front of queue when review findings change.
   370→
   371→    Only injects stages not already confirmed in ``epic_triage_meta``.
   372→
   373→    When stages are already present but all new findings have been resolved
   374→    since injection, auto-prunes the stale stages and updates the hash.
   375→
   376→    When findings are *resolved* (current IDs are a subset of previously
   377→    triaged IDs), the snapshot hash is updated silently — no re-triage
   378→    is needed since the user is working through the plan.
   379→    """
   380→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   381→    result = TriageSyncResult()
   382→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   383→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   384→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   385→
   386→    # Check if any triage stage is already in queue
   387→    already_present = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS)
   388→
   389→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   390→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   391→
   392→    if already_present:
   393→        # Stages present — check if the reason for injection still applies.
   394→        # Only auto-prune when triage was completed before (hash exists),
   395→        # all new findings have been resolved, and no triage work is in
   396→        # progress.  This avoids pruning the initial triage or a
   397→        # user-started triage session.
   398→        if last_hash and not confirmed:
   399→            findings = state.get("findings", {})
   400→            current_review_ids = {
   401→                fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   402→                if f.get("status") == "open"
   403→                and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   404→            }
   405→            triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   406→            new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   407→
   408→            if not new_since_triage:
   409→                # No new findings remain — prune stale stages
   410→                for sid in TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS:
   411→                    while sid in order:
   412→                        order.remove(sid)
   413→                if current_hash:
   414→                    meta["finding_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   415→                    plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   416→                result.pruned = True
   417→        return result
   418→
   419→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash:
   420→        # Distinguish "new findings appeared" from "findings were resolved".
   421→        # Only re-triage when genuinely new findings exist.
   422→        findings = state.get("findings", {})
   423→        current_review_ids = {
   424→            fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   425→            if f.get("status") == "open"
   426→            and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   427→        }
   428→        triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   429→        new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   430→
   431→        if new_since_triage:
   432→            # New review findings appeared — re-triage needed
   433→            insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   434→            stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   435→            existing = set(order)
   436→            injected_count = 0
   437→            for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names):
   438→                if name not in confirmed and sid not in existing:
   439→                    order.insert(insert_at + injected_count, sid)
   440→                    injected_count += 1
   441→            if injected_count:
   442→                result.injected = True
   443→        else:
   444→            # Only resolved findings changed the hash — update silently
   445→            meta["finding_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   446→            plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   447→
   448→    return result
   449→
   450→
   451→@dataclass
   452→class ScoreCheckpointSyncResult:
   453→    """What changed during a score-checkpoint sync."""
   454→
   455→    injected: bool = False
   456→
   457→    @property
   458→    def changes(self) -> int:
   459→        return int(self.injected)
   460→
   461→
   462→def sync_score_checkpoint_needed(
   463→    plan: PlanModel,
   464→    state: StateModel,
   465→    *,
   466→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   467→) -> ScoreCheckpointSyncResult:
   468→    """Inject ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` when all initial reviews complete.
   469→
   470→    Injects when:
   471→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   472→    - ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` is not already in the queue
   473→
   474→    Positioned after subjective items but before triage/create-plan
   475→    so the user sees their updated strict score right after reviews finish.
   476→    """
   477→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   478→    result = ScoreCheckpointSyncResult()
   479→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   480→
   481→    if WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID in order:
   482→        return result
   483→
   484→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   485→    if policy is not None:
   486→        if policy.unscored_ids:
   487→            return result
   488→    else:
   489→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   490→        if unscored:
   491→            return result
   492→
   493→    # Insert after any subjective items, before triage/workflow/findings
   494→    insert_at = 0
   495→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   496→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX):
   497→            insert_at = i + 1
   498→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID)
   499→    result.injected = True
   500→    return result
   501→

   503→@dataclass
   504→class CreatePlanSyncResult:
   505→    """What changed during a create-plan sync."""
   506→
   507→    injected: bool = False
   508→
   509→    @property
   510→    def changes(self) -> int:
   511→        return int(self.injected)
   512→
   513→
   514→def sync_create_plan_needed(
   515→    plan: PlanModel,
   516→    state: StateModel,
   517→    *,
   518→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   519→) -> CreatePlanSyncResult:
   520→    """Inject ``workflow::create-plan`` when reviews complete + objective backlog exists.
   521→
   522→    Only injects when:
   523→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   524→    - At least one objective finding exists
   525→    - ``workflow::create-plan`` is not already in the queue
   526→    - No triage stages are pending
   527→    """
   528→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   529→    result = CreatePlanSyncResult()
   530→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   531→
   532→    if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID in order:
   533→        return result
   534→
   535→    # Don't inject if triage stages are pending
   536→    if any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS):
   537→        return result
   538→
   539→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   540→    if policy is not None:
   541→        if policy.unscored_ids:
   542→            return result
   543→        has_objective = policy.has_objective_backlog
   544→    else:
   545→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   546→        if unscored:
   547→            return result
   548→        findings = state.get("findings", {})
   549→        has_objective = any(
   550→            f.get("status") == "open"
   551→            and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   552→            for f in findings.values()
   553→        )
   554→    if not has_objective:
   555→        return result
   556→
   557→    # Insert after any subjective/workflow items, at the end of the
   558→    # synthetic block (so create-plan comes after score-checkpoint).
   559→    insert_at = 0
   560→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   561→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(TRIAGE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX):
   562→            insert_at = i + 1
   563→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)
   564→    result.injected = True
   565→    return result
   566→
   567→
   568→def compute_new_finding_ids(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
   569→    """Return the set of open review/concerns finding IDs added since last triage.
   570→
   571→    Returns an empty set when no prior triage has recorded ``triaged_ids``.
   572→    """
   573→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   574→    triaged = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", meta.get("synthesized_ids", [])))
   575→    current = {
   576→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   577→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   578→    }
   579→    return current - triaged if triaged else set()
   580→
   581→
   582→def is_triage_stale(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> bool:
   583→    """Side-effect-free check: is triage needed?
   584→
   585→    Returns True when genuinely *new* review findings appeared since the
   586→    last triage.  Triage stage IDs being in the queue alone is not
   587→    sufficient — the new findings that triggered injection may have been
   588→    resolved since then.
   589→
   590→    When findings are merely resolved (current IDs are a subset of
   591→    previously triaged IDs), triage is NOT stale — the user is working
   592→    through the plan.
   593→    """
   594→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   595→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   596→
   597→    # Always check for genuinely new findings (same logic regardless of
   598→    # whether triage stages are in the queue).
   599→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   600→    current_review_ids = {
   601→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   602→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   603→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   604→    }
   605→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   606→    new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   607→    if new_since_triage:
   608→        return True
   609→
   610→    # If triage stages are in queue but there's in-progress triage work,
   611→    # still consider it stale so the user finishes what they started.
   612→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   613→    if confirmed:
   614→        order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   615→        if order & TRIAGE_IDS:
   616→            return True
   617→
   618→    return False
   619→

   621→@dataclass
   622→class ImportScoresSyncResult:
   623→    """What changed during an import-scores sync."""
   624→
   625→    injected: bool = False
   626→
   627→    @property
   628→    def changes(self) -> int:
   629→        return int(self.injected)
   630→
   631→
   632→def sync_import_scores_needed(
   633→    plan: PlanModel,
   634→    state: StateModel,
   635→    *,
   636→    assessment_mode: str | None = None,
   637→) -> ImportScoresSyncResult:
   638→    """Inject ``workflow::import-scores`` after findings-only import.
   639→
   640→    Only injects when:
   641→    - Assessment mode was ``findings_only`` (scores were skipped)
   642→    - ``workflow::import-scores`` is not already in the queue
   643→    - There are assessments in the payload that could be imported
   644→
   645→    Positioned after score-checkpoint, before create-plan.
   646→    """
   647→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   648→    result = ImportScoresSyncResult()
   649→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   650→
   651→    if WORKFLOW_IMPORT_SCORES_ID in order:
   652→        return result
   653→
   654→    # Only inject when scores were skipped (findings-only mode)
   655→    if assessment_mode != "findings_only":
   656→        return result
   657→
   658→    # Insert after any subjective/workflow items
   659→    insert_at = 0
   660→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   661→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX):
   662→            insert_at = i + 1
   663→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_IMPORT_SCORES_ID)
   664→    result.injected = True
   665→    return result

   678→
   679→def sync_communicate_score_needed(
   680→    plan: PlanModel,
   681→    state: StateModel,
   682→    *,
   683→    scores_just_imported: bool = False,
   684→) -> CommunicateScoreSyncResult:
   685→    """Inject ``workflow::communicate-score`` after scores are imported.
   686→
   687→    Only injects when:
   688→    - Scores were just imported (trusted or attested)
   689→    - ``workflow::communicate-score`` is not already in the queue
   690→
   691→    Positioned after import-scores/score-checkpoint, before create-plan.
   692→    """
   693→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   694→    result = CommunicateScoreSyncResult()
   695→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   696→
   697→    if WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID in order:
   698→        return result
   699→
   700→    if not scores_just_imported:
   701→        return result
   702→
   703→    # Insert after any subjective/workflow items
   704→    insert_at = 0
   705→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   706→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX):
   707→            insert_at = i + 1
   708→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID)
   709→    result.injected = True
   710→    return result

    52→def _apply_persisted_exclusions(args, config: dict):
    53→    """Merge CLI --exclude with persisted config.exclude and apply globally."""
    54→    cli_exclusions = getattr(args, "exclude", None) or []
    55→    persisted = config.get("exclude", [])
    56→    combined = list(cli_exclusions) + [e for e in persisted if e not in cli_exclusions]
    57→    if not combined:
    58→        return
    59→    set_exclusions(combined)
    60→    if cli_exclusions:
    61→        print(

    77→    For the review command, the last scan path (stored in state) is used as the

   107→    """Load config/state and attach shared objects to parsed args."""
   108→    config = load_config()

   122→    """Handle explicit help command when present in parser config."""
   123→    topic = list(getattr(args, "topic", []) or [])
   124→    try:

   126→    except SystemExit:

   128→
   129→
   130→def main() -> None:

   132→    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):

   136→            except (AttributeError, OSError):

    42→    if blocked:

   133→def _render_score_impact(
   134→    item: dict, dim_scores: dict, potentials: dict | None,
   135→) -> None:
   136→    """Render dimension score context and impact estimates."""
   137→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   138→    if dim_scores:
   139→        dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   140→        if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   141→            dimension_score = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   142→            strict_val = dimension_score.get("strict", dimension_score["score"])
   143→            print(
   144→                colorize(
   145→                    f"\n  Dimension: {dimension.name} — {dimension_score['score']:.1f}% "
   146→                    f"(strict: {strict_val:.1f}%) "
   147→                    f"({dimension_score['issues']} of {dimension_score['checks']:,} checks failing)",
   148→                    "dim",
   149→                )
   150→            )
   151→
   152→    if potentials and detector and dim_scores:
   153→        try:
   154→            impact = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=1)
   155→            if impact > 0:
   156→                print(colorize(f"  Impact: fixing this is worth ~+{impact:.1f} pts on overall score", "cyan"))
   157→            else:
   158→                dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   159→                if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   160→                    issues = dim_scores[dimension.name].get("issues", 0)
   161→                    if issues > 1:
   162→                        bulk = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=issues)
   163→                        if bulk > 0:
   164→                            print(colorize(
   165→                                f"  Impact: fixing all {issues} {detector} issues → ~+{bulk:.1f} pts",
   166→                                "cyan",
   167→                            ))
   168→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   169→            log(f"  score impact estimate skipped: {exc}")
   170→    elif detector == "review" and dim_scores:
   171→        try:
   172→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   173→            if dim_key:
   174→                breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   175→                for entry in breakdown.get("entries", []):
   176→                    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   177→                        continue
   178→                    entry_key = str(entry.get("name", "")).lower().replace(" ", "_")
   179→                    if entry_key == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   180→                        drag = float(entry.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   181→                        if drag > 0.01:
   182→                            print(colorize(
   183→                                f"  Dimension drag: {entry['name']} costs -{drag:.2f} pts on overall score",
   184→                                "cyan",
   185→                            ))
   186→                        break
   187→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   188→            log(f"  dimension drag estimate skipped: {exc}")
   189→

   191→def _render_item(
   192→    item: dict, dim_scores: dict, findings_scoped: dict, explain: bool,
   193→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   194→) -> None:
   195→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":

   197→        return
   198→    if item.get("kind") == "workflow_stage":
   199→        _render_workflow_stage(item)
   200→        return
   201→    if item.get("kind") == "workflow_action":
   202→        _render_workflow_action(item)
   203→        return
   204→
   205→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   206→    print(colorize(f"  ({confidence} confidence)", "bold"))
   207→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   208→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   209→
   210→    if item.get("detector") == "review":
   211→        print(colorize("  Type: Design review (requires judgment)", "dim"))
   212→    elif is_auto_fix_command(item.get("primary_command")):
   213→        print(colorize("  Type: Auto-fixable", "dim"))
   214→
   215→    if item.get("kind", "finding") == "subjective_dimension":
   216→        _render_subjective_dimension(item, explain=explain)
   217→        return
   218→
   219→    detail = _render_finding_detail(item)
   220→    _render_score_impact(item, dim_scores, potentials)
   221→
   222→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   223→    auto_fix_command = item.get("primary_command")
   224→    if is_auto_fix_command(auto_fix_command):
   225→        similar_count = sum(
   226→            1
   227→            for finding in findings_scoped.values()
   228→            if finding.get("detector") == detector_name and finding["status"] == "open"
   229→        )
   230→        if similar_count > 1:

   236→                )
   237→            )
   238→    if explain:
   239→        explanation = item.get("explain", {})
   240→        count_weight = explanation.get("count", int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0))
   241→        detector = item.get("detector", "")
   242→        base = (
   243→            f"ranked by confidence={confidence}, "
   244→            f"count={count_weight}, id={item.get('id', '')}"
   245→        )
   246→        if dim_scores and detector:
   247→            dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   248→            if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   249→                ds = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   250→                base += (
   251→                    f". Dimension: {dimension.name} at {ds['score']:.1f}% "

   254→        if item.get("detector") == "review" and dim_scores:
   255→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")

   261→                        base += f". Subjective dimension: {ds_name} at {score_str}%"
   262→                        break
   263→        policy = explanation.get("policy")
   264→        if policy:

   269→def render_terminal_items(
   270→    items: list[dict],
   271→    dim_scores: dict,
   272→    findings_scoped: dict,
   273→    *,
   274→    group: str,
   275→    explain: bool,
   276→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   277→    plan: dict | None = None,
   278→    cluster_filter: str | None = None,
   279→) -> None:
   280→    # Show focus header if plan has active cluster
   281→    if plan and plan.get("active_cluster"):
   282→        cluster_name = plan["active_cluster"]
   283→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   284→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   285→        total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   286→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({len(items)} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))
   287→
   288→    if group != "item":
   289→        _render_grouped(items, group)
   290→        return
   291→
   292→    # Detect cluster drill-in: multiple items with cluster focus active
   293→    is_cluster_drill = len(items) > 1 and (
   294→        cluster_filter or (plan and plan.get("active_cluster"))
   295→    )
   296→
   297→    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
   298→        if idx > 0:
   299→            print()
   300→        # Full card for first item, compact for rest in cluster drill-in
   301→        if is_cluster_drill and idx > 0:
   302→            _render_compact_item(item, idx, len(items))
   303→            continue
   304→        queue_pos = item.get("queue_position")
   305→        if queue_pos and len(items) > 1:
   306→            label = f"  [#{queue_pos}]"
   307→        elif len(items) > 1:
   308→            label = f"  [{idx + 1}/{len(items)}]"
   309→        else:
   310→            pos_str = f"  (#{ queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   311→            label = f"  Next item{pos_str}"
   312→        print(colorize(label, "bold"))
   313→        _render_item(item, dim_scores, findings_scoped, explain=explain, potentials=potentials)
   314→

   316→def render_uncommitted_reminder(plan: dict | None) -> None:
   317→    """Show a subtle reminder if there are uncommitted resolved findings."""

   319→        return
   320→    try:
   321→        from desloppify.core.config import load_config
   322→
   323→        config = load_config()
   324→        if not config.get("commit_tracking_enabled", True):
   325→            return
   326→
   327→        uncommitted = plan.get("uncommitted_findings", [])

   331→        count = len(uncommitted)

    16→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    17→# QueueBreakdown — single source of truth for queue numbers
    18→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    19→
    20→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    21→class QueueBreakdown:
    22→    """All numbers needed to render the standardized queue display."""
    23→
    24→    queue_total: int = 0

    39→        ``workflow::run-scan`` guide the user but are not work to complete.

    41→        return max(0, self.queue_total - self.workflow)

    56→    from desloppify.engine.work_queue import QueueBuildOptions, build_work_queue

   133→
   134→def format_queue_headline(breakdown: QueueBreakdown) -> str:
   135→    """The one-line Queue summary. Same format everywhere.
   136→
   137→    Examples::
   138→
   139→        Queue: 1934 items (292 planned · 23 skipped)
   140→        Queue: 1934 items
   141→    """
   142→    n = breakdown.queue_total
   143→    label = f"Queue: {n} item{'s' if n != 1 else ''}"
   144→
   145→    # Parenthesized segments
   146→    segments: list[str] = []
   147→    if breakdown.workflow > 0:
   148→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.workflow} planning step{'s' if breakdown.workflow != 1 else ''}")
   149→    if breakdown.plan_ordered > 0:
   150→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.plan_ordered} planned")
   151→    if breakdown.skipped > 0:
   152→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.skipped} skipped")
   153→    if breakdown.subjective > 0:
   154→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.subjective} subjective")
   155→    if segments:
   156→        sep = " \u00b7 "
   157→        detail = sep.join(segments)
   158→        return f"{label} ({detail})"
   159→    return label

   177→            f"\u2014 {breakdown.focus_cluster_count}/{breakdown.focus_cluster_total}"

   180→        lines.append((focus_line, "cyan"))

   183→    if frozen_score is not None:

   188→
   189→    # Queue headline — always the same

   236→def print_frozen_score_with_queue_context(
   237→    plan: dict,
   238→    queue_remaining: int,
   239→    *,
   240→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown | None = None,
   241→) -> None:
   242→    """Show frozen plan-start score + queue progress.
   243→
   244→    When *breakdown* is provided, uses the standardized queue block.
   245→    Otherwise falls back to the legacy two-line format.
   246→    """
   247→    scores = plan.get("plan_start_scores", {})
   248→    strict = scores.get("strict")
   249→    if strict is None:
   250→        return
   251→
   252→    if breakdown is not None:
   253→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=strict)
   254→        print()
   255→        for text, style in block:
   256→            print(colorize(text, style))
   257→        if queue_remaining > 0:
   258→            print(colorize(
   259→                "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   260→                "dim",
   261→            ))
   262→        return
   263→
   264→    # Legacy fallback
   265→    print(
   266→        colorize(
   267→            f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {strict:.1f}/100",
   268→            "cyan",
   269→        )
   270→    )
   271→    print(
   272→        colorize(
   273→            f"  Queue: {queue_remaining} item{'s' if queue_remaining != 1 else ''}"
   274→            " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   275→            "dim",
   276→        )
   277→    )
   278→
   279→
   280→def _print_objective_drained_banner(
   281→    frozen_strict: float,
   282→    remaining: int,
   283→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown,
   284→) -> None:
   285→    """Show a phase-transition banner when objective work is drained."""
   286→    kind_labels: list[str] = []
   287→    if breakdown.subjective > 0:
   288→        kind_labels.append("subjective")
   289→    if breakdown.workflow > 0:
   290→        kind_labels.append("workflow")
   291→    kind_desc = " + ".join(kind_labels) if kind_labels else "non-objective"
   292→    print(colorize(
   293→        f"\n  Objective queue complete (plan-start was {frozen_strict:.1f})."
   294→        f" {remaining} {kind_desc} item{'s' if remaining != 1 else ''} remain.",
   295→        "cyan",
   296→    ))
   297→    print(colorize(
   298→        "  Run `desloppify next` for remaining work,"
   299→        " then `desloppify scan` to finalize.",
   300→        "dim",
   301→    ))
   302→
   303→
   304→def print_execution_or_reveal(
   305→    state: dict,
   306→    prev,
   307→    plan: dict | None,
   308→) -> None:
   309→    """Context-aware score display: frozen plan-start score or live scores.
   310→
   311→    Three display modes:
   312→
   313→    1. **Frozen** — objective queue items remain → show frozen plan-start score.
   314→    2. **Phase transition** — objective drained, subjective/workflow remains
   315→       → show live scores + transition banner.
   316→    3. **Live** — no active plan cycle or queue is clear → show live scores.
   317→    """
   318→    frozen_strict: float | None = None
   319→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown | None = None
   320→
   321→    if plan and plan.get("plan_start_scores", {}).get("strict") is not None:
   322→        frozen_strict = plan["plan_start_scores"]["strict"]
   323→        try:
   324→            breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan)
   325→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   326→            pass
   327→
   328→    remaining = breakdown.queue_total if breakdown else 0
   329→
   330→    # Frozen: objective work remains — show frozen plan-start score and return
   331→    if remaining > 0 and frozen_strict is not None:
   332→        objective_remaining = remaining - breakdown.subjective - breakdown.workflow
   333→        if objective_remaining > 0:
   334→            print_frozen_score_with_queue_context(
   335→                plan, remaining, breakdown=breakdown,
   336→            )
   337→            return
   338→
   339→    # Live scores (or phase transition): show current scores
   340→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score_update import print_score_update
   341→
   342→    print_score_update(state, prev)
   343→
   344→    # Phase transition: objective drained but subjective/workflow remains
   345→    if remaining > 0 and frozen_strict is not None:
   346→        _print_objective_drained_banner(frozen_strict, remaining, breakdown)
   347→
   348→
   349→def show_score_with_plan_context(state: dict, prev) -> None:
   350→    """Load plan (best-effort) and show frozen or live score context.
   351→
   352→    Encapsulates the common load_plan + PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS + reveal
   353→    choreography so command modules don't each repeat it.
   354→    """
   355→    from desloppify.engine.plan import load_plan
   356→
   357→    try:
   358→        plan = load_plan()
   359→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   360→        plan = None
   361→    print_execution_or_reveal(state, prev, plan)
   362→
   363→
   364→__all__ = [
   365→    "QueueBreakdown",
   366→    "format_queue_block",
   367→    "format_queue_headline",
   368→    "get_plan_start_strict",
   369→    "plan_aware_queue_breakdown",
   370→    "plan_aware_queue_count",
   371→    "print_execution_or_reveal",
   372→    "print_frozen_score_with_queue_context",
   373→    "show_score_with_plan_context",
   374→]
   375→

1→"""Centralized score update display for all state-changing commands."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify import state as state_mod
     6→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score import target_strict_score_from_config

     9→
    10→
    11→def _format_delta(value: float, prev: float | None) -> tuple[str, str]:
    12→    """Return (delta_str, color) for a score change."""
    13→    delta = value - prev if prev is not None else 0
    14→    delta_str = f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})" if delta != 0 else ""
    15→    color = "green" if delta > 0 else ("red" if delta < 0 else "dim")
    16→    return delta_str, color
    17→
    18→
    19→def print_score_update(
    20→    state: dict,
    21→    prev: state_mod.ScoreSnapshot,
    22→    *,
    23→    config: dict | None = None,
    24→    label: str = "Scores",
    25→) -> None:
    26→    """Print score quartet with deltas and strict target progress.
    27→
    28→    Args:
    29→        state: Current state dict (scores already recomputed by save_state).
    30→        prev: ScoreSnapshot taken before the operation.
    31→        config: Project config dict (loaded from disk if not provided).
    32→        label: Prefix label (default "Scores").
    33→    """
    34→    new = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
    35→    if (
    36→        new.overall is None
    37→        or new.objective is None
    38→        or new.strict is None
    39→        or new.verified is None
    40→    ):
    41→        print(colorize(f"\n  {label} unavailable — run `desloppify scan`.", "yellow"))
    42→        return
    43→
    44→    overall_s, overall_c = _format_delta(new.overall, prev.overall)
    45→    objective_s, objective_c = _format_delta(new.objective, prev.objective)
    46→    strict_s, strict_c = _format_delta(new.strict, prev.strict)
    47→    verified_s, verified_c = _format_delta(new.verified, prev.verified)
    48→
    49→    print(
    50→        f"\n  {label}: "
    51→        + colorize(f"overall {new.overall:.1f}/100{overall_s}", overall_c)
    52→        + colorize(f"  objective {new.objective:.1f}/100{objective_s}", objective_c)
    53→        + colorize(f"  strict {new.strict:.1f}/100{strict_s}", strict_c)
    54→        + colorize(f"  verified {new.verified:.1f}/100{verified_s}", verified_c)
    55→    )
    56→
    57→    # Score-drop reassurance after structural fixes
    58→    if new.strict is not None and prev.strict is not None and new.strict < prev.strict:
    59→        print(colorize(
    60→            "  Score dropped — this is normal after structural fixes. "
    61→            "New findings may surface; keep working the queue.",
    62→            "yellow",
    63→        ))
    64→
    65→    # Always show strict target + next-command nudge
    66→    if config is None:
    67→        config = config_mod.load_config()
    68→
    69→    target = target_strict_score_from_config(config, fallback=95.0)
    70→    print_strict_target_nudge(new.strict, target)
    71→
    72→
    73→def print_strict_target_nudge(
    74→    strict: float, target: float, *, show_next: bool = True,
    75→) -> None:
    76→    """Print a one-liner with strict→target and optional next-command nudge."""
    77→    gap = round(target - strict, 1)
    78→    if gap > 0:
    79→        suffix = " — run `desloppify next` to find the next improvement" if show_next else ""
    80→        print(colorize(f"  Strict {strict:.1f} (target: {target:.1f}){suffix}", "dim"))
    81→    else:
    82→        print(colorize(f"  Strict {strict:.1f} — target {target:.1f} reached!", "green"))
    83→
    84→
    85→__all__ = ["print_score_update", "print_strict_target_nudge"]
    86→

   111→def empty_plan() -> PlanModel:
   112→    """Return a new empty plan payload."""
   113→    now = utc_now()
   114→    return {
   115→        "version": PLAN_VERSION,
   116→        "created": now,
   117→        "updated": now,
   118→        "queue_order": [],

   122→        "overrides": {},

   128→        "epic_triage_meta": {},
   129→        "commit_log": [],
   130→        "uncommitted_findings": [],
   131→        "commit_tracking_branch": None,
   132→    }
   133→
   134→
   135→def ensure_plan_defaults(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   136→    """Normalize a loaded plan to ensure all keys exist.
   137→
   138→    Handles migration from v1 (deferred list) to v2 (skipped dict),
   139→    v3 (top-level epics) to v4 (epics unified into clusters),
   140→    v5 (gates) to v6 (unified queue),
   141→    and v6 (synthesis naming) to v7 (triage naming).
   142→    """
   143→    defaults = empty_plan()
   144→    for key, value in defaults.items():
   145→        plan.setdefault(key, value)
   146→
   147→    _ensure_container_types(plan)
   148→    _migrate_deferred_to_skipped(plan)
   149→    _migrate_epics_to_clusters(plan)
   150→    _normalize_cluster_defaults(plan)
   151→    _migrate_v5_to_v6(plan)
   152→    _migrate_synthesis_to_triage(plan)
   153→
   154→
   155→def triage_clusters(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Cluster]:
   156→    """Return clusters whose name starts with ``EPIC_PREFIX``."""
   157→    return {
   158→        name: cluster
   159→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
   160→        if name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX)
   161→    }
   162→
   163→
   164→def validate_plan(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   165→    """Raise ValueError when plan invariants are violated."""
   166→    if not isinstance(plan.get("version"), int):
   167→        raise ValueError("plan.version must be an int")
   168→    if not isinstance(plan.get("queue_order"), list):
   169→        raise ValueError("plan.queue_order must be a list")
   170→
   171→    # No ID should appear in both queue_order and skipped
   172→    skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   173→    overlap = set(plan["queue_order"]) & skipped_ids
   174→    if overlap:
   175→        raise ValueError(
   176→            f"IDs cannot appear in both queue_order and skipped: {sorted(overlap)}"
   177→        )
   178→
   179→    # Validate skip entry kinds
   180→    for fid, entry in plan.get("skipped", {}).items():
   181→        kind = entry.get("kind")
   182→        if kind not in VALID_SKIP_KINDS:
   183→            raise ValueError(
   184→                f"Invalid skip kind {kind!r} for {fid}; must be one of {sorted(VALID_SKIP_KINDS)}"
   185→            )
   186→
   187→

   165→def _merge_potentials_safe(raw_potentials: dict | None) -> dict | None:
   166→    try:
   167→        return merge_potentials(raw_potentials) or None
   168→    except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError):
   169→        return raw_potentials or None
   170→
   171→
   172→def _get_items(args, state: dict, config: dict) -> None:
   173→    count = getattr(args, "count", 1) or 1
   174→    scope = getattr(args, "scope", None)
   175→    status = getattr(args, "status", "open")
   176→    group = getattr(args, "group", "item")
   177→    explain = bool(getattr(args, "explain", False))
   178→    cluster_arg = getattr(args, "cluster", None)
   179→    include_skipped = bool(getattr(args, "include_skipped", False))
   180→
   181→    target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(config, fallback=95.0)
   182→
   183→    # Load the living plan
   184→    plan = load_plan()
   185→    plan_data: dict | None = None
   186→    if (
   187→        plan.get("queue_order")
   188→        or plan.get("overrides")
   189→        or plan.get("clusters")
   190→    ):
   191→        plan_data = plan
   192→
   193→    # Build unified context once — all downstream consumers agree on
   194→    # plan, target_strict, and subjective visibility policy.
   195→    ctx = queue_context(
   196→        state, config=config, plan=plan_data, target_strict=target_strict,
   197→    )
   198→
   199→    # Auto-scope to focus cluster if set and no explicit scope/cluster
   200→    effective_cluster = _resolve_cluster_focus(
   201→        plan_data,
   202→        cluster_arg=cluster_arg,
   203→        scope=scope,
   204→    )
   205→
   206→    queue = build_work_queue(
   207→        state,
   208→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   209→            count=count,
   210→            scope=scope,
   211→            status=status,
   212→            include_subjective=True,
   213→            subjective_threshold=target_strict,
   214→            explain=explain,
   215→            plan=plan_data,
   216→            include_skipped=include_skipped,
   217→            cluster=effective_cluster,
   218→            context=ctx,
   219→        ),
   220→    )
   221→    items = queue.get("items", [])
   222→
   223→    lang = resolve_lang(args)
   224→    lang_name = lang.name if lang else None
   225→    narrative = compute_narrative(
   226→        state,
   227→        context=NarrativeContext(lang=lang_name, command="next", plan=plan_data),
   228→    )
   229→
   230→    payload = _build_next_payload(
   231→        queue=queue,
   232→        items=items,
   233→        state=state,
   234→        narrative=narrative,
   235→        plan_data=plan_data,
   236→    )
   237→    write_query(payload)
   238→
   239→    if _emit_requested_output(args, payload, items):
   240→        return
   241→
   242→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {})
   243→    findings_scoped = state_mod.path_scoped_findings(
   244→        state.get("findings", {}),
   245→        state.get("scan_path"),
   246→    )
   247→
   248→    # Extract frozen plan-start score and queue breakdown for lifecycle display
   249→    plan_start_strict, breakdown = _plan_queue_context(
   250→        state=state,
   251→        plan_data=plan_data,
   252→        context=ctx,
   253→    )
   254→    queue_total = breakdown.queue_total if breakdown else 0
   255→
   256→    next_render_mod.render_queue_header(queue, explain)
   257→    strict_score = state_mod.get_strict_score(state)
   258→    if next_render_mod.show_empty_queue(
   259→        queue,
   260→        strict_score,
   261→        plan_start_strict=plan_start_strict,
   262→        target_strict=target_strict,
   263→    ):
   264→        return
   265→
   266→    raw_potentials = state.get("potentials", {})
   267→    potentials = _merge_potentials_safe(raw_potentials)
   268→    next_render_mod.render_terminal_items(
   269→        items, dim_scores, findings_scoped, group=group, explain=explain,
   270→        potentials=potentials, plan=plan_data,
   271→        cluster_filter=effective_cluster,
   272→    )
   273→    next_render_mod.render_single_item_resolution_hint(items)
   274→    next_render_mod.render_uncommitted_reminder(plan_data)
   275→    next_render_mod.render_followup_nudges(
   276→        state,
   277→        dim_scores,
   278→        findings_scoped,
   279→        strict_score=strict_score,
   280→        target_strict_score=target_strict,
   281→        queue_total=queue_total,
   282→        plan_start_strict=plan_start_strict,
   283→        breakdown=breakdown,
   284→    )
   285→    print()
   286→
   287→
   288→__all__ = ["_low_subjective_dimensions", "cmd_next"]
   289→

   217→            dirty = True

   219→                             detail={"changes": True})
   220→
   221→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score import target_strict_score_from_config
   222→        _target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   223→
   224→        # Compute subjective visibility policy once for consistent gating
   225→        from desloppify.engine.plan import compute_subjective_visibility
   226→        _policy = compute_subjective_visibility(
   227→            runtime.state,
   228→            target_strict=_target_strict,
   229→            plan=plan,
   230→        )
   231→
   232→        # Detect cycle completion: plan_start_scores is empty when the
   233→        # previous cycle drained the queue and revealed scores.  In that
   234→        # case stale subjective dimensions should be prioritized over new
   235→        # objective findings so the user reviews before a new cycle begins.
   236→        _cycle_just_completed = not plan.get("plan_start_scores")
   237→
   238→        stale_changed = _sync_stale_dimensions(
   239→            plan, runtime.state,
   240→            lambda p, s: sync_stale_dimensions(
   241→                p, s, policy=_policy, cycle_just_completed=_cycle_just_completed,
   242→            ),
   243→        )
   244→        if stale_changed:
   245→            dirty = True
   246→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_stale", actor="system",
   247→                             detail={"changes": True})
   248→
   249→        auto_changed = _sync_auto_clusters(
   250→            plan, runtime.state, target_strict=_target_strict, policy=_policy,
   251→            cycle_just_completed=_cycle_just_completed,
   252→        )
   253→        if auto_changed:
   254→            dirty = True
   255→            append_log_entry(plan, "auto_cluster", actor="system",
   256→                             detail={"changes": True})
   257→
   258→        triage_sync = sync_triage_needed(plan, runtime.state)
   259→        if triage_sync.changes:
   260→            dirty = True
   261→            if triage_sync.injected:
   262→                print(
   263→                    colorize(
   264→                        "  Plan: planning mode needed — review findings changed since last triage.",
   265→                        "cyan",
   266→                    )
   267→                )
   268→                append_log_entry(plan, "sync_triage", actor="system",
   269→                                 detail={"injected": True})
   270→
   271→        checkpoint_sync = sync_score_checkpoint_needed(plan, runtime.state, policy=_policy)
   272→        if checkpoint_sync.changes:
   273→            dirty = True
   274→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_score_checkpoint", actor="system",
   275→                             detail={"injected": True})
   276→
   277→        create_plan_sync = sync_create_plan_needed(plan, runtime.state, policy=_policy)
   278→        if create_plan_sync.changes:
   279→            dirty = True
   280→            if create_plan_sync.injected:
   281→                print(
   282→                    colorize(
   283→                        "  Plan: reviews complete — `workflow::create-plan` queued.",
   284→                        "cyan",
   285→                    )
   286→                )
   287→                append_log_entry(plan, "sync_create_plan", actor="system",
   288→                                 detail={"injected": True})
   289→
   290→        seeded = _seed_plan_start_scores(plan, runtime.state)
   291→        if seeded:
   292→            dirty = True
   293→            append_log_entry(plan, "seed_start_scores", actor="system",
   294→                             detail={})
   295→        # Only clear scores that existed before this reconcile pass —
   296→        # never clear scores we just seeded in the same scan.
   297→        if not seeded and _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(runtime.state, plan):
   298→            dirty = True
   299→            append_log_entry(plan, "clear_start_scores", actor="system",
   300→                             detail={})
   301→
   302→        if dirty:
   303→            save_plan(plan, plan_path)
   304→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   305→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)

   393→def _configure_lang_runtime(
   394→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   395→    config: dict[str, object],
   396→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   397→    lang: LangRun | None,
   398→) -> LangRun | None:
   399→    """Populate runtime context and threshold overrides for a selected language."""
   400→    if not lang:
   401→        return None
   402→
   403→    lang_options = resolve_lang_runtime_options(args, lang)
   404→    lang_settings = resolve_lang_settings(config, lang)
   405→    runtime_lang = make_lang_run(
   406→        lang,
   407→        overrides=LangRunOverrides(
   408→            review_cache=state.get("review_cache", {}),
   409→            review_max_age_days=config.get("review_max_age_days", 30),
   410→            runtime_settings=lang_settings,
   411→            runtime_options=lang_options,
   412→            large_threshold_override=config.get("large_files_threshold", 0),
   413→            props_threshold_override=config.get("props_threshold", 0),
   414→        ),
   415→    )
   416→
   417→    lang_capabilities = _state_lang_capabilities(state)
   418→    lang_capabilities[runtime_lang.name] = {
   419→        "fixers": sorted(runtime_lang.fixers.keys()),
   420→        "typecheck_cmd": runtime_lang.typecheck_cmd,
   421→    }
   422→    return runtime_lang

   425→def _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   426→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   427→    *,
   428→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   429→) -> int:
   430→    """Reset known subjective dimensions to 0 so the next scan starts fresh."""
   431→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   432→
   433→    reset_keys = {
   434→        key.strip()
   435→        for key in assessments
   436→        if isinstance(key, str) and key.strip()
   437→    }
   438→    reset_keys.update(_subjective_reset_dimensions(lang_name=lang_name))
   439→
   440→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   441→    for key in sorted(reset_keys):
   442→        payload = assessments.get(key)
   443→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
   444→            payload["score"] = 0.0
   445→            payload["source"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   446→            payload["assessed_at"] = now
   447→            payload["reset_by"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   448→            payload["placeholder"] = True
   449→            payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   450→            payload.pop("components", None)
   451→            payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   452→            continue
   453→        assessments[key] = {
   454→            "score": 0.0,
   455→            "source": "scan_reset_subjective",
   456→            "assessed_at": now,
   457→            "reset_by": "scan_reset_subjective",
   458→            "placeholder": True,
   459→        }
   460→    return len(reset_keys)
   461→
   462→
   463→def _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   464→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   465→) -> int:
   466→    """Expire provisional manual-override assessments at scan start."""
   467→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   468→
   469→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   470→    expired = 0
   471→    for payload in assessments.values():
   472→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   473→            continue
   474→        if payload.get("provisional_override") is not True:
   475→            continue
   476→        payload["score"] = 0.0
   477→        payload["source"] = "manual_override_expired"
   478→        payload["assessed_at"] = now
   479→        payload["reset_by"] = "manual_override_expired"
   480→        payload["placeholder"] = True
   481→        payload.pop("provisional_override", None)
   482→        payload.pop("provisional_until_scan", None)
   483→        payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   484→        payload.pop("components", None)
   485→        payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   486→        expired += 1
   487→    return expired

   492→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   493→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   494→    state = runtime.state if isinstance(runtime.state, dict) else {}
   495→    state_mod.ensure_state_defaults(state)
   496→    path = Path(args.path)

   498→    lang_config = resolve_lang(args)
   499→    reset_subjective_count = 0
   500→    expired_manual_override_count = _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   501→        state
   502→    )
   503→    if getattr(args, "reset_subjective", False):
   504→        reset_subjective_count = _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   505→            state,
   506→            lang_name=getattr(lang_config, "name", None),
   507→        )
   508→
   509→    include_slow = not getattr(args, "skip_slow", False)
   510→    profile = _resolve_scan_profile(getattr(args, "profile", None), lang_config)
   511→    effective_include_slow = _effective_include_slow(include_slow, profile)
   512→
   513→    lang = _configure_lang_runtime(args, config, state, lang_config)
   514→    coverage_warnings = _seed_runtime_coverage_warnings(lang)
   515→    zone_overrides_raw = config.get("zone_overrides")
   516→    zone_overrides = zone_overrides_raw if isinstance(zone_overrides_raw, dict) else None
   517→
   518→    return ScanRuntime(
   519→        args=args,
   520→        state_path=state_file,

   523→        config=config,
   524→        lang=lang,

   526→        profile=profile,
   527→        effective_include_slow=effective_include_slow,
   528→        zone_overrides=zone_overrides,
   529→        reset_subjective_count=reset_subjective_count,
   530→        expired_manual_override_count=expired_manual_override_count,
   531→        coverage_warnings=coverage_warnings,

   535→def _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(
   536→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   537→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   538→) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   539→    """Append stale exclude findings when excluded dirs are unreferenced."""
   540→    extra_exclusions = get_exclusions()
   541→    if not (extra_exclusions and runtime.lang and runtime.lang.file_finder):
   542→        return findings
   543→
   544→    scanned_files = runtime.lang.file_finder(runtime.path)
   545→    stale = _audit_excluded_dirs(
   546→        extra_exclusions, scanned_files, PROJECT_ROOT
   547→    )
   548→    if not stale:
   549→        return findings
   550→
   551→    augmented = list(findings)
   552→    augmented.extend(stale)
   553→    for stale_finding in stale:
   554→        print(colorize(f"  ℹ {stale_finding['summary']}", "dim"))
   555→    return augmented

   563→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int]:

   565→    return _augment_stale_wontfix_impl(

   574→def run_scan_generation(
   575→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   576→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, object], dict[str, object] | None]:
   577→    """Run detector pipeline and return findings, potentials, and codebase metrics."""
   578→    enable_file_cache()
   579→    enable_parse_cache()
   580→    try:
   581→        findings, potentials = plan_mod.generate_findings(
   582→            runtime.path,
   583→            lang=runtime.lang,
   584→            options=PlanScanOptions(
   585→                include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   586→                zone_overrides=runtime.zone_overrides,
   587→                profile=runtime.profile,
   588→            ),
   589→        )
   590→    finally:
   591→        disable_parse_cache()
   592→        disable_file_cache()
   593→
   594→    codebase_metrics = _collect_codebase_metrics(runtime.lang, runtime.path)
   595→    _warn_explicit_lang_with_no_files(
   596→        runtime.args, runtime.lang, runtime.path, codebase_metrics
   597→    )
   598→    findings = _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(findings, runtime)
   599→    decay_scans = _coerce_int(
   600→        runtime.config.get("wontfix_decay_scans"),
   601→        default=_WONTFIX_DECAY_SCANS_DEFAULT,
   602→    )
   603→    findings, monitored_wontfix = _augment_with_stale_wontfix_findings(
   604→        findings,
   605→        runtime,
   606→        decay_scans=max(decay_scans, 0),
   607→    )
   608→    potentials["stale_wontfix"] = monitored_wontfix
   609→    return findings, potentials, codebase_metrics
   610→
   611→
   612→def merge_scan_results(
   613→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   614→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   615→    potentials: dict[str, object],
   616→    codebase_metrics: dict[str, object] | None,
   617→) -> ScanMergeResult:
   618→    """Merge findings into persistent state and return diff + previous score snapshot."""
   619→    scan_path_rel = rel(str(runtime.path))
   620→    prev_scan_path = runtime.state.get("scan_path")
   621→    path_changed = prev_scan_path is not None and prev_scan_path != scan_path_rel
   622→
   623→    if not path_changed:
   624→        prev = state_mod.score_snapshot(runtime.state)
   625→    else:
   626→        prev = state_mod.ScoreSnapshot(None, None, None, None)
   627→    prev_dim_scores = (
   628→        runtime.state.get("dimension_scores", {}) if not path_changed else {}
   629→    )
   630→
   631→    if runtime.lang and runtime.lang.zone_map is not None:
   632→        runtime.state["zone_distribution"] = runtime.lang.zone_map.counts()
   633→    _persist_scan_coverage(runtime.state, runtime.lang)
   634→
   635→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   636→
   637→    diff = state_mod.merge_scan(
   638→        runtime.state,
   639→        findings,
   640→        options=state_mod.MergeScanOptions(
   641→            lang=runtime.lang.name if runtime.lang else None,
   642→            scan_path=scan_path_rel,
   643→            force_resolve=getattr(runtime.args, "force_resolve", False),
   644→            exclude=get_exclusions(),
   645→            potentials=potentials,
   646→            codebase_metrics=codebase_metrics,
   647→            include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   648→            ignore=runtime.config.get("ignore", []),
   649→            subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   650→        ),
   651→    )
   652→
   653→    issues_mod.expire_stale_holistic(
   654→        runtime.state, runtime.config.get("holistic_max_age_days", 30)
   655→    )
   656→    state_mod.save_state(
   657→        runtime.state,
   658→        runtime.state_path,
   659→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   660→    )
   661→
   662→    _clear_needs_rescan_flag(runtime.config)
   663→    _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime)
   664→
   665→    return ScanMergeResult(
   666→        diff=diff,
   667→        prev_overall=prev.overall,
   668→        prev_objective=prev.objective,
   669→        prev_strict=prev.strict,
   670→        prev_verified=prev.verified,
   671→        prev_dim_scores=prev_dim_scores,
   672→    )
   673→
   674→
   675→def resolve_noise_snapshot(
   676→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   677→    config: dict[str, object],
   678→) -> ScanNoiseSnapshot:
   679→    """Resolve noise budget settings and hidden finding counters."""
   680→    noise_budget, global_noise_budget, budget_warning = (
   681→        state_mod.resolve_finding_noise_settings(config)
   682→    )
   683→    findings_by_id = _state_findings(state)
   684→    open_findings = [
   685→        finding
   686→        for finding in state_mod.path_scoped_findings(
   687→            findings_by_id, state.get("scan_path")
   688→        ).values()
   689→        if finding.get("status") == "open"
   690→    ]
   691→    _, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_finding_noise_budget(
   692→        open_findings,
   693→        budget=noise_budget,
   694→        global_budget=global_noise_budget,
   695→    )
   696→
   697→    return ScanNoiseSnapshot(
   698→        noise_budget=noise_budget,
   699→        global_noise_budget=global_noise_budget,
   700→        budget_warning=budget_warning,
   701→        hidden_by_detector=hidden_by_detector,
   702→        hidden_total=sum(hidden_by_detector.values()),
   703→    )
   704→
   705→
   706→def persist_reminder_history(
   707→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   708→    narrative: dict[str, object],
   709→) -> None:
   710→    """Persist reminder history emitted by narrative computation."""
   711→    if not (narrative and "reminder_history" in narrative):
   712→        return
   713→
   714→    runtime.state["reminder_history"] = narrative["reminder_history"]
   715→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   716→    state_mod.save_state(
   717→        runtime.state,
   718→        runtime.state_path,
   719→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   720→    )
   721→

    12→def add_uncommitted_findings(plan: dict[str, Any], finding_ids: list[str]) -> int:
    13→    """Add finding IDs to the uncommitted list (deduplicates).  Returns count added."""
    14→    uncommitted: list[str] = plan.setdefault("uncommitted_findings", [])
    15→    existing = set(uncommitted)
    16→    added = 0
    17→    for fid in finding_ids:
    18→        if fid not in existing:
    19→            uncommitted.append(fid)
    20→            existing.add(fid)
    21→            added += 1
    22→    return added
    23→
    24→
    25→def purge_uncommitted_ids(plan: dict[str, Any], finding_ids: list[str]) -> int:
    26→    """Remove finding IDs from the uncommitted list.  Returns count removed."""
    27→    to_remove = set(finding_ids)
    28→    uncommitted: list[str] = plan.get("uncommitted_findings", [])
    29→    original = len(uncommitted)
    30→    plan["uncommitted_findings"] = [fid for fid in uncommitted if fid not in to_remove]
    31→    return original - len(plan["uncommitted_findings"])

    97→def _finding_summary(state: dict[str, Any], finding_id: str) -> str:

   106→def _score_delta_line(plan: dict[str, Any], state: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
   107→    """Build a score delta summary line from plan_start_scores to current."""
   108→    start = plan.get("plan_start_scores", {})
   109→    current_dim = state.get("dimension_scores", {})
   110→    if not start or not current_dim:
   111→        return ""
   112→
   113→    start_strict = start.get("strict")
   114→    if start_strict is None:
   115→        return ""
   116→
   117→    # Compute current strict from dimension_scores
   118→    try:
   119→        from desloppify.engine._scoring.results.core import compute_aggregate_scores
   120→        scores = compute_aggregate_scores(current_dim)
   121→        current_strict = scores.get("strict", 0)
   122→    except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):
   123→        return ""
   124→
   125→    delta = current_strict - start_strict
   126→    sign = "+" if delta >= 0 else ""
   127→    return f"Score: {start_strict:.1f} → {current_strict:.1f} strict ({sign}{delta:.1f})"

   130→def generate_pr_body(plan: dict[str, Any], state: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
   131→    """Generate the PR description markdown from commit_log."""
   132→    lines: list[str] = ["## Code Health Improvements", ""]
   133→
   134→    commit_log: list[dict] = plan.get("commit_log", [])
   135→    if commit_log:
   136→        lines.append("### Commits")
   137→        lines.append("")
   138→        total_findings = 0
   139→        for record in commit_log:
   140→            sha = record.get("sha", "?")[:7]
   141→            note = record.get("note") or ""
   142→            finding_ids = record.get("finding_ids", [])
   143→            total_findings += len(finding_ids)
   144→
   145→            header = f"**{sha}**"
   146→            if note:
   147→                header += f" — {note}"
   148→            lines.append(header)
   149→
   150→            for fid in finding_ids:
   151→                summary = _finding_summary(state, fid)
   152→                if summary and summary != fid:
   153→                    lines.append(f"- `{fid}` — {summary}")
   154→                else:
   155→                    lines.append(f"- `{fid}`")
   156→            lines.append("")
   157→
   158→        lines.append("### Summary")
   159→        commit_count = len(commit_log)
   160→        lines.append(
   161→            f"{total_findings} finding{'s' if total_findings != 1 else ''} "
   162→            f"resolved across {commit_count} commit{'s' if commit_count != 1 else ''}"
   163→        )
   164→        score_line = _score_delta_line(plan, state)
   165→        if score_line:
   166→            lines.append(score_line)
   167→    else:
   168→        lines.append("*No commits recorded yet.*")
   169→
   170→    return "\n".join(lines)

   173→def suggest_commit_message(
   174→    plan: dict[str, Any],
   175→    template: str,
   176→) -> str:
   177→    """Generate a suggested commit message from uncommitted findings."""
   178→    uncommitted = plan.get("uncommitted_findings", [])
   179→    if not uncommitted:
   180→        return ""
   181→
   182→    # Extract common detector/category
   183→    detectors: set[str] = set()
   184→    dirs: set[str] = set()
   185→    for fid in uncommitted:
   186→        parts = fid.split("::")
   187→        if parts:
   188→            detectors.add(parts[0])
   189→        if len(parts) >= 2:
   190→            file_part = parts[1]
   191→            slash_idx = file_part.rfind("/")
   192→            if slash_idx > 0:
   193→                dirs.add(file_part[:slash_idx + 1])
   194→
   195→    summary_parts: list[str] = []
   196→    if len(detectors) == 1:
   197→        summary_parts.append(f"{next(iter(detectors))}")
   198→    else:
   199→        summary_parts.append(f"{len(detectors)} detector{'s' if len(detectors) != 1 else ''}")
   200→    if len(dirs) == 1:
   201→        summary_parts.append(f"in {next(iter(dirs))}")
   202→
   203→    summary = " ".join(summary_parts)
   204→
   205→    return template.format(
   206→        status="autofix",
   207→        count=len(uncommitted),
   208→        summary=summary,
   209→    )
   210→
   211→
   212→def filter_finding_ids_by_pattern(finding_ids: list[str], patterns: list[str]) -> list[str]:
   213→    """Filter finding IDs by glob patterns (used for --only)."""
   214→    result: list[str] = []
   215→    for fid in finding_ids:
   216→        for pattern in patterns:
   217→            if fnmatch.fnmatch(fid, pattern):
   218→                result.append(fid)
   219→                break
   220→    return result
