```
    58→    effective_plan = context.plan if context is not None else plan
    59→
    60→    result = build_work_queue(
    61→        state,
    62→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
    63→            status="open",
    64→            count=None,
    65→            plan=effective_plan if context is None else None,
    66→            include_skipped=False,
    67→            context=context,
    68→        ),
    69→    )
    70→
    71→    # Collapse clusters for display-level counting
    72→    items = result.get("items", [])
    73→    if effective_plan and not effective_plan.get("active_cluster"):
    74→        items = collapse_clusters(items, effective_plan)
    75→
    76→    queue_total = len(items)
    77→
    78→    # Count subjective and workflow items in the queue.
    79→    # Collapsed clusters whose members are all subjective count as subjective.
    80→    subjective = sum(
    81→        1 for item in items
    82→        if is_subjective_queue_item(item)
    83→    )
    84→    workflow = sum(
    85→        1 for item in items
    86→        if item.get("kind") in ("workflow_stage", "workflow_action")
    87→    )
    88→
    89→    # Plan-derived counts
    90→    plan_ordered = 0
    91→    skipped = 0
    92→    if effective_plan:
    93→        skipped = len(effective_plan.get("skipped", {}))
    94→        # plan_ordered = items that are in queue_order minus skipped
    95→        queue_order = effective_plan.get("queue_order", [])
    96→        skipped_ids = set(effective_plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    97→        plan_ordered = sum(1 for fid in queue_order if fid not in skipped_ids)
    98→
    99→    # Focus cluster info
   100→    focus_cluster = None
   101→    focus_cluster_count = 0
   102→    focus_cluster_total = 0
   103→    if effective_plan:
   104→        active = effective_plan.get("active_cluster")
   105→        if active:
   106→            focus_cluster = active
   107→            cluster_data = effective_plan.get("clusters", {}).get(active, {})
   108→            focus_cluster_total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   109→            # Count how many cluster members are still in the queue
   110→            cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   111→            open_findings = {
   112→                fid
   113→                for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   114→                if f.get("status") == "open"
   115→            }
   116→            focus_cluster_count = len(cluster_member_ids & open_findings)
   117→
   118→    return QueueBreakdown(
   119→        queue_total=queue_total,
   120→        plan_ordered=plan_ordered,
   121→        skipped=skipped,
   122→        subjective=subjective,
   123→        workflow=workflow,
   124→        focus_cluster=focus_cluster,
   125→        focus_cluster_count=focus_cluster_count,
   126→        focus_cluster_total=focus_cluster_total,
   127→    )
   128→
   129→
   130→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   131→# Formatting helpers — single source of truth for queue display
   132→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   133→
   134→def format_queue_headline(breakdown: QueueBreakdown) -> str:
   135→    """The one-line Queue summary. Same format everywhere.
   136→
   137→    Examples::
   138→
   139→        Queue: 1934 items (292 planned · 23 skipped)
   140→        Queue: 1934 items
   141→    """
   142→    n = breakdown.queue_total
   143→    label = f"Queue: {n} item{'s' if n != 1 else ''}"
   144→
   145→    # Parenthesized segments
   146→    segments: list[str] = []
   147→    if breakdown.workflow > 0:
   148→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.workflow} planning step{'s' if breakdown.workflow != 1 else ''}")
   149→    if breakdown.plan_ordered > 0:
   150→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.plan_ordered} planned")
   151→    if breakdown.skipped > 0:
   152→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.skipped} skipped")
   153→    if breakdown.subjective > 0:
   154→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.subjective} subjective")
   155→    if segments:
   156→        sep = " \u00b7 "
   157→        detail = sep.join(segments)
   158→        return f"{label} ({detail})"
   159→    return label
   160→
   161→
   162→def format_queue_block(
   163→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown,
   164→    *,
   165→    frozen_score: float | None = None,
   166→    live_score: float | None = None,
   167→) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
   168→    """Full queue block: focus banner + queue line + contextual hints.
   169→
   170→    Returns a list of ``(text, style)`` pairs ready for ``colorize()``.
   171→    """
   172→    lines: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
   173→
   174→    # Focus banner (prominent, separate)
   175→    if breakdown.focus_cluster:
   176→        focus_line = (
   177→            f"  Focus: `{breakdown.focus_cluster}` "
   178→            f"\u2014 {breakdown.focus_cluster_count}/{breakdown.focus_cluster_total}"
   179→            f" items remaining"
   180→        )
   181→        lines.append((focus_line, "cyan"))
   182→
   183→    # Score line: show both frozen plan-start and live score when available
   184→    if frozen_score is not None:
   185→        if live_score is not None and abs(live_score - frozen_score) >= 0.05:
   186→            delta = round(live_score - frozen_score, 1)
   187→            delta_str = f"{'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f}"
   188→            lines.append((
   189→                f"  Score: strict {live_score:.1f}/100 (plan start: {frozen_score:.1f}, {delta_str})",
   190→                "cyan",
   191→            ))
   192→        else:
   193→            lines.append((
   194→                f"  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {frozen_score:.1f}/100",
   195→                "cyan",
   196→            ))
   197→
   198→    # Queue headline — always the same
   199→    lines.append((f"  {format_queue_headline(breakdown)}", "bold"))
   200→
   201→    # Contextual hints (dim)
   202→    if breakdown.focus_cluster:
   203→        lines.append((
   204→            f"  Unfocus: `desloppify plan focus --clear`"
   205→            f" \u00b7 Cluster details: `desloppify next --cluster {breakdown.focus_cluster} --count 10`",
   206→            "dim",
   207→        ))
   208→    elif breakdown.plan_ordered > 0 or breakdown.skipped > 0:
   209→        lines.append((
   210→            "  Details: `desloppify plan queue`"
   211→            " \u00b7 Skip: `desloppify plan skip <id>`",
   212→            "dim",
   213→        ))
   214→    else:
   215→        lines.append((
   216→            "  Start planning: `desloppify plan`",
   217→            "dim",
   218→        ))
   219→
   220→    return lines
   221→
   222→
   223→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   224→# Legacy / backward-compatible helpers
   225→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   226→
   227→def plan_aware_queue_count(state: dict, plan: dict | None = None) -> int:
   228→    """Count remaining plan-aware queue items (skips excluded, clusters collapsed).
   229→
   230→    .. deprecated::
   231→        Returns ``queue_total`` which **includes** workflow navigation items.
   232→        Prefer ``plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan).actionable`` for
   233→        gate/preflight checks where workflow items should not count.
   234→    """
   235→    return plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan).queue_total
   236→
   237→
   238→def get_plan_start_strict(plan: dict | None) -> float | None:
   239→    """Extract the frozen plan-start strict score, or None if unset."""
   240→    if not plan:
   241→        return None
   242→    return plan.get("plan_start_scores", {}).get("strict")
   243→
   244→
   245→def print_frozen_score_with_queue_context(
   246→    plan: dict,
   247→    queue_remaining: int,
   248→    *,
   249→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown | None = None,
   250→    live_score: float | None = None,
   251→) -> None:
   252→    """Show frozen plan-start score + queue progress.
   253→
   254→    When *breakdown* is provided, uses the standardized queue block.
   255→    Otherwise falls back to the legacy two-line format.
   256→    """
   257→    scores = plan.get("plan_start_scores", {})
   258→    strict = scores.get("strict")
   259→    if strict is None:
   260→        return
   261→
   262→    if breakdown is not None:
   263→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=strict, live_score=live_score)
   264→        print()
   265→        for text, style in block:
   266→            print(colorize(text, style))
   267→        if queue_remaining > 0:
   268→            print(colorize(
   269→                "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   270→                "dim",
   271→            ))
   272→        return
   273→
   274→    # Legacy fallback
   275→    print(
   276→        colorize(
   277→            f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {strict:.1f}/100",
   278→            "cyan",
   279→        )
   280→    )
   281→    print(
   282→        colorize(
   283→            f"  Queue: {queue_remaining} item{'s' if queue_remaining != 1 else ''}"
   284→            " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   285→            "dim",
   286→        )
   287→    )
   288→
   289→
   290→def _print_objective_drained_banner(
   291→    frozen_strict: float,
   292→    remaining: int,
   293→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown,
   294→) -> None:
   295→    """Show a phase-transition banner when objective work is drained."""
   296→    kind_labels: list[str] = []
   297→    if breakdown.subjective > 0:
   298→        kind_labels.append("subjective")
   299→    if breakdown.workflow > 0:
   300→        kind_labels.append("workflow")
   301→    kind_desc = " + ".join(kind_labels) if kind_labels else "non-objective"
   302→    print(colorize(
   303→        f"\n  Objective queue complete (plan-start was {frozen_strict:.1f})."
   304→        f" {remaining} {kind_desc} item{'s' if remaining != 1 else ''} remain.",
   305→        "cyan",
   306→    ))
   307→    print(colorize(
   308→        "  Run `desloppify next` for remaining work,"
   309→        " then `desloppify scan` to finalize.",
   310→        "dim",
   311→    ))
   312→
   313→
   314→def print_execution_or_reveal(
   315→    state: dict,
   316→    prev,
   317→    plan: dict | None,
   318→) -> None:
   319→    """Context-aware score display: frozen plan-start score or live scores.
   320→
   321→    Three display modes:
   322→
   323→    1. **Frozen** — objective queue items remain → show frozen plan-start score.
   324→    2. **Phase transition** — objective drained, subjective/workflow remains
   325→       → show live scores + transition banner.
   326→    3. **Live** — no active plan cycle or queue is clear → show live scores.
   327→    """
   328→    frozen_strict: float | None = None
   329→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown | None = None
   330→
   331→    if plan and plan.get("plan_start_scores", {}).get("strict") is not None:
   332→        frozen_strict = plan["plan_start_scores"]["strict"]
   333→        try:
   334→            breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan)
   335→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   336→            pass
   337→
   338→    remaining = breakdown.queue_total if breakdown else 0
   339→
   340→    # Frozen: objective work remains — show frozen plan-start score and return
   341→    if remaining > 0 and frozen_strict is not None:
   342→        objective_remaining = remaining - breakdown.subjective - breakdown.workflow
   343→        if objective_remaining > 0:
   344→            # Compute live score for delta display alongside frozen
   345→            from desloppify import state as state_mod
   346→            snapshot = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   347→            print_frozen_score_with_queue_context(
   348→                plan, remaining, breakdown=breakdown,
   349→                live_score=snapshot.strict,
   350→            )
   351→            return
   352→
   353→    # Live scores (or phase transition): show current scores
   354→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score_update import print_score_update
   355→
   356→    print_score_update(state, prev)
   357→
   358→    # Phase transition: objective drained but subjective/workflow remains
   359→    if remaining > 0 and frozen_strict is not None:
   360→        _print_objective_drained_banner(frozen_strict, remaining, breakdown)
   361→
   362→
   363→def show_score_with_plan_context(state: dict, prev) -> None:
   364→    """Load plan (best-effort) and show frozen or live score context.
   365→
   366→    Encapsulates the common load_plan + PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS + reveal
   367→    choreography so command modules don't each repeat it.
   368→    """
   369→    from desloppify.engine.plan import load_plan
   370→
   371→    try:
   372→        plan = load_plan()
   373→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   374→        plan = None
   375→    print_execution_or_reveal(state, prev, plan)
   376→
   377→
   378→__all__ = [
   379→    "QueueBreakdown",
   380→    "format_queue_block",
   381→    "format_queue_headline",
   382→    "get_plan_start_strict",
   383→    "plan_aware_queue_breakdown",
   384→    "plan_aware_queue_count",
   385→    "print_execution_or_reveal",
   386→    "print_frozen_score_with_queue_context",
   387→    "show_score_with_plan_context",
   388→]
   389→
```

```
1→"""exclude command: add path patterns and clean stale queue/state entries."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations

     5→import argparse
     6→import sys
     7→from pathlib import Path
     8→
     9→from desloppify import state as state_mod
    10→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.runtime import command_runtime
    11→from desloppify.core import config as config_mod
    12→from desloppify.core.exception_sets import PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS, CommandError
    13→from desloppify.core.file_paths import matches_exclusion
    14→from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize
    15→from desloppify.core.tooling import check_config_staleness
    16→from desloppify.engine.plan import (
    17→    load_plan,
    18→    plan_path_for_state,
    19→    purge_ids,
    20→    save_plan,
    21→)
    22→
    23→
    24→def _state_file_for_runtime(runtime) -> Path:
    25→    """Resolve the effective state file path for a command runtime."""
    26→    state_file = runtime.state_path
    27→    if isinstance(state_file, Path):
    28→        return state_file
    29→    return state_mod.STATE_FILE
    30→
    31→
    32→def _prune_excluded_findings(state: dict, pattern: str) -> list[str]:
    33→    """Drop findings whose file path matches a new exclusion pattern."""
    34→    findings = state.get("findings")
    35→    if not isinstance(findings, dict):
    36→        return []
    37→
    38→    removed_ids = [
    39→        finding_id
    40→        for finding_id, finding in findings.items()
    41→        if isinstance(finding, dict)
    42→        and matches_exclusion(str(finding.get("file", "")), pattern)
    43→    ]
    44→    for finding_id in removed_ids:
    45→        findings.pop(finding_id, None)
    46→    return removed_ids
    47→
    48→
    49→def _purge_removed_ids_from_plan(state_file: Path, removed_ids: list[str]) -> int:
    50→    """Remove pruned finding IDs from queue/skips/clusters in plan.json."""
    51→    if not removed_ids:
    52→        return 0
    53→    plan_file = plan_path_for_state(state_file)
    54→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
    55→    purged = purge_ids(plan, removed_ids)
    56→    if purged:
    57→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)
    58→    return purged
    59→
    60→
    61→def cmd_exclude(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    62→    """Add a path pattern to the exclude list and clean cached queue/state."""
    63→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
    64→    config = runtime.config
    65→    state = runtime.state
    66→    state_file = _state_file_for_runtime(runtime)
    67→
    68→    config_mod.add_exclude_pattern(config, args.pattern)
    69→    config["needs_rescan"] = True
    70→    try:
    71→        config_mod.save_config(config)
    72→    except OSError as exc:
    73→        raise CommandError(f"could not save config: {exc}") from exc
    74→
    75→    removed_ids: list[str] = []
    76→    plan_purged = 0
    77→    if state_file.exists():
    78→        removed_ids = _prune_excluded_findings(state, args.pattern)
    79→        if removed_ids:
    80→            try:
    81→                state_mod.save_state(state, state_file)
    82→            except OSError as exc:
    83→                raise CommandError(f"could not save state: {exc}") from exc
    84→
    85→            try:
    86→                plan_purged = _purge_removed_ids_from_plan(state_file, removed_ids)
    87→            except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
    88→                print(
    89→                    colorize("  Warning: could not update living plan.", "yellow"),
    90→                    file=sys.stderr,
    91→                )
    92→
    93→    print(colorize(f"Added exclude pattern: {args.pattern}", "green"))
    94→    if removed_ids:
    95→        print(f"  Removed {len(removed_ids)} matching findings from state.")
    96→        if plan_purged:
    97→            print(
    98→                colorize(
    99→                    f"  Plan updated: {plan_purged} item(s) removed from queue.",
   100→                    "dim",
   101→                )
   102→            )
   103→    config_warning = check_config_staleness(config)
   104→    if config_warning:
   105→        print(colorize(f"  {config_warning}", "yellow"))
   106→
   107→
   108→__all__ = ["cmd_exclude"]
   109→
```

```
   187→def _print_score_section(state, scores, plan, target_strict_score, ctx=None):
   188→    """Print score header: frozen plan-start or live score with queue breakdown."""
   189→    plan_start_strict = get_plan_start_strict(plan)
   190→    breakdown = None
   191→    queue_remaining = 0
   192→    if plan_start_strict is not None:
   193→        try:
   194→            breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan, context=ctx)
   195→            queue_remaining = breakdown.queue_total
   196→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   197→            logging.debug("Plan-aware queue count failed: %s", exc)
   198→            queue_remaining = 0
   199→    if plan_start_strict is not None and queue_remaining > 0:
   200→        print_frozen_score_with_queue_context(
   201→            plan, queue_remaining, breakdown=breakdown,
   202→        )
   203→    else:
   204→        for line, style in score_summary_lines(
   205→            overall_score=scores.overall,
   206→            objective_score=scores.objective,
   207→            strict_score=scores.strict,
   208→            verified_strict_score=scores.verified,
   209→            target_strict=target_strict_score,
   210→        ):
   211→            print(colorize(line, style))
   212→        # Show queue breakdown even without frozen score
   213→        if breakdown is None:
   214→            try:
   215→                breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan, context=ctx)
   216→            except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   217→                breakdown = None
   218→        if breakdown is not None and breakdown.queue_total > 0:
   219→            block = format_queue_block(breakdown)
   220→            for text, style in block:
   221→                print(colorize(text, style))
   222→    return breakdown
   223→
   224→
   225→def _status_json_payload(
   226→    state: dict,
   227→    stats: dict,
   228→    dim_scores: dict,
   229→    scorecard_dims: list[dict],
   230→    subjective_measures: list[dict],
   231→    suppression: dict,
   232→) -> dict:
   233→    scores = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   234→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   235→    open_scope = (
   236→        state_mod.open_scope_breakdown(findings, state.get("scan_path"))
   237→        if isinstance(findings, dict)
   238→        else None
   239→    )
   240→    return {
   241→        "overall_score": scores.overall,
   242→        "objective_score": scores.objective,
   243→        "strict_score": scores.strict,
   244→        "verified_strict_score": scores.verified,
   245→        "dimension_scores": dim_scores,
   246→        "score_breakdown": compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores) if dim_scores else None,
   247→        "scorecard_dimensions": scorecard_dims,
   248→        "subjective_measures": subjective_measures,
   249→        "potentials": state.get("potentials"),
   250→        "codebase_metrics": state.get("codebase_metrics"),
   251→        "stats": stats,
   252→        "open_scope": open_scope,
   253→        "suppression": suppression,
   254→        "scan_count": state.get("scan_count", 0),
   255→        "last_scan": state.get("last_scan"),
   256→    }
   257→
   258→__all__ = [
   259→    "cmd_status",
   260→    "show_dimension_table",
   261→    "show_focus_suggestion",
   262→    "show_ignore_summary",
   263→    "show_structural_areas",
   264→    "show_subjective_followup",
   265→]
   266→
```

## Comprehensive Report: Plan Sync Architecture Patterns

Based on my thorough exploration of the desloppify codebase, here are the key patterns and findings:

---

### 1. **All Sync Functions Pattern**

I found **8 sync functions** in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/stale_dimensions.py` and one in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/reconcile.py`:

**In stale_dimensions.py:**
- `sync_unscored_dimensions(plan, state)` (lines 204-242)
- `sync_stale_dimensions(plan, state, *, policy=None, cycle_just_completed=False)` (lines 249-330)
- `sync_triage_needed(plan, state)` (lines 365-448)
- `sync_score_checkpoint_needed(plan, state, *, policy=None)` (lines 462-500)
- `sync_create_plan_needed(plan, state, *, policy=None)` (lines 514-565)
- `sync_import_scores_needed(plan, state, *, assessment_mode=None)` (lines 632-665)
- `sync_communicate_score_needed(plan, state, *, scores_just_imported=False)` (lines 679-710)

**In reconcile.py:**
- `sync_plan_after_review_import(plan, state)` (lines 229-267)

---

### 2. **SyncResult Dataclasses - Consistent Interface**

All sync functions return dataclass instances with a **unified pattern**:

**Size-based (list) results:**
- `StaleDimensionSyncResult` (injected: list[str], pruned: list[str])
- `UnscoredDimensionSyncResult` (injected: list[str], pruned: list[str])

**Boolean (workflow) results:**
- `TriageSyncResult` (injected: bool, pruned: bool)
- `ScoreCheckpointSyncResult` (injected: bool)
- `CreatePlanSyncResult` (injected: bool)
- `ImportScoresSyncResult` (injected: bool)
- `CommunicateScoreSyncResult` (injected: bool)

**Special: ReviewImportSyncResult** (different structure):
```python
@dataclass
class ReviewImportSyncResult:
    new_ids: set[str]
    added_to_queue: list[str]
    triage_injected: bool
```

**Universal interface:**
- All expose a `.changes` property (int) that sums mutations
- Used to decide whether to save plan: `if result.changes: dirty = True`

---

### 3. **Mutation Behavior**

**All sync functions:**
- **Mutate plan in-place** (no return value with modified copy)
- Operate on `plan["queue_order"]` directly
- DO NOT return the plan object
- The caller is responsible for saving the mutated plan

Example (from stale_dimensions.py line 220):
```python
order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
# ... modifications to order happen in-place ...
return result  # Only returns what changed, not the plan
```

---

### 4. **Canonical "Load → Sync → Save" Pattern**

The **definitive orchestrator** is `_reconcile_plan_post_scan` in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/scan/scan_workflow.py` (lines 205-305):

```python
def _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime: "ScanRuntime") -> None:
    """Reconcile plan queue metadata and stale subjective review dimensions."""
    try:
        plan_path = runtime.state_path.parent / "plan.json" if runtime.state_path else None
        plan = load_plan(plan_path)  # ← LOAD ONCE
        dirty = False

        # --- Run sync operations, track mutations ---
        if _apply_plan_reconciliation(plan, runtime.state, reconcile_plan_after_scan):
            dirty = True
            # Optionally append log entry
            
        unscored_changed = _sync_unscored_dimensions(plan, runtime.state, sync_unscored_dimensions)
        if unscored_changed:
            dirty = True
            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_unscored", actor="system", detail={"changes": True})
        
        # --- Compute shared context (policy, cycle state) for downstream syncs ---
        _target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
        _policy = compute_subjective_visibility(runtime.state, target_strict=_target_strict, plan=plan)
        _cycle_just_completed = not plan.get("plan_start_scores")
        
        # --- Pass shared context to syncs that need it ---
        stale_changed = _sync_stale_dimensions(
            plan, runtime.state,
            lambda p, s: sync_stale_dimensions(
                p, s, policy=_policy, cycle_just_completed=_cycle_just_completed,
            ),
        )
        if stale_changed:
            dirty = True
            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_stale", actor="system", detail={"changes": True})

        # --- Run more syncs (some share the policy) ---
        triage_sync = sync_triage_needed(plan, runtime.state)
        if triage_sync.changes:
            dirty = True
            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_triage", actor="system", detail={"injected": True})

        checkpoint_sync = sync_score_checkpoint_needed(plan, runtime.state, policy=_policy)
        if checkpoint_sync.changes:
            dirty = True
            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_score_checkpoint", actor="system", detail={"injected": True})

        create_plan_sync = sync_create_plan_needed(plan, runtime.state, policy=_policy)
        if create_plan_sync.changes:
            dirty = True
            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_create_plan", actor="system", detail={"injected": True})

        # --- Run other mutations (seeding scores, clearing cycles) ---
        seeded = _seed_plan_start_scores(plan, runtime.state)
        if seeded:
            dirty = True
            append_log_entry(plan, "seed_start_scores", actor="system", detail={})

        # --- SAVE ONCE at the end ---
        if dirty:
            save_plan(plan, plan_path)
    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)
```

**Key principles:**
1. Load plan **once** at the start
2. Run **all sync operations sequentially** on the loaded plan object
3. Track mutations via `dirty` flag (true if any sync returned `.changes > 0`)
4. Some syncs require **shared context** (policy, cycle state) — compute once, pass to multiple syncs
5. Call `append_log_entry()` **within the dirty block** to record what happened
6. Save plan **once** at the end if `dirty == True`
7. Wrap entire block in `try/except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS` — plan operations are best-effort

---

### 5. **Secondary Orchestrator: Import Flow**

In `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/review/import_cmd.py`, syncing is split into **two separate concerns**:

**A. Finding Sync** (`_sync_plan_after_new_findings`, lines 164-242):
```python
plan = load_plan()  # ← LOAD
result = sync_plan_after_review_import(plan, state)

# Auto-purge covered subjective items
still_unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
covered_ids = [fid for fid in subjective_in_queue if fid not in still_unscored]
if covered_ids:
    purge_ids(plan, covered_ids)

# Check score workflows
checkpoint_result = sync_score_checkpoint_needed(plan, state)
create_plan_result = sync_create_plan_needed(plan, state)

# Log and SAVE
append_log_entry(plan, "review_import_sync", actor="system", detail={...})
save_plan(plan)  # ← SAVE ONCE
```

**B. Score Workflow Sync** (`_sync_score_workflow_items`, lines 245-295):
```python
plan = load_plan()  # ← SEPARATE LOAD (distinct concern)

scores_imported = assessment_mode in ("trusted_internal", "attested_external", "manual_override")
import_scores_result = sync_import_scores_needed(plan, state, assessment_mode=assessment_mode)
communicate_result = sync_communicate_score_needed(plan, state, scores_just_imported=scores_imported)

if injected_parts:
    save_plan(plan)  # ← SAVE ONLY IF CHANGES
```

**Why split?**
- Finding import is triggered by `has_new_findings` (a state change)
- Score sync is triggered by `assessment_policy.mode` (a separate concern)
- They can run independently or together

---

### 6. **Key Invariants & Best Practices**

**Mutation model:**
- Sync functions **always mutate in-place**; they never return a copy
- The caller owns the plan object after the sync
- No "transactional rollback" — once mutated, changes persist in memory until save

**Error handling:**
- All plan operations use `try/except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS`
- Failures are logged but don't crash the command (graceful degradation)
- Plan sync is **best-effort**, not critical-path

**Shared context pattern:**
- When multiple syncs need the same computation (e.g., `SubjectiveVisibility` policy, `cycle_just_completed` flag), **compute once and pass as parameters**
- Reduces redundant state reads and ensures consistency
- Example: `sync_stale_dimensions(plan, state, policy=_policy, cycle_just_completed=_cycle_just_completed)`

**Logging pattern:**
- `append_log_entry()` is called **inside** the `if result.changes` block
- Each sync operation that made changes gets its own log entry
- Log entries capture what changed (e.g., `{"injected": True}`, `{"changes": True}`)

**Optional return values:**
- `sync_plan_after_review_import()` returns `None` if no new findings (early exit)
- Other syncs always return a result object (even if no changes)

---

### 7. **How to Apply This Pattern to New Import Flows**

Based on the existing patterns, here's the canonical template for "load → sync → save":

```python
def _my_new_sync_orchestrator(state: dict, config: dict) -> None:
    """Sync plan after [trigger]."""
    try:
        from desloppify.engine.plan import (
            load_plan, save_plan, append_log_entry, has_living_plan,
        )
        from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
            sync_import_scores_needed, sync_communicate_score_needed,
        )
        
        if not has_living_plan():
            return
        
        # LOAD ONCE
        plan = load_plan()
        dirty = False
        
        # Optional: compute shared context
        from desloppify.engine.plan import compute_subjective_visibility
        policy = compute_subjective_visibility(state, target_strict=95.0, plan=plan)
        
        # RUN SYNCS (in logical order)
        result1 = sync_import_scores_needed(plan, state, assessment_mode="findings_only")
        if result1.changes:
            dirty = True
            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_import_scores", actor="system", detail={"injected": result1.injected})
        
        result2 = sync_communicate_score_needed(plan, state, scores_just_imported=True)
        if result2.changes:
            dirty = True
            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_communicate", actor="system", detail={"injected": result2.injected})
        
        # SAVE ONCE
        if dirty:
            save_plan(plan)
            print(colorize("Plan updated.", "cyan"))
            
    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
        print(colorize(f"Note: skipped plan sync ({exc}).", "dim"))
```

---

### 8. **SyncResult Inspection Patterns**

In callers, always check `.changes` property, never inspect fields directly:

```python
# GOOD: idiomatic
result = sync_triage_needed(plan, state)
if result.changes:
    dirty = True

# ALSO GOOD: when you need specific field info
result = sync_stale_dimensions(plan, state, policy=policy)
if result.injected:
    print(f"Injected {len(result.injected)} stale dimensions")
```

---

## Summary

The canonical pattern is **"load once, run sequential syncs, save once"**:

1. **Load** plan once at entry
2. **Run syncs in order**, tracking `dirty` flag from each result's `.changes` property
3. **Compute shared context** (policy, cycle state) once and pass to multiple syncs that need it
4. **Append log entries** within dirty blocks to record what happened
5. **Save once** at the end if `dirty == True`
6. **Wrap in try/except** for PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS (graceful degradation)

All SyncResult dataclasses follow the same interface with a `.changes` property. Mutation is always in-place; the function doesn't return the plan, only metadata about what changed.

## Summary Report: Score Display and Delta Computation in Desloppify

Based on my read through the desloppify codebase, here's the complete picture of how score deltas are computed and displayed across the CLI:

### **1. Delta Computation Pattern (Score Update Command)**
**File:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/helpers/score_update.py`

The canonical delta formatter is `_format_delta()`:
```python
def _format_delta(value: float, prev: float | None) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Return (delta_str, color) for a score change."""
    delta = value - prev if prev is not None else 0
    delta_str = f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})" if delta != 0 else ""
    color = "green" if delta > 0 else ("red" if delta < 0 else "dim")
    return delta_str, color
```

This is used in `print_score_update()` to display all four score dimensions with colored deltas after state-changing commands. It's **the cleanest, most reusable delta formatter in the codebase**.

---

### **2. Plan-Start vs. Live Score Delta (Empty Queue Scenario)**
**File:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/next_parts/render_support.py`

In `show_empty_queue()`, the delta computation is inlined (not extracted):
```python
if plan_start_strict is not None and strict is not None:
    delta = round(strict - plan_start_strict, 1)
    delta_str = f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})" if abs(delta) >= 0.05 else ""
    print(colorize("\n  Queue cleared!", "green"))
    print(colorize(
        f"  Frozen plan-start: strict {plan_start_strict:.1f} → Live estimate: strict {strict:.1f}{delta_str}",
        "cyan",
    ))
```

**Key differences from `_format_delta()`:**
- Uses `round(..., 1)` instead of just using the raw float
- Has a threshold: only shows delta if `abs(delta) >= 0.05` (filters noise)
- Always shows sign and `.1f` precision format
- Specialized for plan-start vs. live comparison, not general previous-to-current

---

### **3. PR Body Delta (Commit Tracking)**
**File:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/commit_tracking.py`

The `_score_delta_line()` function computes deltas for PR descriptions:
```python
def _score_delta_line(plan: dict[str, Any], state: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Build a score delta summary line from plan_start_scores to current."""
    start = plan.get("plan_start_scores", {})
    current_dim = state.get("dimension_scores", {})
    if not start or not current_dim:
        return ""
    
    start_strict = start.get("strict")
    if start_strict is None:
        return ""
    
    # Compute current strict from dimension_scores
    try:
        from desloppify.engine._scoring.results.core import compute_aggregate_scores
        scores = compute_aggregate_scores(current_dim)
        current_strict = scores.get("strict", 0)
    except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):
        return ""
    
    delta = current_strict - start_strict
    sign = "+" if delta >= 0 else ""
    return f"Score: {start_strict:.1f} → {current_strict:.1f} strict ({sign}{delta:.1f})"
```

**Key characteristics:**
- Imports `compute_aggregate_scores()` on the fly (performance OK since used only in PR generation)
- Returns empty string on any error (safe fallback)
- Takes `plan_start_scores.strict` from frozen plan state
- Computes live `strict` from current `dimension_scores`

---

### **4. Queue Block with Frozen Score (Unified Helper)**
**File:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/helpers/queue_progress.py`

```python
def format_queue_block(
    breakdown: QueueBreakdown,
    *,
    frozen_score: float | None = None,
    live_score: float | None = None,
) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Full queue block: focus banner + queue line + contextual hints."""
    # ... focus banner ...
    
    # Score line: show both frozen plan-start and live score when available
    if frozen_score is not None:
        if live_score is not None and abs(live_score - frozen_score) >= 0.05:
            delta = round(live_score - frozen_score, 1)
            delta_str = f"{'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f}"
            lines.append((
                f"  Score: strict {live_score:.1f}/100 (plan start: {frozen_score:.1f}, {delta_str})",
                "cyan",
            ))
        else:
            lines.append((
                f"  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {frozen_score:.1f}/100",
                "cyan",
            ))
```

1. `print_frozen_score_with_queue_context()` — legacy wrapper
2. `render_followup_nudges()` (render.py) — when queue items exist

## Current State (Messy)

### Problem 1: Two separate sync functions that each load/save plan independently

After a review import, there are currently two functions:
- `_sync_plan_after_new_findings(state, diff)` — gated on `has_new_findings`, loads plan, runs finding sync + checkpoint/create-plan workflow items, saves plan
- `_sync_score_workflow_items(state, assessment_mode)` — always runs, loads plan again, runs import-scores/communicate-score workflow items, conditionally saves plan

Both are in `import_cmd.py`. The call site has two separate gates and two separate calls.

### Problem 2: Plan-start delta computation duplicated in 3+ places

The exact same logic appears in:
- `queue_progress.py` `format_queue_block()` (lines 185-187)
- `render_support.py` `show_empty_queue()` (lines 167-168)  
- `render.py` `render_followup_nudges()` (lines 415-417)

All use identical: `delta = round(live - frozen, 1)`, threshold `abs(delta) >= 0.05`, format `f"{'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f}"`.

### Problem 3: live_score threaded through 3 layers

I added `live_score` as a parameter to `format_queue_block` and thread it from `print_execution_or_reveal` → `print_frozen_score_with_queue_context` → `format_queue_block`. In `print_execution_or_reveal`, I added a `score_snapshot(state)` call to get it. But `get_strict_score(state)` is cheaper (just reads `state["strict_score"]`).

## Canonical Pattern (from scan_workflow.py)

The canonical "load → sync → save" pattern from `_reconcile_plan_post_scan`:
1. Load plan ONCE at entry
2. Run ALL sync operations sequentially on the loaded plan
3. Track mutations via `dirty` flag (each sync returns a result with `.changes` property)
4. `append_log_entry()` for each sync that changed something
5. Save plan ONCE at the end if `dirty == True`
6. Wrap in `try/except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS`

## Design Goal

Replace the messy two-function split with a single orchestrator following the canonical pattern, and DRY the delta computation.

## Proposed Design

### A. Single post-import orchestrator

Replace both `_sync_plan_after_new_findings` and `_sync_score_workflow_items` with:

```python
def _sync_plan_after_import(state: dict, diff: dict, assessment_mode: str) -> None:
    """Orchestrate all post-import plan syncs. Load once, save once."""
    try:
        if not has_living_plan():
            return
        
        plan = load_plan()
        dirty = False
        injected_workflow: list[str] = []
        
        # --- Phase 1: Finding sync (only when new/reopened findings arrived) ---
        has_new = (int(diff.get("new", 0) or 0) > 0 
                   or int(diff.get("reopened", 0) or 0) > 0)
        import_result = None
        covered_ids: list[str] = []
        if has_new:
            import_result = sync_plan_after_review_import(plan, state)
            if import_result is not None:
                dirty = True
            
            # Auto-resolve subjective items covered by this import
            still_unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
            order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
            covered_ids = [
                fid for fid in order 
                if fid.startswith("subjective::") and fid not in still_unscored
            ]
            if covered_ids:
                purge_ids(plan, covered_ids)
                dirty = True
        
        # --- Phase 2: Workflow item injection (always, regardless of finding count) ---
        scores_imported = assessment_mode in (
            "trusted_internal", "attested_external", "manual_override",
        )
        
        for name, result in [
            ("score-checkpoint", sync_score_checkpoint_needed(plan, state)),
            ("import-scores", sync_import_scores_needed(plan, state, assessment_mode=assessment_mode)),
            ("communicate-score", sync_communicate_score_needed(plan, state, scores_just_imported=scores_imported)),
            ("create-plan", sync_create_plan_needed(plan, state)),
        ]:
            if result.changes:
                dirty = True
                injected_workflow.append(name)
        
        # --- Phase 3: Save once, log, print ---
        if not dirty:
            return
        
        if import_result is not None:
            append_log_entry(plan, "review_import_sync", actor="system", detail={...})
        if injected_workflow:
            append_log_entry(plan, "workflow_items_injected", actor="system", detail={
                "items": injected_workflow, "assessment_mode": assessment_mode,
            })
        
        save_plan(plan)
        
        if import_result is not None:
            _print_review_import_sync(state, import_result)
        if injected_workflow:
            labels = " and ".join(f"`workflow::{w}`" for w in injected_workflow)
            print(colorize(f"  Plan: {labels} queued. Run `desloppify next`.", "cyan"))
    
    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
        print(colorize(f"  Note: skipped plan sync after import ({exc}).", "dim"))
```

Call site becomes just:
```python
_sync_plan_after_import(state, diff, assessment_policy.mode)
```

No gate at all — the function handles all gating internally.

### B. Extract `format_plan_delta` helper

Add to `queue_progress.py`:
```python
def format_plan_delta(live: float, frozen: float) -> str:
    """Format plan-start → live delta string, or '' if below threshold."""
    if abs(live - frozen) < 0.05:
        return ""
    delta = round(live - frozen, 1)
    return f"{'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f}"
```

Use it in:
1. `format_queue_block()` in `queue_progress.py`
2. `show_empty_queue()` in `render_support.py` 
3. `render_followup_nudges()` legacy fallback in `render.py`

### C. Use `get_strict_score(state)` instead of `score_snapshot(state).strict`

In `print_execution_or_reveal()`, replace:
```python
from desloppify import state as state_mod
snapshot = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
live_score=snapshot.strict,
```
with:

```
    85→    state: dict,

    89→    """Mark imported manual override assessments as provisional until next scan."""

   164→def _sync_plan_after_new_findings(state: dict, diff: dict) -> None:
   165→    """Sync living plan after review import introduces new findings.
   166→
   167→    Handles: adding new findings to queue, auto-resolving covered subjective
   168→    items, injecting score-checkpoint and create-plan workflow items.
   169→    Only call when new or reopened findings actually arrived.

   172→        from desloppify.engine.plan import (
   173→            append_log_entry,
   174→            has_living_plan,
   175→            load_plan,
   176→            purge_ids,

   182→

   185→
   186→        plan = load_plan()
   187→        result = sync_plan_after_review_import(plan, state)

   190→        from desloppify.engine.plan import current_unscored_ids
   191→        still_unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   192→        order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   193→        subjective_in_queue = [
   194→            fid for fid in order if fid.startswith("subjective::")
   195→        ]
   196→        covered_ids = [
   197→            fid for fid in subjective_in_queue
   198→            if fid not in still_unscored
   199→        ]
   200→        if covered_ids:

   202→
   203→        # Check if score checkpoint and create-plan items should be injected

   206→

   212→        if injected_parts:
```

```
    16→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    17→# QueueBreakdown — single source of truth for queue numbers
    18→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    19→
    20→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    21→class QueueBreakdown:
    22→    """All numbers needed to render the standardized queue display."""
    23→
    24→    queue_total: int = 0
    25→    plan_ordered: int = 0
    26→    skipped: int = 0
    27→    subjective: int = 0
    28→    workflow: int = 0
    29→    focus_cluster: str | None = None
    30→    focus_cluster_count: int = 0
    31→    focus_cluster_total: int = 0
    32→
    33→    @property
    34→    def actionable(self) -> int:
    35→        """Items that represent real work — excludes workflow navigation steps.
    36→
    37→        Use this instead of ``queue_total`` when gating on "is there work left?"
    38→        (e.g. scan preflight, plan-start-score clearing).  Workflow items like
    39→        ``workflow::run-scan`` guide the user but are not work to complete.
    40→        """
    41→        return max(0, self.queue_total - self.workflow)
    42→
    43→
    44→def plan_aware_queue_breakdown(
    45→    state: dict,
    46→    plan: dict | None = None,
    47→    *,
    48→    context: "QueueContext | None" = None,
    49→) -> QueueBreakdown:
    50→    """Build a full :class:`QueueBreakdown` from a single ``build_work_queue`` call.
    51→
    52→    When *context* is provided, its ``plan`` and ``policy`` are forwarded to
    53→    ``build_work_queue`` so the counts agree with the caller's resolution.
    54→    """
    55→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.plan_order import collapse_clusters
    56→    from desloppify.engine.work_queue import QueueBuildOptions, build_work_queue
    57→
    58→    effective_plan = context.plan if context is not None else plan
    59→
    60→    result = build_work_queue(
    61→        state,
    62→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
    63→            status="open",
    64→            count=None,
    65→            plan=effective_plan if context is None else None,
    66→            include_skipped=False,
    67→            context=context,
    68→        ),
    69→    )
    70→
    71→    # Collapse clusters for display-level counting
    72→    items = result.get("items", [])
    73→    if effective_plan and not effective_plan.get("active_cluster"):
    74→        items = collapse_clusters(items, effective_plan)
    75→
    76→    queue_total = len(items)
    77→
    78→    # Count subjective and workflow items in the queue.
    79→    # Collapsed clusters whose members are all subjective count as subjective.
    80→    subjective = sum(
    81→        1 for item in items
    82→        if is_subjective_queue_item(item)
    83→    )
    84→    workflow = sum(
    85→        1 for item in items
    86→        if item.get("kind") in ("workflow_stage", "workflow_action")
    87→    )
    88→
    89→    # Plan-derived counts
    90→    plan_ordered = 0
    91→    skipped = 0
    92→    if effective_plan:
    93→        skipped = len(effective_plan.get("skipped", {}))
    94→        # plan_ordered = items that are in queue_order minus skipped
    95→        queue_order = effective_plan.get("queue_order", [])
    96→        skipped_ids = set(effective_plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    97→        plan_ordered = sum(1 for fid in queue_order if fid not in skipped_ids)
    98→
    99→    # Focus cluster info
   100→    focus_cluster = None
   101→    focus_cluster_count = 0
   102→    focus_cluster_total = 0
   103→    if effective_plan:
   104→        active = effective_plan.get("active_cluster")
   105→        if active:

   107→            cluster_data = effective_plan.get("clusters", {}).get(active, {})
   108→            focus_cluster_total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   109→            # Count how many cluster members are still in the queue
   110→            cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   111→            open_findings = {

   113→                for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   114→                if f.get("status") == "open"
   115→            }
   116→            focus_cluster_count = len(cluster_member_ids & open_findings)
   117→
   118→    return QueueBreakdown(

   121→        skipped=skipped,

   124→        focus_cluster=focus_cluster,
   125→        focus_cluster_count=focus_cluster_count,
   126→        focus_cluster_total=focus_cluster_total,

   133→
   134→def format_queue_headline(breakdown: QueueBreakdown) -> str:
   135→    """The one-line Queue summary. Same format everywhere.
   136→
   137→    Examples::
   138→
   139→        Queue: 1934 items (292 planned · 23 skipped)
   140→        Queue: 1934 items
   141→    """
   142→    n = breakdown.queue_total
   143→    label = f"Queue: {n} item{'s' if n != 1 else ''}"
   144→
   145→    # Parenthesized segments
   146→    segments: list[str] = []
   147→    if breakdown.workflow > 0:
   148→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.workflow} planning step{'s' if breakdown.workflow != 1 else ''}")
   149→    if breakdown.plan_ordered > 0:
   150→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.plan_ordered} planned")
   151→    if breakdown.skipped > 0:
   152→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.skipped} skipped")
   153→    if breakdown.subjective > 0:
   154→        segments.append(f"{breakdown.subjective} subjective")
   155→    if segments:
   156→        sep = " \u00b7 "
   157→        detail = sep.join(segments)
   158→        return f"{label} ({detail})"
   159→    return label

   263→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=strict, live_score=live_score)

   265→        for text, style in block:
   266→            print(colorize(text, style))
   267→        if queue_remaining > 0:
   268→            print(colorize(
   269→                "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   270→                "dim",
   271→            ))
   272→        return
   273→
   274→    # Legacy fallback
   275→    print(
   276→        colorize(
   277→            f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {strict:.1f}/100",
   278→            "cyan",
   279→        )
   280→    )
   281→    print(
   282→        colorize(
   283→            f"  Queue: {queue_remaining} item{'s' if queue_remaining != 1 else ''}"
   284→            " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   285→            "dim",
   286→        )
   287→    )
   288→
   289→
   290→def _print_objective_drained_banner(
   291→    frozen_strict: float,
   292→    remaining: int,
   293→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown,
   294→) -> None:
   295→    """Show a phase-transition banner when objective work is drained."""
   296→    kind_labels: list[str] = []
   297→    if breakdown.subjective > 0:
   298→        kind_labels.append("subjective")
   299→    if breakdown.workflow > 0:
   300→        kind_labels.append("workflow")
   301→    kind_desc = " + ".join(kind_labels) if kind_labels else "non-objective"
   302→    print(colorize(
   303→        f"\n  Objective queue complete (plan-start was {frozen_strict:.1f})."
   304→        f" {remaining} {kind_desc} item{'s' if remaining != 1 else ''} remain.",
   305→        "cyan",
   306→    ))
   307→    print(colorize(
   308→        "  Run `desloppify next` for remaining work,"
   309→        " then `desloppify scan` to finalize.",
   310→        "dim",
   311→    ))
   312→
   313→
   314→def print_execution_or_reveal(
   315→    state: dict,
   316→    prev,
   317→    plan: dict | None,
   318→) -> None:
   319→    """Context-aware score display: frozen plan-start score or live scores.
   320→
   321→    Three display modes:
   322→
   323→    1. **Frozen** — objective queue items remain → show frozen plan-start score.
   324→    2. **Phase transition** — objective drained, subjective/workflow remains
   325→       → show live scores + transition banner.
   326→    3. **Live** — no active plan cycle or queue is clear → show live scores.
   327→    """
   328→    frozen_strict: float | None = None
   329→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown | None = None
   330→
   331→    if plan and plan.get("plan_start_scores", {}).get("strict") is not None:
   332→        frozen_strict = plan["plan_start_scores"]["strict"]
   333→        try:
   334→            breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan)
   335→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   336→            pass
   337→
   338→    remaining = breakdown.queue_total if breakdown else 0
   339→
   340→    # Frozen: objective work remains — show frozen plan-start score and return
   341→    if remaining > 0 and frozen_strict is not None:
   342→        objective_remaining = remaining - breakdown.subjective - breakdown.workflow
   343→        if objective_remaining > 0:
   344→            # Compute live score for delta display alongside frozen
   345→            from desloppify import state as state_mod
   346→            snapshot = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   347→            print_frozen_score_with_queue_context(
   348→                plan, remaining, breakdown=breakdown,
   349→                live_score=snapshot.strict,
   350→            )
   351→            return
   352→
   353→    # Live scores (or phase transition): show current scores
   354→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score_update import print_score_update
   355→
   356→    print_score_update(state, prev)
   357→
   358→    # Phase transition: objective drained but subjective/workflow remains
   359→    if remaining > 0 and frozen_strict is not None:
   360→        _print_objective_drained_banner(frozen_strict, remaining, breakdown)
   361→
   362→
   363→def show_score_with_plan_context(state: dict, prev) -> None:
   364→    """Load plan (best-effort) and show frozen or live score context.
   365→
   366→    Encapsulates the common load_plan + PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS + reveal
   367→    choreography so command modules don't each repeat it.
   368→    """
   369→    from desloppify.engine.plan import load_plan
   370→
   371→    try:
   372→        plan = load_plan()
   373→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   374→        plan = None
   375→    print_execution_or_reveal(state, prev, plan)
   376→
   377→
   378→__all__ = [
   379→    "QueueBreakdown",
   380→    "format_queue_block",
   381→    "format_queue_headline",
   382→    "get_plan_start_strict",
   383→    "plan_aware_queue_breakdown",
   384→    "plan_aware_queue_count",
   385→    "print_execution_or_reveal",
   386→    "print_frozen_score_with_queue_context",
   387→    "show_score_with_plan_context",
   388→]
   389→
```

```
   133→def _render_score_impact(
   134→    item: dict, dim_scores: dict, potentials: dict | None,
   135→) -> None:
   136→    """Render dimension score context and impact estimates."""
   137→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   138→    if dim_scores:
   139→        dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   140→        if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   141→            dimension_score = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   142→            strict_val = dimension_score.get("strict", dimension_score["score"])
   143→            print(
   144→                colorize(
   145→                    f"\n  Dimension: {dimension.name} — {dimension_score['score']:.1f}% "
   146→                    f"(strict: {strict_val:.1f}%) "
   147→                    f"({dimension_score['issues']} of {dimension_score['checks']:,} checks failing)",
   148→                    "dim",
   149→                )
   150→            )
   151→
   152→    if potentials and detector and dim_scores:
   153→        try:
   154→            impact = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=1)
   155→            if impact > 0:
   156→                print(colorize(f"  Impact: fixing this is worth ~+{impact:.1f} pts on overall score", "cyan"))
   157→            else:
   158→                dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   159→                if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   160→                    issues = dim_scores[dimension.name].get("issues", 0)
   161→                    if issues > 1:
   162→                        bulk = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=issues)
   163→                        if bulk > 0:
   164→                            print(colorize(
   165→                                f"  Impact: fixing all {issues} {detector} issues → ~+{bulk:.1f} pts",
   166→                                "cyan",
   167→                            ))
   168→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   169→            log(f"  score impact estimate skipped: {exc}")
   170→    elif detector == "review" and dim_scores:
   171→        try:
   172→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   173→            if dim_key:
   174→                breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   175→                for entry in breakdown.get("entries", []):
   176→                    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   177→                        continue
   178→                    entry_key = str(entry.get("name", "")).lower().replace(" ", "_")
   179→                    if entry_key == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   180→                        drag = float(entry.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   181→                        if drag > 0.01:
   182→                            print(colorize(

   191→def _render_item(
   192→    item: dict, dim_scores: dict, findings_scoped: dict, explain: bool,
   193→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   194→) -> None:
   195→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
   196→        _render_cluster_item(item)
   197→        return
   198→    if item.get("kind") == "workflow_stage":
   199→        _render_workflow_stage(item)
   200→        return
   201→    if item.get("kind") == "workflow_action":
   202→        _render_workflow_action(item)
   203→        return
   204→
   205→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   206→    print(colorize(f"  ({confidence} confidence)", "bold"))
   207→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   208→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   209→
   210→    if item.get("detector") == "review":
   211→        print(colorize("  Type: Design review (requires judgment)", "dim"))
   212→    elif is_auto_fix_command(item.get("primary_command")):
   213→        print(colorize("  Type: Auto-fixable", "dim"))
   214→
   215→    if item.get("kind", "finding") == "subjective_dimension":
   216→        _render_subjective_dimension(item, explain=explain)
   217→        return
   218→
   219→    detail = _render_finding_detail(item)
   220→    _render_score_impact(item, dim_scores, potentials)
   221→
   222→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   223→    auto_fix_command = item.get("primary_command")
   224→    if is_auto_fix_command(auto_fix_command):
   225→        similar_count = sum(
   226→            1
   227→            for finding in findings_scoped.values()
   228→            if finding.get("detector") == detector_name and finding["status"] == "open"
   229→        )
   230→        if similar_count > 1:
   231→            print(
   232→                colorize(
   233→                    f"\n  Auto-fixable: {similar_count} similar findings. "
   234→                    f"Run `{auto_fix_command}` to fix all at once.",
   235→                    "cyan",
   236→                )
   237→            )
   238→    if explain:
   239→        explanation = item.get("explain", {})
   240→        count_weight = explanation.get("count", int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0))
   241→        detector = item.get("detector", "")
   242→        base = (
   243→            f"ranked by confidence={confidence}, "
   244→            f"count={count_weight}, id={item.get('id', '')}"
   245→        )
   246→        if dim_scores and detector:
   247→            dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   248→            if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   249→                ds = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   250→                base += (
   251→                    f". Dimension: {dimension.name} at {ds['score']:.1f}% "
   252→                    f"({ds['issues']} open issues)"
   253→                )
   254→        if item.get("detector") == "review" and dim_scores:
   255→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   256→            if dim_key:
   257→                for ds_name, ds_data in dim_scores.items():
   258→                    if ds_name.lower().replace(" ", "_") == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   259→                        score_val = ds_data.get("score", "?")
   260→                        score_str = f"{score_val:.1f}" if isinstance(score_val, (int, float)) else str(score_val)
   261→                        base += f". Subjective dimension: {ds_name} at {score_str}%"
   262→                        break
   263→        policy = explanation.get("policy")
   264→        if policy:
   265→            base = f"{base}. {policy}"
   266→        print(colorize(f"  explain: {base}", "dim"))
   267→
   268→
   269→def render_terminal_items(
   270→    items: list[dict],
   271→    dim_scores: dict,
   272→    findings_scoped: dict,
   273→    *,
   274→    group: str,
   275→    explain: bool,
   276→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   277→    plan: dict | None = None,
   278→    cluster_filter: str | None = None,
   279→) -> None:
   280→    # Show focus header if plan has active cluster
   281→    if plan and plan.get("active_cluster"):
   282→        cluster_name = plan["active_cluster"]
   283→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   284→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   285→        total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   286→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({len(items)} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))
   287→
   288→    if group != "item":
   289→        _render_grouped(items, group)
   290→        return
   291→
   292→    # Detect cluster drill-in: multiple items with cluster focus active
   293→    is_cluster_drill = len(items) > 1 and (
   294→        cluster_filter or (plan and plan.get("active_cluster"))
   295→    )
   296→
   297→    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
   298→        if idx > 0:
   299→            print()
   300→        # Full card for first item, compact for rest in cluster drill-in
   301→        if is_cluster_drill and idx > 0:
   302→            _render_compact_item(item, idx, len(items))
   303→            continue
   304→        queue_pos = item.get("queue_position")
   305→        if queue_pos and len(items) > 1:
   306→            label = f"  [#{queue_pos}]"
   307→        elif len(items) > 1:
   308→            label = f"  [{idx + 1}/{len(items)}]"
   309→        else:
   310→            pos_str = f"  (#{ queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   311→            label = f"  Next item{pos_str}"
   312→        print(colorize(label, "bold"))
   313→        _render_item(item, dim_scores, findings_scoped, explain=explain, potentials=potentials)
   314→

   378→def render_followup_nudges(
   379→    state: dict,
   380→    dim_scores: dict,
   381→    findings_scoped: dict,
   382→    *,
   383→    strict_score: float | None,
   384→    target_strict_score: float,
   385→    queue_total: int = 0,
   386→    plan_start_strict: float | None = None,
   387→    breakdown: "QueueBreakdown | None" = None,
   388→) -> None:
   389→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
   390→        format_queue_block,
   391→    )
   392→
   393→    subjective_threshold = target_strict_score
   394→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective(state, dim_scores)
   395→    followup = build_subjective_followup(
   396→        state,
   397→        subjective_entries,
   398→        threshold=subjective_threshold,
   399→        max_quality_items=3,
   400→        max_integrity_items=5,
   401→    )
   402→    unassessed_subjective = unassessed_subjective_dimensions(dim_scores)
   403→    # Show frozen plan-start score + queue block when in an active cycle
   404→    if queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None and breakdown is not None:
   405→        frozen = plan_start_strict
   406→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=frozen, live_score=strict_score)
   407→        print()
   408→        for text, style in block:
   409→            print(colorize(text, style))
   410→        print(colorize(
   411→            "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   412→            "dim",
   413→        ))
   414→    elif queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None:
   415→        if strict_score is not None and abs(strict_score - plan_start_strict) >= 0.05:
   416→            delta = round(strict_score - plan_start_strict, 1)
   417→            delta_str = f"{'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f}"
   418→            score_line = f"\n  Score: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 (plan start: {plan_start_strict:.1f}, {delta_str})"
   419→        else:
   420→            score_line = f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {plan_start_strict:.1f}/100"
   421→        print(colorize(score_line, "cyan"))
   422→        print(
   423→            colorize(
   424→                f"  Queue: {queue_total} item{'s' if queue_total != 1 else ''}"
   425→                " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   426→                "dim",
   427→            )
   428→        )
   429→    elif strict_score is not None:
   430→        gap = round(float(target_strict_score) - float(strict_score), 1)
   431→        if gap > 0:
   432→            print(
   433→                colorize(
   434→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 → target {target_strict_score:.1f} (+{gap:.1f} needed)",
   435→                    "cyan",
   436→                )
   437→            )
   438→        else:
   439→            print(
   440→                colorize(
   441→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 meets target {target_strict_score:.1f}",
   442→                    "green",
   443→                )
   444→            )
   445→    # Show queue block after north star when no frozen score
   446→    if breakdown is not None and queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is None:
   447→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown)
   448→        for text, style in block:
   449→            print(colorize(text, style))
   450→
   451→    # Subjective bottleneck banner — only shown when the objective queue is
   452→    # clear.  While objective items remain, the queue is the single authority
   453→    # on what to work on next; no need to distract with subjective advice.
   454→    _objective_remaining = max(
   455→        0,
   456→        (breakdown.queue_total - breakdown.subjective) if breakdown else queue_total,
   457→    )
   458→    if strict_score is not None and dim_scores and _objective_remaining <= 0:
   459→        try:
   460→            health_breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   461→            subjective_drag = sum(
   462→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   463→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   464→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") == "subjective"
   465→            )
   466→            mechanical_drag = sum(
   467→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   468→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   469→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") != "subjective"
   470→            )
   471→            if subjective_drag > mechanical_drag and subjective_drag > 5.0:
   472→                print(colorize(
   473→                    f"\n  Subjective dimensions are the main bottleneck "
   474→                    f"(-{subjective_drag:.0f} pts vs -{mechanical_drag:.0f} pts mechanical).",
   475→                    "yellow",
   476→                ))
   477→                print(colorize(
   478→                    "  Code fixes alone won't close the gap — run "
   479→                    "`desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import` "
   480→                    "to re-score.",
   481→                    "yellow",
   482→                ))
   483→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   484→            log(f"  subjective bottleneck banner skipped: {exc}")
   485→
   486→    # Integrity penalty/warn lines preserved (anti-gaming safeguard, must remain visible).
   487→    for style, message in followup.integrity_lines:
   488→        print(colorize(f"\n  {message}", style))
   489→
   490→    # Rescan nudge after structural work
   491→    if queue_total > 10:
   492→        print(colorize(
   493→            "\n  Tip: after structural fixes (splitting files, moving code), rescan to "
   494→            "let cascade effects settle: `desloppify scan --path .`",
   495→            "dim",
   496→        ))
   497→
   498→    # Collapsed subjective summary.
   499→    coverage_open, _coverage_reasons, _holistic_reasons = subjective_coverage_breakdown(
   500→        findings_scoped
   501→    )
   502→    parts: list[str] = []
   503→    low_dims = len(followup.low_assessed)
   504→    unassessed_count = len(unassessed_subjective)
   505→    stale_count = sum(1 for e in subjective_entries if e.get("stale"))
   506→    open_review = [
   507→        f for f in findings_scoped.values()
   508→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") == "review"
   509→    ]
   510→    if low_dims:
   511→        parts.append(f"{low_dims} dimension{'s' if low_dims != 1 else ''} below target")
   512→    if stale_count:
   513→        parts.append(f"{stale_count} stale")
   514→    if unassessed_count:
   515→        parts.append(f"{unassessed_count} unassessed")
   516→    if len(open_review):
   517→        parts.append(f"{len(open_review)} review finding{'s' if len(open_review) != 1 else ''} open")
   518→    if coverage_open > 0:
   519→        parts.append(f"{coverage_open} file{'s' if coverage_open != 1 else ''} need review")
   520→
   521→    if parts:
   522→        print(colorize(f"\n  Subjective: {', '.join(parts)}.", "cyan"))
   523→        print(colorize("  Run `desloppify show subjective` for details.", "dim"))
   524→
   525→
   526→__all__ = [
   527→    "is_auto_fix_command",

   529→    "render_gate_banner",
```

```
   163→def _seed_plan_start_scores(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel) -> bool:

   179→    }
   180→    return True
   181→
   182→
   183→def _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(
   184→    state: state_mod.StateModel, plan: dict[str, object]
   185→) -> bool:
   186→    """Clear plan-start score snapshot once the queue is fully drained."""
   187→    if not plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   188→        return False
   189→
   190→    try:
   191→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import plan_aware_queue_breakdown
   192→
   193→        breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan)
   194→        queue_empty = breakdown.actionable == 0
   195→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   196→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)
   197→        return False
   198→    if not queue_empty:
   199→        return False
   200→    state["_plan_start_scores_for_reveal"] = dict(plan["plan_start_scores"])
   201→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {}
   202→    return True
   203→
   204→
   205→def _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime: "ScanRuntime") -> None:
   206→    """Reconcile plan queue metadata and stale subjective review dimensions."""
   207→    try:
   208→        plan_path = runtime.state_path.parent / "plan.json" if runtime.state_path else None
   209→        plan = load_plan(plan_path)
   210→        dirty = False
   211→
   212→        if _apply_plan_reconciliation(plan, runtime.state, reconcile_plan_after_scan):
   213→            dirty = True
   214→
   215→        unscored_changed = _sync_unscored_dimensions(plan, runtime.state, sync_unscored_dimensions)
   216→        if unscored_changed:
   217→            dirty = True
   218→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_unscored", actor="system",
   219→                             detail={"changes": True})
   220→
   221→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score import target_strict_score_from_config
   222→        _target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   223→
   224→        # Compute subjective visibility policy once for consistent gating
   225→        from desloppify.engine.plan import compute_subjective_visibility
   226→        _policy = compute_subjective_visibility(
   227→            runtime.state,
   228→            target_strict=_target_strict,
   229→            plan=plan,
   230→        )
   231→
   232→        # Detect cycle completion: plan_start_scores is empty when the
   233→        # previous cycle drained the queue and revealed scores.  In that
   234→        # case stale subjective dimensions should be prioritized over new
   235→        # objective findings so the user reviews before a new cycle begins.
   236→        _cycle_just_completed = not plan.get("plan_start_scores")
   237→
   238→        stale_changed = _sync_stale_dimensions(
   239→            plan, runtime.state,
   240→            lambda p, s: sync_stale_dimensions(
   241→                p, s, policy=_policy, cycle_just_completed=_cycle_just_completed,
   242→            ),
   243→        )
   244→        if stale_changed:
   245→            dirty = True
   246→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_stale", actor="system",
   247→                             detail={"changes": True})
   248→
   249→        auto_changed = _sync_auto_clusters(
   250→            plan, runtime.state, target_strict=_target_strict, policy=_policy,
   251→            cycle_just_completed=_cycle_just_completed,
   252→        )
   253→        if auto_changed:
   254→            dirty = True
   255→            append_log_entry(plan, "auto_cluster", actor="system",
   256→                             detail={"changes": True})
   257→
   258→        triage_sync = sync_triage_needed(plan, runtime.state)
   259→        if triage_sync.changes:
   260→            dirty = True
   261→            if triage_sync.injected:
   262→                print(
   263→                    colorize(
   264→                        "  Plan: planning mode needed — review findings changed since last triage.",
   265→                        "cyan",
   266→                    )
   267→                )
   268→                append_log_entry(plan, "sync_triage", actor="system",
   269→                                 detail={"injected": True})
   270→
   271→        checkpoint_sync = sync_score_checkpoint_needed(plan, runtime.state, policy=_policy)
   272→        if checkpoint_sync.changes:
   273→            dirty = True
   274→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_score_checkpoint", actor="system",
   275→                             detail={"injected": True})
   276→
   277→        create_plan_sync = sync_create_plan_needed(plan, runtime.state, policy=_policy)
   278→        if create_plan_sync.changes:
   279→            dirty = True
   280→            if create_plan_sync.injected:
   281→                print(
   282→                    colorize(
   283→                        "  Plan: reviews complete — `workflow::create-plan` queued.",
   284→                        "cyan",
   285→                    )
   286→                )
   287→                append_log_entry(plan, "sync_create_plan", actor="system",
   288→                                 detail={"injected": True})
   289→
   290→        seeded = _seed_plan_start_scores(plan, runtime.state)
   291→        if seeded:
   292→            dirty = True
   293→            append_log_entry(plan, "seed_start_scores", actor="system",
   294→                             detail={})
   295→        # Only clear scores that existed before this reconcile pass —
   296→        # never clear scores we just seeded in the same scan.
   297→        if not seeded and _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(runtime.state, plan):
   298→            dirty = True
   299→            append_log_entry(plan, "clear_start_scores", actor="system",
   300→                             detail={})
   301→
   302→        if dirty:
   303→            save_plan(plan, plan_path)
   304→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   305→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)
   306→

   308→def _state_subjective_assessments(
   309→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   310→) -> dict[str, object]:
   311→    """Return normalized subjective assessment store from state."""
   312→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
   313→    if isinstance(assessments, dict):
   314→        return assessments
   315→    raise ScanStateContractError(
   316→        "state.subjective_assessments must be an object; rerun with a valid state file"
   317→    )

   320→def _state_lang_capabilities(
   321→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   322→) -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
   323→    """Return normalized language capability map from state."""
   324→    capabilities = state.get("lang_capabilities")
   325→    if capabilities is None:
   326→        normalized: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
   327→        state["lang_capabilities"] = normalized
   328→        return normalized
   329→    if isinstance(capabilities, dict):
   330→        return capabilities
   331→    raise ScanStateContractError(
   332→        "state.lang_capabilities must be an object when present"
   333→    )

   336→def _state_findings(state: state_mod.StateModel) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
   337→    """Return normalized finding map from state."""
   338→    findings = state.get("findings")
   339→    if isinstance(findings, dict):
   340→        return findings
   341→    raise ScanStateContractError(
   342→        "state.findings must be an object; state file appears corrupted"
   343→    )

   347→    """Resolve subjective dimensions that should reset on scan baseline reset."""
   348→    return resettable_default_dimensions(lang_name=lang_name)
```
